ko, $\frac{\cos A - \sin A + \cos A + \sin A}{\cos A - \sin A - (\cos A + \sin A)} = \frac{\sqrt{3} - 1 + \sqrt{3} + 1}{\sqrt{3} - 1 - (\sqrt{3} + 1)}$ [ta hanyar componendo da dividendo]
ko, $\frac{2 \cos A}{-2 \sin A} = \frac{2\sqrt{3}}{-2}$
ko, $\frac{\cos A}{\sin A} = \sqrt{3}$ [ta hanyar ninka kowane bangare da $(-1)$]
ko, $\cot A = \cot 30^\circ [\because \cot 30^\circ = \sqrt{3}]$
$\therefore A = 30^\circ$
$\therefore$ Bayan da ake bukata shine, $A = 30^\circ$ (Ans.)

Question: Idan $A$ da $B$ su ne kusurwoyi masu tsawon digiri 90 ko kasa da haka (acute angles) kuma $\cot (A + B) = 1$, $\cot(A - B) = \sqrt{3}$, tantance ƙimomin $A$ da $B$.
Solution:
An bayar, $\cot(A + B) = 1$
ko kuma, $\cot (A + B) = \cot 45^\circ [\because \cot 45^\circ = 1]$
$\therefore A + B = 45^\circ \text{.......... (i)}$
da $\cot (A - B) = \sqrt{3}$
ko kuma, $\cot (A - B) = \cot 30^\circ [\because \cot 30^\circ = \sqrt{3}]$
$\therefore A - B = 30^\circ \text{.......... (ii)}$
Idan muka ƙara lissafi (i) da (ii) muna samu,
$2A = 75^\circ$
ko kuma, $A = \frac{75^\circ}{2}$
$\therefore A = 37\frac{1}{2}^\circ$
A sake, idan muka cire lissafi (ii) daga (i) muna samu,
$2B = 15^\circ$
ko kuma, $B = \frac{15^\circ}{2} \quad \therefore B = 7\frac{1}{2}^\circ$
$\therefore$ Ƙididdigar da ake bukata sune, $A = 37\frac{1}{2}^\circ$ da $B = 7\frac{1}{2}^\circ$ (Amsa.)

Question: Nuna cewa, $\cos 3A = 4 \cos^3 A - 3 \cos A$ lokacin da $A = 30^\circ$.
Solution:
An bayar, $A = 30^\circ$.
L.H.S.$= \cos 3A = \cos (3 \times 30^\circ)$
$= \cos 90^\circ = 0$
R.H.S.$= 4 \cos^3 A - 3 \cos A = 4(\cos 30^\circ)^3 - 3\cos 30^\circ$
$= 4 \times \left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)^3 - 3 \times \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = 4 \times \frac{3\sqrt{3}}{8} - \frac{3\sqrt{3}}{2}$
$= \frac{3\sqrt{3}}{2} - \frac{3\sqrt{3}}{2} = 0$
$\therefore \cos 3A = 4 \cos^3 A - 3 \cos A$ (An nuna)

Question: Warware: $\sin \theta + \cos \theta = 1$, a lokacin da $0^\circ \leq \theta \leq 90^\circ$.
Solution:
An bayar da wannan equation: $\sin \theta + \cos \theta = 1$
ko kuma, $(\sin \theta + \cos\theta)^2 = (1)^2$ [ta hanyar rage dukkan bangarori biyu]
ko kuma, $\sin^2 \theta + 2 \sin \theta \cos \theta +\cos^2\theta = 1$
ko kuma, $1 + 2 \sin \theta \cos \theta = 1$
ko kuma, $2 \sin \theta \cos \theta = 0$
ko kuma, $\sin \theta \cos \theta = 0$
Idan, $\sin \theta = 0$ ko kuma, $\cos \theta = 0$
ko kuma, $\sin \theta = \sin 0^\circ$ ko kuma, $\cos \theta = \cos 90^\circ$
$\therefore \theta = 0^\circ$ ko kuma $\theta = 90^\circ$
$\therefore$ Maganin da ake bukata shine $\theta = 0^\circ$ ko $90^\circ$ (Ams.)

Question: Warware: $\cos^2\theta - \sin^2\theta = 2 - 5 \cos \theta$, lokacin da $\theta$ ke kusurwa mai tsini.
Solution:
An bada tsarin lissafin,
$\cos^2\theta - \sin^2\theta = 2 - 5 \cos\theta$
ko kuma, $\cos^2\theta - (1 - \cos^2\theta) = 2 - 5 \cos\theta$ [\because \sin^2\theta = 1 - \cos^2\theta]$
ko kuma, $\cos^2\theta - 1 + \cos^2\theta = 2 - 5 \cos\theta$
ko kuma, $2 \cos^2\theta - 1 = 2 - 5 \cos\theta$
ko kuma, $2\cos^2\theta + 5\cos\theta - 1 - 2 = 0$
ko kuma, $2\cos^2\theta + 5\cos\theta - 3 = 0$
ko kuma, $2 \cos^2\theta + 6\cos\theta - \cos\theta - 3 = 0$
ko kuma, $2\cos\theta (\cos\theta + 3) - 1(\cos\theta + 3) = 0$
ko kuma, $(\cos\theta + 3) (2 \cos\theta - 1) = 0$
Idan dai, $\cos\theta + 3 = 0$ ko kuma, $2 \cos\theta - 1 = 0$
ko kuma, $\cos\theta = -3$ ko kuma, $2 \cos\theta = 1$
[Amma, $\cos\theta \neq -3$, ko kuma, $\cos\theta = \frac{1}{2}$
Domin, $-1 \leq \cos\theta \leq 1$] ko kuma, $\cos\theta = \cos 60^\circ [\because \cos 60^\circ = \frac{1}{2}]$
$\therefore \theta = 60^\circ$
$\therefore$ Amsar da ake buƙata ita ce, $\theta = 60^\circ$ (Amsa).

Question: Warware: $2 \sin^2\theta + 3 \cos\theta - 3 = 0$, inda $\theta$ yaro ne mai kusurwa *mai tsanani*.
Solution:
An baka equation ɗin, $2 \sin^2\theta + 3 \cos\theta - 3 = 0$
ko kuma, $2(1 - \cos^2\theta) + 3 \cos\theta - 3 = 0 [\because \sin^2\theta = 1 - \cos^2\theta]$
ko kuma, $2 - 2 \cos^2\theta + 3 \cos\theta - 3 = 0$
ko kuma, $-2 \cos^2\theta + 3 \cos\theta - 1 = 0$
ko kuma, $2 \cos^2\theta - 3 \cos\theta + 1 = 0$ [ta hanyar ninkawa duka bangarorin da $(-1)$]
ko kuma, $2 \cos^2\theta - 2 \cos\theta - \cos\theta + 1 = 0$
ko kuma, $2 \cos\theta (\cos\theta - 1) - 1 (\cos\theta - 1) = 0$
ko kuma, $(\cos\theta - 1) (2\cos\theta - 1) = 0$
idan, $\cos\theta - 1 = 0$ ko kuma, $2 \cos\theta - 1 = 0$
ko kuma, $\cos\theta = 1$ ko kuma, $2 \cos\theta = 1$
ko kuma, $\cos\theta = \cos 0^\circ$ ko kuma, $\cos\theta = \frac{1}{2}$
$\therefore \theta = 0^\circ$ ko kuma, $\cos\theta = \cos 60^\circ$
$\therefore \theta = 60^\circ$
$\because \theta \neq 0^\circ$ [Ba za a karɓa ba, saboda $\theta$ ɗan kusurwa ne mai kaifi]
$\therefore$ **Amshin da ake buƙata shine, $\theta = 60^\circ$ (Amsa.)**

Question: Warware: $\tan^2\theta - (1 + \sqrt{3}) \tan\theta + \sqrt{3} = 0$
Solution:
Daga dalar da aka bayar, $\tan^2\theta - (1 + \sqrt{3}) \tan\theta + \sqrt{3} = 0$
ko, $\tan^2\theta - \tan\theta - \sqrt{3} \tan\theta + \sqrt{3} = 0$
ko, $\tan\theta (\tan\theta - 1) - \sqrt{3} (\tan\theta - 1) = 0$
ko, $(\tan\theta - 1) (\tan\theta - \sqrt{3}) = 0$
Idan $\tan\theta - 1 = 0$ ko, $\tan\theta - \sqrt{3} = 0$
ko, $\tan\theta = 1$ ko, $\tan\theta = \sqrt{3}$
ko, $\tan\theta = \tan 45^\circ$ ko, $\tan\theta = \tan 60^\circ$
$\therefore \theta = 45^\circ$ $\therefore \theta = 60^\circ$
$\therefore$ Matsalar da ake buƙata ita ce, $\theta = 45^\circ$ ko, $60^\circ$. (Ams.)

Question: Warware: $3\cot^2 60^\circ + \frac{1}{4} \operatorname{cosec}^2 30^\circ + 5\sin^2 45^\circ - 4\cos^2 60^\circ$
Solution:
Bayar da magana: $3\cot^2 60^\circ + \frac{1}{4} \operatorname{cosec}^2 30^\circ + 5\sin^2 45^\circ - 4 \cos^2 60^\circ$
$= 3.\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right)^2 + \frac{1}{4}. (2)^2 + 5. \left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\right)^2 - 4.\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^2$
$= 3.\frac{1}{3} + \frac{1}{4}. 4 + 5.\frac{1}{2} - 4.\frac{1}{4}$
$= 1 + 1 + \frac{5}{2} - 1$
$= 1 + \frac{5}{2} = \frac{2+5}{2} = \frac{7}{2}$ (Ams.)

Question:
Idan $\angle B = 90^\circ$, $AB = 5 \text{ cm}$, $BC = 12 \text{ cm}$ na $\triangle ABC$,
nemo tsawon $AC$.
Solution:
A cewar theorem ɗin Pythagoras,
$AC = \sqrt{AB^2 + BC^2}$
$= \sqrt{5^2 + (12)^2}$
$= \sqrt{25 + 144}$
$= \sqrt{169} = 13$
$\therefore AC = 13 \text{ cm}$ (Ams.)

Question:
Idan $\angle B = 90^\circ$, $AB = 5 \text{ cm}$, $BC = 12 \text{ cm}$ na $\triangle ABC$,
kuma idan $\angle C = \theta$, nemo ƙimar $\sin\theta + \cos\theta$.
Solution:
A bisa ga theorem ɗin Pythagorean,
$AC = \sqrt{AB^2 + BC^2}$
$= \sqrt{5^2 + (12)^2}$
$= \sqrt{25 + 144}$
$= \sqrt{169} = 13$
$\therefore AC = 13 \text{ cm}$
Yanzu, $\sin\theta = \frac{AB}{AC} = \frac{5}{13}$
da $\cos\theta = \frac{BC}{AC} = \frac{12}{13}$
$\therefore \sin\theta + \cos\theta = \frac{5}{13} + \frac{12}{13} = \frac{5 + 12}{13} = \frac{17}{13}$
$\therefore \sin\theta + \cos\theta = \frac{17}{13}$ (Ams.)

Question: Idan $\angle B = 90^\circ$, $AB = 5 \text{ cm}$, $BC = 12 \text{ cm}$ na $\triangle ABC$, ta amfani da **wannan bayanin**, nuna cewa, $\sec^2 A + \operatorname{cosec}^2 A = \sec^2 A . \operatorname{cosec}^2 A$.
Solution:
A cewar theorems ɗin Pythagoras,
$AC = \sqrt{AB^2 + BC^2}$
$= \sqrt{5^2 + (12)^2}$
$= \sqrt{25 + 144}$
$= \sqrt{169} = 13$
$\therefore AC = 13 \text{ cm}$
Yanzu, ɓangaren Hagu (L.H.S.) $= \sec^2 A + \operatorname{cosec}^2 A$
$= \left(\frac{AC}{AB}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{AC}{BC}\right)^2$
$= \left(\frac{13}{5}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{13}{12}\right)^2$
$= \frac{169}{25} + \frac{169}{144}$
$= \frac{24336 + 4225}{3600}$
$= \frac{28561}{3600}$
Bango na Dama (R.H.S) $= \sec^2 A \cdot \operatorname{cosec}^2 A$
$= \left(\frac{AC}{AB}\right)^2 \cdot \left(\frac{AC}{BC}\right)^2$
$= \left(\frac{13}{5}\right)^2 \cdot \left(\frac{13}{12}\right)^2$
$= \frac{169}{25} \cdot \frac{169}{144}$
$= \frac{28561}{3600}$
$\therefore \sec^2 A + \operatorname{cosec}^2 A = \sec^2 A \cdot \operatorname{cosec}^2 A$ (An nuna)

Question:
Idan $\sin\theta = \text{p}$, $\cos\theta = \text{q}$, $\tan\theta = \text{r}$, inda $\theta$ ke kusurwa mai kaifi.
Idan $\text{r} = \sqrt{\frac{1}{3}}$, nemo ƙimar $\theta$.
Solution:
An bayar da cewa, $\tan\theta = \text{r}$
A nan, $\text{r} = \sqrt{\left(3\right)^{-1}}$
ko kuma, $\tan\theta = \sqrt{\left(3\right)^{-1}}$
ko kuma, $\tan\theta = \sqrt{\frac{1}{3}}$
ko kuma, $\tan\theta = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$
ko kuma, $\tan\theta = \tan30^{\circ}$
$\therefore\theta = 30^{\circ}$ (Amsa.)

Question:
bari $\sin\theta = \text{p}$, $\cos\theta = \text{q}$, $\tan\theta = \text{r}$, inda $\theta$ ke kusurwa mai kaifi.
Idan $\text{p} + \text{q} = \sqrt{2}$, tabbatar da cewa $\theta = 45^{\circ}$
Solution:
An bamu cewa,
$\sin\theta = \text{p}, \cos\theta = \text{q} \text{ kuma } \text{p} + \text{q} = \sqrt{2}$
ko kuma, $\sin\theta + \cos\theta = \sqrt{2}$
ko kuma, $\sin\theta = \sqrt{2} - \cos\theta$
ko kuma, $\sin^{2}\theta = \left(\sqrt{2} - \cos\theta\right)^{2}$
ko kuma, $1 - \cos^{2}\theta = 2 - 2\sqrt{2}\cos\theta + \cos^{2}\theta$
ko kuma, $1 - \cos^{2}\theta - 2 + 2\sqrt{2}\cos\theta - \cos^{2}\theta = 0$
ko kuma, $- 2 \cos^{2}\theta + 2\sqrt{2}\cos\theta - 1 = 0$
ko kuma, $2\cos^{2}\theta - 2\sqrt{2}\cos\theta + 1 = 0$
ko kuma, $\left(\sqrt{2}\cos\theta - 1\right)^{2} = 0$
ko kuma, $\sqrt{2}\cos\theta - 1 = 0$
ko kuma, $\sqrt{2}\cos\theta = 1$
ko kuma, $\cos\theta = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$
ko kuma, $\cos\theta = \cos45^{\circ}$
$\therefore \theta = 45^{\circ}$ (An tabbatar)

Question:
bari $\sin\theta = \text{p}$, $\cos\theta = \text{q}$, $\tan\theta = \text{r}$, inda $\theta$ ke kasancewa kusurwa mai tsanani.
Idan $7\text{p}^{2} + 3\text{q}^{2} = 4$, nuna cewa, $\tan\theta = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$
Solution:
An ba da cewa,
$\sin\theta = \text{p},$
$\cos\theta = \text{q}$
yanzu, $7\text{p}^{2} + 3\text{q}^{2} = 4$
ko kuma, $7\sin^{2}\theta + 3\cos^{2}\theta = 4$
ko kuma, $7\sin^{2}\theta + 3(1 - \sin^{2}\theta) = 4$
ko kuma, $7 \sin^{2}\theta + 3 - 3\sin^{2}\theta = 4$
ko kuma, $4 \sin^{2}\theta + 3 = 4$
ko kuma, $4 \sin^{2}\theta = 4 - 3$
ko kuma, $4 \sin^{2}\theta = 1$
ko kuma, $\sin^{2}\theta = \frac{1}{4}$
ko kuma, $\sin\theta = \sqrt{\frac{1}{4}}$
ko kuma, $\sin\theta = \frac{1}{2}$
ko kuma, $\sin\theta = \sin30^{\circ}$
$\therefore \theta = 30^{\circ}$
$\text{L.H.S.} = \tan\theta = \tan30^{\circ} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$
$= \text{R.H.S.}$
$\therefore \tan\theta = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$ (An Nuna)

Question: Idan kusurwar **daukaka** na saman **dutsen ma'adinin** shine $30^\circ$ a wani wuri a ƙasa kuma tsayin shine $26$ mita, to nemi nisan **wannan wuri** daga **dutsen ma'adinin**.
Solution:
Bari,
Nisan jirgin sama daga Ɗan hakar iskar kwal ita ce
$BC = x$ m,
Tsayar Ɗan hakar iskar kwal $AC = 26$ m
Kuma kusurwar ɗagawar saman Ɗan hakar iskar kwal a wurin B ita ce $\angle ABC = 30^\circ$
Daga $\triangle ABC$ muna samun,
$\tan \angle ABC = \frac{AC}{BC}$
ko kuma, $\tan 30^\circ = \frac{26}{x}$
ko kuma, $\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{26}{x}$ [$\because \tan 30^\circ = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$]
ko kuma, $x = 26 \times \sqrt{3}$
$\therefore x = 45.033$ (kusan)
$\therefore$ Nisan jirgin sama daga Ɗan hakar iskar kwal shi ne $45.033$ m (kusan) (Amsa.)

Question: Idan saman itace yana da nisan mita $20$ daga ƙasa a wani wuri a ƙasa kuma kusurwar daukaka ta kai $60^\circ$, nemo tsawon itacen.
Solution:
Bari muce,
Tsayar itace $AC = h$ m,
Nisa daga ƙafar itace C zuwa wani maki B shine $BC = 20$ m
A maki B, kusurwar ɗaukaka ta itace shine $\angle ABC = 60^\circ$
Yanzu, daga $\triangle ABC$,
$\tan \angle ABC = \frac{AC}{BC}$
ko, $\tan 60^\circ = \frac{h}{20}$
ko, $\sqrt{3} = \frac{h}{20}$ [Domin, $\tan 60^\circ = \sqrt{3}$]
ko, $h = 20\sqrt{3}$
$\therefore h = 34.641$ (kusan)
$\therefore$ Tsayar itace $34.641$ m ce (kusan) (Amsa).

Question: Bari matashin tsani mai tsawon $18$ m ya taba saman bangon, yana samar da kusurwar $45^\circ$ tare da ƙasa. Nemi tsayin bangon.
Solution:
Bari,
wurin da ke saman bango inda aka kasa labule ya zama B kuma tsawon bangon ya zama $AB = h$ m.
Don haka, tsawon labulen,
$OB = 18$ m kuma $\angle AOB = 45^\circ$
Yanzu, daga $\triangle AOB$ muna samun,
$\sin \angle AOB = \frac{AB}{OB}$
ko, $\sin 45^\circ = \frac{AB}{OB}$
 ko, $\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} = \frac{h}{18}$ [$\because \sin 45^\circ = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$]
$\therefore h = \frac{18}{\sqrt{2}} = \frac{18\sqrt{2}}{2} = 12.728$
Tsawon bangon = $12.728$ m (kimanin) (Amsa.)

Question: Idan kusurwar *tsanwa* na wani maki a ƙasa da ke da nisan mita $20$ daga saman gidan ya kasance $30^\circ$, to, nemo tsayin gidan.
Solution:
Bari, tsayin gidan $AB = h$ m, kusurwar raguwar wani wuri C a ƙasa $\angle CAD = 30^\circ$ kuma $AC = 20$ m.
$\therefore \angle CAD = \angle ACB = 30^\circ$ (DA $\parallel$ BC, saboda su kusurwoyi ne na madadin)
Yanzu, daga $\triangle ABC$,
$\sin \angle ACB = \frac{AB}{AC}$
ko kuma, $\sin 30^\circ = \frac{h}{20}$
ko kuma, $\frac{1}{2} = \frac{h}{20}$ [$\because \sin 30^\circ = \frac{1}{2}$]
ko kuma, $2h = 20$
ko kuma, $h = \frac{20}{2} \therefore h = 10$
$\therefore$ Tsayin gidan shine $10$ m. (Amsa.)

Question: Lambobin ɗagawar wani hasumi daga kowane wuri a ƙasa su ne $60^\circ$. Idan aka koma baya da mita $25$, lambobin ɗagawar ya zama $30^\circ$, menene tsayin hasumin?
Solution:
Bari, tsayin hasumiyar, $AB = h$ m kuma kusurwar daukaka ita ce $\angle ACB = 60^\circ$. Bayan an koma baya CD = 25 m daga maki C, kusurwar daukaka ta zama $\angle ADB = 30^\circ$.
Bari, $BC = x$ m.
$\therefore BD = BC + CD = (x + 25)$ m
Yanzu, daga $\triangle ABC$ muna samun,
$\tan 60^\circ = \frac{AB}{BC}$
ko, $\sqrt{3} = \frac{h}{x}$ [$\because \tan 60^\circ = \sqrt{3}$]
$\therefore x = \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}}$ .......... (i)
Da sake, daga $\triangle ABD$ muna samun,
$\tan \angle ADB = \frac{AB}{BD}$
ko, $\tan 30^\circ = \frac{h}{x+25}$
ko, $\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{h}{x+25}$ [$\because \tan 30^\circ = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$]
ko, $\sqrt{3}h = x + 25$
ko, $\sqrt{3}h = \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}} + 25$ [tare da taimakon lissafin (i)]
ko, $\sqrt{3}h - \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}} = 25$
ko, $\frac{3h - h}{\sqrt{3}} = 25$
ko, $\frac{2h}{\sqrt{3}} = 25$
ko, $2h = 25\sqrt{3}$
ko, $h = \frac{25\sqrt{3}}{2}$
$\therefore h = 21.651$ (kimanin)
$\therefore$ Tsayin hasumiyar shi ne $21.651$ m (kimanin) (Amsa.)

Question: Angle of elevation na wani katafaren gini ya koma $60^\circ$ daga $45^\circ$ ta hanyar tafiyar $60$ mita zuwa wani minare. Nemi tsayin minaren.
Solution:
Bari, tsayin hasumiyar ya kasance $AB = h$ m kuma kusurwar daukaka $\angle ADB = 45^\circ$. Bayan motsawa $CD = 60$ m daga wurin D, kusurwar daukaka ta zama $\angle ACB = 60^\circ$.
Bari, $BC = x$ m
$\therefore BD = BC + CD = (x+60)$ m.
Yanzu, daga $\triangle ABC$ muna samu,
$\tan 60^\circ = \frac{AB}{BC}$
ko kuma, $\sqrt{3} = \frac{h}{x}$ [$\because \tan 60^\circ = \sqrt{3}$]
$\therefore x = \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}}$ ............ (i)
Kuma, daga $\triangle ABD$ muna samu,
$\tan \angle ADB = \frac{AB}{BD}$
ko kuma, $\tan 45^\circ = \frac{h}{x+60}$
ko kuma, $1 = \frac{h}{x+60}$ [$\because \tan 45^\circ = 1$]
ko kuma, $h = x+60$
ko kuma, $h = \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}} + 60$ [ta hanyar taimakon lissafi (i)]
ko kuma, $h - \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}} = 60$
ko kuma, $\frac{\sqrt{3}h - h}{\sqrt{3}} = 60$
ko kuma, $\sqrt{3}h - h = 60\sqrt{3}$
ko kuma, $(\sqrt{3}-1)h = 60\sqrt{3}$
ko kuma, $h = \frac{60\sqrt{3}}{\sqrt{3}-1}$
$= \frac{60\sqrt{3}(\sqrt{3}+1)}{(\sqrt{3}-1)(\sqrt{3}+1)} = \frac{60(3+\sqrt{3})}{(\sqrt{3})^2-(1)^2}$
$= \frac{60(3+\sqrt{3})}{2}$
$= 30(3+\sqrt{3})$
$h = 141.962$ (kusa da haka).
$\therefore$ Tsayin hasumiyar shine $141.962$ m (kusa da haka). (Amsa).

Question: Wani mutum da yake tsaye a wani wuri a gefen kogi ya lura cewa kusurwar ɗaukaka ta wani hasumiya da yake daidai a gabansa a wani gefen kogin shine $60^\circ$. Yayin da ya koma baya da mita $32$, sai ya lura cewa kusurwar ɗaukaka ta hasumiya ta zama $30^\circ$. Nemi tsayin hasumiya da faɗin kogi.
Solution:
Bari, tsayin hasumiyar ya kasance $AB = h$ m kuma kusurwar daukaka ta hasumiyar shine $\angle ACB$.
Bayan motsi $CD = 32$ m daga wurin C kusurwar daukaka ta zama $\angle ADB = 30^\circ$.
Bari, fadin kogin, $BC = x$ m.
$\therefore BD = BC + CD = (x+32)$ m
Yanzu, daga $\triangle ABC$ muna samu,
$\tan \angle ACB = \frac{AB}{BC}$
ko kuma, $\tan 60^\circ = \frac{h}{x}$
ko kuma, $\sqrt{3} = \frac{h}{x}$ [$\because \tan 60^\circ = \sqrt{3}$]
$\therefore x = \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}}$ ............ (i)
Kuma, daga $\triangle ABD$ muna samu,
$\tan \angle ADB = \frac{AB}{BD}$
ko kuma, $\tan 30^\circ = \frac{h}{x+32}$
ko kuma, $\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{h}{x+32}$ [$\because \tan 30^\circ = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$]
ko kuma, $\sqrt{3}h = x+32$
ko kuma, $\sqrt{3}h = \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}} + 32$; [Da taimakon lissafi (i)]
ko kuma, $\sqrt{3}h - \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}} = 32$
ko kuma, $\frac{3h-h}{\sqrt{3}} = 32$
ko kuma, $\frac{2h}{\sqrt{3}} = 32$
ko kuma, $2h = 32\sqrt{3}$
ko kuma, $h = \frac{32\sqrt{3}}{2}$
$\therefore h = 27.712$ m (kimanin.)
Maye gurbin darajar $h$ a cikin lissafi (i) muna samu,
$x = \frac{32\sqrt{3}}{2} \times \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = 16$ m.
$\therefore$ Tsayin hasumiyar shine $27.71$ m (kimanin.) kuma fadin kogin shine $16$ m. (Ams.)

Question: Bari tsawon sandar da ya karye ya zama $64$ m, ya karye zuwa gida biyu ba tare da rabuwa gaba daya ba, sannan kuma ya yi kusurwa $60^\circ$ da ƙasa. Nemi tsawon ɓangaren sandar da ya karye.
Solution:
Bari, tsayin sandar, $AB = 64$ m.
Sandar ta karye zuwa gida biyu ba tare da rarrabuwa gaba ɗaya ba a wajen C kuma tana yin kusurwa $\angle BDC = 60^\circ$ da ƙasa.
Bari, $AC = CD = x$ m
$\therefore BC = (64 - x)$ m
Yanzu, daga $\triangle BCD$ muna samun,
$\sin \angle BDC = \frac{BC}{CD}$
ko kuma, $\sin 60^\circ = \frac{64-x}{x}$
ko kuma, $\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = \frac{64-x}{x}$
ko kuma, $\sqrt{3}x = 128 - 2x$
ko kuma, $(\sqrt{3}+2)x = 128$
ko kuma, $x = \frac{128}{\sqrt{3}+2}$
ko kuma, $x = \frac{128(\sqrt{3}-2)}{(\sqrt{3}+2)(\sqrt{3}-2)}$
ko kuma, $x = \frac{128(\sqrt{3}-2)}{(\sqrt{3})^2-(2)^2}$
ko kuma, $x = \frac{128(\sqrt{3}-2)}{3-4}$
ko kuma, $x = \frac{128(\sqrt{3}-2)}{-1}$
ko kuma, $x = -128(\sqrt{3}-2)$
ko kuma, $x = 128(2-\sqrt{3})$
$\therefore x = 34.298$ (kimanin) [$\because$ tsawon abu koyaushe yana da kyau]
$\therefore$ Tsawon ɓangaren da ya karye shine $34.298$ m (kimanin)

Question: Bishiya ta karye saboda guguwa, inda sashen da ya karye ya yi wani kusurwa na $30^\circ$ da dayan sashen, kuma yana taɓo ƙasa da nisan mita $12$ daga inda ta karye. Nemo tsawon dukan bishiyar.
Solution:
Bari, dukkanin tsawon bishiyar, $AB = h$ m, an karye bishiyar a wurin C kuma ɓangaren $BC = x$ m yana yin wani kusurwa $\angle BCD = 30^\circ$ da wani ɓangaren kuma ya taɓa ƙasa da nisan $BD = 12$ m daga gare ta.
A nan, $CD = AC = AB - BC = (h - x)$ m.
Yanzu, daga $\triangle BCD$ muna samu,
$\tan \angle BCD = \frac{BD}{BC}$
ko kuma, $\tan 30^\circ = \frac{12}{x}$ [$\because \tan 30^\circ = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$]
ko kuma, $\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{12}{x}$
$\therefore x = 12\sqrt{3}$
Sannan kuma, $\sin \angle BCD = \frac{BD}{CD}$
ko kuma, $\sin 30^\circ = \frac{12}{h-x}$
ko kuma, $\frac{1}{2} = \frac{12}{h-x}$ [$\because \sin 30^\circ = \frac{1}{2}$]
ko kuma, $h-x = 24$
ko kuma, $h = 24 + x$
ko kuma, $h = 24 + 12\sqrt{3}$; [tare da maye gurbin ƙimar x]
$h = 44.79$ m (kusan)
Dukkanin tsawon bishiyar shine $44.79$ m (kusan) (Ams.)

Question:
A tsaye a duk inda yake a gefen kogi, wani mutum ya lura cewa kusurwar daukaka zuwa wata itace mai tsawon mita $150$, wadda take daidai a gabansa a dayan gefen kogi, shine $30^\circ$. Mutumin ya fara tafiya zuwa itacen ta jirgin ruwa. Amma ya kai wani wuri mai nisan mita $10$ daga itacen saboda gudun ruwan.
Dangane da wannan bayanin, nuna shi ta hanyar zane.
Solution: Bari, faɗin kogin $AB = x$ m da kuma tsayin itacen $BC = 150$ m. A maki A, kusurwar ɗaukar itacen $\angle CAB = 30^\circ$ kuma idan wurin jirgin ruwan a gefen kogin na biyu yana a maki D, to $AD = y$ m kuma $BD = 10$ m.

Question:
Daga kowane wuri a gefen kogi, wani mutum ya lura cewa kusurwar ɗagawar wata bishiya mai tsawon mita $150$ wacce take daidai a gabansa a kan wani gefen kuwa ita ce $30^\circ$. Mutumin ya fara tafiya zuwa ga bishiyar ta hanyar kwale-kwale. Amma ya isa nesa da mita $10$ daga bishiyar saboda gudun ruwan.
  Nemo faɗin kogin.
Solution:
Daga $\triangle ABC$ muna samu,
$\tan \angle CAB = \frac{BC}{AB}$
ko kuma, $\tan 30^\circ = \frac{150}{x}$
ko kuma, $\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{150}{x}$ [$\because \tan 30^\circ = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$]
ko kuma, $x = 150\sqrt{3}$
$\therefore x \approx 259.808$
$\therefore$ Nisa na kogin shine $\approx 259.808$ m (Amsa.)

Question:
A tsaye a kowane wuri a gefen kogi, wani mutum ya lura cewa kusurwar daukakawa zuwa saman wata bishiya mai tsayin $150$ mita da ke tsaye daidai a gefen kogi na gaba da shi ita ce $30^\circ$. Mutumin ya fara tafiya zuwa wurin bishiyar ta jirgin ruwa. Amma ya isa wurin da ya kai ga $10$ mita kafin bishiyar saboda gudun kogi.
Nemo nesa daga inda ya fara tafiya zuwa inda ya isa.
Solution:
Ta hanyar amfani da kaidar Pythagoras, mun samu daga $\triangle BAD$,
$CD^2 = AB^2 + BD^2$
$\therefore CD = \sqrt{(150\sqrt{3})^2 + 10^2}$
$= \sqrt{67500 + 100}$
$= \sqrt{67600}$
$= 260$
$\therefore$ Nisa daga wurin farawa zuwa wurin da zai je shine $260$ m. (Amsa.)

Question:
20. Bayan an kafa ta don yin kusurwa $60^\circ$ da ƙasa, wata doguwar leddar mita $16$ tana taɓa saman wani bango da ke tsaye.
A bisa ga bayanin da aka bayar, nuna wannan bayanin ta hanyar zane.
Solution: Bari, tsayin bango $AB = h$ mita, tsawon tsani $AC = 16$ mita kuma yana yin kusurwa tare da ƙasa $\angle ACB = 60^\circ$

Question:
Bari kwalan da tsawonta ya kai $16$ m taɓa saman bango tsaye, tare da samar da kusurwa $60^\circ$ da ƙasa.
Nemo tsayin bangon.
Solution:
Ta amfani da siffar `a', Daga $\triangle ABC$,
$\sin \angle ACB = \frac{AB}{AC}$
Ko kuma, $\sin 60^{\circ} = \frac{h}{16}$
Ko kuma, $\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = \frac{h}{16}$ [$\therefore \sin 60^{\circ} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$]
Ko kuma, $2h = 16\sqrt{3}$
Ko kuma, $h = \frac{16\sqrt{3}}{2}$
Ko kuma, $h = 8\sqrt{3}$
$\therefore h = 13.86$ mita
$\therefore$ tsayin bangon $= 13.86$ mita (Ams.)

Question:
Bari sandar da tsawonta ya kai 16 m ta kasance tana taɓa saman bango tsaye, kuma ta samar da kusurwa mai girman $60^\circ$ da ƙasa.
Nawa ne za a buƙaci a motsa ƙafar sandar tare da layin kwance don ta ci gaba da taɓa bango kuma ta samar da kusurwa mai girman $30^\circ$ da ƙasa?
Solution:
Daga `b' $AB = 8\sqrt{3}$ mita
Bari, Tsani ya kasance a motsa $x$ mita daga matsayinsa na baya.
Yanzu, $AC = DE = 16$ mita
kuma $BE = BC + x$
Anan, $BC^{2} + AB^{2} = AC^{2}$
ko kuma, $BC^{2} = AC^{2} - AB^{2}$
ko kuma, $BC^{2} = (16)^{2} - (8\sqrt{3})^{2}$
ko kuma, $BC^{2} = 64$
$\therefore BC = 8$
$\therefore BE = 8 + x$
Don haka, $\cos 30^{\circ} = \frac{BE}{DE} = \frac{BC+CE}{AC} = \frac{8+x}{16}$
ko kuma, $\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = \frac{8+x}{16}$ ko kuma, $16+2x = 16\sqrt{3}$
ko kuma, $2x = 16\sqrt{3} - 16$
ko kuma, $x = \frac{16\sqrt{3} - 16}{2}$
$\therefore x = 5.86$ m.
$\therefore$ Tsani yana da motsawa $5.86$ mita daga matsayinsa na baya (Ams.)

Question:
A cikin zanen, $CD = 96$ mita.
Menene ma'aunin $\angle CAD$ a digiri?
Solution:
Daga zane,
$\angle ADC = 30^{\circ}$
da $\angle ACB = 60^{\circ}$
$\angle ACD = 180^{\circ} - 60^{\circ} = 120^{\circ}$
$\therefore \angle CAD = 180^{\circ} - (120^{\circ} + 30^{\circ})$
$= 180^{\circ} - 150^{\circ} = 30^{\circ}$ (Ams.)

Question:
A cikin zane, $CD = 96$ mita.
Nemo tsawon $BC$.
Solution:
Tsayar hasumiyar $AB = h$ mita kuma kusurwar ganiwar $\angle ACB = 60^{\circ}$. Yayin da ake komawa baya daga C, $CD =$ $96$ mita. Kusurwar ganiwar a D, $\angle ADB = 30^{\circ}$.
Bari, tsawon BC $x$ mita.
$\therefore BD = BC + CD$
$= (x + 96)$ mita. Bari $BC = x$ mita.
Daga $\triangle ABC$, $\tan \angle ACB = \frac{AB}{BC}$
ko kuma, $\tan 60^{\circ} = \frac{h}{x}$ ko kuma, $\sqrt{3} = \frac{h}{x}$ $[\tan 60^{\circ} = \sqrt{3}]$
$\therefore x = \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}}$ \quad ......... (i)
Daga $\triangle ABD$, $\tan \angle ADB = \frac{AB}{BD}$
ko kuma, $\tan 30^{\circ} = \frac{h}{x+96}$
ko kuma, $\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{h}{x+96}$ \quad $[\tan 30^{\circ} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}]$
ko kuma, $\sqrt{3}h = x + 96$
ko kuma, $\sqrt{3}h = \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}} + 96$ \quad [Daga (i)]
ko kuma, $\sqrt{3}h - \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}} = 96$ ko kuma, $\frac{3h - h}{\sqrt{3}} = 96$
ko kuma, $\frac{2h}{\sqrt{3}} = 96$ ko kuma, $2h = 96\sqrt{3}$
ko kuma, $h = \frac{96\sqrt{3}}{2}$
$\therefore h = 83.138$ mita.
Saka darajar $h$ a cikin lissafi (i)
$x = \frac{96\sqrt{3}}{2} \times \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$
$\therefore x = 48$
$\therefore$ tsawon BC $48$ mita. (Amsa)

Question:
A cikin zane, $CD = 96$ mita.
Nemo kewaye na $\triangle ACD$.
Solution:
Daga `b',
tsayin hasumiya $AB = h = 48\sqrt{3}$ mita
kuma $BC = x = 48$ mita
An baka, $CD = 96$ mita
$\therefore$ A cikin $\triangle ABD$, $\sin 30^{\circ} = \frac{AB}{AD}$
ko kuma , $\frac{1}{2} = \frac{48\sqrt{3}}{AD}$ ko kuma , $AD = 48\sqrt{3} \times 2$
$\therefore AD = 96\sqrt{3}$ mita
A cikin $\triangle ABC$
$\sin 60^{\circ} = \frac{AB}{AC}$
ko kuma , $\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = \frac{48\sqrt{3}}{AC}$
ko kuma , $\sqrt{3}AC = 48\sqrt{3} \times 2$
ko kuma , $AC = \frac{96\sqrt{3}}{\sqrt{3}}$
$\therefore AC = 96$ mita
$\therefore$ Kewayen $\triangle ACD = (AC + CD + AD)$
$= (96 + 96 + 96\sqrt{3})$ mita
$= (192 + 166.28)$ mita
$= 358.277$ mita (Amsa.)

Question: Idan jikunan murabba'ai biyu sune a da b mita bi da bi, menene zai zama rashen yankunansu?
Solution:
Tsawon gefen murabba'i na $1$ = $\text{a mita}$
$\therefore$ Samar da murabba'i na $1$ = $\text{a} \times \text{a murabba'in mita}$ = $\text{a}^2 \text{ murabba'in mita}$
Tsawon gefen murabba'i na $2$ = $\text{b mita}$
$\therefore$ Samar da murabba'i na $2$ = $\text{b} \times \text{b murabba'in mita}$ = $\text{b}^2 \text{ murabba'in mita}$
Yanzu, $\frac{\text{samar da murabba'i na } 1}{\text{samar da murabba'i na } 2} = \frac{\text{a}^2}{\text{b}^2}$
$\therefore$ Samar da murabba'i na $1$: Samar da murabba'i na $2$ = $\text{a}^2 : \text{b}^2$
Amsar $\text{a}^2 : \text{b}^2$

Question: Idan **samamme** na'urar da'ira ya yi daidai da **samamme** na'urar murabba'i, nemo rabo na **zagayen su**.
Solution:
Bari mu ɗauka cewa, juzu'in da'ira shine $r$ ka'ida kuma tsawon gefen murabba'i shine $x$ ka'ida.
Mun sani, fadin da'ira = $\pi r^2$ murabba'i ka'ida.
Fadin murabba'i = $x^2$ murabba'i ka'ida.
Saboda haka, gwargwadon tambayar, $\pi r^2 = x^2$.
Ko kuma, $\frac{r^2}{x^2} = \frac{1}{\pi}$.
Ko kuma, $\frac{r}{x} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{\pi}}$ ...... (i).
Sake, kewaye da'ira = $2\pi r$ ka'ida.
Kuma kewaye da murabba'i = $4x$ ka'ida.
$\therefore \frac{\text{kewaye da'ira}}{\text{kewaye da murabba'i}} = \frac{2\pi r}{4x} = \frac{\pi r}{2x} = \frac{\pi}{2} \times \frac{r}{x}$.
$= \frac{\pi}{2} \times \frac{1}{\sqrt{\pi}}$ [saka ƙimomi daga (i)].
$= \frac{\sqrt{\pi}}{2}$.
$\therefore$ Kewaye da'ira : kewaye da murabba'i = $\sqrt{\pi} : 2$.
Amsa: $\sqrt{\pi} : 2$.

Question: Idan rabo na lambobi biyu 3:4 ne kuma L.C.M ɗinsu 180 ne, ƙididdige waɗancan lambobi biyun.
Solution:
A ɗauka cewa, lambobin sune $3x$ da $4x$
[inda $x$ shine abin rabo na gama-gari]
$\therefore \text{K.L.M na } 3x \text{ da } 4x \text{ shine} = 3 \times 4 \times x = 12x$
Dangane da tambayar, $12x = 180$
ko kuma, $x = \frac{180}{12} \quad \therefore x = 15$
$\therefore \text{Lambar farko}=3x = 3 \times 15 = 45 \text{ kuma}$
$\text{Lamba ta biyu}=4 \times 15 = 60$
Ams. $45 \text{ da } 60.$

Question: Rabon ɗalibai marasa halarta da waɗanda suka halarta a wata rana a ajinku ya kasance $1:4$. Bayyana adadin ɗalibai marasa halarta a cikin kashi dangane da jimillar ɗalibai.
Solution:
A ɗauka, yawan ɗaliban da suka yi rashin halarta $= x$ kuma yawan ɗaliban da suka halarta $= 4x$
[a nan x waniaggi ne mai kyau da ke nuna ma'auni]
Yawan dukan ɗalibai $= x + 4x = 5x$
$\therefore$ Ɗaliban da suka yi rashin halarta a cikin kashi na dukan ɗalibai
$= \frac{\text{yawan ɗaliban da suka yi rashin halarta}}{\text{yawan dukan ɗalibai}} \times 100\%$
$= \frac{x}{5x} \times 100\% = 20 \%$
Amsa. $20\%$

Question: Abin farko ana sayensa, sannan kuma ana sayar da shi da asara ta $28\%$. Nemi rabo tsakanin farashin saye da farashin sayarwa.
Solution:
A ɗauka, farashin saye $= 100$
$\therefore$ Farashin sayarwa a asara ta $28\%$ shi ne $=\text{Tk.}(100 - 28) = 72$
$\therefore \frac{\text{farashin sayarwa}}{\text{farashin saye}} = \frac{72}{100} = \frac{18}{25}$
$\therefore \text{farashin sayarwa: farashin saye} = 18 : 25$
Ams. $18 : 25$

Question: Tarin shekarun mahaifi da ɗansa ya kai $70$ shekara. Shekaru $7$ da suka gabata, rabon shekarunsu ya kasance $5:2$. Mene ne rabon shekarunsu bayan shekaru $5$?
Solution:
7 years ago, ratio of ages of father and son was $5:2$.
$\therefore \text{Bari mu ce, shekaru 7 da suka wuce, shekarun mahaifin } = 5x \text{ shekara}$
$\text{ da kuma na '' dansa '' } = 2x \text{ shekara}$
$\therefore \text{Shekarun mahaifin a yanzu } = (5x + 7) \text{ shekara}$
$\text{ da kuma na '' dansa '' } = (2x + 7) \text{ shekara}$
A cewar tambayar, $5x + 7 + 2x + 7 = 70$
ko, $7x + 14 = 70$
ko, $7x = 70 - 14$
ko, $7x = 56$
ko, $x = \frac{56}{7}$
$\therefore x = 8$
$\therefore \text{Shekarun mahaifin nan gaba bayan shekaru } 5=(5x + 7 + 5) \text{ shekara}$
$= (5x + 12) \text{ shekara}$
$= (5 \times 8 + 12) \text{ shekara,'}$
$= (40 + 12) \text{ shekara,'}$
$= 52 \text{ shekara}$
kuma shekarun dansa nan gaba bayan shekaru $5$ = $(2x + 7 + 5) \text{ shekara}$
$= (2x + 12) \text{ shekara}$
$= (2 \times 8 + 12) \text{ shekara,'}$
$= (16 + 12) \text{ shekara,'}$
$= 28 \text{ shekara}$
$\therefore \text{ Rabe-raben shekarunsu nan gaba bayan shekaru } 5$ = $52 : 28$
$= 13 : 7$
Amsa. $13:7$

Question:
Idan $a:b=b:c$, tabbatar da cewa,
 $\frac{a}{c}=\frac{a^2+b^2}{b^2+c^2}$
Solution:
An bayar, $a : b = b : c$
ko kuma, $\frac{a}{b} = \frac{b}{c}$
ko kuma, $\frac{a^2}{b^2} = \frac{b^2}{c^2}$ [sami'in dukkan bangarorin]
ko kuma, $\frac{a^2 + b^2}{b^2} = \frac{b^2 + c^2}{c^2}$ [ta hanyar componendo]
ko kuma, $\frac{a^2 + b^2}{b^2 + c^2} = \frac{b^2}{c^2}$ [ta hanyar alternendo]
ko kuma, $\frac{a^2 + b^2}{b^2 + c^2} = \frac{ac}{c^2}$ [$\because \frac{a}{b} = \frac{b}{c} \therefore ac = b^2$]
ko kuma, $\frac{a^2 + b^2}{b^2 + c^2} = \frac{a}{c}$
$\therefore \frac{a}{c} = \frac{a^2 + b^2}{b^2 + c^2}$ (An tabbatar)

Question:
Idan $a:b=b:c$, tabbatar da cewa,
    $a^2b^2c^2\left(\frac{1}{a^3}+\frac{1}{b^3}+\frac{1}{c^3}\right)=a^3+b^3+c^3$
Solution:
An bayar, $a : b = b : c$
ko kuma, $\frac{a}{b} = \frac{b}{c}$
$\therefore b^2 = ac$
SASAN GWARA (L.H.S.) $= a^2b^2c^2 \left(\frac{1}{a^3} + \frac{1}{b^3} + \frac{1}{c^3}\right)$
$= \frac{a^2b^2c^2}{a^3} + \frac{a^2b^2c^2}{b^3} + \frac{a^2b^2c^2}{c^3}$
$= \frac{b^2c^2}{a} + \frac{a^2c^2}{b} + \frac{a^2b^2}{c}$
$= \frac{b^2c^2}{a} + \frac{(ac)^2}{b} + \frac{a^2b^2}{c}$
$= \frac{ac \cdot c^2}{a} + \frac{(b^2)^2}{b} + \frac{a^2 \cdot ac}{c}$ [$\because \frac{a}{b} = \frac{b}{c} \therefore ac = b^2$]
$= c^3 + \frac{b^4}{b} + a^3 = c^3 + b^3 + a^3$
$= a^3 + b^3 + c^3 = \text{SASAN DAMA (R.H.S.)}$
$\therefore a^2b^2c^2 \left(\frac{1}{a^3} + \frac{1}{b^3} + \frac{1}{c^3}\right) = a^3 + b^3 + c^3$ (An tabbatar)

Question:
Idan $a:b=b:c$, tabbatar cewa,
$\frac{abc(a+b+c)^3}{(ab+bc+ca)^3}=1$
Solution:
An bayar, $a : b = b : c \text{ wato, } \frac{a}{b} = \frac{b}{c}$
A ɗauka, $\frac{a}{b} = \frac{b}{c} = k$
$\therefore b = ck$
$\therefore a = bk \cdot k = ck^2$
L.H.S. $= \frac{abc(a+b+c)^3}{(ab+bc+ca)^3}$
$= \frac{ck^2 \times ck \times c(ck^2 + ck + c)^3}{(ck^2 \times ck + ck \times c + c \times ck^2)^3}$
$= \frac{c^3k^3 \{c(k^2 + k + 1)\}^3}{(c^2k^3 + c^2k + c^2k^2)^3}$
$= \frac{c^3k^3 \times c^3(k^2+k+1)^3}{\{c^2k(k^2+1+k)\}^3}$
$= \frac{c^6k^3(k^2+k+1)^3}{c^6k^3(k^2+k+1)^3} = 1 = \text{R.H.S.}$
$\therefore \frac{abc(a+b+c)^3}{(ab+bc+ca)^3} = 1$ (An tabbatar)

Question:
Warware:
$\frac{1-\sqrt{1-x}}{1+\sqrt{1-x}}=\frac{1}{3}$
Solution:
$\frac{1-\sqrt{1-x}}{1+\sqrt{1-x}}=\frac{1}{3}$
ko kuma, $\frac{(1-\sqrt{1-x})+(1+\sqrt{1-x})}{(1-\sqrt{1-x})-(1+\sqrt{1-x})} = \frac{1+3}{1-3}$ [ta hanyar gamawa da raba]
ko kuma, $\frac{1-\sqrt{1-x}+1+\sqrt{1-x}}{1-\sqrt{1-x}-1-\sqrt{1-x}} = \frac{4}{-2}$
ko kuma, $\frac{2}{-2\sqrt{1-x}} = \frac{4}{-2}$
ko kuma, $\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-x}} = 2$
ko kuma, $\frac{1}{1-x} = 4$ [ta hanyar daure duka gefe]
ko kuma, $4(1-x) = 1$ [ta hanyar ninkawa]
ko kuma, $4 - 4x = 1$
ko kuma, $-4x = 1 - 4$
ko kuma, $-4x = -3$
ko kuma, $x = \frac{3}{4}$
$\therefore$ Maganin shine $x = \frac{3}{4}$

Question:
Warware:
    $81 \left(\frac{1-x}{1+x}\right)^3 = \frac{1+x}{1-x}$
Solution:
$81 \left(\frac{1-x}{1+x}\right)^3 = \frac{1+x}{1-x}$
ko, $81 = \frac{1+x}{1-x} \times \left(\frac{1+x}{1-x}\right)^3$
ko, $(9)^2 = \left\{\left(\frac{1+x}{1-x}\right)^2\right\}^2$
ko, $\left(\frac{1+x}{1-x}\right)^2 = 9$ [ana ɗaukar square root]
ko, $\frac{1+x}{1-x} = \pm 3$ [ana ɗaukar square root]
$\therefore \frac{1+x}{1-x} = 3$
ko, $1+x = 3(1-x)$
ko, $1+x = 3-3x$
ko, $4x = 2$
$\therefore x = \frac{1}{2}$
ko, $\frac{1+x}{1-x} = -3$
ko, $1+x = -3(1-x)$
ko, $1+x = -3+3x$
ko, $4 = 2x$
ko, $2x = 4$
$\therefore x = 2$
$\therefore$ Maganin da ake buƙata $x = 2$ , $\frac{1}{2}$

Question:
Idan $\frac{a}{b} = \frac{b}{c} = \frac{c}{d}$, nuna cewa,
1) $\frac{a^3 + b^3}{b^3 + c^3} = \frac{b^3 + c^3}{c^3 + d^3}$
Solution:
An bayar, $\frac{a}{b} = \frac{b}{c} = \frac{c}{d}$
Bari, $\frac{a}{b} = \frac{b}{c} = \frac{c}{d} = k$
$\therefore c = dk$
$b = ck = dk \cdot k = dk^2$
$a = bk = dk^2 \cdot k = dk^3$
L.H.S. $= \frac{a^3 + b^3}{b^3 + c^3} = \frac{(dk^3)^3 + (dk^2)^3}{(dk^2)^3 + (dk)^3}$
$= \frac{d^3k^9 + d^3k^6}{d^3k^6 + d^3k^3} = \frac{d^3k^6(k^3 + 1)}{d^3k^3(k^3 + 1)} = k^3$
R.H.S. $= \frac{b^3 + c^3}{c^3 + d^3} = \frac{(dk^2)^3 + (dk)^3}{(dk)^3 + d^3}$
$= \frac{d^3k^6 + d^3k^3}{d^3k^3 + d^3} = \frac{d^3k^3(k^3 + 1)}{d^3(k^3 + 1)}$
$= k^3$
$\therefore \frac{a^3 + b^3}{b^3 + c^3} = \frac{b^3 + c^3}{c^3 + d^3}$ (An nuna)

Question:
Idan $\frac{a}{b} = \frac{b}{c} = \frac{c}{d}$, nuna cewa,
     $(a^2 + b^2 + c^2)(b^2 + c^2 + d^2) = (ab + bc + cd)^2$
Idan $x = \frac{4ab}{a+b}$, nuna cewa, $\frac{x+2a}{x-2a} + \frac{x+2b}{x-2b} = 2$, inda $a \ne b$.
Solution:
An bayar, $x = \frac{4ab}{a+b}$
ko kuma, $x = \frac{2a \times 2b}{a+b}$
$\therefore \frac{x}{2a} = \frac{2b}{a+b}$ da $\frac{x}{2b} = \frac{2a}{a+b}$
kamar yadda, $\frac{x}{2a} = \frac{2b}{a+b}$
Sa'an nan, $\frac{x+2a}{x-2a} = \frac{2b+a+b}{2b-a-b}$
[ta hanyar componendo da dividendo]
$\therefore \frac{x+2a}{x-2a} = \frac{a+3b}{b-a}$ ..... (i)
Kuma, kamar yadda $\frac{x}{2b} = \frac{2a}{a+b}$
Sa'an nan, $\frac{x+2b}{x-2b} = \frac{2a+a+b}{2a-a-b}$
[ta hanyar componendo da dividendo]
$\therefore \frac{x+2b}{x-2b} = \frac{3a+b}{a-b}$ ..... (ii)
Ta hanyar ƙara lissafi (i) da (ii) muna samu,
$\frac{x+2a}{x-2a} + \frac{x+2b}{x-2b} = \frac{a+3b}{b-a} + \frac{3a+b}{a-b}$
$= \frac{a+3b}{b-a} + \frac{3a+b}{-(b-a)} = \frac{a+3b}{b-a} - \frac{3a+b}{b-a}$
$= \frac{a+3b-(3a+b)}{b-a} = \frac{a+3b-3a-b}{b-a}$
$= \frac{2b-2a}{b-a} = \frac{2(b-a)}{(b-a)}$
$= 2$
$\therefore \frac{x+2a}{x-2a} + \frac{x+2b}{x-2b} = 2$ (An nuna)

Question:
Idan $x = \frac{\sqrt[3]{m+1} + \sqrt[3]{m-1}}{\sqrt[3]{m+1} - \sqrt[3]{m-1}}$, tabbatar da cewa
$x^3 - 3mx^2 + 3x - m = 0$.
Solution:
An bayar,
$x = \frac{\sqrt[3]{m+1} + \sqrt[3]{m-1}}{\sqrt[3]{m+1} - \sqrt[3]{m-1}}$
ko kuma, $\frac{x+1}{x-1} = \frac{\sqrt[3]{m+1} + \sqrt[3]{m-1} + \sqrt[3]{m+1} - \sqrt[3]{m-1}}{\sqrt[3]{m+1} + \sqrt[3]{m-1} - (\sqrt[3]{m+1} - \sqrt[3]{m-1})}$
[ ta hanyar yin componendo da dividendo ]
ko kuma, $\frac{x+1}{x-1} = \frac{2\sqrt[3]{m+1}}{2\sqrt[3]{m-1}}$
ko kuma, $\frac{x+1}{x-1} = \sqrt[3]{\frac{m+1}{m-1}}$
ko kuma, $\left(\frac{x+1}{x-1}\right)^3 = \left(\sqrt[3]{\frac{m+1}{m-1}}\right)^3$ [ yin cubic ɗai-ɗai bangarorin biyu ]
ko kuma, $\frac{(x+1)^3}{(x-1)^3} = \frac{m+1}{m-1}$
ko kuma, $\frac{x^3 + 3x^2 + 3x + 1}{x^3 - 3x^2 + 3x - 1} = \frac{m+1}{m-1}$
ko kuma, $\frac{x^3 + 3x^2 + 3x + 1 + x^3 - 3x^2 + 3x - 1}{x^3 + 3x^2 + 3x + 1 - (x^3 - 3x^2 + 3x - 1)} = \frac{m+1+m-1}{m+1-(m-1)}$
[ Sake ta hanyar yin componendo da dividendo ]
ko kuma, $\frac{2x^3 + 6x}{2 + 6x^2} = \frac{2m}{2}$
ko kuma, $\frac{2(x^3 + 3x)}{2(1 + 3x^2)} = m$
ko kuma, $x^3 + 3x = m(1 + 3x^2)$ [ ta hanyar yin cross multiplication ]
$\therefore x^3 - 3mx^2 + 3x - m = 0$ (An tabbatar)

Question:
Idan $x = \frac{\sqrt{2a+3b} + \sqrt{2a-3b}}{\sqrt{2a+3b} - \sqrt{2a-3b}}$, nuna cewa,
$3bx^2 - 4ax + 3b = 0$.
Solution:
An bayar,
$x = \frac{\sqrt{2a+3b} + \sqrt{2a-3b}}{\sqrt{2a+3b} - \sqrt{2a-3b}}$
ko kuma, $\frac{x+1}{x-1} = \frac{\sqrt{2a+3b} + \sqrt{2a-3b} + \sqrt{2a+3b} - \sqrt{2a-3b}}{\sqrt{2a+3b} + \sqrt{2a-3b} - (\sqrt{2a+3b} - \sqrt{2a-3b})}$
[ta hanyar gamawa da raba (componendo and dividendo)]
ko kuma, $\frac{x+1}{x-1} = \frac{2\sqrt{2a+3b}}{2\sqrt{2a-3b}}$
ko kuma, $\frac{x+1}{x-1} = \sqrt{\frac{2a+3b}{2a-3b}}$
ko kuma, $\left(\frac{x+1}{x-1}\right)^2 = \left(\sqrt{\frac{2a+3b}{2a-3b}}\right)^2$ [ta hanyar yin murabba'i ga bangarori biyu]
ko kuma, $\frac{(x+1)^2}{(x-1)^2} = \frac{2a+3b}{2a-3b}$
ko kuma, $\frac{(x+1)^2 + (x-1)^2}{(x+1)^2 - (x-1)^2} = \frac{2a+3b + 2a-3b}{2a+3b - (2a-3b)}$
[Kuma sake ta hanyar gamawa da raba (componendo and dividendo)]
ko kuma, $\frac{2(x^2+1)}{4x} = \frac{4a}{6b}$
[$\therefore (a+b)^2+(a-b)^2 = 2(a^2+b^2)$ da kuma $(a+b)^2-(a-b)^2=4ab$]
ko kuma, $\frac{x^2+1}{2x} = \frac{2a}{3b}$
ko kuma, $3b(x^2+1) = 4ax$ [ta hanyar haɗa ƙollewa (cross multiplication)]
ko kuma, $3bx^2 + 3b = 4ax$
$\therefore 3bx^2 - 4ax + 3b = 0$ (An nuna)

Question: Idan $\frac{a^2 + b^2}{b^2 + c^2} = \frac{(a+b)^2}{(b+c)^2}$, nuna cewa a, b, c suna cikin **ci-gaba na rabo** (continued proportion).
Solution:
An bayar,
$\frac{a^2 + b^2}{b^2 + c^2} = \frac{(a+b)^2}{(b+c)^2}$
ko kuma, $\frac{(b+c)^2}{b^2 + c^2} = \frac{(a+b)^2}{a^2 + b^2}$ [ta hanyar amfani da alternendo]
ko kuma, $\frac{b^2 + c^2 + 2bc}{b^2 + c^2} = \frac{a^2 + b^2 + 2ab}{a^2 + b^2}$
ko kuma, $\frac{b^2 + c^2 + 2bc - (b^2 + c^2)}{b^2 + c^2} = \frac{a^2 + b^2 + 2ab - (a^2 + b^2)}{a^2 + b^2}$
[ta hanyar amfani da dividendo]
ko kuma, $\frac{2bc}{b^2 + c^2} = \frac{2ab}{a^2 + b^2}$
ko kuma, $\frac{c}{b^2 + c^2} = \frac{a}{a^2 + b^2}$ [ta hanyar raba dukkan bangarorin da $2b$]
ko kuma, $a(b^2+c^2) = c(a^2+b^2)$
ko kuma, $ab^2 + ac^2 = a^2c + b^2c$
ko kuma, $ac^2 - a^2c = b^2c - ab^2$
ko kuma, $ac(c - a) = b^2(c - a)$
ko kuma, $ac = b^2$
ko kuma, $\frac{ac}{bc} = \frac{b^2}{bc}$ [ta hanyar raba dukkan bangarorin da $bc$]
ko kuma, $\frac{a}{b} = \frac{b}{c}$
ko kuma, $a : b = b : c$
$\therefore a, b, c$ suna cikin tsari na gamammiyar rabbai. (An tabbatar)
Exact Answer: a, b, c suna cikin gwargwado.

Question:
Idan $\frac{x}{b+c} = \frac{y}{c+a} = \frac{z}{a+b}$, tabbatar da cewa
$\frac{a}{y+z-x} = \frac{b}{z+x-y} = \frac{c}{x+y-z}$
Solution:
Dauki cewa, $\frac{x}{b+c} = \frac{y}{c+a} = \frac{z}{a+b} = k$
$\therefore x = k(b+c)$, $y = k(c+a)$, $z = k(a+b)$
Yanzu, $y+z-x = k(c+a)+k(a+b)-k(b+c)$
$= k(c+a+a+b-b-c) = 2ak$
$\therefore \frac{a}{y+z-x} = \frac{a}{2ak} = \frac{1}{2k}$
Tafarkon haka, $z+x-y = k(a+b)+k(b+c)-k(c+a)$
$= k(a+b+b+c-c-a)$
$= 2bk$
$\therefore \frac{b}{z+x-y} = \frac{b}{2bk} = \frac{1}{2k}$
Tafarkon haka, $x+y-z = k(b+c)+k(c+a)-k(a+b)$
$= k(b+c+c+a-a-b)$
$= 2ck$
$\therefore \frac{c}{x+y-z} = \frac{c}{2ck} = \frac{1}{2k}$
Tun da, $\frac{a}{y+z-x}$, $\frac{b}{z+x-y}$ da $\frac{c}{x+y-z}$
Duk wani rabo yana daidai da $\frac{1}{2k}$.
$\therefore \frac{a}{y+z-x} = \frac{b}{z+x-y} = \frac{c}{x+y-z}$ (An tabbatar)

Question:
Idan $\frac{bz-cy}{a} = \frac{cx-az}{b} = \frac{ay-bx}{c}$, tabbatar da cewa
$\frac{x}{a} = \frac{y}{b} = \frac{z}{c}$
Solution:
Duba cewa, $\frac{bz-cy}{a} = \frac{cx-az}{b} = \frac{ay-bx}{c} = k$
$\therefore bz-cy = ak$ \dotfill (i)
$\therefore cx-az = bk$ \dotfill (ii)
$\therefore ay-bx = ck$ \dotfill (iii)
Yanzu ta hanyar ninka lissafin (i),(ii) da (iii) da a, b da c bi da bi,
$abz-acy = a^2k$
$bcx-abz = b^2k$
$acy-cbx = c^2k$
$0 = k(a^2+b^2+c^2)$ [ta hanyar tara su]
$\therefore k = 0$ [$\because$ Kamar yadda a, b, c d constants ne, $a^2+b^2+c^2 \ne 0$]
Don haka, $\frac{bz-cy}{a} = 0$ sake, $\frac{cx-az}{b} = 0$
ko kuma, $bz-cy = 0$ ko kuma, $cx-az = 0$
ko kuma, $bz = cy$ ko kuma, $cx = az$
$\therefore \frac{z}{c} = \frac{y}{b}$ \dotfill (iv) $\therefore \frac{x}{a} = \frac{z}{c}$ \dotfill (v)
Daga lissafin (iv) da (v), $\frac{x}{a} = \frac{y}{b} = \frac{z}{c}$ (An nuna)

Question: Idan $\frac{a+b-c}{a+b} = \frac{b+c-a}{b+c} = \frac{c+a-b}{c+a}$ kuma $a+b+c \ne 0$, tabbatar cewa $a=b=c$.
Solution:
An bayar,
$\frac{a+b-c}{a+b} = \frac{b+c-a}{b+c} = \frac{c+a-b}{c+a}$ kuma $a+b+c \ne 0$
ko kuma, $\frac{a+b-c-(a+b)}{a+b} = \frac{b+c-a-(b+c)}{b+c} = \frac{c+a-b-(c+a)}{c+a}$ [ta hanyar dividendo]
ko kuma, $\frac{-c}{a+b} = \frac{-a}{b+c} = \frac{-b}{c+a}$
ko kuma, $\frac{c}{a+b} = \frac{a}{b+c} = \frac{b}{c+a}$ [ta hanyar ninka da (-1)]
ko kuma, $\frac{a+b}{c} = \frac{b+c}{a} = \frac{c+a}{b}$ [ta hanyar invertendo]
ko kuma, $\frac{a+b}{c}+1 = \frac{b+c}{a}+1 = \frac{c+a}{b}+1$ [ta hanyar componendo]
ko kuma, $\frac{a+b+c}{c} = \frac{b+c+a}{a} = \frac{c+a+b}{b}$
ko kuma, $\frac{1}{c} = \frac{1}{a} = \frac{1}{b}$ [ta hanyar raba da $(a+b+c)$, inda $a+b+c \ne 0$]
ko kuma, $c=a=b$ [ta hanyar invertendo]
$\therefore a=b=c$ (An tabbatar)

Question: Idan $\frac{x}{xa+yb+zc} = \frac{y}{ya+zb+xc} = \frac{z}{za+xb+yc}$ kuma $x+y+z \ne 0$, nuna cewa, kowane ɗaya daga cikin rabo shine $\frac{1}{a+b+c}$.
Solution:
An bayar,
$\frac{x}{xa+yb+zc} = \frac{y}{ya+zb+xc} = \frac{z}{za+xb+yc}$
Daga dokar daidaitawa mun sani,
Idan $\frac{a}{b} = \frac{c}{d} = \frac{e}{f}$, to $\frac{a}{b} = \frac{c}{d} = \frac{e}{f} = \frac{a+c+e}{b+d+f}$
$\therefore$ An bayar, kowane rabo zai yi daidai da rabo mai zuwa,
wato, $\frac{x+y+z}{xa+yb+zc+ya+zb+xc+za+xb+yc}$
[Ta hanyar ƙara masu gudanarwa da masu rarrabawa]
$= \frac{x+y+z}{xa+xb+xc+ya+yb+yc+za+zb+zc}$
$= \frac{x+y+z}{x(a+b+c)+y(a+b+c)+z(a+b+c)}$
$= \frac{x+y+z}{(x+y+z)(a+b+c)}$
$= \frac{1}{a+b+c}$ (An nuna)

Question: Idan $(a+b+c)p = (b+c-a)q = (c+a-b)r = (a+b-c)s$, to fa tabbatar da cewa, $\frac{1}{q} + \frac{1}{r} + \frac{1}{s} = \frac{1}{p}$
Solution:
A yi tunanin cewa,
$(a+b+c)p = (b+c-a)q = (c+a-b)r = (a+b-c)s = k$
$\therefore p(a+b+c) = k$
ko kuma, $p = \frac{k}{a+b+c}$
$\therefore \frac{1}{p} = \frac{a+b+c}{k}$ \dotfill (i)
Sake, $q(b+c-a) = k$
ko kuma, $q = \frac{k}{b+c-a}$
$\therefore \frac{1}{q} = \frac{b+c-a}{k}$ \dotfill (ii)
kuma $r(c+a-b) = k$
ko kuma, $r = \frac{k}{c+a-b}$
$\therefore \frac{1}{r} = \frac{c+a-b}{k}$ \dotfill (iii)
Sake, $s(a+b-c) = k$
ko kuma, $s = \frac{k}{a+b-c}$
$\therefore \frac{1}{s} = \frac{a+b-c}{k}$ \dotfill (iv)
Idan muka ƙara lissafi (ii), (iii) da (iv) zamu samu,
$\frac{1}{q} + \frac{1}{r} + \frac{1}{s} = \frac{b+c-a}{k} + \frac{c+a-b}{k} + \frac{a+b-c}{k}$
$= \frac{1}{k}(b+c-a+c+a-b+a+b-c)$
$= \frac{a+b+c}{k}$ [daga (i)]
$= \frac{1}{p}$
$\therefore \frac{1}{q} + \frac{1}{r} + \frac{1}{s} = \frac{1}{p}$ (An tabbatar)

Question:
Idan $lx = my = nz$, to, nuna cewa,
$\frac{x^2}{yz} + \frac{y^2}{zx} + \frac{z^2}{xy} = \frac{mn}{l^2} + \frac{nl}{m^2} + \frac{lm}{n^2}$.
Solution:
A ce, $lx = my = nz = k$
$\therefore x = \frac{k}{l}$, $y = \frac{k}{m}$ da $z = \frac{k}{n}$
L.H.S. $= \frac{x^2}{yz} + \frac{y^2}{zx} + \frac{z^2}{xy}$
$= \frac{\left(\frac{k}{l}\right)^2}{\left(\frac{k}{m}\right) \times \left(\frac{k}{n}\right)} + \frac{\left(\frac{k}{m}\right)^2}{\left(\frac{k}{n}\right) \times \left(\frac{k}{l}\right)} + \frac{\left(\frac{k}{n}\right)^2}{\left(\frac{k}{l}\right) \times \left(\frac{k}{m}\right)}$ [sanya ƙimomin x, y da z]
$= \frac{\frac{k^2}{l^2}}{\frac{k^2}{mn}} + \frac{\frac{k^2}{m^2}}{\frac{k^2}{nl}} + \frac{\frac{k^2}{n^2}}{\frac{k^2}{ml}}$
$= \left(\frac{k^2}{l^2} \times \frac{mn}{k^2}\right) + \left(\frac{k^2}{m^2} \times \frac{nl}{k^2}\right) + \left(\frac{k^2}{n^2} \times \frac{ml}{k^2}\right)$
$= \frac{mn}{l^2} + \frac{nl}{m^2} + \frac{lm}{n^2}$
$= \text{R.H.S.}$
$\therefore \frac{x^2}{yz} + \frac{y^2}{zx} + \frac{z^2}{xy} = \frac{mn}{l^2} + \frac{nl}{m^2} + \frac{lm}{n^2}$ (An nuna).

Question:
Idan $\frac{p}{q} = \frac{a^2}{b^2}$ kuma $\frac{a}{b} = \sqrt{\frac{a+q}{a-q}}$, nuna cewa,
$\frac{p+q}{a} = \frac{p-q}{q}$.
Solution:
An bayar, $\frac{p}{q} = \frac{a^2}{b^2}$
ko kuma, $\frac{p+q}{p-q} = \frac{a^2+b^2}{a^2-b^2}$ [ta hanyar amfani da ka'idar "componendo and dividendo"]
\dotfill (i)
Sake, $\frac{a}{b} = \sqrt{\frac{a+q}{a-q}}$
ko kuma, $\frac{a^2}{b^2} = \frac{a+q}{a-q}$ ;[ta hanyar yin murabba'i]
ko kuma, $\frac{a^2+b^2}{a^2-b^2} = \frac{(a+q)+(a-q)}{(a+q)-(a-q)}$; [ta hanyar amfani da ka'idar "componendo and dividendo"]
ko kuma, $\frac{a^2+b^2}{a^2-b^2} = \frac{2a}{2q}$
$\therefore \frac{a^2+b^2}{a^2-b^2} = \frac{a}{q}$ \dotfill (ii)
Mun samu daga (i) da (ii),
$\frac{p+q}{p-q} = \frac{a}{q}$
$\therefore \frac{p+q}{a} = \frac{p-q}{q}$ (An nuna).

Question: Lambobin nauyi na katako mai girman santimita kubik 1 (1 cm³) ita ce desigiram 7 (7 dg). Nawa ne kashi ɗari (percentage) na nauyin katako idan aka kwatanta da nauyin ruwa mai girman daidai da shi?
Solution:
Nauyin 1 cubic cm. na katako gram 7 ne.
Mun sani,
Nauyin 1 cubic cm. na ruwa $= 1$ gm. $= 10$ decigram.
Kashi na 7 decigram cikin 10 decigram
$= \frac{7}{10} \times 100 \% = 70 \%$
Amsar. $70\%$

Question: Rarraba Tk. $300$ tsakanin a, b, c, d ta yadda rabon da suka samu ke nan: ɓangaren a : ɓangaren b $= 2:3$, ɓangaren b : ɓangaren c $= 1:2$, kuma ɓangaren c : ɓangaren d $= 3:2$.
Solution:
An bayar,
$a:b = 2:3$
$b:c = 1:2 = (1 \times 3) : (2 \times 3) = 3:6$
[inayen sassa biyu na rabbakin da 3]
$c:d = 3:2 = (3 \times 2) : (2 \times 2) = 6:4$
[inayen sassa biyu na rabbakin da 2]
$\therefore a:b:c:d = 2:3:6:4$
Bari, rabon a ya kasance Tk.$2x$
Rabon b ya kasance Tk.$3x$
Rabon c ya kasance Tk $6x$.
Kuma rabon d ya kasance Tk.$4x$
A bisa ga tambayar,
$2x + 3x + 6x + 4x = 300$
ko kuma, $15x = 300$
ko kuma, $x = \frac{300}{15}$
$\therefore x = 20$
$\therefore$ Rabin a shine Tk.$2x$ = Tk. $(2 \times 20)$ = Tk.$40$
Rabin b shine Tk.$3x$. = Tk. $(3 \times 20)$ = Tk.$60$
Rabin c shine Tk.$6x$ = Tk. $(6 \times 20)$ = Tk.$120$
Kuma rabon d shine Tk.$4x$ = Tk. $(4 \times 20)$ = Tk. $80$
Amsawa. Rabin a Tk.$40$, rabon b Tk.$60$, rabon c Tk.$120$ da rabon d Tk.$80$

Question: Bari 'yan kifi uku su kama kifaye guda 690. Rabe-raben rabonsu sune $\frac{2}{3}$, $\frac{4}{5}$ da $\frac{5}{6}$. Yaya yawancin kifaye kowannensu zai samu?
Solution: Rabo na sassa shine $\frac{2}{3} : \frac{4}{5} : \frac{5}{6}$. Don sauƙaƙe rabo, nemo ragaggen yawa gama gari, wanda shine 30. Rabo ya zama $\frac{2}{3}\times 30 : \frac{4}{5}\times 30 : \frac{5}{6}\times 30 = 20:24:25$. Jimlar sassa na rabo shine $20+24+25=69$. Mafarancin masunci ya samu $\frac{20}{69} \times 690 = 200$ kifi. Na biyun masunci ya samu $\frac{24}{69} \times 690 = 240$ kifi. Na uku masunci ya samu $\frac{25}{69} \times 690 = 250$ kifi.

Question: Perimita na wani triangle shine 45 cm. Ƙimar rabon tsawon gefensa ita ce $3:5:7$. Nemi tsawon kowane gefe.
Solution: Bari gefunan triangle ɗin su kasance $3x$, $5x$, da $7x$. Perimeter ɗin shi ne jimlar gefunan, saboda haka $3x + 5x + 7x = 45$. Wannan yana sauƙaƙewa zuwa $15x = 45$. Rarrabawa da 15 yana bayar da $x=3$. Tsawon gefe na farko shine $3x = 3(3) = 9$ cm. Tsawon gefe na biyu shine $5x = 5(3) = 15$ cm. Tsawon gefe na uku shine $7x = 7(3) = 21$ cm.

Question: Idan rabo na lambobi biyu shine $5:7$ kuma H.C.F. ɗinsu shine $4$, menene L.C.M. na lambobin?
Solution:
Rabon lambobi biyu $5:7$
kuma mafi girman sadaki (H.C.F.) ɗinsu $= 4$
Bari, lamba ta farko $= 5x$
kuma lamba ta biyu $= 7x$
$\therefore$ Mafi girman sadaki (H.C.F.) na lambobin $= x$
kuma mafi ƙarancin sadaki (L.C.M.) $= 5 \times 7 \times x = 35x$
A cewar tambayar, $x=4$
$\therefore$ Mafi ƙarancin sadaki (L.C.M.) na lambobin $= 35 \times 4 = 140$
Amsa. $140$

Question: A wani wasan kwallon kriket, jimillar gudu da Sakib, Mushfique da Mashrafi suka ci shine 171. Rabin gudu da aka ci tsakanin Sakib da Mushfique, da kuma tsakanin Mushfique da Mashrafi shine $3:2$. Su nawa ne gudun da kowa ya ci a kansa?
Solution:
Adadin gudun da Sakib ya ci : Adadin gudun da Mushfique ya ci $= 3:2$
$= (3 \times 3) : (2 \times 3)$
[Yin daraja ga bangarori biyu na ra'ayi da 3]
$= 9:6$
Adadin gudun da Mushfique ya ci : Adadin gudun da Mashrafi ya ci $= 3:2 = (3 \times 2) : (2 \times 2)$
$= 6:4$
[Yin daraja ga bangarori biyu na ra'ayi da 2]
$\therefore$ Adadin gudun da Sakib ya ci : Adadin gudun da Mushfique ya ci : Adadin gudun da Mashrafi ya ci $= 9:6:4$
Bari, Adadin gudun da Sakib ya ci $= 9x$
Adadin gudun da Mushfique ya ci $= 6x$
Kuma, Adadin gudun da Mashrafi ya ci $= 4x$
A bisa ga tambayar,
$9x + 6x + 4x = 171$
ko kuma, $19x = 171$ ko kuma, $x = \frac{171}{19}$
$\therefore x = 9$
$\therefore$ Adadin gudun da Sakib ya ci $= 9x = (9 \times 9) = 81$
Adadin gudun da Mushfique ya ci $= 6x = (6 \times 9) = 54$
Kuma, Adadin gudun da Mashrafi ya ci $= 4x = (4 \times 9) = 36$
Amsa. Adadin gudun da Sakib, Mushfique da Mashraf suka ci sune $81, 54$ da $36$ gudun bi da biyu.

Question: A wata ofis, akwai jami'ai 2, masu aiki 7 da kuma masu ɗaukar kaya 3. Idan mai ɗaukar kaya ya samu Tk. 1, mai aiki ya samu Tk. 2, kuma jami'i ya samu Tk. 4. Jimillar albashin su shine Tk. 150,000. Mene ne albashin kowane ɗayansu?
Solution:
Idan mai ɗauke da kaya ya samu Tk. 1 to sai ma’aikaci ya samu Tk. 2 kuma jami’i ya samu Tk. 4
$\therefore$ Raddin albashin jami’i, ma’aikaci da mai ɗauke da kaya $= 4:2:1$
Bari, Albashin jami’i $=$ Tk.$4x$
$\therefore$ Albashin ma’aikaci $=$ Tk.$2x$
Kuma Albashin mai ɗauke da kaya $=$ Tk. $x$
Dangane da tambayar,
$4x \times 2 + 2x \times 7 + x \times 3 = 150000$
ko, $8x + 14x + 3x = 150000$
ko, $25x = 150000$
ko, $x = \frac{150000}{25}$ $\therefore x = 6000$
$\therefore$ 1 mai ɗauke da kaya ya samu Tk. $(1 \times 6000)$ ko, Tk.$6000$
1 ma’aikaci ya samu Tk. $(6000 \times 2)$ ko, Tk.$12000$
Kuma 1 jami’i ya samu Tk. $(6000 \times 4)$ ko, Tk.$24000$
Amsa. Jami’i ya samu Tk.$24000$, Ma’aikaci ya samu Tk.$12000$ kuma mai ɗauke da kaya ya samu Tk.$6000$.

Question: Idan an ƙara gefunan murabba'i da $20\%$, kaso nawa ne na karuwar *samarar* murabba'in?
Solution:
Bari, tsawon kowane gefen murabba'i ya kasance 'a' raka'a.
$\therefore$ Yanar murabba'in shine $a^2$ murabba'in raka'a.
Bayan karuwa da $20\%$, tsawon kowane gefe zai kasance $(a + 20\%$ na $a)$ raka'a
$= (a + \frac{20a}{100})$ raka'a $= (a + \frac{a}{5})$ raka'a
$= \frac{5a+a}{5}$ raka'a $= \frac{6a}{5}$ raka'a
Saboda haka, yanar sabon murabba'in da ya karu $= (\frac{6a}{5})^2$ murabba'in raka'a
$= \frac{36a^2}{25}$ murabba'in raka'a
$\therefore$ Janar karuwar yanar murabba'i $= (\frac{36a^2}{25} - a^2)$ murabba'in raka'a
$= (\frac{36a^2 - 25a^2}{25})$ murabba'in raka'a $= \frac{11a^2}{25}$ murabba'in raka'a
$\therefore$ Kashi na janar karuwar yanar
$= \frac{\text{Janar karuwar yanar}}{\text{Yanar da ta gabata}} \times 100 = \frac{\frac{11a^2}{25}}{a^2} \times 100$
$= \frac{11a^2}{25} \times \frac{1}{a^2} \times 100 = 44$
Amsa. $44\%$

Question: Idan tsawon wani rectangle ya karu da $10\%$ kuma faɗinsa ya ragu da $10\%$, menene kashi na karuwa ko raguwa a cikin farrar rectangle ɗin?
Solution:
Bari, tsawon rectangle $= x$ unit da faɗin rectangle $= y$ unit
Don haka, wurin rectangle $= xy$ murabba'in unit
Tsawon da aka ƙara $= 10\%$ na $x = (\frac{10}{100} \text{ na } x)$ unit
$= \frac{x}{10}$ unit
Faɗin da aka rage $= 10\%$ na $y = (\frac{10}{100} \text{ na } y)$ unit
$= \frac{y}{10}$ unit
$\therefore$ Tsawon sabon rectangle $= (x + \frac{x}{10})$ unit $= \frac{11x}{10}$ unit
kuma faɗin sabon rectangle $= (y - \frac{y}{10})$ unit $= \frac{9y}{10}$ unit
$\therefore$ Wurin sabon rectangle $= (\frac{11x}{10} \times \frac{9y}{10})$ murabba'in unit
$= \frac{99xy}{100}$ murabba'in unit
Wurin da aka rage $= (xy - \frac{99xy}{100})$ murabba'in unit
$= (\frac{100xy - 99xy}{100})$ murabba'in unit
$= \frac{xy}{100}$ murabba'in unit
$\therefore$ Kashi na wurin da aka rage
$= \frac{\text{Wurin da aka rage}}{\text{Wurin da ya gabata}} \times 100 = \frac{\frac{xy}{100}}{xy} \times 100$
$= \frac{xy}{100} \times \frac{1}{xy} \times 100 = 1$

Amsa. $1\%$

Question: A wani fili, rabbakin samarwa kafin da bayan ban ruwa shine $4:7$. A wannan filin, yawan samar da shinkafar da aka samu a baya ya kasance $304$ quintal. Yawan samar da shinkafar bayan ban ruwa zai kasance nawa?
Solution:
Bari, yawan amfanin kafin ban ruwa $= 4x$ quintal
To, yawan amfanin bayan ban ruwa $= 7x$ quintal
A bisa ga tambayar,
$4x = 304$
ko kuma, $x = \frac{304}{4}$
$\therefore x = 76$
$\therefore$ Yawan amfanin bayan ban ruwa $= 7x$ quintal
$= (7 \times 76)$ quintal $= 532$ quintal
Amsa. 532 quintal.

Question: Idan rabo tsakanin shinkafa da manoman da aka samu daga gareta shine $3:2$ kuma rabo tsakanin alkama da semovita da aka samu daga gareta shine $4:3$, nemi rabo tsakanin manoman da aka samu daga shinkafa da semovita da aka samu daga alkama idan an yi amfani da adadi guda na shinkafa da alkama.
Solution:
Rabon buhun shinkafa da shinkafar da aka samu daga buhun shinkafa $= 3:2 = 1:\frac{2}{3}$
[raba dukkan adadin rabo da 3]
Kuma, rabon alkama da garin alkama da aka samu daga alkama $= 4:3 = 1:\frac{3}{4}$
[raba dukkan adadin rabo da 4]
Yanzu, rabon buhun shinkafa da shinkafar da aka samu daga buhun shinkafa daga wani adadi na yau da kullun $= 1:\frac{2}{3}$
kuma, rabon alkama da garin alkama da aka samu daga alkama daga wannan adadi na yau da kullun $= 1:\frac{3}{4}$
$\therefore$ Rabin shinkafar da aka samu da garin alkama da aka samu daga buhun shinkafa da alkama na wannan adadi na yau da kullun $= \frac{2}{3}:\frac{3}{4}$
$= (\frac{2}{3} \times 12):(\frac{3}{4} \times 12) = 8:9$
$\therefore$ Rabin da ake bukata $= 8:9$
Amsa. $8:9$

Question: Faɗin wani filin ƙasa shine murabba'in mita $432$. Idan **nisan** tsawon wannan filin da na wani filin **na farko** da **nisan** faɗin wannan filin da na wani filin **na biyu** sune $3:4$ da $2:5$ bi da bi, to menene faɗin wani filin?
Solution:
Bari, tsawon fili na farko $= 3x$ mita
$\therefore$ tsawon fili na biyu $= 4x$ mita,
kuma faɗin fili na farko $= 2y$ mita
$\therefore$ faɗin fili na biyu $= 5y$ mita
Inuwar fili na farko $= 3x \times 2y$ murabba'in raka'a
$= 6xy$ murabba'in raka'a
A bisa ga tambayar, $6xy = 432$
ko kuma, $xy = \frac{432}{6}$
$\therefore xy = 72$
$\therefore$ Inuwar wani fili $= 4x \times 5y$ murabba'in raka'a
$= 20xy$ murabba'in raka'a
$= 20 \times 72$ murabba'in raka'a
$= 1440$ murabba'in raka'a

Amsa. $1440$ murabba'in raka'a.

Question: Zami da Simi sun karɓi lamunoni na adadi daban-daban a ƙimar $10\%$ ribar asali (sauƙi) a rana ɗaya daga Banki ɗaya. Jimillar jari da riba da Zami ya mayar bayan shekaru $2$ ya yi daidai da jimillar jari da riba da Simi ta mayar bayan shekaru $3$. Nemi rabo na lamunoninsu.
Solution:
Bari, Yawan lamunin Zami da Simi su kasance $x$ Tk. da $y$ Tk. bi da bi.
Mun sani, Ribar = Babban Kudi $\times$ Kudi na Ribar $\times$ Lokaci
$\therefore$ A kan ribar tattalin arziki ta $10\%$ bayan shekaru $2$ Zami zai bayar da ribar Tk. $(x \times \frac{10}{100} \times 2) = \text{Tk.} \frac{x}{5}$
$\therefore$ A kan ribar tattalin arziki ta $10\%$ bayan shekaru $3$ Simi zai bayar da ribar $= \text{Tk.} (y \times \frac{10}{100} \times 3) = \text{Tk.} \frac{3y}{10}$
Zami zai mayar bayan shekaru 2 $= \text{Tk.} (x + \frac{x}{5})$
$= \text{Tk.} (\frac{5x+x}{5}) = \text{Tk.} \frac{6x}{5}$
Kuma Simi zai mayar bayan shekaru 3 $= (y + \frac{3y}{10})$ Tk.
$= (\frac{10y+3y}{10})$ Tk. $= \frac{13y}{10}$ Tk.
A bisa ga tambayar,
$\frac{6x}{5} = \frac{13y}{10}$
ko, $60x = 65y$ [ta hanyar *cross-multiplication*]
ko, $\frac{x}{y} = \frac{65}{60}$
ko, $\frac{x}{y} = \frac{13}{12} \therefore x:y = 13:12$ (Amsa.)

Question:
Rabon ɗaliban da suka halarta da waɗanda basu halarta a wata rana a ajin shine $1:4$.
Nuna yawan ɗaliban da basu halarta a matsayin kashi idan aka kwatanta da jimlar ɗalibai.
Solution:
Bari yawan ɗaliban da suka yi kewara = $x$
Kuma yawan ɗaliban da suka halarci = $4x$
[Anan, $x$ yana nufin wani adadi mai kyau wanda ke da alaƙa da adadi]
$\therefore$ Jimlar yawan ɗaliban = $x + 4x = 5x$
$\therefore$ Yawan ɗaliban da suka yi kewara a matsayin kashi daga cikin jimlar yawan ɗaliban
$= \frac{\text{Yawan ɗaliban da suka yi kewara}}{\text{Jimlar yawan ɗaliban}} \times 100\%$
$= (\frac{x}{5x} \times 100)\%$
$= 20\%$
Amsa. $20\%$

Question:
Ashik, Mizan, Anika da Ahona sun fara kasuwanci tare da jimillar jari na Tk. $195000$ kuma sun samu ribar Tk $26500$ bayan karewar shekara guda. A cikin jarin kasuwancin, rabon Ashik : rabon Mizan = $2:3$, rabon Mizan : rabon Anika = $4:5$ kuma rabon Anika : rabon Ahona = $5:6$.
Nemo adadin jarin kowane mutum a cikin wannan kasuwancin.
Solution:
An ba da, a wani saka hannun jari na kasuwanci,
Rabin Ashik : Rabin Mizan $= 2 : 3 = 8 : 12$
Rabin Mizan : Rabin Anika $= 4 : 5 = 12 : 15$
Rabin Anika : Rabin Ahona $= 5 : 6 = 15 : 18$
$\therefore$ Rabin jarin Ashik : Mizan : Anika : Ahona
$= 8 : 12 : 15 : 18$ (Amsa.)

Question:
Ashik, Mizan, Anika da Ahona sun fara kasuwanci da jimillar jari na Tk. $195000$ kuma sun samu riba ta Tk $26500$ bayan karewar shekara guda. A cikin jarin kasuwancin, rabon Ashik: rabon Mizan $= 2:3$, rabon Mizan: rabon Anika $= 4:5$ kuma rabon Anika: rabon Ahona $= 5:6$.
Tantance adadin jarin kowace mutum a cikin wannan kasuwancin.
Solution:
Daga '25',
Ashik : Mizan : Anika : Ahona $= 8 : 12 : 15 : 18$
$\therefore$ Jimillar adadin rabo $= 8 + 12 + 15 + 18 = 53$
Jimillar babban jari $=$ Tk. $195000$

Babban jarin Ashik $= \left(195000 \times \frac{8}{53}\right) = \text{Tk}.29433.96$ (Amsa.)

Babban jarin Mizan $= \left(195000 \times \frac{12}{53}\right) = \text{Tk}.44150.94$ (Amsa.)

Babban jarin Anika $= \left(195000 \times \frac{15}{53}\right) = \text{Tk}.55188.68$ (Amsa.)

Babban jarin Ahona $= \left(195000 \times \frac{18}{53}\right) = \text{Tk}.66226.42$ (Amsa.)

Question:
Ashik, Mizan, Anika da Ahona sun fara kasuwanci tare da jimillar jarin Tk $195000$ kuma sun samu ribar Tk $26500$ bayan karewar shekara guda. A jarin kasuwancin, rabon Ashik: rabon Mizan $= 2:3$, rabon Mizan: rabon Anika $= 4:5$ kuma rabon Anika: rabon Ahona $= 5:6$.
An sake saka kashi $60\%$ na ribar a cikin kasuwancin a ƙarshen shekara. Idan an raba ragowar ribar bisa ga rabo na jarin, to tsakanin Ahona da Ashik, wa zai samu babbar adadin kuɗin ribar?
Solution:
Rinji a ƙarshen shekara $=$ Tk. $26500$
Zuba jari $= 60\%$ na $26500 = \frac{60}{100}$ na $26500 = \text{Tk}.15900$
$\therefore$ Saura $= (26500 - 15900) = \text{Tk}.10600$
Daga 'b',
Jimillar adadin rabo $= 53$
Rinji na Ashik $= \left(\frac{8}{53} \text{ na } 10600\right) = \text{Tk}. (200 \times 8)$
$= \text{Tk}.1600$
Rinji na Ahona $= \left(\frac{18}{53} \text{ na } 10600\right) = \text{Tk}. (200 \times 18)$
$= \text{Tk}. 3600$
Rinji mafi yawa da Ahona ya samu $=$ Tk. $(3600 - 1600)$
$= \text{Tk}.2000$
$\therefore$ Ahona ya samu Tk.$2000$ fiye da rinji (Amsa.)

Question:
Bayar da dalilai, ka faɗi ko waɗannan sassauƙan ma'auni na lokaci guda suna daidaituwa (consistent)/marasa daidaituwa (inconsistent), masu dogara juna (mutually dependent)/marasa dogara juna (mutually independent) sannan ka nuna adadin mafita:
1. $x - y = 4$
$x + y = 10$
Solution:
Wurin da aka ba mu na Madaidaicin Jennings: $x - y = 4$
$x + y = 10$
Rabo na coefficients na x shine $\frac{1}{1}$
Kuma rabo na coefficients na y shine $\frac{-1}{1}$
Mun samu, $\frac{1}{1} \ne \frac{-1}{1}$
Don haka, madaidaicin Jennings yana daidai kuma abubuwan da ke ciki ba su dogara da juna ba. Madaidaicin Jennings yana da mafita ɗaya kawai (na musamman).
Exact Answer:
Mun samu, $\frac{1}{1} \ne \frac{-1}{1}$
Saboda haka, tsarin dalar ya dace kuma dalar ba su da tasiri. Tsarin dalar yana da mafita ɗaya (mai ban mamaki) kawai.

Question:
Tsaftace ta hanyar jayayya ko tsarin ya dace/bai dace ba, ko kuma yan dambara-dambara ce/ba dambara ba, kuma ka nuna adadin mafita ga wadannan daidaitawa masu karo biyu masu sauki:

2. $2x + y = 3$
$4x + 2y = 6$
Solution:
Ga tsarin daidaitawa: $2x + y = 3$
$4x + 2y = 6$
Rabon ƙididdiga na x shine $\frac{2}{4}$ ko $\frac{1}{2}$
Rabon ƙididdiga na y shine $\frac{1}{2}$
kuma rabon lambobi marasa motsi shine $\frac{3}{6}$ ko $\frac{1}{2}$
$\therefore \frac{2}{4} = \frac{1}{2} = \frac{3}{6}$
Don haka, tsarin daidaitawar yana daidai kuma daidaitawar suna dogara ga juna. Tsarin daidaitawar yana da adadi mara iyaka na mafita.
Exact Answer: Saboda haka, tsarin daidaito yana daidai kuma daidaiton suna dogara ga juna. Tsarin daidaito yana da adadi mara iyaka na mafita.

Question:
A bayyana tare da muhawara ko waɗannan tsarin daidaitawa masu sauƙi suna da dacewa/rashin dacewa, dogaro da juna/rashin dogaro da juna, kuma a nuna adadin mafita guda ɗaya ko fiye ko babu.
3. $x - y - 4 = 0$
$3x - 3y - 10 = 0$
Solution:
Wannan tsarin na mahadi da aka bayar:
$x - y - 4 = 0$ \quad (i)
$3x - 3y - 10 = 0$ \quad (ii)
ko kuma, $\begin{cases} x - y = 4 \ldots \ldots \ldots \ldots \ldots \text{(iii)} \ 3x - 3y = 10 \ldots \ldots \ldots \ldots \ldots \text{(iv)} \end{cases}$
Rabon masu lamba na x shine $\frac{1}{3}$
Rabon masu lamba na y shine $\frac{-1}{-3}$ ko $\frac{1}{3}$
Kuma rabon adadi mara canzawa shine $\frac{4}{10}$ ko $\frac{2}{5}$
Muna samu, $\frac{1}{3} = \frac{-1}{-3} \ne \frac{4}{10}$
Saboda haka, tsarin mahadi bai dace ba kuma mahadodin ba su dogara da juna. Babu mafita ga tsarin mahadi.
Exact Answer: Don haka, tsarin da'awowi ba shi da cikakkiyar amsa kuma da'awowi ba su da alaƙa. Tsarin da'awowi ba shi da maslaha.

Question:
Bada dalilai kan ko masu zuwa masu tarin ma'auni masu sauƙi sun yi daidai/ba su yi daidai ba, sun dogara da juna/ba su dogara da juna ba, sannan kuma nuna adadin mafita.

4. $3x + 2y = 0$
   $6x + 4y = 0$
Solution:
Daidaitawa da aka bayar:
$3x + 2y = 0$
$6x + 4y = 0$
Rabon jami'an $x$ shine $\frac{3}{6}$ ko $\frac{1}{2}$
kuma rabon jami'an $y$ shine $\frac{2}{4}$ ko $\frac{1}{2}$
$\therefore \frac{3}{6} = \frac{2}{4}$ [$\because c_1 = c_2 = 0$]
Don haka, daidaitawar tana daidai kuma daidaitawar suna da dogaro ga juna. Daidaitawar tana da mafita mara iyaka.
Exact Answer:
$\therefore \frac{3}{6} = \frac{2}{4}$ [$\because c_1 = c_2 = 0$]
Don haka, tsarin da'awowi yana da daidaituwa kuma da'awowi suna dogara da juna. Tsarin da'awowi yana da adadi marar iyaka na mafita.

Question:
Kambani da dalilai ko waɗannan dāidaitawa masu sauƙi masu zaman kansu suna da mafita/babu mafita, suna dogara ga junansu/ba sa dogara ga junansu kuma nuna adadin mafita:

5. $3x + 2y = 0$
   $9x - 6y = 0$
Solution:
Ga tsarin daidaitawa: $3x + 2y = 0$
$9x - 6y = 0$
Rabon ma'auni na x shine $\frac{3}{9}$ ko $\frac{1}{3}$
kuma rabon ma'auni na y shine $\frac{2}{-6}$ ko $-\frac{1}{3}$
Muna samun, $\frac{3}{9} \ne \frac{2}{-6}$
Don haka, tsarin daidaitawar yana daidai kuma daidaitawar suna dogara ga junansu. Tsarin daidaitawar yana da mafita guda ɗaya kawai (na musamman).
Exact Answer: Saboda haka, tsarin daidaitawa yana daidai kuma ƙididdigar ba su da dogara ga juna. Tsarin daidaitawa yana da ɗaya (na musamman) bayani.

Question:
6. $5x - 2y = 16$
$15x - 6y = 10$
Solution:
Duba tsarin magance na equations:
$5x - 2y - 16 = 0$ \ldots \ldots \ldots (i)
$3x - \frac{6}{5}y = 2$ \ldots \ldots \ldots (ii)
ko kuma, $\begin{cases} 5x - 2y = 16 \ldots \ldots \ldots \text{(iii)} \ 3x - \frac{6}{5}y = 2 \ldots \ldots \ldots \text{(iv)} \end{cases}$
Rabon coefficients na x shine $\frac{5}{3}$
Rabon coefficients na y shine $\frac{-2}{-\frac{6}{5}}$ ko $\frac{5}{3}$
Rabon adadi marar canzawa shine $\frac{16}{2}$ ko $\frac{8}{1}$
Muna samu, $\frac{5}{3} = \frac{-2}{-\frac{6}{5}} \ne \frac{16}{2}$
Saboda haka, tsarin equations din bai dace ba kuma equations din ba su da alaka. Tsarin equations din babu wata mafita.
Exact Answer:
Mun samu, $\frac{5}{3} = \frac{-2}{-\frac{6}{5}} \ne \frac{16}{2}$
Saboda haka, tsarin daidaitawa ba shi daidai ba ne kuma daidaitawa suna da 'yanci ga juna. Tsarin daidaitawa babu mafita.

Question:
Bada dalilai kan ko waɗannan ma'auni biyu masu sauƙi ne masu dacewa/babu dacewa, masu dogaro da juna/masu zaman kansu kuma ka nuna adadin mafita.
$-\frac{1}{2}x + y = -1$
$x - 2y = 2$
Solution:
An baka tsarin daidaito:
$\frac{1}{2}x + y = -1$
$x - 2y = 2$

Rabo na coefficients na $x$ shine $\frac{\frac{1}{2}}{1}$ ko $\frac{1}{2}$
Rabo na coefficients na $y$ shine $\frac{1}{-2}$
Kuma rabo na tsayayyen lambobi (constant terms) shine $\frac{-1}{2}$

Muna samun, $\frac{\frac{1}{2}}{1} \neq \frac{1}{-2} = \frac{-1}{2}$

Don haka, tsarin daidaito ba shi daidai, kuma daidaito suna da 'yancin kansu. Tsarin daidaito yana da mafita guda ɗaya.
Exact Answer: Don haka, tsarin daidaito yana daidaitacce kuma daidaito suna dogara ga juna. Tsarin daidaito suna da adadi mara iyaka na mafita.

Question:
Tabbatar da dalilai ko waɗannan sauƙaƙƙun ma'auni na lokaci guda suna daidai/marasa daidai, masu dogaro da juna/masu zaman kansu, kuma ka nuna adadin mafita.
8. $-\frac{1}{2}x - y = 0$, $x - 2y = 0$
Solution:
Ga tsarin daidaitattun lissafin:
$-\frac{1}{2}x - y = 0$
$x - 2y = 0$
Rabo tsakanin masu ma'auni na x shine $\frac{-1/2}{1}$ ko $-\frac{1}{2}$
Rabo tsakanin masu ma'auni na y shine $\frac{-1}{-2}$ ko $\frac{1}{2}$
Muna samu, $\frac{-1}{2} \ne \frac{-1}{-2}$ [$\because c_1 = c_2 = 0$]
Don haka, tsarin daidaitattun lissafin yana da daidaituwa kuma daidaitattun lissafin basu da alaƙa da juna. Tsarin daidaitattun lissafin yana da mafita ɗaya tak (na musamman).
Exact Answer:
Muna samun, $\frac{-1}{2} \ne \frac{-1}{-2}$ [$\because c_1 = c_2 = 0$]
Saboda haka, tsarin daidaitattun lissafi yana daidai kuma daidaitattun lissafin ba su dogara da juna ba. Tsarin daidaitattun lissafin yana da ɗaya (na musamman) mafita.

Question:
Bayan haka, tare da dalilai, ku faɗi ko waɗannan *tsarin daidaitawa* masu sauƙi suna dacewa/marasa dacewa, masu dogaro da juna/masu dogaro da kansu, ku kuma nuna adadin mafita na:

9. $-\frac{1}{2}x + y = -1, x + y = 5$
Solution:
Ga tsarin farko na lissafin jimloli:
$-\frac{1}{2}x + y = -1$
$x + y = 5$

Rabon dumu-dumin da ke tare da x shine $\frac{-1/2}{1}$ ko $-\frac{1}{2}$
Rabon dumu-dumin da ke tare da y shine $\frac{1}{1}$ ko $1$
Muna samun, $\frac{-1}{2} \ne \frac{1}{1}$

Don haka, tsarin jimlolin yana da inganci kuma jimlolin ba su dogara ga juna ba. Tsarin jimlolin yana da ɗaya kawai (na musamman) mafita.
Exact Answer:
Muna samu, $\frac{-1}{2} \ne \frac{1}{1}$
Don haka, tsarin daidaito yana daidai kuma daidaiton ba su dogara ga juna ba. Tsarin daidaito yana da mafita ɗaya tak.

Question: Menuna da hujjar ko masu jituwa ne/marasa jituwa, dogara juna ne/ba dogara juna ba, kuma a nuna adadin mafita na wadannan masu jituwa masu sauƙi masu zuwa: 10. $ax - cy = 0$, $cx - ay = c^2 - a^2$
Solution:
Ga tsarin daidaitattun lissafin da aka bayar: $ax - cy = 0$
$cx - ay = c^2 - a^2$
Rabon ma'auni na x shine $\frac{a}{c}$
Rabon ma'auni na y shine $\frac{-c}{-a}$ ko $\frac{c}{a}$
Muna samu, $\frac{a}{c} \ne \frac{c}{a}$
Don haka, tsarin daidaitattun lissafin yana daidai kuma daidaitattun lissafin ba su dogara ga juna ba. Tsarin daidaitattun lissafin yana da mafita guda ɗaya (ta musamman).
Exact Answer:
Muna samun, $\frac{a}{c} \ne \frac{-c}{-a}$
Saboda haka, tsarin daidaito yana daidai kuma daidaitattun suna dogara da juna. Tsarin daidaito yana da ɗaya kawai (na musamman) mafita.

Question:
Warware ta hanyar maye gurbin:
\quad 7x - 3y = 31
9x - 5y = 41
Solution:
An bayar, $7x-3y=31 \dots\dots (i)$
$9x-5y=41 \dots\dots (ii)$
Daga lissafi (i), muna samu,
$7x = 31 + 3y$
ko kuma, $x = \frac{31+3y}{7} \dots\dots\dots (iii)$

Sanya darajar $x = \frac{31+3y}{7}$ a cikin lissafi (ii) muna
samun, $\frac{9(31+3y)}{7} - 5y = 41$
ko kuma, $\frac{279+27y}{7} - 5y = 41$
ko kuma, $\frac{279+27y-35y}{7} = 41$
ko kuma, $279 - 8y = 287 \quad \text{[ta hanyar wuce giciye da karɓa]}$
ko kuma, $-8y = 287 - 279 \quad \text{[ta hanyar canza wuri]}$
ko kuma, $-8y = 8$
$\therefore y = -1 \quad \text{[raba dukkan gefuna da (-8)]}$
Yanzu sanya darajar $y$ a cikin (iii)
$x = \frac{31 + 3(-1)}{7}$
$x = \frac{31 - 3}{7}$
$x = \frac{28}{7}$
$x = 4$
$\therefore \text{Maganar da ake buƙata : } (x, y) = (4, -1)$

Question:
Warware ta hanyar maye gurbin ruwa kamar haka:
$\frac{x}{2} + \frac{y}{3} = 1$
$\frac{x}{3} + \frac{y}{2} = 1$
Solution:
An bayar, \frac{x}{2} + \frac{y}{3} = 1 \quad \dots\dots \quad (i) \
\frac{x}{3} + \frac{y}{2} = 1 \quad \dots\dots \quad (ii) \
\
Daga lamba (i), muna samun \frac{x}{2} + \frac{y}{3} = 1 \
ko kuma, \frac{3x+2y}{6} = 1 \
\therefore 3x + 2y = 6 \quad \dots\dots \quad \text{(iii) [ta hanyar ninka dukkan bangarori da 6]} \
Daga lamba (ii), muna samun, \
\frac{x}{3} + \frac{y}{2} = 1 \
ko kuma, \frac{2x+3y}{6} = 1 \
ko kuma, 2x+3y=6 \quad \text{[ta hanyar ninka kusa-kusa]} \
ko kuma, 3y=6-2x \quad \text{[ta hanyar canja wuri]} \
\therefore y = \frac{6-2x}{3} \quad \dots\dots \quad \text{(iv)} \
Yanzu, ta hanyar saka darajar \
y = \frac{6-2x}{3} a cikin (iii) muna samun, \
3x + 2 \times \frac{6-2x}{3} = 6 \
ko kuma, 3x + \frac{12-4x}{3} = 6 \
ko kuma, \frac{9x+12-4x}{3} = 6 \
ko kuma, \frac{5x+12}{3} = 6 \
ko kuma, 5x+12 = 18 \quad \text{[ta hanyar ninka kusa-kusa]} \
ko kuma, 5x = 18-12 \quad \text{[ta hanyar canja wuri]} \
ko kuma, 5x = 6 \
\therefore x = \frac{6}{5} \text{ [ta hanyar raba dukkan bangarori da 5]} \
Yanzu, ta hanyar saka darajar x a cikin (iv) muna samun, \
y = \frac{6-2 \times \frac{6}{5}}{3} = \frac{6-\frac{12}{5}}{3} \
= \frac{\frac{30-12}{5}}{3} = \frac{\frac{18}{5}}{3} = \frac{18}{5 \times 3} = \frac{6}{5} \
\therefore Lissafi da ake buƙata (x, y) = \left( \frac{6}{5}, \frac{6}{5} \right)

Question:
Warware ta hanyar maye gurbin:
$\frac{x}{a} + \frac{y}{b} = 2$
$ax + by = a^2 + b^2$
Solution:
An bayar, $\frac{x}{a} + \frac{y}{b} = 2$ \quad \dotfill (i)
$ax + by = a^2 + b^2$ \quad \dotfill (ii)
Daga lamba (i), muna samun
$\frac{y}{b} = 2 - \frac{x}{a}$
ko kuma, $\frac{y}{b} = \frac{2a-x}{a}$
$\therefore y = \frac{2ab-bx}{a}$ \quad \dotfill (iii)
Yanzu, muna saka kimar $y = \frac{2ab-bx}{a}$ a cikin lamba
(iii) muna samun,
$ax + \frac{b(2ab-bx)}{a} = a^2 + b^2$
ko kuma, $\frac{a^2x + 2ab^2 - b^2x}{a} = a^2 + b^2$
ko kuma, $a^2x - b^2x + 2ab^2 = a^3 + ab^2$
[ta hanyar haɗawa daidai]
ko kuma, $a^2x - b^2x = a^3 + ab^2 - 2ab^2$ [Ta hanyar motsi]
ko kuma, $x(a^2 - b^2) = a^3 - ab^2$
ko kuma, $x(a^2 - b^2) = a(a^2 - b^2)$
ko kuma, $x = \frac{a(a^2-b^2)}{(a^2-b^2)} \therefore x=a$
Yanzu, muna saka kimar x a (iii) muna samun,
$y = \frac{2ab-ab}{a} = \frac{ab}{a} \therefore y=b$
$\therefore$ Neman Maganin$(x,y) = (a, b)$.

Question:
Warware ta hanyar maye gurbin $7x - 3y = 31$
$9x - 5y = 41$
Solution:
An bayar, $7x - 3y = 31$ \dotfill (i)
$9x - 5y = 41$ \dotfill (ii)
Ta hanyar ninka (i) da 5 da kuma (ii) da 3 muna samu,
$35x - 15y = 155$ \dotfill (iii)
$27x - 15y = 123$ \dotfill (iv)
Ta hanyar cire lissafi (iv) daga lissafi (iii), muna samu,
$(35x - 15y) - (27x - 15y) = 155 - 123$
ko, $35x - 15y - 27x + 15y = 32$
ko, $8x = 32$
$\therefore x = 4$ [ta hanyar raba kowane bangare da 8]
Yanzu, ta hanyar saka kimar x a (i) muna samu,
$7 \times 4 - 3y = 31$
ko, $28 - 3y = 31$
ko, $-3y = 31 - 28$
ko, $-3y = 3$
$\therefore y = -1$ [ta hanyar raba kowane bangare da (-3)]
$\therefore$ Nemi Bayani$(x, y) = (4, -1)$

Question:
Warware ta hanyar maye gurbin:
$7x - 8y = -9$
$5x - 4y = -3$
Solution:
Dolewar da aka bayar sune,
$7x - 8y = -9$ \dotfill (i)
$5x - 4y = -3$ \dotfill (ii)
Yin ninka dukkan bangarorin lamba (ii) da
$7x - 8y = -9$
$10x - 8y = -6$
$-3x = -3$ [ta hanyar ragi]
ko, $x = 1$ [ta hanyar raba dukkan bangarori da (-3)]
$\therefore x = 1$
Yanzu, saka kimar x a cikin (ii) muna samu,
$5 \cdot 1 - 4y = -3$
ko, $5 - 4y = -3$
ko, $-4y = -3 - 5$
ko, $-4y = -8$
ko, $y = 2$ [ta hanyar raba dukkan bangarori da (-4)]
$\therefore y = 2$
$\therefore$ Maganin da ake bukata$(x, y) = (1, 2)$

Question:
Warware ta hanyar maye gurbin:
$ax + by = c$
$a^2x + b^2y = c^2$
Solution:
An bayar, $ax + by = c$ \dotfill (i)
$a^2x + b^2y = c^2$ \dotfill (ii)
Ta hanyar ninka lissafi (i) da $b$ muna samu,
$abx + b^2y = bc$ \dotfill (iii)
Sa'ad da muka cire lissafi (ii) daga lissafi (iii) muna samu,
$(abx + b^2y) - (a^2x + b^2y) = bc - c^2$
ko kuma, $abx - a^2x = bc - c^2$
ko kuma, $x(ab - a^2) = bc - c^2$
ko kuma, $x = \frac{bc - c^2}{ab - a^2}$
$\therefore x = \frac{c(b - c)}{a(b - a)}$
Yanzu, sa'ad da muka sanya darajar $x$ a (i) muna samu,
$a \times \frac{c(b - c)}{a(b - a)} + by = c$
ko kuma, $\frac{c(b - c)}{b - a} + by = c$
ko kuma, $by = c - \frac{c(b - c)}{b - a}$
ko kuma, $by = \frac{c(b - a) - c(b - c)}{b - a}$
ko kuma, $by = \frac{cb - ca - cb + c^2}{b - a}$
ko kuma, $by = \frac{c^2 - ca}{b - a}$
ko kuma, $by = \frac{c(c - a)}{b - a}$
$\therefore y = \frac{c(c - a)}{b(b - a)}$
$\therefore$ Nema Wajen Magani$(x, y) = \left(\frac{c(b - c)}{a(b - a)}, \frac{c(c - a)}{b(b - a)}\right)$

Question:
Warware ta hanyar kere-keren karkata:
$2x + 3y + 5 = 0$
$4x + 7y + 6 = 0$
Solution:
An bayar, $2x + 3y + 5 = 0$ \dotfill (i)
$4x + 7y + 6 = 0$ \dotfill (ii)
Ta amfani da hanyar ninkawa (cross-multiplying) a cikin lissafi (i)
da (ii) muna samu, $\frac{x}{3 \times 6 - 7 \times 5} = \frac{y}{5 \times 4 - 6 \times 2} = \frac{1}{2 \times 7 - 4 \times 3}$
ko kuma, $\frac{x}{18 - 35} = \frac{y}{20 - 12} = \frac{1}{14 - 12}$
ko kuma, $\frac{x}{-17} = \frac{y}{8} = \frac{1}{2}$
$\therefore \frac{x}{-17} = \frac{1}{2}$
ko kuma, $x = -\frac{17}{2}$ da $\frac{y}{8} = \frac{1}{2}$ ko kuma, $y = \frac{8}{2} = 4$
$\therefore x = -8\frac{1}{2}$ da $y = 4$
$\therefore$ Amsar da ake bukata$(x, y) = \left(-\frac{17}{2}, 4\right)$

Question:
Ku warware ma'auni masu zuwa ta hanyar ninkawa da gyara:
$3x - 5y + 9 = 0$
$5x - 3y - 1 = 0$
Solution:
An bayar, $3x - 5y + 9 = 0$ \dotfill (i)
$5x - 3y - 1 = 0$ \dotfill (ii)
Ta hanyar amfani da hanyar ninkawa ta gicciye a cikin lissafi (i) da (ii) muna samun,
$\frac{x}{(-5)(-1) - (-3) \times 9} = \frac{y}{9 \times 5 - (-1) \times 3} = \frac{1}{3 \times (-3) - 5 \times (-5)}$
ko, $\frac{x}{5 + 27} = \frac{y}{45 + 3} = \frac{1}{-9 + 25}$
ko, $\frac{x}{32} = \frac{y}{48} = \frac{1}{16}$
Don haka, $\frac{x}{32} = \frac{1}{16}$
ko, $x = \frac{32}{16} = 2$ da $\frac{y}{48} = \frac{1}{16}$
ko, $y = \frac{48}{16} = 3$
Don haka, Mafita da ake buƙata $(x, y) = (2, 3)$

Question:
Warware ta hanyar gamawa ta giciye
$x + 2y = 7$
$2x - 3y = 0$
Solution:
An bayar, $x + 2y = 7$ \dotfill (i)
$2x - 3y = 0$ \dotfill (ii)
Ta hanyar mayar da gefen dama na dukkan ilahihai zuwa 0 (sifili) ta hanyar canza wuri, muna samu,
$x + 2y - 7 = 0$
$2x - 3y + 0 = 0$
Yanzu da muke amfani da hanyar ƙarewar haɗin kai a cikin ilahihai (i) da (ii) muna samu,
$\frac{x}{2 \times 0 - (-3) \times (-7)} = \frac{y}{(-7) \times 2 - 0 \times 1} = \frac{1}{1 \times (-3) - 2 \times 2}$
ko, $\frac{x}{0 - 21} = \frac{y}{-14 - 0} = \frac{1}{-3 - 4}$
ko, $\frac{x}{-21} = \frac{y}{-14} = \frac{1}{-7}$
$\therefore \frac{x}{-21} = \frac{1}{-7}$
ko, $x = \frac{-21}{-7} = 3$ kuma $\frac{y}{-14} = \frac{1}{-7}$
ko, $y = \frac{-14}{-7} = 2$
$\therefore$ Saurin Magani$(x, y) = (3, 2)$

Question:
Warware ta hanyar ninkawa da karkatawa:
$4x + 3y = -12$
$2x = 5$
Solution:
Abubuwan da aka bayar sune,
$4x + 3y = -12$ \dotfill (i)
$2x = 5$ \dotfill (ii)
Ta hanyar canja wurin abubuwan zuwa gefen dama na kowace lissafi domin ya zama 0 (sifili), muna samu,
$4x + 3y + 12 = 0$
$2x + 0y - 5 = 0$
Yanzu ta hanyar amfani da hanyar ninkawa da giciye a cikin lissafi (i) da (ii) muna samu,
$\frac{x}{3 \times (-5) - 0 \times 12} = \frac{y}{12 \times 2 - 4 \times (-5)} = \frac{1}{4 \times 0 - 2 \times 3}$
ko kuma, $\frac{x}{-15 - 0} = \frac{y}{24 + 20} = \frac{1}{0 - 6}$
ko kuma, $\frac{x}{-15} = \frac{y}{44} = \frac{1}{-6}$
$\therefore \frac{x}{-15} = \frac{1}{-6}$ ko $\frac{y}{44} = \frac{1}{-6}$
ko kuma, $x = \frac{-15}{-6}$ ko, $y = \frac{44}{-6}$
$\therefore x = \frac{5}{2}$ ko, $y = -\frac{22}{3} \therefore y = -7\frac{1}{3}$
$\therefore$ Mafi kyawun magani $(x, y) = \left(\frac{5}{2}, -7\frac{1}{3}\right)$

Question:
Warware ta hanyar tsallake-wuri:
$-7x + 8y = 9$
$5x - 4y = -3$
Solution:
An bayar, $-7x + 8y = 9$ \dotfill (i)
$5x - 4y = -3$ \dotfill (ii)
Ta hanyar canza wuri don sanya gefen dama na dukkan Equations ya zama 0 (sifili), mun samu,
$-7x + 8y - 9 = 0$
$5x - 4y + 3 = 0$
Yanzu, ta amfani da hanyar gyara ta hanyar ninkawa (cross-multiplying method) a cikin Equations (i) da (ii) mun samu,
$\frac{x}{8 \times 3 - (-4) \times (-9)} = \frac{y}{(-9) \times 5 - 3 \times (-7)} = \frac{1}{(-7) \times (-4) - 5 \times 8}$
ko kuma, $\frac{x}{24 - 36} = \frac{y}{-45 + 21} = \frac{1}{28 - 40}$
ko kuma, $\frac{x}{-12} = \frac{y}{-24} = \frac{1}{-12}$
$\therefore \frac{x}{-12} = \frac{1}{-12}$ ko kuma, $x = \frac{-12}{-12} = 1$ da kuma $\frac{y}{-24} = \frac{1}{-12}$
ko kuma, $y = \frac{-24}{-12} = 2$
$\therefore$ Ma'auni da ake bukata $(x, y) = (1, 2)$

Question:
Warware ta hanyar **rabe-raben gicciye** $3x - y - 7 = 0$
$2x + y - 3 = 0$
Solution:
An bayar da waɗannan ƙididdigar:
$3x - y - 7 = 0$ \dotfill (i)
$2x + y - 3 = 0$ \dotfill (ii)
Yanzu, ta amfani da hanyar gamawa ta faɗaɗawa a cikin ƙididdiga (i) da (ii) muna samun,
$\frac{x}{(-1) \times (-3) - 1 \times (-7)} = \frac{y}{(-7) \times 2 - 3 \times (-3)} = \frac{1}{3 \times 1 - 2 \times (-1)}$
ko kuma, $\frac{x}{3 + 7} = \frac{y}{-14 + 9} = \frac{1}{3 + 2}$
ko kuma, $\frac{x}{10} = \frac{y}{-5} = \frac{1}{5}$
\therefore $\frac{x}{10} = \frac{1}{5}$ da $\frac{y}{-5} = \frac{1}{5}$
ko kuma, $x = \frac{10}{5}$ ko kuma, $y = \frac{-5}{5}$
\therefore $x = 2$, $y = -1$
\therefore Mafi Dacce Magani$(x, y) = (2, -1)$

Question:
Warware ta hanyar **ƙanƙarewa** (ko **wuce-wuce-ninka**):
$ax + by = a^2 + b^2$
$2bx - ay = ab$
Solution:
An bayar, $ax + by = a^2 + b^2$ \dotfill (i)
$2bx - ay = ab$ \dotfill (ii)
Ta hanyar motsa bayan abubuwan zuwa gefen sifili na d'aya na d'ar'arori, muna samun,
$ax + by - (a^2 + b^2) = 0$
$2bx - ay - ab = 0$
Yanzu ta amfani da hanyar ninkawa ta k'etare a d'ar'arori (i) da (ii) muna samun,
$\frac{x}{b \times (-ab) - (-a) \times \{-(a^2 + b^2)\}} = \frac{y}{-(a^2 + b^2) \times 2b - (-ab) \times a} = \frac{1}{a \times (-a) - 2b \times b}$
ko, $\frac{x}{-ab^2 - a(a^2 + b^2)} = \frac{y}{-2b(a^2 + b^2) + a^2b} = \frac{1}{-a^2 - 2b^2}$
ko, $\frac{x}{-ab^2 - a^3 - ab^2} = \frac{y}{-2a^2b - 2b^3 + a^2b} = \frac{1}{-a^2 - 2b^2}$
ko, $\frac{x}{-a^3 - 2ab^2} = \frac{y}{-a^2b - 2b^3} = \frac{1}{-a^2 - 2b^2}$
ko, $\frac{x}{-a(a^2 + 2b^2)} = \frac{y}{-b(a^2 + 2b^2)} = \frac{1}{-(a^2 + 2b^2)}$
ko, $\frac{x}{a} = \frac{y}{b} = \frac{1}{1}$ [ta hanyar ninkawa da $-(a^2 + 2b^2)$]
$\therefore \frac{x}{a} = \frac{1}{1}$ ko, $x = a$ da $\frac{y}{b} = \frac{1}{1}$ ko, $y = b$
$\therefore$ Maganin da ake nema$(x, y) = (a, b)$

Question:
Warware ta hanyar ƙetare-hadawa $y(3 + x) = x(6 + y)$
$3(3 + x) = 5(y - 1)$
Solution:
An bayar, $y(3 + x) = x(6 + y)$ \dotfill (i)
$3(3 + x) = 5(y - 1)$ \dotfill (ii)
Daga lissafin (i) muna samu,
$3y + xy = 6x + xy$
ko kuma, $6x + xy - 3y - xy = 0$
ko kuma, $6x - 3y = 0$
Daga lissafin (ii) muna samu,
$9 + 3x = 5y - 5$
ko kuma, $3x - 5y + 9 + 5 = 0$
ko kuma, $3x - 5y + 14 = 0$
Don haka sabon tsarin lissafin (i) da (ii) kamar haka:
$6x - 3y + 0 = 0$ \dotfill (iii)
$3x - 5y + 14 = 0$ \dotfill (iv)
Yanzu ta yin amfani da hanyar ninkawa ta giciye a lissafi (iii) da (iv) muna samu,
$\frac{x}{(-3) \times 14 - (-5) \times 0} = \frac{y}{0 \times 3 - 6 \times 14} = \frac{1}{6 \times (-5) - 3 \times (-3)}$
ko kuma, $\frac{x}{-42 + 0} = \frac{y}{0 - 84} = \frac{1}{-30 + 9}$
ko kuma, $\frac{x}{-42} = \frac{y}{-84} = \frac{1}{-21}$
$\therefore \frac{x}{-42} = \frac{1}{-21}$ ko kuma, $x = \frac{-42}{-21} = 2$
kuma $\frac{y}{-84} = \frac{1}{-21}$ ko kuma, $y = \frac{-84}{-21} = 4$
$\therefore$ Maganin da ake buƙata$(x, y) = (2, 4)$

Question:
A warware ta hanyar ninkawa ta giciye:
$(x+2)(y-3) = y(x-1)$
$5x - 11y - 8 = 0$
Solution:
An bayar, $(x+2)(y-3) = y(x-1)$ \dotfill (i)
$5x - 11y - 8 = 0$ \dotfill (ii)
Daga lissafi (i) mun samu,
$(x+2)(y-3) = y(x-1)$
ko kuma, $xy + 2y - 3x - 6 = xy - y$
ko kuma, $xy - y - xy - 2y + 3x + 6 = 0$
ko kuma, $3x - 3y + 6 = 0$
$\therefore x - y + 2 = 0$ \dotfill (iii)
Yanzu, ta hanyar yin ninkas-ninkas a lissafi (iii) da (iv) mun samu,
$\frac{x}{(-1) \times (-8) - (-11) \times 2} = \frac{y}{2 \times 5 - (-8) \times 1} = \frac{1}{1 \times (-11) - 5 \times (-1)}$
