Question: Bari a ga wani akwatun sarai da ke tsaye a kan wani murabba'in gini mai faɗin murabba'in mita $48$. Tsayinsa $3$ m ne kuma diagonal ɗinsa $13$ m ne. Tantance tsawon da faɗin akwatun sarai.
Solution:
Bari, tsawon murabba'i mai juzu'i $=a$ m
Nisa, $''$ $''$ $''$ $=b$ m
$\therefore$ Yankin kasa $=ab$ murabba'in mita $=48$ murabba'in mita
Mun sani, tsawon diagonal na murabba'i mai juzu'i $=\sqrt{a^2+b^2+c^2}$
An bayar, tsayi, $c=3$ m.
$\therefore 13=\sqrt{a^2+b^2+3^2}$
ko, $169=a^2+b^2+9$ [ta hanyar sanyawa dukkan bangarori murabba'i]
ko, $a^2+b^2=169-9=160$ ......... (i)
Mun sani, $(a+b)^2=a^2+b^2+2ab$
$=160+2\times 48 [\therefore a^2+b^2=160\text{ da }ab=48]$
$=256$
$\therefore a+b=\sqrt{256}=16$ ......... (ii)
Kuma, $(a-b)^2=a^2+b^2-2ab$
$=160-96=64$
$\therefore a-b=8$ ......... (iii)
Yanzu ta hanyar tara (ii) da (iii) muna samun,
$2a=24$
ko, $a=12$
kuma ta hanyar cire (iii) daga (ii) muna samun,
$2b=8$,
ko, $b=4$
Don haka, tsawon $12$ m. da nisa $4$ m.
Amsa. Tsawon shine $12$ m. da nisa shine $4$ m.

Question: Ma'aunan wajen akwatin katako mai siffar *tsawonka* sune $8$ cm., $6$ cm. da $4$ cm. bi da bi, kuma jimillar fadin saman ciki shine $88$ cm$^2$. Nemi kaurin katako na akwatin.
Solution:
Bari, kaurin katakon akwatin ya kasance $x$ cm.
Na gefunan ciki,
tsawonsa, $a=(8-2x)$ cm.
fadinsa, $b=(6-2x)$ cm. da
tsayinsa, $c=(4-2x)$ cm.
$\therefore$ Girman dukkan saman ciki na akwatin
$=2(ab+bc+ca)$ sq.cm
$=2\{(8-2x)(6-2x)+(6-2x)(4-2x)+(8-2x)(6-2x)\}$
$=2(24-20x+4x^2+32-24x+4x^2+48-28x+4x^2)$
$=2(12x^2-72x+104)$
A cewar tambayar,
$2(12x^2-72x+104)=88$
ko, $12x^2-72x+104=44$ [ta hanyar raba dukkan bangarori da 2]
ko, $12x^2-72x+104-44=0$
ko, $12x^2-72x+60=0$
ko, $12(x^2-6x+5)=0$
ko, $x^2-6x+5=0$
ko, $x^2-5x-x+5=0$
ko, $x(x-5)-1(x-5)=0$
ko, $(x-5)(x-1)=0$
Ko dai, $(x-5)=0$ ko, $(x-1)=0$
$\therefore x=5$ $\therefore x=1$
Amma kaurin akwatin ba zai iya wuce fadiwarsa ba wato $x \ne 5$
$\therefore x=1$
Ams. Kaurin akwatin shine $1$ cm.

Question: Tsawon bango yana da mita $25$, tsayinsa yana da mita $6$, kuma faɗinsa yana da santimita $30$. Tsawon bulo, faɗinsa, da tsayinsa shine santimita $10$, $5$ cm, da $3$ cm. bi da bi. Tantance adadin bulo da ake buƙata don gina bangon da bulo.
Solution:
Bari, tsawon bangon, $a=25$ m.
$=25\times 100$ cm.
$=2500$ cm.
Tsawo $b=6$ m.
$=6\times 100$ cm. [$\therefore 1$ m. $=100$ cm.]
$=600$ cm.
da kuma kauri $c=30$ cm.
$\therefore$ Ƙimar bango $=abc$ cm$^3$.
$=2500\times 600\times 30$ cm$^3$.
$=45000000$ cm$^3$.

Kuma,
Bari, tsawon bulo $p=10$ cm.
nisa $''$ $''$ $q=5$ cm.
da kuma tsawo $''$ $''$ $r=3$ cm.
$\therefore$ Ƙimar bulo $=pqr$ cm$^3$.
$=10\times 5\times 3$ cm$^3$.
$=150$ cm$^3$.

Bari yawan bulo da ake buƙata don gina bangon $=x$
Don haka, ƙimar bango $=x\times$ ƙimar bulo
$=x\times 150$ cm$^3$.
$=150x$ cm$^3$.

Dangane da tambayar,
$150x=45000000$
ko kuma, $x=\frac{45000000}{150}$
$\therefore x=300000$
$\therefore$ Yawan bulo da ake buƙata don gina bangon shine $300000$

Question: Yankin saman kowane fuska na kubu na da girman murabba'i 400 cm. Nema tsawon diagonal na kubu.
Solution:
Bari, $a$ ya zama gefen siffar kubu.
$\therefore$ Girman dukkan sararin saman $=6a^2$ santimita murabba'i.
A bisa ga tambayar, $6a^2=2400$
ko kuma, $a^2=\frac{2400}{6}$
ko kuma, $a^2=400$
$\therefore a=20$
$\therefore$ Gefen kubu $=20$ cm.
$\therefore$ Diagonal na kubu $=\sqrt{3}a$ cm.
$=\sqrt{3}\times 20$ cm.
$=34.641$ cm. (Kimantawa)

Question: Dangane da silinda mai tsawon $12$ cm da **jarabkasar** gindinsa $5$ cm. Nemo jimillar fa'idodin jikin silinda da kuma ƙarar silinda.
Solution:
Bari, tsayin silinda $h=12$ cm. da kuma **jarabbin gindin** $r=5$ cm.
$\therefore$ Girman dukan saman $=2\pi r (r+h)$ murabba'in raka'a
$=2\times 3.1416\times 5\times (5+12)$ murabba'in cm.
$=6.2832\times 5\times 17$ murabba'in cm.
$=534.072$ murabba'in cm. (kusan)
kuma ƙarar silinda $=\pi r^2 h$ cm$^3$.
$=3.1416\times 5^2 \times 12$ cm$^3$.
$=942.48$ cm$^3$. (kusan)

Question: An ba da cewa **sararin kewaye** na silindarin da'irar mai dama ya kai $100$ santimita murabba'i, kuma **ƙididdigar ƙusaginsa** ya kai $150$ santimita sanyi. Nemi tsayin silinda da kuma radius ɗinsa.
Solution:
Bari, tsayin silinda ya kasance h cm.
kuma **diamita** tushe shine r cm.
Akwai faɗin gefen silinda $=2\pi rh$ murabba'in raka'a
kuma ƙarar sa $=\pi r^2 h$ cm$^3$
Dangane da tambayar,
$2\pi rh = 100$ ......... (i)
$\pi r^2 h = 150$ ......... (ii)
Daga (ii) $\div$ (i) muke samu,
ko, $\frac{\pi r^2 h}{2\pi rh} = \frac{150}{100}$
ko, $\frac{r}{2}=1.5$
ko, $r=1.5\times 2$
$\therefore r=3$
Don haka, **diamita** tushe $=3$ cm.
Saka darajar r a (i) muke samu,
$2\pi\times 3\times h = 100$
ko, $6\times 3.1416\times h = 100$
ko, $h=\frac{100}{6\times 3.1416}$
$\therefore h=5.305$
Don haka tsayin silinda $=5.305$ cm.

Question: Area na sararin bangaren zagayawar sililin dama shine $4400$ murabba'in santimita. Idan tsayinsa shine $30$ santimita, nemi girman dukkan sararin bangarensa.
Solution:
Bari, tsawon silinda mai madauwari daidai gwargwado, $h=30$ cm.
kuma **jari** na gindin sa shine $r$ cm.
$\therefore$ Girman saman karkata $=2\pi rh$ murabba'in raka'a
$=2\times 3.1416\times r\times 30$ murabba'in cm.
$=60\times 3.1416\times r$ murabba'in cm.
A bisa ga tambayar, $60\times 3.1416\times r=4400$
ko kuma, $r=\frac{4400}{60\times 3.1416}=\frac{220}{3\times 3.1416}$
$\frac{220}{9.4248}=23.34267$
$\therefore$ **Jari** na gindin sa $r=23.34267$ cm. (kamar haka)
$\therefore$ Girman dukkan saman silinda
$=2\pi r (r+h)$ murabba'in cm.
$=2\times 3.1416\times 23.34267 (23.34267+30)$ murabba'in cm.
$=6.2832\times 23.34267\times 53.34267$ murabba'in cm.
$=7823.6$ murabba'in cm. (kamar haka)
$\therefore$ Girman dukkan saman silinda shine $7823.6$ murabba'in cm.

Question: A ce ana da bututun ƙarfe wanda diamita na ciki da na waje sune $12$ cm. da $14$ cm. bi da bi, kuma tsayin bututun shine $5$ mita, nemo nauyin bututun ƙarfe inda nauyin $1$ cm$^3$ na ƙarfe shine $7.2$ gm.
Solution:
An ba da, diamita na ciki na bututu $=12$ cm.
kuma diamita na waje na bututu $=14$ cm.
Tsayi $h=5$ m. $=5\times 100$ cm.
$=500$ cm.
kuma an ba da cewa nauyin $7.2$ gm na Bakin Karfe yana daidai da $1$ cm$^3$.
Mun sani,
ƙarar silinda $=\pi r^2 h$ cm$^3$.
$\therefore$ Ƙarar waje na bututu $=\pi\times (\frac{14}{2})^2 \times 500$ cm$^3$.
$=76969.2$ cm$^3$. (kusan)
kuma ƙarar ciki na bututu $=\pi\times (\frac{12}{2})^2 \times 500$ cm$^3$.
$=56548.8$ cm$^3$. (kusan)
Yanzu,
Ƙarar Bakin Karfe $=$ Ƙarar waje na bututu $-$ Ƙarar ciki na bututu
$=(76969.2-56548.8)$ cm$^3$.
$=20420.4$ cm$^3$. (kusan)
$\therefore$ Nauyin Bakin Karfe na bututu $=20420.4\times 7.2$ gm
$=147026.88$ gm
$=\frac{147026.88}{1000}$ kg
$=147.027$ kg (kusan)

Question: A ce dai yankin murabba'i da yankin rectangular suna da girman iyaka iri ɗaya. Tsawon rectangular ɗin ya fi faɗinsa sau 3 kuma yankinsa yawan murabba'i na mita 1200. Tantance iyakar rectangular ɗin ta amfani da alamar tambaya, x.
Solution:
Daga cikin, Tsawon rectangle = x mita
Tsawon faɗi = 3x mita
\therefore Perimeter na Rectangle = 2(x + 3x) = 2 \times 4x
= 8x mita

Question: Tarin murabba'i da kuma tarin siffar rectangle suna da ma'auni iri ɗaya. Tsawon siffar rectangle ɗin ya ninka ninki uku na faffadarsa, kuma **faɗinsa** ita ce murabba'i 1200 mita. Nemi faɗin tarin murabba'i.
Solution:
Area na rectangle = (3x \times x) sq. m = 3x^2 sq. m
A bisa ga tambayar, 3x^2 = 1200
ko kuma, x^2 = \frac{1200}{3}
ko kuma, x^2 = 400
\therefore x = 20 mita
\therefore Nisa na rectangle = 20 m
Tsawon rectangle = (3 \times 20) m = 60 m
\therefore Perimeter na rectangle = 2(60 + 20) m
= (2 \times 80) m
= 160 mita

Bari, gefe ɗaya na murabba'i = a m
Perimeter na wannan murabba'i = 4a m
Tun da, Perimeter na wannan murabba'i = Perimeter na wannan rectangle
\therefore 4a = 160 [Daga 'a']
ko kuma, a = \frac{160}{4}
\therefore a = 40 mita
Mun sani,
Area na murabba'i = a^2 sq. unit = (40)^2 sq. m
= 1600 sq. mita

Question: Aniyayi lissafin kewayen wani yanki mai siffar murabba'i da kuma wani yanki mai siffar rectangle. Tsawon rectangle din shine sau 3 na fadiwarsa kuma yankinsa shine murabba'i 1200 mita. A yi la'akari da wata hanya mai fadin mita 1.5 wadda ke kewaye da yankin rectangle din. Nawa ne tarkunan yanki 25x12.5 murabba'i cm za a bukata domin rufe hanyar?
Solution:
Tsawon murabba'i mai iyaka $= 60$ m, nisa $= 20$ m

Tsawon murabba'i mai iyaka har da titin $= (60 + 2\times 1.5)$ m.
$= (60 + 3)$ m.
$= 63$ m.

Nisan murabba'i mai iyaka har da titin $= (20 + 2\times 1.5)$ m.
$= (20 + 3)$ m.
$= 23$ m.

Kekaren murabba'i mai iyaka har da titin $= (63 \times 23)$ murabba'i m.
$= 1449$ murabba'i m.
Kekaren murabba'i mai iyaka ba tare da titi ba
$= (\text{Tsawon} \times \text{nisan}) $ murabba'i raka'a
$= (60 \times 20)$ murabba'i m.
$= 1200$ murabba'i m.
$\therefore$ Kekaren titin $= (1449 - 1200)$ murabba'i m. $= 249$ murabba'i m.

An ba da cewa, kekaren saman bulo $= 25 \times 12.5$ murabba'i cm
$= \frac{25 \times 12.5}{100 \times 100}$ murabba'i m.
$= .03125$ murabba'i m.
Don haka, adadin bulo $= \frac{249}{.03125}$
$= 79.68$

Question: Nemo lambar da ba ta da iyaka a tsakanin $\sqrt{3}$ da $4$.
Solution:
Anan, $\sqrt{3}=1.7320508 \ldots$
 
Bari mu yi tunanin cewa, $a=\dfrac{\sqrt{3}+4}{2} \approx 2.866$ da $b=\dfrac{\sqrt{3}+4+4}{3} \approx 3.244$

A bayyane yake cewa $a$ da $b$ duka lambobi ne na gaske kuma duka biyun sun fi $\sqrt{3}$ girma kuma sun fi $4$ ƙanƙanta saboda
$a$ shine matsakaici na lambobi biyu marasa daidaituwa $\sqrt{3}$ da $4$, kuma $b$ shine matsakaici na lambobi $\sqrt{3}, \ 4 $ da $4$. 

Wannan yana nufin, $\sqrt{3} < 2.866 < 4$ da $\sqrt{3} < 3.244 < 4$

Bugu da ƙari, ba za a iya bayyana $a$ da $b$ a matsayin ɓangarori ba.

$ \therefore a$ da $b$ sune lambobin da ake bukata. 

A gaskiya ma za mu iya gina adadi marasa iyaka na irin waɗannan lambobi na sha'iri.
Exact Answer: a da b su ne lambobi masu so.

Question: Tabbatar da cewa idan aka ƙara ɗaya ga samfurin lambobi na halitta guda $4$ da ke biye da juna, hakan zai zama cikakken murabba'i.
Solution:
Bari jimlar lambobi masu biyowa su kasance  $x, \ x+1, \ x+2, \ x+3$।

Idan muka ƙara $1$ zuwa samfurin waɗannan lambobi $4$ muna samun:

\qquad $x(x+1)(x+2)(x+3)+1$

\qquad $=x(x+3)(x+1)(x+2)+1$

\qquad $=(x^2+3x)(x^2+3x+2)+1$

\qquad $=a(a+2)+1 \ \text{[A ɗauka $x^2+3x = a$  ]}$

\qquad $= a^2+2a+1 = (a+1)^2$

\qquad $=(x^2+3x+1)^2$

wanda cikakkiyar murabba'i ne. Don haka lokacin da aka ƙara $1$ zuwa samfurin kowace lambobi guda huɗu masu biyowa na halitta wannan cikakkiyar murabba'i ne.

Question: Tubah wajen jujjuya danyen lambobin nan masu maimaitawa na kaso $0.\dot{3}$, $0.\dot{2}\dot{4}$, da kuma $42.34\dot{7}\dot{8}$ zuwa kaso na gama gari.
Canza $5.23\overline{457}$ zuwa fraction na gama gari.
Tebura $45.2\dot{3}4\dot{6}$ zuwa dabra gaba-ɗaya.
Solution:
45.2$\dot{3}$4$\dot{6}$=$\dfrac{452346-452}{9990}$=$\dfrac{451894}{9990}$=$\dfrac{225947}{4995}$=$45\dfrac{1172}{4995}$\\
$\therefore$ Ƙimar da ake so a matsayin ɓangaren lambobi ita ce $45\dfrac{1172}{4995}$.

Question: Sanya $32.\dot{5}6\dot{7}$ zuwa wata fraction ta al'ada.
Canja $5.\dot{6}$, $7.3\dot{4}\dot{5}$, da $10.78\dot{4}2\dot{3}$ zuwa ɓacaccen maimaitawa.
Solution:
Lambobin da ke maimaitawa a cikin adadi, kamar $5.\dot{6}$, $7.3\dot{4}\dot{5}$, da $10.78\dot{4}2\dot{3}$, suna da adadi mara maimaitawa daidai da $0$, $1$, da $2$ a jere. A nan, $10.78\dot{4}2\dot{3}$ tana da mafi yawan adadi a ɓangaren da ba ya maimaitawa. Don haka, domin mu canza su zuwa irin waɗannan lambobin maimaitawa, dole ne mu sami adadi $2$ a ɓangaren da ba ya maimaitawa na kowace lamba. Lambobin maimaitawa $5.\dot{6}$, $7.3\dot{4}\dot{5}$, da $10.78\dot{4}2\dot{3}$ suna da adadi $1$, $2$, da $3$ a jere a ɓangaren da ke maimaitawa, bi da bi.

Babbancin ƙarancin lamba (LCM) na $1$, $2$, da $3$ shine $6$. Saboda haka, domin mu canza su zuwa irin waɗannan lambobin maimaitawa, dole ne mu sami adadi $6$ a ɓangaren da ke maimaitawa na kowace lamba.

Don haka:
$5.\dot{6} = 5.6\overline{666666}$
$7.3\dot{4}\dot{5} = 7.3\overline{454545}$
$10.78\dot{4}2\dot{3} = 10.78\overline{423423}$

Lambobin maimaitawa da ake buƙata, bi da bi, sune: $5.6\overline{666666}$, $7.3\overline{454545}$, da $10.78\overline{423423}$.

Question: Sanya $1.7643$, $3.\dot{2}\dot{4}$ da  $2.78\dot{3}4\dot{6}$ zuwa ga mafi ƙanƙantar siffarsu ta abubuwan da ba su maimaitawa na lambobi na goma.
Solution:
A cikin $1.7643$ muna da lambobi $4$ a cikin ɓangaren da ba ya maimaitawa kuma babu wani ɓangare mai maimaitawa. A cikin $3.\dot{2}\dot{4}$ adadin lambobi a ɓangaren da ba ya maimaitawa shine $0$, kuma na ɓangaren da ke maimaitawa shine $2$; a $2.78\dot{3}4\dot{6}$ adadin lambobi a ɓangaren da ba ya maimaitawa shine $2$, kuma na ɓangaren da ke maimaitawa shine $3$. A nan, mafi girman adadin lambobi da ba sa maimaitawa shine $4$, kuma adadin lambobi a ɓangarorin da ke maimaitawa sune $2$ da $3$. Ƙaramar Haɗin Sauƙi (LCM) na waɗannan shine $6$. Saboda haka, kowane lambar lissafi dole ne ya sami lambobi $4$ da ba sa maimaitawa da lambobi $6$ masu maimaitawa. \\
$\therefore $ $1.7643 = 1.7643\dot{0}0000\dot{0}$, $3.\dot{2}\dot{4} = 3.2424\dot{2}4242\dot{4}$ da $2.78\dot{3}4\dot{6} = 2.7834\dot{6}3463\dot{4}$.\\
Nassoshi masu maimaitawa da ake so su kasance kamar haka sune bi da bi: $1.7643\dot{0}0000\dot{0}$, $3.2424\dot{2}4242\dot{4}$ da $2.7834\dot{6}3463\dot{4}$.

Question: Ƙara $3.\dot{8}\dot{9}$, $2.1\dot{7}\dot{8}$ da kuma $5.89\dot{7}9\dot{8}$.
Ƙara $8.9\dot{4}7\dot{8}$, $2.346$ da $4.\dot{7}\dot{1}$.
Yanke $5.24\dot{6}7\dot{3}$ daga $8.2\dot{4}\dot{3}$.
A cire $16.\dot{4}3\dot{7}$ daga $24.45\dot{6}4\dot{5}$.
Ninka $4.\dot{3}$ da $5.\dot{7}$.
Solution:
$$4.\dot{3}  = \dfrac{43-4}{9}=\dfrac{39}{9}=\dfrac{13}{3}$$
$$5.\dot{7}  = \dfrac{57-5}{9}=\dfrac{52}{9}$$

$$\therefore 4.\dot{3} \times 5.\dot{7} = \dfrac{13}{3} \times \dfrac{52}{9} = \dfrac{676}{27}=25.\dot{0}3\dot{7}$$

Sakamakon da ake buƙata shine $25.\dot{0}3\dot{7}$.

Question: Dabam dabam $0.2\dot{8}$ da $42.\dot{1}\dot{8}$ = $0.2\dot{8} \times 42.\dot{1}\dot{8}$
Nawa ne $2.5\times 4.3\dot{5} \times 1.2\dot{3}\dot{4}$?
Raba $7.\dot{3}\dot{2}$ da $0.2\dot{7}$.
Solution:
$$7.\dot{3}\dot{2}=\dfrac{732-7}{99}=\dfrac{725}{99}$$
        $$0.2\dot{7}=\dfrac{27-2}{90}=\dfrac{25}{90}=\dfrac{5}{18}$$

$$\therefore 7.\dot{3}\dot{2} \div 0.2\dot{7} = \dfrac{725}{99} \div \dfrac{5}{18} = \dfrac{725}{99} \times \dfrac{18}{5} = \dfrac{290}{11}=26.\dot{3}\dot{6}$$

Sakamakon da ake so shine $26.\dot{3}\dot{6}$.

Question: Raba $9.45$ da $2.8\dot{6}\dot{3}$.
Solution:
$$9.45 = \dfrac{945}{100} ‌\qquad \qquad \qquad 2.8\dot{6}\dot{3}=\dfrac{2863-28}{990}=\dfrac{2835}{990}$$
$$\therefore 9.45 \div 2.8\dot{6}\dot{3} = \dfrac{945}{100} \div \dfrac{2835}{990} = \dfrac{945}{100} \times \dfrac{990}{2835} =  \dfrac{189\times 99}{2\times 2835} = \dfrac{33}{10}=3.3$$                             
Sakamakon da ake so shi ne $3.3$

Question: Bari $A = \{7, 14, 21, 28\}$. A bayyana $A$ ta hanyar gina tarin yadda kowane sinadarin ke da sifofi masu zuwa.
Solution:
Abubuwan da ke cikin $A$ su ne $7, 14, 21, 28$.

Anan, kowane abu yana kasancewa **ninki bakwai** na $7$ kuma bai wuce $28$ ba.

$\therefore$ $A = \{x:x |\text{ninki bakwai ne na }  7 $   \text{kuma}  $0<x \leq 28\}$

Question: B = \{x:x,   \    \text{shine mabagi na } 28\}  ka nuna shi ta hanyar lissafin da ke tattare da shi.
Solution:
Anan,          
$28 = 1 \times 28= 2 \times 14= 4 \times 7$

$\therefore$ abubuwan da aka samu na  $28$ sune    $1,  2,  4,  7,  14,  28$

Don haka saitin da ake so shine   $B = \{1, 2, 4, 7, 14, 28\}$

Question: Bari $C = \{x:x$ ɗan kwayoyin halitta ne maras tushe kuma $x^{2} < 18\}$ a bayyana shi ta hanyar amfani da hanyar jeri.
Solution:
$1, 2, 3, 4, 5, ...$ dukkanin su lambobi ne masu girma (positive integers).

A nan, idan

        $x=1$ to,  $x^{2} = 1^{2} = 1; $ idan $\ x=2$  to,  $x^{2} = 2^{2} = 4$

idan        $x=3$  to,  $x^{2}=3^{2}=9; $ idan $\ x=4$ to,  $x^{2} = 4^{2} = 16$

        idan $x=5$  to,  $x^{2} = 5^{2} = 25$ ; wanda ya fi girma daga   $18$.


$\therefore$ kamar yadda sharuɗɗan suka nuna lambobi masu girma da suka dace sune $1, 2, 3$ da $4$.

$\therefore$ saitin da aka bayar shine   $C = \{1, 2, 3, 4\}$

Question: Tabbatar da cewa tarin dukkan lambobin halitta (natural numbers) gida ne marar iyaka.
Solution:
Set ɗin lambobi na halitta $N = \{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, ...\}$

Set ɗin $A = \{1, 3, 5, 7, ...\}$ wanda ya ƙunshi lambobi marasa iyali (odd numbers) daga cikin set ɗin $N$

Set ɗin $B= \{2, 4, 6, 8, ...\}$ wanda ya ƙunshi lambobi masu iyali (even numbers) daga cikin set ɗin $N$

Set ɗin lambobi $C =\{3, 6, 9, 12, ...\}$ waɗanda su ne ninkawa na 3 (multiples of 3) daga cikin $N$

A nan, ba za a iya tantance yawan abubuwan da ke cikin waɗannan set ɗin da ke asalin abubuwa daga $N$ ta hanyar ƙididdigewa ba. Sakamakon haka, $A, B, C$ set ɗi ne marasa iyaka.

$\therefore N$ set ne marar iyaka.

Question: Rubuta abubuwan da ke ƙasa da $P = \{x, y, z\}$ sannan ka nuna waɗanda suke abubuwan da ke ƙasa da su amma ba su zama duka ba (proper subsets).
Solution:
An bayar, $P = \{x, y, z\}$

Ƙananan jadawali na $P$ sune $\{x, y, z\}, \{x, y\}, \{x, z\}, \{y, z\}, \{x\}, \{y\}, \{z\}, \varnothing$.

Ƙananan jadawali na gaske na $P$ sune $\{x, y\}, \{x, z\}, \{y, z\}, \{x\}, \{y\}, \{z\}, \varnothing$.

Question: Idan $P = \{x: x \text{ shine abin da ya kasuwa ga } 12\}$ kuma $Q = \{x: x \text{ shine kelaye na } 3 \text{ kuma } x \leq 12\}$, to, nemi $P - Q$.
Solution:
An ba mu, $P=\{x:x$ dila ce ta $12 \}$

A nan, dilolin $12$ sune $1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12$.

$\therefore$ $P = \{1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12\}$

Duk da haka, $Q=\{x:3$ dila ce ta $x$ kuma $x \leq 12\}$

A nan, lambobi da suka fi ko suka yi daidai da $12$ waɗanda $3$ ke iya raba su sune $3, 6, 9, 12$.

$\therefore$ $Q = \{3, 6, 9, 12\}$

$\therefore$ $P - Q = \{1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12\} - \{3, 6, 9, 12\} = \{1, 2, 4\}$

Saitin shine: $\{1, 2, 4\}$

Question: Bari  $C = \{3, 4, 5\}$  da  $D = \{4, 6, 8\}$, ƙayyade   $C \cup D.$
Idan $P = \{x \in N: 2 < x \leq 6\}$ kuma $Q = \{x \in N: x$ lambar g----------------- ne kuma $x\leq 8\}$ tantance $P \cap Q.$
Solution:
An bayar da:

$P = \{x \in N: 2 < x \leq 6\} = \{3, 4, 5, 6\}$

$Q = \{x \in N: x$ lamba ce mai ƙarifi kuma $x\leq 8\} = \{2, 4, 6, 8\}$

$\therefore$ $P \cap Q = \{3, 4, 5, 6\} \cap \{2, 4, 6, 8\} = \{4, 6\}$

Saita da za a ƙayyade shine $\{4, 6\}$

Question: Nemo adadin abubuwan da ke cikin tarin masu karfi na $A = \varnothing$, $B = \{a\}$, $C = \{a, b\}.$
Solution:
Anan $P(A) = \{\varnothing\}$

$\therefore$ adadin abubuwa na $A$ shine $0$ kuma adadin abubuwa na aikinsa na iko shine
$ = 1 = 2^0$

Kuma $P(B) = \{\{a\}, \varnothing\}$

$\therefore$ adadin abubuwa na $B$ shine $1$, kuma adadin abubuwa na aikinsa na iko shine
$ = 2 = 2^1.$

Kuma $P(C) = \{\{a\}, \{b\}, \{a, b\}, \varnothing\}$

$\therefore$ adadin abubuwa na $C$ shine $2$ kuma adadin abubuwa na aikinsa na iko shine
$ = 4 = 2^2$

Don haka idan adadin abubuwa na wani saiti shine $n$, to adadin abubuwa na aikinsa na iko shine $2^n.$
Exact Answer: idan adadin abubuwan da ke cikin rukuni ne n, to adadin abubuwan da ke cikin cikakken rukuni nasa shine 2^n.

Question: Idan $(2x+y, 3)=(6, x-y)$ ne, to, ka tantance $(x, y)$.
Solution:
An bayar da $(2x+y, 3)=(6, x-y)$

A bisa ka'idojin ma'aurata da aka tsara,

$2x + y = 6 \cdots\cdots (1)$

$x - y = 3 \cdots\cdots (2)$

Ta hanyar ƙara lissafi (1) da (2) muna samun $3x=9$ ko kuma $x=3$

Sanya darajar $x$ a cikin lissafi (1) muna samu, $6+y=6$ ko kuma $y=0$

$\therefore (x, y) = (3, 0)$

Question: Idan $P = \{1, 2, 3\}$, $Q = \{3, 4\}$, $R = P \cap Q$ to sai a tantance $P\times R$ da $R\times Q.$
Kayyade tarin lambobin halitta waɗanda ke da ragowar $23$ lokacin da aka raba $311$ da $419$ da su.
Solution:
Addu'a da lambobi na al'ada waɗanda ke barin ragowar $23$ lokacin da aka raba su da $311$ da $419$ za su kasance fiye da $23$ kuma za su kasance masu raba gama gari na duka $311-23 = 288$ da $419-23 = 396$.

A ɗauka cewa saitin lambobi na al'ada waɗanda suka fi $23$ girma kuma suka raba $288$ shine $A$.

Anan $288 = 1 \times 288 = 2 \times 144 = 3 \times 96 = 4 \times 72 = 6 \times 48 = 8 \times 36 = 9 \times 32 = 12 \times 24 = 16 \times 18$

$\therefore A = \{24, 32, 36, 48, 72, 96, 144, 288\}$

A ɗauka cewa saitin lambobi na al'ada mafi girma daga $23$ kuma waɗanda suka raba $396$ shine $B$.

Anan $396 = 1 \times 396 = 2 \times 198 = 3 \times 132 = 4 \times 99 = 6 \times 66 = 9 \times 44 = 11 \times 36 = 12 \times 33 = 18 \times 22$

$\therefore B = \{33, 36, 44, 66, 99, 132, 198, 396\}$

$\therefore$ $A \cap B= \{24, 32, 36, 48, 72, 96, 144, 288\} \cap \{33, 36, 44, 66, 99, 132, 198, 396\}$

$\therefore$ $A \cap B= \{36\}$

Saitin da ake nema shine $\{36\}$

Question: Daga cikin ɗalibai $100$, $88$ sun yi nasara a Bangla, $80$ a Lissafi, kuma $70$ sun yi nasara a dukkan darussan biyu. Nuna wannan bayanin a cikin diagram ɗin Venn, kuma ku nemo ɗaliban da suka kasa a dukkan darussan biyu.
Solution:
A cikin zane na Venn, wurin murabba'i yana wakiltar $U$ saitin ɗalibai $100.$ Sassan ɗaliban da suka ci jarabawar Bangla da Lissafi ana nuna su ta $B$ da $M,$ bi da bi. A sakamakon haka, zane na Venn ya kasu kashi $4$ disjoint sets da ake kira $P, Q, R,$ da $F.$

Anan, saitin ɗaliban da suka ci jarabawar duka batutuwan shine $Q = B\cap M,$ wanda adadinsa shine $70.$

$P$ shine saitin ɗaliban da suka ci jarabawar Bangla kawai. Adadinsa shine $|P|= 88 - 70 = 18.$

$R$ shine saitin ɗaliban da suka ci jarabawar Lissafi kawai. $\therefore, \ |R|= 80 - 70 = 10.$

Ɗaliban da suka ci jarabawar aƙalla batun ɗaya sune $P \cup Q\cup R = B\cup M,$ kuma adadinsu shine $18 + 10 + 70 = 98.$

$F$ shine saitin ɗaliban da suka kasa a duka batutuwan, kuma
$|F|= 100 - 98 = 2.$

$\therefore$ adadin ɗaliban da suka kasa a duka batutuwan shine $2.$

Question: Idan $P = \{2, 3, 4\}$, $Q = \{4, 6\}$ kuma ga abubuwa na $P$ da $Q$ akwai dangantaka  $y=2x$  to, nemo dangantakar.
Solution:
An bayar da  $P = \{2, 3, 4\}$  kuma  $Q = \{4, 6\}$

A bisa ga tambayar  $R = \{(x, y):x\in P,  y\in Q$ kuma  $y=2x\}$

Anan,   $P \times Q = \{2, 3, 4\}\times \{4, 6\} = \{(2, 4), (2, 6), (3, 4), (3, 6), (4, 4), (4, 6)\}$

$\therefore$ $R = \{(2, 4), (3, 6)\}$

Dangantakar da ake nema ita ce  $\{(2, 4), (3, 6)\}$

Question: Idan $A = \{1, 2, 3\}$, $B = \{0, 2, 4\}$ kuma abubuwan da ke cikin $A$ da $B$ suna da alaƙar $x = y - 1$, nemo abubuwan da suka dace da wannan alaƙar.
Idan $f(x)=x^{2} - 4x +3$ ne, to a tantance $f(-1)$.
Idan $g(x)=x^{3}+ax^{2}-3x-6$, to menene darajar $a$ wanda zai sa $g(-2)=0$?
Solution:
An bayar da $g(x)=x^{3}+ax^{2}-3x-6$

$\therefore$ $g(-2)=(- 2)^{3}+a(- 2)^{2}-3(-2)-6$

\qquad $ = -8+4a+6-6 = 4a-8$

Kamar yadda tambayar ta bukata, $g(-2)=0$

$\therefore$ $4a-8=0$ ko kuma $4a=8$ ko kuma $a=2$

$\therefore$ idan $a=2$   to  $g(-2)=0.$

Question: Nemo **gabas** da kuma **sakamakon** dangantaka $S=\{(2, 1), (2, 2), (3, 2), (4, 5)\}$.
Solution:
An bayar da  $S=\{(2, 1), (2, 2), (3, 2), (4, 5)\}$

Na farko, abubuwa na farko na ma'aurata masu tsari na $S$ sune $2, 2, 3, 4$ kuma abubuwa na biyu sune $1, 2, 2, 5$।

$\therefore,  Dom\   S = \{2, 3, 4\}$  kuma $Range \ S = \{1, 2, 5\}$

Question:
barkan $U=\{x:x \in N$ kuma $x \le 6\},$ 
$A=\{x:x$ lambobbi ne masu kaso biyu kawai kuma $x\le 5\},$  Tantance $A^c$.
Solution:
An ba da $U=\{x:x \in N$ kuma $x \le 6\} =\{1,2,3,4,5,6\}$

\qquad $A=\{x:x$ {\rm shine lambobi masu\ siffa\ kuma}  $x\le 5\}=\{2,3,5\}$
 
$\therefore \ A^c=U \setminus A=\{1,2,3,4,5,6\}-\{2,3,5\}=\{1,4,6\}$

Question:
Bari Jimillar Tarin ta zama $U=\{x:x \in N$ da  $x \le 6\},$ 
$A=\{x:x$ **lambar prima ce kuma** $x\le 5\},$ 
$B=\{x: x$ **lambar daidai ce kuma** $x \le 6\}.$ 
Nuna cewa, $A \cup B=(A\setminus B) \cup (B \setminus A) \cup (A \cap B)$
Solution:
\qquad $A=\{x:x$ {\rm lamba ce mai kaso biyu kawai kuma}  $x\le 5\}=\{2,3,5\}$                                                                                                     An bayar

$B=\{x: x$ {\rm lamba ce mai kaso biyu kawai kuma }  $x\le 6\}=\{2,4,6\}$ 

$\therefore \ A \cup B=\{2,3,5\} \cup \{2,4, 6\}=\{2,3,4,5,6\} \cdots\cdots (1)$

$A\setminus B= \{2,3,5\}-\{2,4,6\}=\{3,5\}$

$B \setminus A=\{2,4,6\}-\{2,3,5\}=\{4,6\}$

$A \cap B=\{2,3,5\}\cap \{2,4,6\}=\{2\}$

$\therefore \ (A \setminus B) \cup (B \setminus A) \cup (A \cap B)=\{3,5\}\cup \{4,6\}\cup \{2\}=\{2,3,4,5,6\} \cdots (2)$

Don haka ta hanyar kwatanta $(1)$ da $(2)$ muna samu, 

$A \cup B=(A\setminus B) \cup (B \setminus A) \cup (A \cap B)$

Question:
Bari Tarin Duniya ya kasance $U=\{x:x \in N$ kuma  $x \le 6\},$ 
$A=\{x:x$ {\rm lamba ce mai kaso biyu (prime) kuma} $x\le 5\},$ 
$B=\{x: x$ {\rm lambar sa-rago ce (even number) kuma }  $x\le 6\}$ kuma 
$C=A \setminus B$. Tabbatar cewa, $(A \cap C) \times B=(A \times B) \cap (C \times B)$

Bari $A=\{4,5,6,7\}, \ B=\{0,1,2,3\}$.
Tabbatar cewa, tarin $A$ da tarin $B$ ba su da wani abu ɗaya a haɗin gwiwarsu (disjoint).
Solution:
An bayar,
$A=\{4,5,6,7\}$ da $B=\{0,1,2,3\}$

$\therefore \ A \cap B=\{4,5,6,7\} \cap \{0,1,2,3\} =\varnothing$

Tunda $A \cap B=\varnothing$, to sai a ce $A$ da $B$ su ne abubuwan da ba su haɗu ba (disjoint sets).
Exact Answer: A da B ba su haɗu

Question: B = \{0, 1, 2, 3\}. Kayyade P(B) don nuna cewa adadin abubuwan da ke cikin P(B) shine $2^n$, inda $n$ shine adadin abubuwan da ke cikin B.
Solution:
$B=\{0,1,2,3\} $
 
 $\therefore\  P(B)=\{\{0\},\{1\}, \{2\},\{3\},\{0,1\},\{0,2\},\{0,3\},\{1,2\},\{1,3\},\{2,3\},$
 
  \hspace{1 cm} $ \{0,1,2\},\{0,1,3\},\{0,2,3\},\{1,2,3\},\{0,1,2,3\}, \varnothing \}$
 
 A nan, yawan abubuwa a cikin $B$ shine $4$ kuma yawan abubuwa a cikin power set shine $2^4=16$.
 
 $\therefore$ idan $n$ shine yawan abubuwa na $B$, to yawan abubuwa na power set shine $2^n$.
 
 $\therefore$ yawan abubuwa na $P(B)$ ya bi ka'idar $2^n$.
Exact Answer: yawan abubuwan P(B) ya bi ka'idar 2^n

Question: Menene murabba'in $(4x+5y)$?
Menene murabba'in $(3a-7b)$?
Nemo murabba'in $996$ ta hanyar amfani da dabara ta murabba'i.
Menene murabba'in $a+b+c+d$?
Sauƙaƙe: $(5x+7y+3z)^{2}+2(7x-7y-3z)(5x+7y+3z)+(7x-7y-3z)^{2}$
Solution:
Bari, $5x+7y+3z=a$ da $7x-7y-3z=b$

\therefore {Bayyanawa da aka bayar} &=a^{2}+2\cdot b\cdot a+b^{2} = a^{2}+2ab+b^{2}\\
&=  (a+b)^{2}\\
&=  \{(5x+7y+3z)+(7x-7y-3z)\}^{2}  {[ Ta hanyar maye gurbin ƙimar $a$ da $b$ ]}\\
&=  (5x+7y+3z+7x-7y-3z)^2\\
&=  (12x)^{2} =  144x^{2}

Question: Idan $x-y=2$ kuma $xy=24$, menene ƙimar $x+y$?
Tabbatar da cewa, $(a+b)^{4}-(a-b)^{4}=8ab(a^{2}+b^{2})$
Idan $a+b+c=15$ da $a^{2}+b^{2}+c^{2}=83$, menene ƙimar $ab+bc+ac$?
Idan $a+b+c=2$ kuma $ab+bc+ac=1$, menene ƙimar $(a+b)^{2}+(b+c)^{2}+(c+a)^{2}$ ?
Saka $(2x+3y)(4x-5y)$ a matsayin **bambancin** murabba'ai biyu.
Solution:
Bari, $2x+3y=a$ da $4x-5y=b$

$\therefore$ Maganar da aka bayar $ab=\left(\dfrac{a+b}{2}\right)^{2}-\left(\dfrac{a-b}{2}\right)^{2}$

\qquad$=\left(\dfrac{2x+3y+4x-5y}{2}\right)^{2}-\left(\dfrac{2x+3y-4x+5y}{2}\right)^{2}$   [Ta hanyar maye gurbin dabi'u na $a$ da $b$]

\qquad$=\left(\dfrac{6x-2y}{2}\right)^{2}-\left(\dfrac{8y-2x}{2}\right)^{2}$

\qquad$=\left\{\dfrac{2(3x-y)}{2}\right\}^{2}-\left\{\dfrac{2(4y-x)}{2}\right\}^{2}$

\qquad$=(3x-y)^{2}-(4y-x)^{2}$  

$\therefore (2x+3y)(4x-5y)=(3x-y)^{2}-(4y-x)^{2}$

Question: Nemo kuban $2x+3y$.
Nemo kashi uku na $2x-y$.
Idan $x-y=8$ da $xy=5$, menene ƙimar $x^{3}-y^{3}+8(x+y)^{2}$?
Idan $a=\sqrt{3}+\sqrt{2}$, tabbatar da cewa, $a^{3}+\dfrac{1}{a^{3}}=18\sqrt{3}$.
Solution:
An bayar da cewa, $a=\sqrt{3}+\sqrt{2}\ $

\qquad $\therefore \  \dfrac{1}{a} =\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{3}+\sqrt{2}}$

\qquad $=\dfrac{\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{2}}{(\sqrt{3}+\sqrt{2})(\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{2})}$ [ta hanyar ninka masu da ɓangaren sama da ɓangaren ƙasa da $(\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{2})$ ]

\qquad $=\dfrac{\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{2}}{(\sqrt{3})^{2}-(\sqrt{2})^{2}} =\dfrac{\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{2}}{3-2}=\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{2}$

$\therefore \ a+\dfrac{1}{a}=(\sqrt{3}+\sqrt{2})+(\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{2})=\sqrt{3}+\sqrt{2}+\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{2}=2\sqrt{3}$

Yanzu, $a^{3}+\dfrac{1}{a^{3}} =\left(a+\dfrac{1}{a}\right)^{3}-3\cdot a\cdot \dfrac{1}{a}\left(a+\dfrac{1}{a}\right)$

\qquad $=(2\sqrt{3})^{3}-3(2\sqrt{3}) \left[\because a+\dfrac{1}{a}=2\sqrt{3}\right]$

\qquad $=2^{3}\cdot (\sqrt{3})^{3}-3\times 2\sqrt{3} =8\cdot 3\sqrt{3}-6\sqrt{3}$

\qquad $ =24\sqrt{3}-6\sqrt{3}=18\sqrt{3}$ (An nuna)

Question: Idan $x+y=5,\  xy=6$ kuma $x > y$ Nemi ƙimar $2(x^2+y^2)$.
Solution:
Muna da, $2(x^2+y^2) = 2\{(x+y)^2 - 2xy\}$

\qquad $= 2(5^2 - 2\cdot 6) = 2 \times 13 = 26$

\qquad $\therefore 2(x^2+y^2) = 26$

Question: Idan $x+y=5,\  xy=6$ kuma $x > y$, Nemi ƙimar $x^3-y^3-3(x^2+y^2)$.
Solution:
An baka cewa, $x+y=5$ da $xy=6,\  x > y$

$\therefore x - y = \pm \sqrt{(x+y)^2-4xy}$

\qquad $= \pm \sqrt{5^2 - 4\cdot 6} = \pm \sqrt{25-24} = \pm \sqrt{1} = \pm 1$

$x^3-y^3 - 3(x^2+y^2)$

\qquad $= (x-y)^3 + 3xy(x-y) - \dfrac{3}{2}\cdot 2(x^2+y^2)$

\qquad $= 1^3 + 3\cdot 6\cdot 1 - \dfrac{3}{2}\cdot  26$ ko kuma $ (-1)^3 + 3\cdot 6\cdot (-1) - \dfrac{3}{2}\cdot  26$

\qquad $= 1 + 18 - 39$ ko kuma $-1 - 18 - 39$

\qquad $= -20$ ko kuma -$58$

$\therefore x^3-y^3-3(x^2+y^2) = -20$ ko kuma $-58$

Question: Idan $x+y=5,\  xy=6$ kuma $x > y$ Nemi ƙimar $x^5+y^5$.
Solution:
An bayar da cewa, $x+y=5$ da $xy=6,\  x > y$

$\therefore x - y = \pm \sqrt{(x+y)^2-4xy}$

\qquad $= \pm \sqrt{5^2 - 4\cdot 6} = \pm \sqrt{25-24} = \pm \sqrt{1} = \pm 1$                                                                                                                                                                                                           $x+y=5$ da $x-y=\pm 1$

Idan an haɗa, $2x = 6,4$ \qquad $\therefore x = \dfrac{6}{2} = 3$ ko $\dfrac{4}{2} = 2$

Idan an cire, $2y = 4,\ 6$  \qquad $\therefore y = \dfrac{4}{2} = 2$ ko $\dfrac{6}{2} = 3$

$\therefore x^5+y^5 = 3^5 + 2^5 = 243 + 32 = 275$ [Za a samu sakamakon iri ɗaya ko da idan $x=2$ da $y=3$ ne]

Question: A warware zuwa ga jimilla: $3a^{2}b+6ab^{2}+12a^{2}b^{2}$
Tsaftace zuwa abubuwa masu haɗin gwiwa: $2ab(x-y)+2bc(x-y)+3ca(x-y)$
Solution:
Muna da:
$2ab(x-y)+2bc(x-y)+3ca(x-y)=(x-y)(2ab+2bc+3ca)$

Na farko, zamu iya gano kalmar gama gari a kowane abu na gefen hagu na daidaito.
Kalmar gama gari ita ce $(x-y)$.

Da wannan, zamu iya fitar da $(x-y)$ daga kowane abu:
$(x-y)[2ab + 2bc + 3ca]$

Don haka, daidaiton zai zama:
$(x-y)(2ab+2bc+3ca)=(x-y)(2ab+2bc+3ca)$

Daidaito yana nan daidai.

Amsar ƙarshe da aka rufe ita ce:
$\boxed{(x-y)(2ab+2bc+3ca)}$

Question: Ku warware zuwa abubuwan da za a iya raba su: $4x^{2}+12x+9$
Warware zuwa abubuwan da za a iya rarrabawa: $9x^{2}-30xy+25y^{2}$
Warware zuwa abubuwan da aka ninka: $a^{2}-1+2b-b^{2}$
Warware zuwa sassa: $a^{4}+64b^{4}$
Bayyanawa zuwa sinadaran: $x^{2}+12x+35$
Sarrafa zuwa *abubuwa* masu *yawaitawa*: $x^{2}+x-20$
Ƙididdige abubuwan da za a iya raba su (factors) na: $3x^{2}-x-14$
Faɗa zuwa ga abubuwa masu rarrabewa: $8x^{3}+36x^{2}y+54xy^{2}+27y^{3}$

Soke zuwa abubuwa: 
$8a^{3}+27b^{3}$

'Bari a warware zuwa abubuwan da aka haɗa:
$a^6 - 64$
Nemi haɗuran da ke cikin: $x^{3}+6x^{2}y+11xy^{2}+6y^{3}$
Warware zuwa abubuwan da ake rabawa: $x^{3}-x-6$
Solution:
Anan, $f(x)=x^{3}-x-6$ wani polynomial ne. Abubuwan da ke raba $-6$ gaba ɗaya sune $\pm 1, \pm 2, \pm 3, \pm 6$.

Yanzu, idan muka sanya $x=1, -1$ muna gani cewa ƙimar $f(x)$ ba sifili ba ce.

Amma, idan muka sanya $x=2$ muna gani cewa ƙimar $f(x)$ ba sifili ba ce.

Don haka, $f(2)=2^{3}-2-6=8-2-6=0$.

Saboda haka, $x-2$ abun da ke raba $f(x)$ ne.

$\therefore f(x)= x^{3}-x-6$

\qquad $ =x^{3}-2x^{2}+2x^{2}-4x+3x-6$

\qquad $ =x^{2}(x-2)+2x(x-2)+3(x-2)$

\qquad $ =(x-2)(x^{2}+2x+3)$

Question: Rusa zuwa sassa: $x^{3}-3xy^{2}+2y^{3}$ da kuma $x^{2}+xy-2y^{2}$.
Solution:
A nan, za mu yi la'akarin $x$ a matsayin mai canzawa (variable) kuma $y$ a matsayin adadi na dindindin (constant).

Muna kallon wannan sassauƙa a matsayin polynomial na $x$.

Bari mu ce,  $f(x)=x^{3}-3xy^{2}+2y^{3}$

To,    $f(y)=y^{3}-3y\cdot y^{2}+2y^{3}=y^{3}-3y^{3}+2y^{3}=0$

Don haka,    $(x-y)$ wani sashi ne na $f(x)$.

Yanzu, $x^{3}-3xy^{2}+2y^{3}$

\qquad $ =x^{3}-x^{2}y+x^{2}y-xy^{2}-2xy^{2}+2y^{3}$

\qquad $        =x^{2}(x-y)+xy(x-y)-2y^{2}(x-y)$

\qquad $        =(x-y)(x^{2}+xy-2y^{2})$

Bari mu sake cewa,    $g(x)=x^{2}+xy-2y^{2}$

Don haka, $g(y)=y^{2}+y\cdot y-2y^{2} = y^{2}+y^{2}-2y^{2} = 0$

Don haka, $(x-y)$ wani sashi ne na $g(x)$.

Don haka, $g(x)= x^{2}+xy-2y^{2}$
  
\qquad $        =x^{2}-xy+2xy-2y^{2}$
  
\qquad $        =x(x-y)+2y(x-y)$
  
\qquad $        =(x-y)(x+2y)$  

Don haka, $x^{3}-3xy^{2}+2y^{3}=(x-y)^{2}(x+2y)$

Question: Ku warware zuwa abubuwan da aka haɗa: $54x^{4}+27x^{3}a-16x-8a$
Solution:
Bari, $f(x)=54x^{4}+27x^{3}a-16x-8a$

Sa'an nan, $f\Bigg(-\dfrac{1}{2}a\Bigg)=54\Bigg(-\dfrac{1}{2}a\Bigg)^{4}+27a\Bigg(-\dfrac{1}{2}a\Bigg)^{3}-16\Bigg(-\dfrac{1}{2}a\Bigg)-8a$

\qquad        $=\dfrac{27}{8}a^{4}-\dfrac{27}{8}a^{4}+8a-8a=0$

$\therefore$ $x-\Bigg(-\dfrac{1}{2}a\Bigg)=x+\dfrac{a}{2}=\dfrac{1}{2}(2x+a)$ wani sashe ne na $f(x)$.

Don haka, $(2x+a)$ wani sashe ne na $f(x)$.

Yanzu, $54x^{4}+27x^{3}a-16x-8a$

\qquad $=27x^{3}(2x+a)-8(2x+a)$

\qquad $=(2x+a)(27x^{3}-8)$

\qquad $=(2x+a)\{(3x)^{3}-(2)^{3}\}$

\qquad $=(2x+a)(3x-2)(9x^{2}+6x+4)$

Question:
$g(a)=a^3+a^2+10a-8$, idan aka raba $g(a)$ da $(a-2)$ to, ana samun ragowar

a) 36
b) 40
c) 44
d) 48
Solution:
An bayar,
$g(a)=a^3+a^2+10a-8$

a bisa ga theorem ɗin saura, idan an raba $g(a)$ da $(a-2)$ to saura zai zama $g(2)$.

$\therefore \ g(2)=2^3+2^2+10\cdot 2-8=8+4+20-8=32-8=24$

$\therefore \ g(2)=24$

Sauran da aka ƙididdige shi shine $24$.

Question: Awarware cikin factors: $f(a)=a^3-9+(a+1)^3$
Solution:
$f(a)=a^3-9+(a+1)^3$

$f(a)$ wani polynomial ne, idan muka sanya $a=1$, to sakamakon polynomial ɗin zai zama sifili.

Don haka $(a-1)$ wani factor ne na polynomial ɗin.

$\therefore \ f(a)=a^3-9+a^3+3a^2+3a+1=2a^3+3a^2+3a-8$

\qquad $=2a^3-2a^2+5a^2-5a+8a-8$

\qquad $=2a^2(a-1)+5a(a-1)+8(a-1)$

\qquad $=(a-1)(2a^2+5a+8)$

$\therefore \ a^3-9+(a+1)^3=(a-1)(2a^2+5a+8)$

Question: Don wani bikin wasanni na shekara-shekara, membobin wata kungiya sun yi kasafin kuɗi na Tk. $45000$ kuma suka raba shi cewa kowane memba zai bayar da kuɗi daidai. Amma membobi $5$ sun ki bayarwa. Sakamakon haka, adadin kuɗin da kowane memba ya bayar ya karu da Tk. $15$. Didaga yawa membobin kungiyar suke?
Solution:
Bari adadin membobin ƙungiyar ya zama $x$ kuma kuɗin gudunmawar kowane mutum ya zama Tk. $q$.

Sannan jimillar kuɗin gudunmawa, Tk $A=qx=45,000$.

A gaskiya adadin membobin sun kasance $(x-5)$ kuma kuɗin gudunmawar kowane mutum ya zama Tk. $(q+15)$.

Sannan, jimillar kuɗin gudunmawa $(x-5)(q+15)$.

Bisa ga tambayar,

\qquad $qx=(x-5)(q+15)$ $\cdots\cdots (1)$

\qquad $qx=45000$ $\cdots\cdots (2)$

Daga lamba (1) muna samu,

\qquad $qx=(x-5)(q+15)$

\qquad ko, $qx=qx-5q+15x-75$

\qquad ko, $5q=15x-75=5(3x-15)$

$\therefore$ $q=3x-15$

Saka darajar $q$ a cikin (2),

\qquad $(3x-15)\times x=45000$

\qquad ko, $3x^{2}-15x=45000$

\qquad ko, $x^{2}-5x=15000$ [raba dukkan bangarorin da 3]

\qquad ko, $x^{2}-5x-15000=0$

\qquad ko, $x^{2}-125x+120x-15000=0$

\qquad ko, $x(x-125)+120(x-125)=0$

\qquad ko, $(x-125)(x+120)=0$

Don haka, $(x-125)=0$ ko $(x+120)=0$

\qquad ko, $x=125$ ko, $x=-120$

Saboda adadin membobin ba zai iya zama mara kyau ba, don haka darajar $x$ kamar $-120$ ba ta karɓuwa bace.

Don haka, adadin membobin ƙungiyar shine $125$.

Question: Bari mutum ya iya tuki jirgin ruwa mai nisa $x$ km a lokaci $t_1$ awa yana fafatawa da ruwa. Don ya iya rufe wannan nisa tare da ruwan, sai ya dauki $t_2$ awa. Nawa ne saurin jirgin ruwan da kuma na ruwan?
Solution:
Bari saurin jirgin ruwa a ruwa mara motsi ya kasance $u$ km a kowace awa kuma saurin gudun ruwan ya kasance $v$ km a kowace awa.

Sannan, yayin da yake biye da gudun ruwan, saurin jirgin ruwa mai tasiri shine $(u+v)$ km a kowace awa kuma yayin da yake gaban gudun ruwan, saurin jirgin ruwa mai tasiri shine $(u-v)$ km a kowace awa.

Mun sani, $\text{sauri}=\dfrac{\text{nisa da aka yi}}{\text{lokaci}}$
\newpage

A cewar tambayar, $u+v=\dfrac{x}{t_2}$ $\cdots\cdots (1)$

        kuma $u-v=\dfrac{x}{t_1}$ $\cdots\cdots (2)$

Idan muka ƙara littattafan (1) da (2) za mu samu,

    $2u=\dfrac{x}{t_2}+\dfrac{x}{t_1}=x\Bigg(\dfrac{1}{t_1}+\dfrac{1}{t_2}\Bigg)$ ko kuma,     $u=\dfrac{x}{2}\Bigg(\dfrac{1}{t_1}+\dfrac{1}{t_2}\Bigg)$

Idan muka cire littafin (2) daga littafin (1) za mu samu,

    $2v=\dfrac{x}{t_2}-\dfrac{x}{t_1}=x\Bigg(\dfrac{1}{t_2}-\dfrac{1}{t_1}\Bigg)$ ko kuma,      $v=\dfrac{x}{2}\Bigg(\dfrac{1}{t_2}-\dfrac{1}{t_1}\Bigg)$

Don haka saurin gudun ruwan shine $\dfrac{x}{2}\Bigg(\dfrac{1}{t_2}-\dfrac{1}{t_1}\Bigg)$ km a kowace awa kuma saurin jirgin ruwan shine $\dfrac{x}{2}\Bigg(\dfrac{1}{t_1}+\dfrac{1}{t_2}\Bigg)$ km a kowace awa.
Exact Answer: \dfrac{x}{2}\Bigg(\dfrac{1}{t_2}-\dfrac{1}{t_1}\Bigg) km a kowace awa da saurin kwale-kwale shine \dfrac{x}{2}\Bigg(\dfrac{1}{t_1}+\dfrac{1}{t_2}\Bigg)

Question: Bari wani bututu ya cika wani tanki marar komai cikin minti $12$. Wani bututu kuma yana fitar da lita $14$ na ruwa a kowace minti. Idan aka buɗe bututun biyu tare kuma aka cika tankin marar komai cikin minti $96$, ruwa nawa tankin ya ƙunsa?
Solution:
Bari $x$ lita na ruwa ya shiga a kowace minti ta bututu na farko, kuma tanki na iya dauke da $y$ lita na ruwa.

A cewar tambayar, bututu na farko ya cika tanki a cikin minti $12$.

$\therefore y=12x$ $\cdots\cdots (1)$

Sannan kuma, bututu biyu tare suka cika tanki marar komai a cikin minti $96$.

$\therefore y=96x-96\times 14$ $\cdots\cdots (2)$

Daga lissafi $(1)$ muna samu, $x=\dfrac{y}{12}$.

Ta hanyar maye gurbin darajar $x$ a lissafi $(2)$ muna samu,

      $y=96\times\dfrac{y}{12}-96\times 14$

ko,    $y=8y-96\times 14$

ko,    $7y=96\times 14$

ko,    $y=\dfrac{96\times 14}{7}=192$

Don haka, jimillar ruwan da ke cikin tankin shine $192$ lita.

Question: Farashin littafi ɗaya ₦24 ne. Wannan farashin ya kai 80% na ainihin farashin. Gwamnati tana bayar da tallafi ga farashin da ya rage. Nawa ne kuɗin da gwamnati ke bayarwa a matsayin tallafi ga kowane littafi?
Solution:
Farashin kasuwa = $80\%$ na farashin gaskiya

Mun sani, $p=br$

Anan, $p=24$ Tk da $r=80\%=\dfrac{80}{100}$

        $\therefore 24=b\times\dfrac{80}{100}$

Ko kuma, $b=\dfrac{24\times 100}{80}$

$\therefore b=30$ Tk.

Don haka, farashin gaskiya na littafin shine Tk. $30$.

$\therefore$ Adadin kuɗin tallafi Tk. $=(30-24)$ ko Tk. $=6$

Don haka, kuɗin tallafi ga kowane littafi shine Tk. $6$.

Question: Asara ita ce $r\%$ lokacin da aka sayar da 'yan kwandunan lemu $n$ a kan kowace taka. Nawa ne 'yan kwandunan lemu da ya kamata a sayar a kan kowace taka don samun riba ta $s\%$?
Solution:
Idan farashin sayan kayan ya kasance Tk $100$, to farashin siyarwa a asarar $r\%$ shine Tk $(100-r)$.

Idan farashin siyarwa shine Tk. $(100-r)$, to farashin sayan kayan shine Tk. $100$

$\therefore$ Idan farashin siyarwa shine Tk. $1$, to farashin sayan kayan shine Tk. $\dfrac{100}{100-r}$.

Kuma, idan farashin sayan kayan ya kasance Tk. $100$, to farashin siyarwa a ribar $s\%$ shine Tk. $(100+s)$.

$\therefore$ Idan farashin sayan kayan shine Tk. $\dfrac{100}{100-r}$, to farashin siyarwa a ribar $s\%$ shine Tk. $\Bigg(\dfrac{100+s}{100}\times\dfrac{100}{100-r}\Bigg)$

        $=$ Tk. $\dfrac{100+s}{100-r}$

Saboda haka, a cikin Tk. $\dfrac{100+s}{100-r}$ adadin lemo za a sayar shine $n$.

$\therefore$ A cikin Tk. $1$ adadin lemo za a sayar shine $n\times\Bigg(\dfrac{100-r}{100+s}\Bigg)$

Don haka, $\dfrac{n(100-r)}{100+s}$ lemo za a sayar duk daya taka.

Question: Menene ribar Tk. $650$ a cikin shekaru $6$ a ƙimar riba Tk. $7\%$ a kowace shekara?
Solution:
Muna da,    $I=Pnr$

A nan,    $P=650$ Tk,    $n=6$ shekara, kashi a kowace shekara $s=7$ Tk

$\therefore  r=\dfrac{s}{100}=\dfrac{7}{100}$         

$\therefore  I=650\times 6\times\dfrac{7}{100}=273$         

Don haka, ribar ita ce Tk. $273$.

Question: Nemo babban jari da riba mai yawa na Tk. 15,000 a cikin shekaru 3 a kudin riba na kaso 6 a kowace shekara.
Solution:
Muna da,   $C=P(1+r)^{n}$  [inda $C$ ke zama babban riba a yayin da ake lissafin riba tare da haɗi]

An bayar,  $P=15000$ Tk,    $r=6\%=\dfrac{6}{100}$,    $n=3$ shekara

$\therefore C=15000\Bigg(1+\dfrac{6}{100}\Bigg)^{3}=15000\Bigg(1+\dfrac{3}{50}\Bigg)^{3} =15000\Bigg(\dfrac{53}{50}\Bigg)^{3}$   

       \qquad $=15000\times\dfrac{53}{50}\times\dfrac{53}{50}\times\dfrac{53}{50} =\dfrac{446631}{25} =17865.24$  

$\therefore$ Babban riba tare da haɗi shine Tk $17865.24$

$\therefore$ Riba tare da haɗi shine Tk. $ (17865.24-15000)$   Tk. $=2865.24$.

Question: Asara ita ce $x\%$ lokacin da aka sayar da ice cream $10$ a kowace taka. Nawa ne ice cream ya kamata a sayar a kowace taka don samun riba ta $z\%$?
Solution:
Idan farashin sayen kayan ya kasance ₦$100$, farashin siyarwa a asara $x\%$ shine ₦$=(100-x)$

Idan farashin siyarwa shine ₦$(100-x)$ to farashin sayen kayan shine ₦$100$

$\therefore$ Idan farashin siyarwa shine ₦$1$ to farashin sayen kayan shine ₦ $\dfrac{100}{100-x}$

Don haka, farashin sayen kayan 10 ice creams shine ₦ $\dfrac{100}{100-x}$

$\therefore$ Farashin sayen kayan 1 ice cream shine ₦ $\dfrac{100}{(100-x) \times 10}$.

Kuma idan farashin sayen kayan ya kasance ₦$100$, farashin siyarwa a ribar $z\%$ shine ₦$(100+z)$

Idan farashin sayen kayan shine ₦$100$ to farashin siyarwa shine ₦$(100+z)$.

Idan farashin sayen kayan shine ₦$1$ to farashin siyarwa shine ₦ $\dfrac{100+z}{100}$

$\therefore \ $ Idan farashin sayen kayan shine ₦ $\dfrac{100}{(100-x) \times 10}$

\qquad\qquad to farashin siyarwa shine ₦ $\dfrac{100+z}{100} \times \dfrac{100}{(100-x) \times 10}$   $=\dfrac{(100+z)}{(100-x) \times 10}$

Farashin siyarwa na 1 ice cream shine ₦ $\dfrac{(100+z)}{(100-x) \times 10} =\dfrac{100+z}{1000-10x}$

Don haka, za a sayar da $\dfrac{1000-10x}{100+z}$ ice creams a kowane taka.

Question: Nemo ƙimõmi: $\dfrac{5^2}{5^3}$
Nemo ƙimomin: $\left( \dfrac{2}{3}\right) ^5 \times \left( \dfrac{2}{3}\right) ^{-5}$
Solution: $\left( \dfrac{2}{3}\right) ^5 \times \left( \dfrac{2}{3}\right) ^{-5}= \left( \dfrac{2}{3} \right) ^{5-5}=\left( \dfrac{2}{3}\right )^0=1$

Question: Sauƙaƙe: $\dfrac{5^4 \times 8 \times 16}{2^5 \times 125}$
Solution:
$\dfrac{5^4\times 8\times 16}{2^5\times 125}= \dfrac{5^4\times 2^3\times 2^4}{2^5\times 5^3}=\dfrac{5^4\times 2^{3+4}}{5^3\times 2^5}=\dfrac{5^4}{5^3}\times \dfrac{2^7}{2^5}$

$= 5^{4-3}\times 2^{7-5} =5^1\times2^2= 5\times 4=20$

Question: Sauƙaƙe: $\dfrac{3\cdot2^n-4\cdot2^{n-2}}{2^n- 2^{n-1}}$
Solution:
$\dfrac{3\cdot2^n-4\cdot2^{n-2}}{2^n- 2^{n-1}} = \dfrac{3\cdot2^n-2^2\cdot2^{n-2}}{2^n- 2^n\cdot2^{-1}} = \dfrac{3\cdot2^n-2^{2+n-2}}{2^n- 2^n\cdot\dfrac{1}{2}}$ 

$=\dfrac{3\cdot2^n-2^{n}}{\left(1-\dfrac{1}{2}\right)\cdot2^n}= \dfrac{(3-1)\cdot2^n}{\dfrac{1}{2}\cdot2^n}=\dfrac{2\cdot2^n}{\dfrac{1}{2}\cdot2^n}=2\cdot 2=4$

Question: Tabbatar da cewa, $\left(a^p\right)^{q-r}\cdot(a^q)^{r-p}\cdot(a^r)^{p-q}= 1$
Solution:
$\left(a^p\right)^{q-r}\cdot(a^q)^{r-p}\cdot(a^r)^{p-q} = a^{p(q-r)}\cdot a^{q(r-p)}\cdot a^{r(p-q)} \ [\because \left(a^m\right)^n=a^{mn}]$

\qquad\qquad$=a^{pq-pr}\cdot a^{qr-pq}\cdot a^{pr-qr} =a^{pq-pr+qr-pq+pr-qr} =a^0=1$

Question: Sauƙaƙe: $12^{-\frac{1}{2}} \times \sqrt[3]{54}$
Sauƙaƙe: $(-3)^3 \times \left(-\dfrac{1}{2}\right)^2$
Solution:
$(-3)^3\times \left(-\dfrac{1}{2}\right)^2$
$=(-3)(-3)(-3)\times \left(-\dfrac{1}{2}\right)\left(-\dfrac{1}{2}\right)$
$=-27\times \dfrac{1}{4}$
$=-\dfrac{27}{4}$

Question: Warware: $4^{x+1}=32$
Solution:
$4^{x+1}=32$ \qquad ko, $(2^2)^{x+1}=32$ \qquad ko, $2^{2x+2}=2^5$

$\therefore 2x+2=5$ \enspace [idan $a^x=a^y$, to $x=y$]

ko, $2x= 5-2$ \enspace ko, $2x=3$

$\therefore x=\dfrac{3}{2}$

Question: Nemo ƙimomin: $\log_{10} 100$
Nemo ƙimomin: $\log_3 \dfrac{1}{9}$
Solution:
$\log_3\left(\dfrac{1}{9}\right)=\log_3\left(\dfrac{1}{3^2}\right)=\log_3 3^{-2}=-2\log_3 3$        $[\because \log_a M^r=r\log_a M]$

$ = -2\times 1=-2$ $[\because \log_a a=1]$

Question: Nemo ƙimar: $\log_{\sqrt{3}} 81$
Solution:
$\log_{\sqrt{3}}81=\log_{\sqrt{3}}3^4=\log_{\sqrt{3}}\{(\sqrt{3})^2\}^4=\log_{\sqrt{3}}(\sqrt{3})^8$

$=8\log_{\sqrt{3}} \sqrt{3} =8\times 1 = 8$ $[\because \log_a a=1]$

Question: Menene log na $5\sqrt{5}$ zuwa gamamman $5$?
Solution:
Log na $5\sqrt{5}$ zuwa tushe na $5$

$=\log_5 5\sqrt{5}=\log_5 (5\times 5^{\frac{1}{2}})=\log_5 5^{\frac{3}{2}}$

$=\dfrac{3}{2}\log_5 5$ $[\because \log_a M^r=r\log_a M]$

$=\dfrac{3}{2}\times 1 = \dfrac{3}{2}$ $[\because \log_a a=1]$

Question: Idan log na $400$ da tushe $b$ yayi daidai da $4$, to menene ƙimar $b$?
Solution:
Bari tushe ya zama $a$

$\therefore$  Dangane da tambayar, $\log_a 400=4$   

$\therefore a^4=400$
  ko, $a^4=(20)^2=\{(2\sqrt{5})^2\}^2=(2\sqrt{5})^4$   

$\therefore  a=2\sqrt{5}$ \qquad $[\because   a^x=b^x,\ a^x\neq 0,\ a=b]$    

$\therefore$ Tushe $2\sqrt{5}$

Question: Nemo ƙimar $x$: $\log_{10} x=-2$
Nemo ƙimar $x$: $\log_x 324=4$
Solution:
$\log_x 324=4$

ko kuma, $x^{4}=324=3\times 3\times 3\times 3\times 2\times 2 = 3^{4}\times 2^{2}$
 
ko kuma, $x^{4}=3^{4}\times (\sqrt{2})^{4}$

  ko kuma, $x^{4}=(3\sqrt{2})^{4}$

 $\therefore x=3\sqrt{2}$

Question: Tabbatar da cewa, $3\log_{10} 2+\log_{10} 5=\log_{10} 40$
Solution:
Lambobin gefe na hagu $= 3\log_{10} 2+\log_{10} 5$

  \qquad   $=\log_{10} 2^{3}+\log_{10} 5 \qquad [\because \log_a M^{r}=r\log_a M]$

  \qquad   $=\log_{10} 8+\log_{10} 5$

  \qquad   $=\log_{10} (8\times 5) \qquad [\because \log_a (MN)=\log_a M+\log_a N]$

  \qquad   $=\log_{10} 40 =$ lambobin gefe na dama (an tabbatar)

Question: Nemo **cewa** siffofin log na lambobi masu zuwa: $5570$
Solution:
$5570=5.570\times 1000=5.570\times 10^3$

$\therefore$ Halayyar log na lambar ita ce $3$.

Yawan lambobi a cikin lamba $5570$ shi ne $4$.

$\therefore$ Halayyar log na lambar $=4-1=3$.

Question: Nemo **gwanatin** log na lambobin da ke biyowa: $45.70$
Solution:
$45.70=4.570\times 10^1$
        
$\therefore$ Siffar logaritmin lambar ita ce $1$

Akwai lambobi $2$ a sashin da ba na ɓarkewa ba (wato, a gefen hagu na ɗigo) na lambar.

$\therefore$ Siffar logaritmin lambar $=2-1=1$

Question: Nemo siffofin log na lambobin da ke biyowa: $0.4305$
Solution:
$0.4305=4.305\times 10^{-1}$
        $\therefore$ Abin da ya rage na log na lambar shi ne $-1$

        $\therefore$ Abin da ya rage na log na lambar shi ne $=0-1=-1=\bar{1}$

Babu sifili a tsakanin alamar dabo da lambar sa ta farko mai daraja a cikin lambar $0.4305$, wato akwai sifilai $0$.

$\therefore$ Abin da ya rage na log na lambar shi ne $=-(0+1)=-1=\bar{1}$

$\therefore$ Abin da ya rage na log na lambar $0.4305$ shi ne $\bar{1}$

Question: Nemo halayen log na lambobi masu zuwa: $0.000435$
Solution:
$0.000435=4.35\times 10^{-4}$        

$\therefore$ Halayen logarabin lambar shine $-4$ ko $\bar{4}$  

$\therefore$ Halayen logarabin lambar shine $=-(3+1)=-4=\bar{4}$  

$\therefore$ Halayen logarabin lambar $0.000435$ shine $\bar{4}$

Question: Warware: $\dfrac{5x}{7}-\dfrac{4}{5}= \dfrac{x}{5}-\dfrac{2}{7}$
Solution:
$\dfrac{5x}{7}-\dfrac{4}{5}= \dfrac{x}{5}-\dfrac{2}{7}$ \enspace ko kuma, $\dfrac{5x}{7}-\dfrac{x}{5}=\dfrac{4}{5}-\dfrac{2}{7}$ \enspace [ta hanyar canja wuri]

\enspace ko kuma, $\dfrac{25x-7x}{35}=\dfrac{28-10}{35}$ \enspace ko kuma, $\dfrac{18x}{35}= \dfrac{18}{35}$

\enspace ko kuma, $18x=18$ \enspace ko kuma, $x=1$

$\therefore$ **Amsar ita ce $x=1$**

Question: Warware: $(y-1)(y+2)= (y+4)(y-2)$
Solution:
$(y-1)(y+2)= (y+4)(y-2)$

\qquad        ko, $y^2-y+2y-2=y^2+4y-2y-8$  

\qquad        ko, $y-2=2y-8$ 

\qquad        ko, $y-2y=-8+2$  [ta hanyar canja wuri]

\qquad        ko, $-y=-6$ 

\qquad        ko, $y=6$   

$\therefore$ Mafita ita ce $y=6$

Question: Warware ma'auni kuma rubuta tarin mafita: $\dfrac{6x+1}{15}-\dfrac{2x-4}{7x-1}=\dfrac{2x-1}{5}$
Solution:
$\dfrac{6x+1}{15}-\dfrac{2x-4}{7x-1}=\dfrac{2x-1}{5}$

\qquad        ko kuma, $\dfrac{6x+1}{15}-\dfrac{2x-1}{5}=\dfrac{2x-4}{7x-1}$ \qquad     [ta hanyar canzawa wuri]

\qquad        ko kuma, $\dfrac{6x+1-6x+3}{15}= \dfrac{2x-4}{7x-1}$ 

\qquad   ko kuma, $\dfrac{4}{15}= \dfrac{2x-4}{7x-1}$ 

\qquad        ko kuma, $15(2x-4)=4(7x-1)$        [ta hanyar wuce gwiwa]

\qquad        ko kuma, $30x-60=28x-4$

\qquad        ko kuma, $30x-28x=60-4$ \qquad         [ta hanyar canzawa wuri]

\qquad        ko kuma, $2x=56$   \qquad ko kuma, $x=28$ 

$\therefore$ Maganin shi ne $x=28$  

kuma saitin maganin shi ne $S=\{28\}$

Question: Warware: $\dfrac{1}{x-3}+\dfrac{1}{x-4}=\dfrac{1}{x-2}+\dfrac{1}{x-5}$
Solution:
$\dfrac{1}{x-3}+\dfrac{1}{x-4}=\dfrac{1}{x-2}+\dfrac{1}{x-5}$

\qquad        ko, $\dfrac{x-4+x-3}{(x-3)(x-4)}=\dfrac{x-5+x-2}{(x-2)(x-5)}$

\qquad   ko, $\dfrac{2x-7}{x^2-7x+12}=\dfrac{2x-7}{x^2-7x+10}$

Lissafin gajerun sassa na gefe biyu sun yi daidai. A sake,manyan lambobi na gefe biyu sun yi daidai, amma ƙananan lambobi ba su yi daidai ba. A wannan yanayin, idan kawai lissafin manyan lambobin ya zama sifili, gefe biyu za su yi daidai.

$\therefore 2x-7=0$ \qquad ko, $2x=7$ \qquad ko, $x=\dfrac{7}{2}$

$\therefore$  Sashin shine $x=\dfrac{7}{2}$

Question: Lambar da ke wurin *yan dama* na wani lamba mai lambobi biyu tana fi lambar da ke wurin *ashirrai* girma da $2$. Idan aka sauya wuraren lambobin, sabuwar lambar da aka samu za ta yi kasa da sau biyu na lambar da aka bayar da $6$. Nemi lambar.
Solution:
Bari lambar da ke wurin **gommai** ta kasance $x$. Sai lambar da ke wurin raka'a za ta kasance $x+2$.

$\therefore$ lambar ita ce $10x+(x+2)$ ko kuma, $11x+2$

Yanzu, idan an juye wuraren lambobi, lambar da aka canza za ta kasance $10(x+2)+x$ ko kuma, $11x+20$

A cewar tambayar, $11x+20= 2(11x+2)-6$

ko kuma, $11x+20= 22x+4-6$

ko kuma, $22x-11x= 20+6-4$ [ta hanyar canjawa wuri]

ko kuma, $11x=22$

ko kuma, $x=2$

$\therefore$ lambar ita ce $11x+2= 11\times 2+2=24$

$\therefore$ lambar da aka bayar ita ce $24$

Question: Aji guda, idan ɗalibai $4$ ne suke zaune a kowane kujera, kujeru $3$ ne ke raguwa babu kowa. Amma idan ɗalibai $3$ ne suke zaune a kowane kujera, ɗalibai $6$ ne ke raguwa ba su samu wuri ba. Menene yawan ɗaliban a ajin?
Solution:
Bari adadin ɗalibai a ajin ya zama $x$

Domin, idan ɗalibai $4$ aka zaunar da su a kowace sanda, sanda $3$ za su ragu babu kowa, adadin sandunan ajin nan $=\dfrac{x}{4}+3$

A sake, domin, idan ɗalibai $3$ aka zaunar da su a kowace sanda, ɗalibai $6$ za su ragu zaune, adadin sandunan ajin nan $=\dfrac{x-6}{3}$

Domin adadin sandunan ba ya canzawa,

don haka $\dfrac{x}{4}+3=\dfrac{x-6}{3}$ \enspace ko, $\dfrac{x+12}{4}=\dfrac{x-6}{3}$

ko, $4x-24=3x+36$ \enspace ko, $4x-3x=36+24$

ko, $x=60$

$\therefore$ adadin ɗalibai a ajin shine $60$

Question: Mista Kabir, daga Tk $56000$ ɗinsa, ya saka wasu kuɗi a kan ƙimar riba $12\%$ a kowace shekara, sauran kuɗin kuma a kan ƙimar riba $10\%$ a kowace shekara. Bayan shekara ɗaya ya samu cikakken riba na Tk. $6400$. Nawa ne kuɗin da ya saka a kan ƙimar riba $12\%$?
Solution:
Bari Mista Kabir ya saka Tk. $x$ a karkashin wani ribar yawa na $12\%$.

$\therefore$ ya saka Tk. $(56000-x)$ a karkashin wani ribar yawa na $10\%$.

Yanzu, ribar Tk. $x$ a cikin shekara $1$ ita ce Tk. $x\times \dfrac{12}{100}$ ko Tk. $\dfrac{12x}{100}$.

Bayan haka, ribar Tk. $(56000 - x)$ a cikin shekara $1$ ita ce Tk. $(56000-x)\times \dfrac{10}{100}$ ko Tk. $\dfrac{10(56000-x)}{100}$.

Daga tambayar, $\dfrac{12x}{100}+\dfrac{10(56000-x)}{100}=6400$

ko kuma, $12x+560000-10x=640000$

ko kuma, $2x=640000-560000$

ko kuma, $2x=80000$

ko kuma, $x=40000$

$\therefore$ Mista Kabir ya saka Tk. $40000$ a karkashin wani ribar yawa na $12\%$.
Exact Answer: Malam Kabir ya saka Tk. 40000 a kan ƙimar riba 12%

Question: Warware: $(x+2)(x-3)=0$
Solution:
$(x+2)(x-3)=0$

$\therefore x+2=0$ ko  $x-3=0$

Idan $x+2=0$, to $x=-2$

Sannan, idan $x-3=0$, to $x=3$

$\therefore$ mafita ita ce $x=-2$  ko  $x=3$

Question: Nemo tarin magancewa: $y^{2}=\sqrt{3}y$
Solution:
$y^{2}=\sqrt{3}y$

ko kuma, $y^{2}-\sqrt{3}y=0$ \qquad   [Ta hanyar canza wuri, an mayar da gefen dama da sifili]

ko kuma, $y(y-\sqrt{3})=0$

Don haka, $y=0$ ko kuma  $y-\sqrt{3}=0$

A sake, idan $y-\sqrt{3}=0$, to $y=\sqrt{3}$

Don haka, saitin magani shine  $\{0,\sqrt{3}\}$

Question: Warware da rubuta tarin mafita: $x-4=\dfrac{x-4}{x}$
Solution:
$x-4=\dfrac{x-4}{x}$   

        ko kuma, $x(x-4)=x-4$ \qquad        [ta hanyar dai-dai-da-kai]

        ko kuma, $x(x-4)-(x-4)=0$ \qquad [ta hanyar canza wuri]

        ko kuma, $(x-4)(x-1)=0$ 

$\therefore x-4=0$   ko kuma   $x-1=0$

Idan  $x-4=0$,  $x=4$

Har ila yau, idan $x-1=0$, $x=1$ 

$\therefore $  saitin mafita shine  $\{1,4\}$

Question: Warware: $\left(\dfrac{x+a}{x-a}\right)^{2}-5\left(\dfrac{x+a}{x-a}\right)+6=0$
Solution:
$\left(\dfrac{x+a}{x-a}\right)^{2}-5\left(\dfrac{x+a}{x-a}\right)+6=0\ldots (1)$

Bari muce, $\dfrac{x+a}{x-a}=y$

$\therefore Daga (1)$ zamu samu, $y^{2}-5y+6=0$

ko kuma, $y^{2}-2y-3y+6=0$

ko kuma, $y(y-2)-3(y-2)=0$

ko kuma, $(y-2)(y-3)=0$

$\therefore idan $y-2=0$, $y=2$

ko kuma idan $y-3=0$, $y=3$

Yanzu, idan $y=2$,

$\dfrac{x+a}{x-a}=\dfrac{2}{1}$ \qquad [sanya darajar $y$ ]

ko kuma, $x+a=2(x-a)$ \qquad [ta hanyar ninkawa ta gicciye]

ko kuma, $x+a=2x-2a$

ko kuma, $2x-x=a+2a$

ko kuma, $x=3a$

Duk wannan, idan $y=3$,

$\dfrac{x+a}{x-a}=\dfrac{3}{1}$

ko kuma, $x+a=3(x-a)$ \qquad [ta hanyar ninkawa ta gicciye]

ko kuma, $x+a=3x-3a$

ko kuma, $3x-x=a+3a$

ko kuma, $x=2a$

$\therefore$ Maganin shine $x=2a$ ko kuma, $x=3a$

Question: Lissafi na kasa (denominator) na wata ɓara mai karancin daraja (proper fraction) ya fi lissafi na sama (numerator) girma da 4. Idan an murabba'i (squared) ɓara ɗin, lissafinsa na kasa zai fi lissafinsa na sama girma da 40. Nemi ɓara ɗin.
Solution:
Bari babbar lissafin (numerator) na ɓangare (fraction) ya kasance $x$ kuma ƙaramin lissafin (denominator) ya kasance $x+4$.

Don haka, ɓangaren shi ne $\dfrac{x}{x+4}$.

Sikwai na ɓangaren =$\left(\dfrac{x}{x+4}\right)^{2}=\dfrac{x^{2}}{(x+4)^{2}}=\dfrac{x^{2}}{x^{2}+8x+16}$

A nan, babbar lissafin = $x^{2}$ kuma ƙaramin lissafin = $x^{2}+8x+16$.

Daga tambayar, $x^{2}+8x+16=x^{2}+40$.

ko, $8x+16=40$.

ko, $8x=40-16$.

ko, $8x=24$.

ko, $x=3$.

$\therefore x+4=3+4=7$.

$\therefore \dfrac{x}{x+4}=\dfrac{3}{7}$.

$\therefore$ ɓangaren shi ne $\dfrac{3}{7}$.

Question: A ce akwai wani lambu mai siffar rectangle wanda tsayinsa ya kai $50$ mita kuma faɗinsa ya kai $40$ mita. Akwai wani wuri mai faɗi iri ɗaya a ko'ina a cikin gefen ciki na lambun da aka keɓe. Idan yankin lambun da ba wancan gefen ba ya kai murabba'i $1200$ mita, to, menene faɗin wancan gefen da aka keɓe a mita?
Solution:
Bari faɗin hanyar ya kasance $x$ mita.

Ba tare da hanyar ba, tsawon lambun zai kasance $(50-2x)$ mita kuma faɗin zai kasance $(40-2x)$ mita.

$\therefore$ Ba tare da hanyar ba, wurin lambun = $(50-2x)\times (40-2x)$ murabba'in mita.

A cewar tambayar, $(50-2x)\times (40-2x)=1200$.

ko, $2000-80x-100x+4x^2=1200$.

ko, $4x^2-180x+800=0$.

ko, $x^2-45x+200=0$ [ta hanyar raba da $4$].

ko, $x^2-5x-40x+200=0$.

ko, $x(x-5)-40(x-5)=0$.

ko, $(x-5)(x-40)=0$.

$\therefore x-5=0$ ko $x-40=0$.

idan $x-5=0$, $x=5$.

idan $x-40=0$, $x=40$.

Amma faɗin hanyar zai zama ƙasa da $40$ mita daga faɗin lambun.

$\therefore x\neq 40;\ \therefore x = 5$.

$\therefore$ hanyar faɗinta $5$ mita ne.

Question: Shahik ya sayi wasu alkalami akan Tk. $240$. Idan zai samu ƙarin alkalami ɗaya akan wannan kuɗin, matsakaicin farashin kowane alkalami zai ragu da Tk. $1$. Nawa ne adadin alkalami da ya saya?
Solution:
Bari, Shahik ya saya $x$  keken rubutu gaba ɗaya akan Tk. $240$.  Sannan kowane keken rubutu yana kashe Tk $\dfrac{240}{x}$.
 
Idan zai samu keken rubutu $(x+1)$ akan Tk. $240$, to, farashin kowane keken rubutu zai zama Tk. $\dfrac{240}{x+1}$.

Bisa ga tambayar, $\dfrac{240}{x+1}=\dfrac{240}{x}-1$  

ko, $\dfrac{240}{x+1}=\dfrac{240-x}{x}$  

ko, $240x=(x+1)(240-x)$\qquad [ta hanyar ninkawa]

ko, $240x=240x+240-x^2-x$ 

ko, $x^2+x-240=0$          [ta hanyar canja wuri]

ko, $x^2+16x-15x-240=0$  

ko, $x(x+16)-15(x+16)=0$  

ko, $(x+16)(x-15)=0$  

$\therefore x+16=0$,  ko $x-15=0$ 

\quad idan $x+16=0$, $x=-16$ 

\quad idan $x-15=0$, $x=15$ 

Amma adadin keken rubutu $x$, ba zai iya zama mara kyau ba

$\therefore x\neq -16$; $\ \therefore x=15$     

$\therefore$ Shahik ya saya keken rubutu $15$.

Question:
A wani jarabawar ajin IX na wata makaranta, jimillar makin $x$ ɗalibai da aka samu a darasin lissafi shine $1950$. Idan a wannan jarabawar, makin wani sabon ɗalibi a darasin lissafi shine $34$ kuma an ƙara shi ga jimillar makin farko, matsakaicin makin ya ragu da $1$.

a. Rubuta matsakaicin makin da aka samu na duk ɗalibai, ciki har da sabon ɗalibin, da kuma matsakaicin makin ɗalibai $x$ na farko, duka a cikin magana da $x$.
Solution:
Matsakaicin darajoji da $x$ ɗalibai suka samu = $\dfrac{1950}{x}$

Matsakaicin darajoji da $(x+1)$ ɗalibai suka samu, wanda ya haɗa da sabon ɗalibin $=\dfrac{1950+34}{x+1}=\dfrac{1984}{x+1}$

Question: Ta hanyar samar da **ilimi** daga sharuɗɗan da aka bayar, nuna cewa, $x^2+35x-1950=0$
Solution:
Daga tambayar, $\dfrac{1950}{x}=\dfrac{1984}{x+1}+1$

\quad        ko kuma, $\dfrac{1950}{x}-\dfrac{1984}{x+1}=1$ \quad    [ta hanyar canja wuri]

\quad        ko kuma, $\dfrac{1950x+1950-1984x}{x(x+1)}=1$  

\quad        ko kuma, $x^2+x=1950x-1984x+1950$ \quad   [ta hanyar wanzar da karkata]

\quad        ko kuma, $x^2+x=1950-34x$  

\quad        $\therefore x^2+35x-1950=0$ \quad   [an nuna]

Question:
A wani jarrabawar ajin IX na wata makaranta, jimillar maki na ɗalibai $x$ da aka samu a lissafi shine $1950$. Idan a wannan jarrabawar, makin wani sabon ɗalibi a lissafi shine $34$ kuma aka ƙara shi ga jimillar maki ta farko, matsakaicin maki ya ragu da $1$.

\item Ta hanyar nemo ƙimar $x$, nemo matsakaicin maki a lokuta biyu.
Solution:
$x^2+35x-1950=0$

\quad        ko kuma, $x^2+65x-30x-1950=0$

\quad        ko kuma, $x(x+65)-30(x+65)=0$

\quad        ko kuma, $(x+65)(x-30)=0$

$\therefore x+65=0$ ko $x-30=0$

 Idan $x+65=0$, $x=-65$

 Sake, idan $x-30=0$, $x=30$

   Tun da yawan ɗalibai, watau $x$ ba zai iya kasancewa mara kyau ba,

  Don haka, $x\neq -65$

$\therefore x=30$

$\therefore$ a yanayin farko, matsakaici = $\dfrac{1950}{30}=65$ kuma a yanayin na biyu, matsakaici = $\dfrac{1984}{31}=64$
Exact Answer: a harka ta farko, matsakaicin = \dfrac{1950}{30}=65 kuma a harka ta biyu, matsakaicin = \dfrac{1984}{31}=64

Question: Idan $\text{tan} A=\dfrac{4}{3}$, nemo sauran abubuwan da ke tattare da sin, kos, da tan na kusurwa $A$.
Solution:
An ba da cewa, $\text{tan} A=\dfrac{4}{3}$।

Don haka, gefe na gaba ga kusurwar $A$= $4$, gefe makwabta ga kusurwar $A$= $3$

hypotenuse =$\sqrt{4^{2}+3^{2}}=\sqrt{25}=5$

Saboda haka, $\text{sin} A =\dfrac{4}{5}$, $\text{cos} A =\dfrac{3}{5}$, $\text{cot} A =\dfrac{3}{4}$

$\text{cosec} A =\dfrac{5}{4}$, $\text{sec} A =\dfrac{5}{3}$

Question: $\angle B$ shi ne kusurwar dama na wani triangle mai kusurwar dama $ABC$. Idan $\text{tan} A=1$, to tabbatar da gaskiyar $2\text{sin} A\text{cos} A=1$.
Solution:
An baka cewa, $\text{tan} A=1$

To, gefen da yake gaban kusurwar = gefen da yake kusa da kusurwar = $a$

Guntun da yake gefen = $\sqrt{a^{2}+a^{2}}=\sqrt{2}a$

Don haka, $\text{sin} A= \dfrac{a}{\sqrt{2}a} =\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$, $\text{cos} A= \dfrac{a}{\sqrt{2}a} =\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$

Yanzu, Bangaren hagu, $=2\text{sin} A\text{cos} A=2\cdot\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\cdot\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}=2\cdot\dfrac{1}{2}=1=$ Bangaren dama.

 $\therefore$ $2\text{sin} A\text{cos} A=1$ gaskiya ne.

Question: Tabbatar da cewa, $\text{tan}\theta+\text{cot}\theta=\text{sec}\theta\cdot\text{cosec}\theta$
Solution:
Hannun hagu  $= \text{tan}\theta+\text{cot}\theta$ 

                $=\dfrac{\text{sin}\theta}{\text{cos}\theta}+\dfrac{\text{cos}\theta}{\text{sin}\theta}$ 

                $= \dfrac{\text{sin}^{2}\theta+\text{cos}^{2}\theta}{\text{sin}\theta\cdot\text{cos}\theta}$    

                $= \dfrac{1}{\text{sin}\theta\cdot \text{cos}\theta}$  [$\because \text{sin}^{2}\theta+\text{cos}^{2}\theta=1$]  

                 $= \dfrac{1}{\text{sin}\theta}\cdot\dfrac{1}{\text{cos}\theta}$ 

                $= \text{cosec}\theta\cdot\text{sec}\theta$ 

                $= \text{sec}\theta\cdot\text{cosec}\theta =$ Hannun dama (An tabbatar)

Question: Tabbatar da cewa, $\text{sec}^{2}\theta+\text{cosec}^{2}\theta=\text{sec}^{2}\theta\cdot\text{cosec}^{2}\theta$
Solution:
L.H.S. $=\text{sec}^{2}\theta +\text{cosec}^{2}\theta$  

		$=  \dfrac{1}{\text{cos}^{2}\theta} +\dfrac{1}{\text{sin}^{2}\theta}$

		$=  \dfrac{\text{sin}^{2}\theta +\text{cos}^{2}\theta}{\text{cos}^{2}\theta\cdot\text{sin}^{2}\theta}$ 

       		$=  \dfrac{1}{\text{cos}^{2}\theta\cdot \text{sin}^{2}\theta}$ 

       		$=  \dfrac{1}{\text{cos}^{2}\theta}\cdot\dfrac{1}{\text{sin}^{2}\theta}$

       		$=  \text{sec}^{2}\theta\cdot\text{cosec}^{2}\theta$

		$=$ R.H.S (An tabbatar)

Question: Tabbatar da cewa, $\dfrac{1}{1+\text{sin}^{2}\theta}+\dfrac{1}{1+\text{cosec}^{2}\theta}=1$
Solution:
L.H.S. $= \dfrac{1}{1+\text{sin}^{2}\theta}+\dfrac{1}{1+\text{cosec}^{2}\theta}$ 

		$= \dfrac{1}{1+\text{sin}^{2}\theta}+\dfrac{1}{1+\dfrac{1}{\text{sin}^{2}\theta}}$

		$= \dfrac{1}{1+\text{sin}^{2}\theta}+\dfrac{\text{sin}^{2}\theta}{1+\text{sin}^{2}\theta}$ 

		$= \dfrac{1+\text{sin}^{2}\theta}{1+\text{sin}^{2}\theta}$

		$= 1  =$ R.H.S (An tabbatar)

Question: Tabbatar da cewa: $\dfrac{1}{2-\text{sin}^{2}\theta}+\dfrac{1}{2+\text{tan}^{2}\theta}=1$
Solution:
L.H.S.	$= \dfrac{1}{2-\text{sin}^{2}\theta}+\dfrac{1}{2+\text{tan}^{2}\theta}$  

		$= \dfrac{1}{2-\text{sin}^{2}\theta}+\dfrac{1}{2+\dfrac{\text{sin}^{2}\theta}{\text{cos}^{2}\theta}}$

		$= \dfrac{1}{2-\text{sin}^{2}\theta}+\dfrac{\text{cos}^{2}\theta}{2\text{cos}^{2}\theta+\text{sin}^{2}\theta}$

		$= \dfrac{1}{2-\text{sin}^{2}\theta}+\dfrac{\text{cos}^{2}\theta}{2(1-\text{sin}^{2}\theta)+\text{sin}^{2}\theta}$ 

		$= \dfrac{1}{2-\text{sin}^{2}\theta}+\dfrac{\text{cos}^{2}\theta}{2-2\text{sin}^{2}\theta+\text{sin}^{2}\theta}$ 

		$= \dfrac{1}{2-\text{sin}^{2}\theta}+\dfrac{1-\text{sin}^{2}\theta}{2-\text{sin}^{2}\theta}$

		$= \dfrac{2-\text{sin}^{2}\theta}{2-\text{sin}^{2}\theta}$

		$= 1  =$ R.H.S (An tabbatar)

Question: Tabbatar da cewa: $\dfrac{\text{tan} A}{\text{sec} A+1}-\dfrac{\text{sec} A-1}{\text{tan} A}=0$
Solution:
L.H.S. $=\dfrac{\text{tan} A}{\text{sec} A+1}-\dfrac{\text{sec} A-1}{\text{tan} A}$  

		$=\dfrac{\text{tan}^{2}A-(\text{sec}^{2}A-1)}{(\text{sec} A+1)\text{tan} A}$    

		$=\dfrac{\text{tan}^{2}A-\text{tan}^{2}A}{(\text{sec} A+1)\text{tan} A}$  [$\because \text{sec}^{2}A-1=\text{tan}^{2}A$]

		$=\dfrac{0}{(\text{sec} A+1)\text{tan} A}$  

		$=0   =$ R.H.S (An nuna)

Question: Nuna cewa: $\sqrt{\dfrac{1-\text{sin} A}{1+\text{sin} A}}=\text{sec} A-\text{tan} A$
Solution:
L.H.S. $=\sqrt{\dfrac{1-\text{sin} A}{1+\text{sin} A}}$

		$=\sqrt{\dfrac{(1-\text{sin} A)(1-\text{sin} A)}{(1+\text{sin} A)(1-\text{sin} A)}}$ [Ta hanyar ninkawaNumerator da denominator da $\sqrt{1-\text{sin} A}$]

		$=\sqrt{\dfrac{(1-\text{sin} A)^{2}}{1-\text{sin}^{2}A}}$

		$=\sqrt{\dfrac{(1-\text{sin} A)^{2}}{\text{cos}^{2}A}}$

		$=\dfrac{1-\text{sin} A}{\text{cos} A}$

		$=\dfrac{1}{\text{cos} A}-\dfrac{\text{sin} A}{\text{cos} A}$

		$=\text{sec} A-\text{tan} A$

       $=$ R.H.S (An tabbatar)

Question: Idan $\text{tan} A+\text{sin} A=a$ da $\text{tan} A-\text{sin} A=b$, tabbatar da cewa, $a^{2}-b^{2}=4\sqrt{ab}$
Solution:
An bayar da cewa, $\text{tan} A+\text{sin} A=a$ da $\text{tan} A-\text{sin} A=b$  

	L.H.S. $=a^{2}-b^{2}$ 

		$=(\text{tan} A+\text{sin} A)^{2}-(\text{tan} A-\text{sin} A)^{2}$  	

		$=4\text{tan} A\text{sin} A$ $[\because (a+b)^2 - (a-b)^2 = 4ab]$    

       		$=4\sqrt{\text{tan}^{2}A\text{sin}^{2}A}$  

       		$=4\sqrt{\text{tan}^{2}A(1-\text{cos}^{2}A)}$  

       		$=4\sqrt{\text{tan}^{2}A-\text{tan}^{2}A.\text{cos}^{2}A}$ 	

      		$=4\sqrt{\text{tan}^{2}A-\text{sin}^{2}A}$  [$\because \text{tan}A=\dfrac{\text{sin}A}{\text{cos}A}$]

       		$=4\sqrt{(\text{tan} A+\text{sin} A)(\text{tan} A-\text{sin} A)}$  

       		$=4\sqrt{ab}$  

      		$=$ R.H.S (An tabbatar)

Question: Idan $\text{sec} A+\text{tan} A=\dfrac{5}{2}$, ku nemo ƙimar $\text{sec} A-\text{tan} A$.
Solution:
An ba mu cewa, $\text{sec} A+\text{tan} A=\dfrac{5}{2}\ldots(1)$

Mun sani cewa, $\text{sec}^{2}A=1+\text{tan}^{2}A$

Ko kuma, $\text{sec}^{2}A-\text{tan}^{2}A=1$

Ko kuma, $(\text{sec} A+\text{tan} A)(\text{sec} A-\text{tan} A)=1$

Ko kuma, $\dfrac{5}{2}(\text{sec} A-\text{tan} A)=1$   [Daga $(1)$]

Don haka, $\text{sec} A-\text{tan} A=\dfrac{2}{5}$

Question:
Nemo ƙimar:

$\dfrac{1-\text{sin}^{2}45\degree}{1+\text{sin}^{2}45\degree}+\text{tan}^{2}45\degree$
Solution:
An bayar da magana $=\dfrac{1-\text{sin}^{2}45\degree}{1+\text{sin}^{2}45\degree}+\text{tan}^{2}45\degree$

                $=\dfrac{1-\left(\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\right)^{2}}{1+\left(\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\right)^{2}} + (1)^2$  [$\because \text{sin} 45\degree=\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$ da $\text{tan} 45\degree=1$]

                $=\dfrac{1-\dfrac{1}{2}}{1+\dfrac{1}{2}}+1=\dfrac{\dfrac{1}{2}}{\dfrac{3}{2}}+1=\dfrac{1}{3}+1=\dfrac{4}{3}$

Question:
Nemo darajoji:

$\text{cot} 90\degree\cdot\text{tan} 0\degree\cdot\text{sec} 30\degree\cdot \text{cosec} 60\degree$
Solution:
Dàrèwa= $\text{cot} 90\degree\cdot\text{tan} 0\degree\cdot \text{sec} 30\degree\cdot\text{cosec} 60\degree$

                $=0\cdot 0 \cdot \dfrac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\cdot \dfrac{2}{\sqrt{3}}=0$

                           [ $\because \text{cot} 90\degree=0, \text{tan} 0\degree=0, \text{sec} 30\degree=\dfrac{2}{\sqrt{3}}, \text{cosec} 60\degree=\dfrac{2}{\sqrt{3}}$ ]

Question:
Nemo ƙimar:

$\sin 60\degree \cos 30\degree + \cos 60\degree \sin 30\degree$
Solution:
An bayar da magana $=\text{sin} 60\degree\cdot \text{cos} 30\degree+\text{cos} 60\degree\cdot \text{sin} 30\degree$  

                 $=\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\cdot\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}+\dfrac{1}{2}\cdot \dfrac{1}{2}$ 

                [ $\because \text{sin} 60\degree=\text{cos} 30\degree=\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}, \text{cos} 60\degree=\text{sin} 30\degree=\dfrac{1}{2}$]

                $=\dfrac{3}{4}+\dfrac{1}{4}=\dfrac{4}{4}=1$

Question:
Nemo ƙimar:

$\dfrac{1-\text{tan}^{2}60\degree}{1+\text{tan}^{2}60\degree}+\text{sin}^{2}60\degree$
Solution:
An bayar da tsari $=\dfrac{1-\text{tan}^{2}60\degree}{1+\text{tan}^{2}60\degree}+\text{sin}^{2}60\degree$

                 $=\dfrac{1-(\sqrt{3})^{2}}{1+(\sqrt{3})^{2}}+\left(\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)^{2}$  [$\because \text{tan} 60\degree=\sqrt{3}, \text{sin} 60\degree=\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$]

                 $=\dfrac{1-3}{1+3}+\dfrac{3}{4}=\dfrac{-2}{4}+\dfrac{3}{4}$

                 $=\dfrac{-2+3}{4}=\dfrac{1}{4}$

Question: Idan $\sqrt{2}\cos(A-B)=1$, $2\sin(A+B)=\sqrt{3}$ kuma $A,B$ kusurwoyi ne masu tsawon digiri kasa da 90, nemo ƙimomin $A$ da $B$.
Solution:
$\sqrt{2}\text{cos}(A-B)=1$

ko kuma, $\text{cos}(A-B)=\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$

ko kuma, $\text{cos}(A-B)=\text{cos} 45\degree$   [$\because \text{cos} 45\degree=\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$ ]

  $\therefore A-B=45^{0}\ldots(1)$           

kuma $2\text{sin}(A+B)=\sqrt{3}$

ko kuma, $\text{sin}(A+B)=\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$

ko kuma, $\text{sin}(A+B)=\text{sin} 60\degree$  [$\because \text{sin} 60\degree=\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$ ]

  $\therefore A+B=60^{0}\ldots(2)$           

Sa'ad da muka ƙara $(1)$ da $(2)$, muna samun,

        $2A=105^{0}$ 

   $\therefore   A=\dfrac{105^{0}}{2}=52\dfrac{1^{0}}{2}$            

Bayan haka, sa'ad da muka cire $(2)$ daga $(1)$, muna samun,

        $2B=15^{0}$                 

   $\therefore B=\dfrac{15^{0}}{2}=7\dfrac{1^{0}}{2}$          

Ana buƙatar $A=52\dfrac{1^{0}}{2}$ da $B=7\dfrac{1^{0}}{2}$

Question: Idan $\dfrac{\text{cos} A-\text{sin} A}{\text{cos} A+\text{sin} A}=\dfrac{1-\sqrt{3}}{1+\sqrt{3}}$, nemo ƙimar $A$.
Solution:
$\dfrac{\text{cos} A-\text{sin} A}{\text{cos} A+\text{sin} A}=\dfrac{1-\sqrt{3}}{1+\sqrt{3}}$

ko,  $\dfrac{\text{cos} A-\text{sin} A+\text{cos} A+\text{sin} A}{\text{cos} A-\text{sin} A-\text{cos} A-\text{sin} A}=\dfrac{1-\sqrt{3}+1+\sqrt{3}}{1-\sqrt{3}-1-\sqrt{3}}$ [Ta hanyar ƙari-rase]         

ko,  $\dfrac{2\text{cos} A}{-2\text{sin} A}=\dfrac{2}{-2\sqrt{3}}$         

ko,  $\dfrac{\text{cos} A}{\text{sin} A}=\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$         

ko,  $\text{cot} A=\text{cot} 60\degree$         

$\therefore A=60\degree$

Question: Idan $A=45\degree$ Tabbatar da cewa, $\text{cos} 2A=\dfrac{1-\text{tan}^{2}A}{1+\text{tan}^{2}A}$.
Solution:
An baka cewa, $A=45\degree$

Muna da buƙatar tabbatar da cewa, $\text{cos} 2A=\dfrac{1-\text{tan}^{2}A}{1+\text{tan}^{2}A}$

L.H.S. $=\text{cos} 2A$

$=\text{cos}(2\times 45\degree)=\text{cos} 90\degree=0$

R.H.S. $=\dfrac{1-\text{tan}^{2}A}{1+\text{tan}^{2}A}$

$=\dfrac{1-\text{tan}^{2}45\degree}{1+\text{tan}^{2}45\degree}=\dfrac{1-(1)^{2}}{1+(1)^{2}}$

$=\dfrac{0}{2}=0$

$\therefore$ L.H.S. $=$ R.H.S. (An tabbatar)

Question: Warware $2\text{cos}^{2}\theta+3\text{sin}\theta-3=0$, inda $\theta$ ke kusurwa mai kaifi.
Solution:
An bayar da tsarin lissafin $2\text{cos}^{2}\theta+3\text{sin}\theta-3=0$

        ko,  $2(1-\text{sin}^{2}\theta)+3\text{sin}\theta-3=0$

        ko,  $2(1+\text{sin}\theta)(1-\text{sin}\theta)-3(1-\text{sin}\theta)=0$

        ko,  $(1-\text{sin}\theta)\{2(1+\text{sin}\theta)-3\}=0$

        ko,  $(1-\text{sin}\theta)\{2\text{sin}\theta-1\}=0$

         $\therefore 1-\text{sin}\theta=0$       

           ko, $\text{sin}\theta=1$           

               ko, $\text{sin}\theta= \text{sin} 90^{0}$          

          ko, $\theta= 90\degree$                  

 ko,  $2\text{sin}\theta-1=0$

ko,  $2\text{sin}\theta=1$

ko,  $\text{sin}\theta=\dfrac{1}{2}$

ko,  $\text{sin}\theta=\text{sin} 30\degree$

ko,  $\theta=30\degree$                                                             

$\theta$ yanki ne mai kaifi, saboda haka $\theta=30\degree$.

Question:
Lissafi:

Sama da ƙasa, kusurwar duba saman wani dogon katafaren gini daga wani wuri a ƙasa tana da girman $30\degree$ a nesa na $75$ mita daga ƙafar sa. Nemo tsawon katafaren ginin.
Solution:
Bari, tsayin hasumiyar shine $AB= h$ mita.
Angula na tashin hankali a $C$ daga ƙafar hasumiyar $BC=75$ mita na $A$
a ƙasa shine $\angle ACB=30\degree$.

Daga $\bigtriangleup ABC$ muna samu, $\text{tan} \angle ACB=\cfrac{AB}{BC}$

ko, $\text{tan}  30\degree=\dfrac{h}{75}$ ko, $\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{3}}=\dfrac{h}{75}$  ko, $\sqrt{3}h=75$  ko, $h=\dfrac{75}{\sqrt{3}}$

ko, $h=\cfrac{75\sqrt{3}}{3}$ [ta hanyar ninkawa daidai da na ƙasa da sama da $\sqrt{3}$]

ko, $h=25\sqrt{3}$

$\therefore h=43.301$   (kusa).

$\therefore$ Tsayin hasumiyar shine $43.30$ mita (kusa).

Question: Tsawon itace ɗin shine $105$ mita. Idan kusurwar duba saman itacen daga wani wuri a ƙasa da ƙafa ta, tana $60\degree$, nemo nisan wancan wuri a ƙasa daga ƙafar itacen.
Solution:
Bari, nisan wurin a ƙasa daga ƙafar itacen ya kasance $BC= x$ mita. Tsayin itacen
$AB= 105$ mita kuma a $C$ kusurwar ɗagawar saman itacen ita ce $\angle ACB=60\degree$
Daga $\bigtriangleup ABC$ muna samun,

 $\text{tan} \angle ACB=\cfrac{AB}{BC}$


ko, $\text{tan}  60\degree=\dfrac{105}{x}$  

ko, $\sqrt{3}=\dfrac{105}{x}$ [$\because \text{tan}  60^{0}=\sqrt{3}$] 

ko, $\sqrt{3}x=105$  ko, $x=\cfrac{105}{\sqrt{3}}$  ko, $x=\cfrac{105\sqrt{3}}{3}$  ko, $x=35\sqrt{3}$  

$\therefore x=60.622$   (kusan.)

$\therefore$ Nisa da ake buƙata na wurin a ƙasa daga ƙafar itacen shi ne
 $60.62$ mita (kusan.).

Question: Tura mai tsawon mita 18 ta taɓa ruɓin bango kuma tana yin kusurwar $45\degree$ da sararin sama. Nemi tsawon bangon.
Solution:
Bari, tsawon bango $AB=h$ mita, 
tsawon tangalmi $AC$ shine $18$m. kuma yana bada kusurwa $\angle ACB = 45\degree$ tare da 
ƙasa.

Daga $\triangle ABC$ muna samu, $\text{sin}  \angle ACB=\dfrac{AB}{AC}$  

ko kuma,  $\text{sin}  45\degree = \dfrac{h}{18}$

ko kuma,  $\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}= \dfrac{h}{18}$ $\left[ \because \text{sin}  45\degree =\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \right]$

ko kuma,   $\sqrt{2}h=18$     ko kuma,        $h=\dfrac{18}{\sqrt{2}}$  

ko kuma,   $h=\dfrac{18\sqrt{2}}{2}$        [ta hanyar ninka maƙare da kuma ƙasa da $\sqrt{2}$]  

ko kuma, $h=12.728$ (ƙiyasin) 

Don haka, tsawon tangalmin da ake buƙata na bangon shine $12.73$ (ƙiyasin)

Question: Bishiya ta kwanta sakamakon guguwa. An dallelawa bishiyar sandar da tsayinsa ya kai mita $7$ daga ƙafarta domin ta mike. Idan kusurwar hawan sandar a wurin da ta taɓa ƙasa shine $30\degree$, nemi tsawon sandar.
Solution:
Bari, tsayin sandar daga ƙafa da ta jingina ga itacen ya kasance $AB= 7$ mita kuma kusurwar ragi ita ce $\angle DBC=30\degree$.

$\therefore \angle ACB=\angle DBC=30\degree$ [kusurwa madadin]

Daga $\bigtriangleup ABC$ muna samun,

$\text{sin} \angle ACB=\cfrac{AB}{BC}$ ko, $\text{sin} 30\degree=\cfrac{7}{BC}$

ko, $\cfrac{1}{2}=\cfrac{7}{BC}$ $\left[ \because \text{sin} 30\degree=\cfrac{1}{2}\right]$

$\therefore BC=14$

$\therefore$ Tsawon sandar da ake buƙata shine $14$ mita.

Question: Giɗar ɗaukaka daga wani wuri a kan rufin ginin tana nan $60^{0}$ daga kowane wuri a ƙasa. Da tafiya baya 42 m daga wannan wuri, giɗar ɗaukaka zuwa saman ginin ta zama $45^{0}$. Nemi tsawon ginin.
Solution:
Bari, tsayin ginin shi ne $AB= h$ mita. Ƙimar da aka ɗaga sama daga saman ta $ \angle ACB=60^{0}$. Ƙimar da aka ɗaga ta zama $ \angle ADB=45^{0}$ lokacin da aka koma baya daga $C$ ta $CD= 42$ mita.

Bari, $BC=x$ mita.

$ \therefore BD=BC+CD=(x+42)$ mita.

Daga $ \bigtriangleup ABC $ muna samun,

$ \text{tan} \angle ACB=\dfrac{AB}{BC} $ ko, $ \text{tan} 60\degree=\dfrac{h}{x} $

ko, $ \sqrt{3}=\dfrac{h}{x} $ $ \left[ \because \text{tan} 60\degree = \sqrt{3} \right] $

$ \therefore x=\dfrac{h}{\sqrt{3}}\ldots(1) $

Duk wani lokaci, Daga $ \bigtriangleup ABD $ muna samun, $ \text{tan} \angle ADB=\text{tan} 45\degree=\dfrac{AB}{BD} $

ko, $ \text{tan} 45\degree=\dfrac{h}{x+42} $ ko, $ 1=\dfrac{h}{x+42} $ [$\because \text{tan} 45^{0}=1$]

ko, $ h=x+42 $ ko, $ h=\dfrac{h}{\sqrt{3}}+42 $ [daga ($1$)]

ko, $ \sqrt{3}h=h+42\sqrt{3} $ ko, $ \sqrt{3}h-h=42\sqrt{3} $ ko, $ (\sqrt{3}-1)h=42\sqrt{3} $ ko, $ h=\dfrac{42\sqrt{3}}{\sqrt{3}-1} $

$ \therefore h=99.373 $ (kimanin.)

$ \therefore $ Tsayin ginin shi ne $ 99.37 $ mita (kimanin.).

Question: Wata sanda ta karye, inda wani sashe ta taɓa ƙasa da nisan mitoci $10$ daga ƙafarta, sai kuma sauran sashinta ya yi kusurwa ta $30^{0}$ da sashin da ya karye. Nemi tsawon sandar gaba ɗaya.
Solution:
Bari, tsawon sandar gaba ɗaya $AB= h$ mita. Ya karye a tsawon $BC= x$ mita ba tare da rabuwa ba, kuma ya yi kusurwa da ɗayan, $\angle BCD=30^{0}$ kuma ya taɓa ƙasa a nesa $BD= 10$ mita daga ƙafa.

A nan, $CD=AC=AB-BC=(h-x)$ mita.

Daga $\bigtriangleup BCD$ muna samu,

 $\text{tan} \angle BCD=\cfrac{BD}{BC}$ ko kuma, $\text{tan} 30\degree=\cfrac{10}{x}$

ko kuma, $\cfrac{1}{\sqrt{3}}=\cfrac{10}{x}$  $\therefore x=10\sqrt{3}$

Kuma, $\text{sin} \angle BCD=\cfrac{BD}{CD}$ ko kuma, $\text{sin} {30^{0}}=\cfrac{BD}{CD}$ ko kuma, $\cfrac{1}{2}=\cfrac{10}{h-x}$

ko kuma, $h-x=20$ ko kuma, $h=20+x$ ko kuma, $h=20+10\sqrt{3}$ [sanya darajar $x$]

$\therefore h=37.321$ (kusan.)

$\therefore$ Tsawon sandar shine $37.32$ mita (kusan.).

Question: Bari $A$ da $B$ su yi tafiyar nesa da aka tsayar a cikin minti $t_1$ da $t_2$. Nuna yadda matsakaicin saurin $A$ da $B$ yake dangane da juna.
Solution:
Bari matsakaicin saurin $A$ da $B$ su zama $v_1$ mita a kowace minti da $v_2$ mita a kowace minti, bi da bi. Don haka, a cikin lokaci $t_1$ minti $A$ zai yi tafiyar $v_1t_1$ mita kuma a cikin lokaci $t_2$ minti $B$ zai yi tafiyar $v_2t_2$ mita. Haka nan, zamu iya rubuta kamar haka.
$v_1t_1 = v_2t_2$   $\therefore \dfrac{v_1}{v_2}=\dfrac{t_2}{t_1}$  
Anan, rabon saurin ya yi sabanin daidai da rabon lokaci.

Question: Yanzu haka, **nisan** shekarun mahaifi da ɗansa ya kasance $7:2$, kuma bayan shekara $5$ da zuwa, **nisan** zai zama $8:3$. Menene shekarunsu na yanzu?
Solution:
Bari shekaru na yanzu na mahaifin su zama $a$ da na ɗansa su zama $b$.

Don haka, ta hanyar sharuɗɗan matsala ta farko da ta biyu, muna da,

        $\dfrac{a}{b}=\dfrac{7}{2} ...(1)$        

        $\dfrac{a+5}{b+5}=\dfrac{8}{3} ...(2)$ 

        Daga lissafi ($1$), mun samu,

        $a=\dfrac{7b}{2} ...(3)$ 

        Daga lissafi ($2$), mun samu,

          $3(a+5)=8(b+5)$ 
          
          ko kuma, $3a+15=8b+40$

                 ko kuma, $3a-8b=40-15$ 

                 ko kuma, $3\times\dfrac{7b}{2}-8b=25$   [ta hanyar amfani da ($3$)]         

                  ko kuma, $\dfrac{21b-16b}{2}=25$ 

                  ko kuma, $5b=50$ 

        $\therefore b=10$ 

A lissafi ($3$), ta hanyar saka $b=10$, mun samu $a=\dfrac{7 \times 10}{2}=35$.

$\therefore$ Shekaru na yanzu na mahaifin su ne $35$ shekara, kuma na ɗansa su ne $10$ shekara.

Question: Idan $a:b=b:c$, tabbatar da cewa, $\left(\dfrac{a+b}{b+c}\right)^{2}=\dfrac{a^{2}+b^{2}}{b^{2}+c^{2}}$
Solution:
An bayar da cewa, $a:b=b:c$

$\therefore b^{2}=ac$

Yanzu, $\left(\dfrac{a+b}{b+c}\right)^{2}=\dfrac{(a+b)^{2}}{(b+c)^{2}}$

$=\dfrac{a^{2}+2ab+b^{2}}{b^{2}+2bc+c^{2}}$

$=\dfrac{a^{2}+2ab+ac}{ac+2bc+c^{2}}$

$=\dfrac{a(a+2b+c)}{c(a+2b+c)}$

 $=\dfrac{a}{c}$

Kuma,   $\dfrac{a^{2}+b^{2}}{b^{2}+c^{2}}=\dfrac{a^{2}+ac}{ac+c^{2}}$

$=\dfrac{a(a+c)}{c(a+c)}$

$=\dfrac{a}{c}$

$\therefore \left(\dfrac{a+b}{b+c}\right)^{2}=\dfrac{a^{2}+b^{2}}{b^{2}+c^{2}}$

Question: Idan $ \dfrac{a}{b}=\dfrac{c}{d}$, nuna cewa, $\dfrac{a^{2}+b^{2}}{a^{2}-b^{2}}=\dfrac{ac+bd}{ac-bd}$
Solution:
Bari, $\dfrac{a}{b}=\dfrac{c}{d}=k$

$\therefore a=bk$ da $c=dk$    

Yanzu, $\dfrac{a^{2}+b^{2}}{a^{2}-b^{2}}=\dfrac{(bk)^{2}+b^{2}}{(bk)^{2}-b^{2}}=\dfrac{b^2(k^2+1)}{b^2(k^2-1)} = \dfrac{k^{2}+1}{k^{2}-1}$ 

Kuma, $\dfrac{ac+bd}{ac-bd}=\dfrac{bk\cdot dk+bd}{bk \cdot dk-bd}=\dfrac{bd(k^{2}+1)}{bd(k^{2}-1)}=\dfrac{k^{2}+1}{k^{2}-1}$

$\therefore \dfrac{a^{2}+b^{2}}{a^{2}-b^{2}}=\dfrac{ac+bd}{ac-bd}$

Question: Warware: $\dfrac{1-ax}{1+ax}\sqrt{\dfrac{1+bx}{1-bx}}=1$ inda $0<b<2a<2b$
Solution:
An bayar da cewa, $\dfrac{1-ax}{1+ax}\sqrt{\dfrac{1+bx}{1-bx}}=1$

         ko, $\sqrt{\dfrac{1+bx}{1-bx}}=\dfrac{1+ax}{1-ax}$

         ko, $\dfrac{1+bx}{1-bx}=\dfrac{(1+ax)^{2}}{(1-ax)^{2}}$ [ta hanyar daukaka bangarori biyu zuwa murabba'i]

          ko, $\dfrac{1+bx}{1-bx}=\dfrac{1+2ax+a^{2}x^{2}}{1-2ax+a^{2}x^{2}}$

                ko, $\dfrac{1+bx+1-bx}{1+bx-1+bx}=\dfrac{1+2ax+a^{2}x^{2}+1-2ax+a^{2}x^{2}}{1+2ax+a^{2}x^{2}-1+2ax-a^{2}x^{2}}$ [ta hanyar gamawa da raba]

          ko, $\dfrac{2}{2bx}=\dfrac{2(1+a^{2}x^{2})}{4ax}$

          ko, $2ax=bx(1+a^{2}x^{2})$

          ko, $x\{2a-b(1+a^{2}x^{2})\}=0$

            $\therefore \ x=0$  
                
                Ko dai, $2a-b(1+a^{2}x^{2})=0$

                       ko, $b(1+a^{2}x^{2})=2a$ 

                      ko, $1+a^{2}x^{2}=\dfrac{2a}{b}$

                     ko, $a^{2}x^{2}=\dfrac{2a}{b}-1$

                     ko, $x^{2}=\dfrac{1}{a^{2}}\left(\dfrac{2a}{b}-1\right)$

                     $\therefore x=\pm\dfrac{1}{a}\sqrt{\dfrac{2a}{b}-1}$

Don haka, mafita da ake bukata ita ce $x=0, \pm\dfrac{1}{a}\sqrt{\dfrac{2a}{b}-1}$

Question: Idan $\dfrac{\sqrt{1+x}+\sqrt{1-x}}{\sqrt{1+x}-\sqrt{1-x}}=p$, tabbatar cewa, $p^{2}-\dfrac{2p}{x}+1=0$.
Solution:
An bamu cewa,
$\dfrac{\sqrt{1+x}+\sqrt{1-x}}{\sqrt{1+x}-\sqrt{1-x}}=p$ 

ko kuma, $\dfrac{\sqrt{1+x}+\sqrt{1-x}+\sqrt{1+x}-\sqrt{1-x}}{\sqrt{1+x}+\sqrt{1-x}-\sqrt{1+x}+\sqrt{1-x}}=\dfrac{p+1}{p-1}$  [ta hanyar yin amfani da hanyar componendo - dividendo]

ko kuma, $\dfrac{2\sqrt{1+x}}{2\sqrt{1-x}}=\dfrac{p+1}{p-1}$

ko kuma, $\dfrac{\sqrt{1+x}}{\sqrt{1-x}}=\dfrac{p+1}{p-1}$      

ko kuma, $\dfrac{1+x}{1-x}=\dfrac{(p+1)^{2}}{(p-1)^{2}}=\dfrac{p^{2}+2p+1}{p^{2}-2p+1}$  [ta hanyar yin murabba'i ga bangarori biyu]

ko kuma, $\dfrac{1+x+1-x}{1+x-1+x}=\dfrac{p^{2}+2p+1+p^{2}-2p+1}{p^{2}+2p+1-p^{2}+2p-1}$  [ta hanyar yin amfani da hanyar componendo - dividendo]

ko kuma, $\dfrac{2}{2x}=\dfrac{2(p^{2}+1)}{4p}$

ko kuma, $\dfrac{1}{x}=\dfrac{p^{2}+1}{2p}$  

ko kuma, $p^{2}+1=\dfrac{2p}{x}$

$\therefore p^{2}-\dfrac{2p}{x}+1=0$
