An bayar da $U = \{a, b, c, x, y, z\}$, $A = \{a, b, x\}$, da $B = \{c, y\}$.

Na farko, muna neman cikamakin $B$, wanda aka bayyana da $B'$. Cikamakin wani jeri $B$ dangane da jeri na duniya $U$ shine jerin dukkan abubuwan da ke cikin $U$ waɗanda ba sa cikin $B$. Don haka, $B' = U - B = \{a, b, c, x, y, z\} - \{c, y\} = \{a, b, x, z\}$.

Sa'an nan, muna neman haɗin kan jeri $A$ da cikamakin jeri $B$, $A \cup B'$. Haɗin kan jeruka biyu shine jeri da ke ɗauke da duk abubuwan da ke cikin ɗayan jeruka biyu. Don haka, $A \cup B' = \{a, b, x\} \cup \{a, b, x, z\} = \{a, b, x, z\}$.

Tun da sakamakon $A \cup B'$ shine $\{a, b, x, z\}$ kuma $B'$ ma $\{a, b, x, z\}$ ne, mun tabbatar da cewa $A \cup B' = B'$.

Question: A ba da cewa duniyar duka $U = \{a, b, c, x, y, z\}$ da kuma subsets $A = \{a, b, x\}$ da $B = \{c, y\}$, tabbatar da cewa $A' \cap B = B$.
Solution:
An bamu $U = \{a, b, c, x, y, z\}$, $A = \{a, b, x\}$, da $B = \{c, y\}$.
Na farko, muna neman dukkanin abubuwan da ke cikin $A'$ (complement na $A$), wanda aka yiwa lakabi da $A'$. $A' = U - A = \{a, b, c, x, y, z\} - \{a, b, x\} = \{c, y, z\}$.
Sa'an nan, muna neman haɗuwa (intersection) tsakanin saiti $A'$ da saiti $B$, wato $A' \cap B$. Haɗuwa tsakanin saiti biyu ita ce saiti wanda ya ƙunshi dukkan abubuwan da ke tsakaninsu duka. Don haka, $A' \cap B = \{c, y, z\} \cap \{c, y\} = \{c, y\}$.
Tun da sakamakon $A' \cap B$ shine $\{c, y\}$ kuma $B$ ma shine $\{c, y\}$, mun tabbatar da cewa $A' \cap B = B$.

Question: A ba da tarin sararin duniya $U = \{a, b, c, x, y, z\}$ da tarin-ƙarami $A = \{a, b, x\}$ da $B = \{c, y\}$, nemo tarin $(A \cap B) \cup (A \cap B')$.
Solution:
An bayar da $U = \{a, b, c, x, y, z\}$, $A = \{a, b, x\}$, da $B = \{c, y\}$.
Da farko, muna neman haɗuwar saɓaɓɓun abubuwa na saɓaɓɓun abubuwa $A$ da $B$, wato $A \cap B$. Tun da babu wani abun gama gari tsakanin $A$ da $B$, haɗuwarsu ita ce saɓaɓɓun abubuwa: $A \cap B = \{a, b, x\} \cap \{c, y\} = \emptyset$.
Bayan haka, muna neman abin da ya rage na saɓaɓɓun abubuwa $B$, wato $B'$. $B' = U - B = \{a, b, c, x, y, z\} - \{c, y\} = \{a, b, x, z\}$.
Sa'an nan, muna neman haɗuwar saɓaɓɓun abubuwa na saɓaɓɓun abubuwa $A$ da $B'$, wato $A \cap B'$. Abubuwan da ke gama gari su ne $a$, $b$, da $x$. Don haka, $A \cap B' = \{a, b, x\} \cap \{a, b, x, z\} = \{a, b, x\}$.
A ƙarshe, muna neman haɗuwar sakamakon biyu: $(A \cap B) \cup (A \cap B') = \emptyset \cup \{a, b, x\} = \{a, b, x\}$.
(Lura: Wannan misali ne na dokar rarrabawa ta ka'idar saɓaɓɓun abubuwa, musamman $A \cap (B \cup B') = A \cap U = A$. Tun da $B$ da $B'$ ba su da abin da ke tsakaninsu, $A \cap B$ da $A \cap B'$ suma ba su da abin da ke tsakaninsu, kuma haɗuwarsu ita ce kawai saɓaɓɓun abubuwan da ke cikin $A$ waɗanda suke ko dai a cikin $B$ ko a cikin $B'$, wanda kuma duka saɓaɓɓun abubuwan $A$ ne.)

Question:
Bari $A = \{x: 2 < x \le 5, x \in \mathbb{R}\}$ da $B = \{x: 1 \le x < 3, x \in \mathbb{R}\}$ da $C = \{2, 4, 5\}$. Nuna waɗannan tarin ta amfani da salon ƙayyadadden tarin:
$A \cap B$
Solution:
An bayar da cewa, $A = \{x: 2 < x \leq 5, x \in R\}$,
$B = \{x: 1 \leq x < 3, x \in R\}$ da $C = \{2, 4, 5\}$
 $A \cap B = \{x: 2 < x \leq 5, x \in R\} \cap \{x: 1 \leq x < 3, x \in R\}$
$= \{x: 2 < x < 3, x \in R\}$

Question:
An ba da cewa, $A = \{x: 2 < x \le 5, x \in R\}$
da $B = \{x: 1 \le x < 3, x \in R\}$ da $C = \{2, 4, 5\}$. Bayyana tarukan masu zuwa a cikin bayanin taru:
$A' \cap B'$
Solution:
An bayar da cewa, $A = \{x: 2 < x \leq 5, x \in R\}$,
$B = \{x: 1 \leq x < 3, x \in R\}$ da kuma $C = \{2, 4, 5\}$
Anan, $U = R$
$\therefore A \cup B = \{x: 2 < x \leq 5, x \in R\} \cup \{x: 1 \leq x < 3, x \in R\}$
$= \{x: 1 \leq x \leq 5, x \in R\}$
A bisa dokar De Morgan,
$A' \cap B' = (A \cup B)' = U - (A \cup B)$
$= R - \{x: 1 \leq x \leq 5, x \in R\}$
$= \{x: x < 1 \text{ ko } x > 5, x \in R\}$

Question:
Duk da cewa, $A = \{x: 2 < x \le 5, x \in R\}$
da $B = \{x: 1 \le x < 3, x \in R\}$ da $C = \{2, 4, 5\}$. Nuna waɗannan tarin a cikin salon bayanin tarin:
 $A' \cup B$
Solution:
An bayar da cewa, $A = \{x: 2 < x \leq 5, x \in R\}$,
$B = \{x: 1 \leq x < 3, x \in R\}$ da $C = \{2, 4, 5\}$
$A' \cap B$
$A' = U - A = R - \{x: 2 < x \leq 5, x \in R\}$
$= \{x: x \leq 2 \text{ ko } x > 5, x \in R\}$
$B = \{x: 1 \leq x < 3, x \in R\}$
$A' \cup B = \{x: x < 3 \text{ ko } x > 5, x \in R\}$

Question:
An bā, $U = \{x: x < 10, x \in R\}$, $A = \{x: 1 < x \le 4\}$
da $B = \{x: 3 \le x < 6\}$. Ka bayyana waɗannan *rukunnai* a hanyar gina rukuni:
$A \cap B$
Solution:
An bayar da cewa, $U = \{x:x < 10, x \in R\}$
$A = \{x: 1 < x \leq 4\}$
da kuma $B = \{x: 3 \leq x < 6\}$
$A \cap B = \{x: 1 < x \leq 4\} \cap \{x: 3 \leq x < 6\}$
$= \{x: 3 \leq x \leq 4\}$
[Lura: Amsar da ke cikin littafin makaranta ba daidai ba ce.]

Question:
An bayar da cewa, $U = \{x: x < 10, x \in R\}$, $A = \{x: 1 < x \le 4\}$
da $B = \{x: 3 \le x < 6\}$. Nuna waɗannan taruka ta hanyar tarin-ƙayyadewa:
 $A' \cap B$
Solution:
An bayar da cewa, $U = \{x:x < 10, x \in R\}$
$A = \{x: 1 < x \leq 4\}$
kuma $B = \{x: 3 \leq x < 6\}$
$A' = U - A$
$= \{x: x < 10, x \in R\} - \{x: 1 < x \leq 4\}$
$= \{x: x \leq 1 \text{ ko } 4 < x < 10\}$
$\therefore A' \cap B = \{x: x \leq 1 \text{ ko } 4 < x < 10\} \cap \{x: 3 \leq x < 6\}$
$= \{x: 4 < x < 6\}$

Question:
An baki: $U = \{x: x < 10, x \in R\}$, $A = \{x: 1 < x \le 4\}$
kuma $B = \{x: 3 \le x < 6\}$. Nuna tarin masu biyowa ta hanyar ginin tarin:
 $A \cap B'$
Solution:
An bayar da cewa, $U = \{x:x < 10, x \in R\}$
$A = \{x: 1 < x \leq 4\}$
da $B = \{x: 3 \leq x < 6\}$
$B' = U - B$
$= \{x: x < 10, x \in R\} - \{x: 3 \leq x < 6\}$
$= \{x: x < 3 \text{ ko } 6 \leq x < 10\}$
$\therefore A \cap B' = \{x: 1 < x \leq 4\} \cap \{x: x < 3 \text{ ko } 6 \leq x < 10\}$
$= \{x: 1 < x < 3\}$

Question:
An baki $U = \{x: x < 10, x \in R\}$, $A = \{x: 1 < x \le 4\}$
da $B = \{x: 3 \le x < 6\}$. Nuna tarin masu biyowa ta hanyar tsarin gina tarin:
 $A' \cap B'$
Solution:
An bayar, $U = \{x:x < 10, x \in R\}$
$A = \{x: 1 < x \leq 4\}$
da $B = \{x: 3 \leq x < 6\}$
$A \cup B = \{x: 1 < x \leq 4\} \cup \{x: 3 \leq x < 6\}$
$= \{x: 1 < x < 6\}$
A bisa ga dokar De Morgan,
$A' \cap B' = (A \cup B)'$
$= U - (A \cup B)$
$= \{x: x < 10, x \in R\} - \{x: 1 < x < 6\}$
$= \{x: x \leq 1 \text{ ko } 6 \leq x < 10\}$
[LURA: Amsar da ke cikin littafin malanta ba daidai ba ce.]

Question:
An ba da tarin $A$ da $B$ a ƙasa ga kowane lamari. Nemi $A \cup B$ kuma ka tabbatar da cewa $A \subset (A \cup B)$ da kuma $B \subset (A \cup B)$
$A = \{-2, -1, 0, 1, 2\}$ kuma $B = \{-3, 0, 3\}$
Solution:
An bayar, $A = \{-2, -1, 0, 1, 2\}$ da $B = \{-3, 0, 3\}$
$\therefore A \cup B = \{-2, -1, 0, 1, 2\} \cup \{-3, 0, 3\}$
$= \{-3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3\}$ (Amsa.)
[K.B.: Amsar da ke littafin malamin ba daidai ba ce.]
$\therefore A \subset (A \cup B)$ da $B \subset (A \cup B)$ (An tabbatar)

Question:
An ba da tarin $A$ da $B$ a ƙasa ga kowane yanayi. Nemi $A \cup B$ kuma ka tabbatar cewa $A \subset (A \cup B)$ da $B \subset (A \cup B)$.
$A = \{x: x \in \mathbb{N}, x < 10$ kuma $x$ shine ninkawa na $2\}$
kuma $B = \{x: x \in \mathbb{N}, x < 10$ kuma $x$ shine ninkawa na $3\}$.
Solution:
$A = \{x: x \in \mathbb{N}, x < 10$ kuma $x$ ƙididdiga ce ta $2\}$
$B = \{x: x \in \mathbb{N}, x < 10$ kuma $x$ ƙididdiga ce ta $3\}$
$\therefore A = \{2, 4, 6, 8\}$ kuma $B = \{3, 6, 9\}$
$\therefore A \cup B = \{2, 4, 6, 8\} \cup \{3, 6, 9\}$
$= \{2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 9\}$ (Amsa.)
[LURA: Amsar da ke cikin littafin makaranta tana nan kuskure.]
$\therefore A \subset (A \cup B)$ kuma $B \subset (A \cup B)$ (An tabbatar)

Question:
Nemo $A \cap B$ a kowane yanayi a ƙasa kuma tabbatar cewa $(A \cap B) \subset A$ da kuma $(A \cap B) \subset B$
$A = \{0, 1, 2, 3\}$; $B = \{-1, 0, 2\}$
Solution:
An bayar da cewa, $A = \{0, 1, 2, 3\}$ da $B = \{-1, 0, 2\}$
$\therefore A \cap B = \{0, 1, 2, 3\} \cap \{-1, 0, 2\}$
$\therefore A \cap B = \{0, 2\}$ (Ams.)
$\therefore (A \cap B) \subset A$ da $(A \cap B) \subset B$ (An tabbatar)

Question:
Nemo $A \cap B$ a kowane yanayi a ƙasa kuma tabbatar cewa $(A \cap B) \subset A$ da $(A \cap B) \subset B$
$A = \{a, b, c, d\}$, $B = \{b, x, c, y\}$
Solution:
An bayar da cewa, $A = \{a, b, c, d\}$ da $B = \{b, x, c, y\}$
$\therefore A \cap B = \{a, b, c, d\} \cap \{b, x, c, y\}$
$= \{b, c\}$ (Ams.)
$\therefore (A \cap B) \subset A$ da $(A \cap B) \subset B$ (An tabbatar)

Question:
A cikin dalibai mata na kwalejin Begum Rokeya, an gudanar da bincike game da halayensu na karatu ga mujallun Bichitra, Sandhani da Purbani. An gano cewa 60% na 'yan matan na karanta Bichitra, 50% na karanta Sandhani, 50% na karanta Purbani, 30% na karanta Bichitra da Sandhani, 30% na karanta Bichitra da Purbani, 20% na karanta Sandhani da Purbani, yayin da 10% ke karanta dukkan mujallun uku.
Waɗanne kaso na 'yan matan ne ba sa karanta kowace ɗaya daga cikin mujallun uku?
Solution:
Bari, saitin dukkan 'yan mata shine U, saitin 'yan matan da ke karanta Bichitra shine B, saitin 'yan matan da ke karanta Sandhani shine S, saitin 'yan matan da ke karanta Purbani shine P.
$\therefore$ A cikin kashi, $n(U)=100\%$, $n(B)=60\%$, $n(S)=50\%$, $n(P)=50\%$, $n(B \cap S)=30\%$, $n(B \cap P)=30\%$, $n(P \cap S)=20\%$, $n(P \cap B \cap S)=10\%$
Saitin 'yan matan da ke karanta aƙalla ɗaya daga cikin jaridun shine $(B \cup P \cup S)$ [An nuna a cikin zane na Venn]

$\therefore$ Adadin 'yan matan da ba sa karanta ɗaya daga cikin jaridu uku shine $n(U) - n(B \cup P \cup S)$ [Wani bangare mai farin a cikin zane na Venn]
Yanzu, $n(B \cup P \cup S) = n(B) + n(P) + n(S) - n(B \cap P)$
$- n(B \cap S) - n(P \cap S) + n(B \cap P \cap S)$
$= 60\% + 50\% + 50\% - 30\% - 30\% - 20\% + 10\%$
$= 90\%$
$\therefore$ Kashi na 'yan matan, waɗanda ba sa karanta ɗaya daga cikin jaridu uku,
$n(U) - n(B \cup P \cup S) = 100\% - 90\% = 10\%$ (Amsa.)

Question:
A cikin ɗalibai mata na kwalejin Begum Rokeya, an gudanar da bincike game da al'adar karantun mujalladai na Bichitra, Sandhani, da kuma Purbani. An gano cewa kashi 60% na 'yan matan suna karanta Bichitra, kashi 50% suna karanta Sandhani, kashi 50% suna karanta Purbani, kashi 30% suna karanta Bichitra da Sandhani, kashi 30% suna karanta Bichitra da Purbani, kashi 20% suna karanta Sandhani da Purbani, yayin da kashi 10% ke karanta mujalladai uku duka.
Menene kaso na 'yan matan da ke karanta mujalladai biyu kawai daga cikin mujalladai da aka ambata a sama?
Solution:
Bari, dabarar duk 'yan mata ta zama U, dabarar 'yan matan da suka karanta Bichitra ta zama B, dabarar 'yan matan da suka karanta Sandhani ta zama S, dabarar 'yan matan da suka karanta Purbani ta zama P.
$\therefore$ A cikin kashi, $n(U)=100\%$, $n(B)=60\%$, $n(S)=50\%$, $n(P)=50\%$, $n(B \cap S)=30\%$, $n(B \cap P)=30\%$, $n(P \cap S)=20\%$, $n(P \cap B \cap S)=10\%$
Yawan 'yan matan da suka karanta Bichitra da kuma Purbani kawai, $= n((B \cap P) \setminus S)$
$= n(B \cap P) - n(B \cap P \cap S)$ [An nuna shi a cikin diagram na Venn]
$= 30\% - 10\% = 20\%$
Dabarar 'yan matan da suka karanta Bichitra da Purbani kawai.
Yawan 'yan matan da suka karanta Bichitra da Sandhani kawai $= n[(B \cap S) \setminus P]$
$= n(B \cap S) - n(B \cap P \cap S)$ [An nuna shi a cikin diagram na Venn]
$= 30\% - 10\% = 20\%$
Dabarar 'yan matan da suka karanta Bichitra da Sandhani kawai.
Yawan 'yan matan da suka karanta Sandhani da Purbani kawai $= n[(P \cap S) \setminus B]$
$= n(P \cap S) - n(P \cap B \cap S)$
$= 20\% - 10\% = 10\%$
[An nuna shi a cikin diagram na Venn]
Dabarar 'yan matan da suka karanta Purbani da Sandhani kawai.
$\therefore$ Kashi na 'yan matan da suka karanta mujalladai biyu kawai $= 20\% + 20\% + 10\% = 50\%$ [An nuna shi a cikin diagram na Venn]
Dabarar 'yan matan da suka karanta mujalladai biyu kawai
Ams. 50%

Question:
$A = \{x: x \in R \text{ kuma } x^2 - (a+b)x + ab = 0\}$
$B = \{1, 2\}$ da $C = \{2, 4, 5\}$
Nemo abubuwan da ke cikin saitin $A$.
Solution:
$A = \{x: x \in R \text{ kuma } x^2 - (a+b)x + ab = 0\}$
$= \{x: x \in R \text{ kuma } x^2 - ax - bx + ab = 0\}$
$= \{x: x \in R \text{ kuma } x(x - a) - b(x - a) = 0\}$
$= \{x: x \in R \text{ kuma } (x - a)(x - b) = 0\}$
$= \{x: x \in R \text{ kuma } x = a, b\}$
$\therefore$ Abubuwan da ke cikin saitin $A$ sune $a$ da $b$.

Daga cikin ɗalibai 100 na ajin, 42 daga cikinsu suna buga kwallon kafa, 46 suna buga kurket, kuma 39 suna buga shataranji. Daga cikin waɗannan, 13 suna buga kwallon kafa da kurket, 14 suna buga kurket da shataranji, kuma 12 suna buga kwallon kafa da shataranji. Bugu da ƙari, 7 daga cikin ɗaliban ba su iya kowace ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan wasannin ba.
Nemo yawan ɗaliban da ke iya dukkan wasannin uku.
Solution:
Bari dukkan ɗaliban su zama $U$, ɗaliban da suka ƙware a kwallon ƙafa su zama $F$, ɗaliban da suka ƙware a kriket su zama $C$, kuma ɗaliban da suka ƙware a shayi su zama $D$.
$n(U) = 100$
$n(F) = 42$, $n(C) = 46$, $n(D) = 39$
$n(F \cap C) = 13$, $n(C \cap D) = 14$, $n(F \cap D) = 12$
$n(F \cup C \cup D)' = 7$
Mun sani, $n(F \cup C \cup D)' = n(U) - n(F \cup C \cup D)$
Ko kuma, $7 = 100 - n(F \cup C \cup D)$
$\therefore n(F \cup C \cup D) = 93$
Yanzu, $n(F \cup C \cup D) = n(F) + n(C) + n(D) - n(F \cap C) - n(F \cap D) - n(C \cap D) + n(F \cap C \cap D)$
Ko kuma, $93 = 42 + 46 + 39 - 13 - 12 - 14 + n(F \cap C \cap D)$
Ko kuma, $n(F \cap C \cap D) + 88 = 93$
$\therefore n(F \cap C \cap D) = 5$
$\therefore$ Yawan ɗaliban da suka ƙware a wasanni uku ɗin nan shine $5$.
Amsa. Ɗalibai $5$.

Question:
Daga cikin ɗalibai 100 na ajin koyo, 42 daga cikinsu suna buga ƙwallon ƙafa, 46 suna buga cricket, kuma 39 suna buga satar jinka. Daga cikin waɗannan, 13 suna buga ƙwallon ƙafa da cricket, 14 suna buga cricket da satar jinka, kuma 12 suna buga ƙwallon ƙafa da satar jinka. Bugu da ƙari, 7 ɗalibai ba su yi ƙwarewa a kowace ɗayan waɗannan wasannin ba.

a) Nawa ne ɗaliban da ke ƙware a aƙalla wasa ɗaya?
b) Nawa ne ɗaliban da ke ƙware a wasu wasanni biyu kawai?
Solution:
Kadai ke buga kwallon kafa $= n(F) - n(F \cap C) - n(F \cap D) + n(F \cap C \cap D)$
$= 42 - 13 - 12 + 5 = 22$
Kadai ke buga kurket $= n(C) - n(F \cap C) - n(C \cap D) + n(F \cap C \cap D)$
$= 46 - 13 - 14 + 5 = 24$
Kadai ke buga shash = $n(D) - n(D \cap C) - n(D \cap F) + n(F \cap C \cap D)$
$= 39 - 14 - 12 + 5 = 18$
$\therefore$ Masu kwarewa a wasanni daya kawai $= 22 + 24 + 18 = 64$ dalibai.
Kadai ke buga kwallon kafa da kurket $= n(F \cap C) - n(F \cap C \cap D)$
$= 13 - 5 = 8$
Kadai ke buga kurket da shash $= n(C \cap D) - n(F \cap C \cap D)$
$= 14 - 5 = 9$
Kadai ke buga kwallon kafa da shash $= n(F \cap D) - n(F \cap C \cap D)$
$= 12 - 5 = 7$
$\therefore$ Yawan dalibai masu kwarewa a akalla wasanni biyu $= (8 + 9 + 7)$ dalibai $= 24$ dalibai.
Ams. $64$ dalibai da $24$ dalibai.

Question: Nemo tarin $P(\emptyset)$ da kuma $P(\{\emptyset\})$.
Solution:
$P(\emptyset) = \{\emptyset\}$ (Ams.)
da $P(\{\emptyset\}) = \{\{\emptyset\}, \emptyset\}$ (Ams.)

Question: Wani magini ne yake zaune a wani ƙauye. Shi ne kaɗai yake gina gidaje ga waɗanda ba su gina gidajensu ba. Wanene ya gina gidan maginin?
Solution:
An ba da cewa, akwai wani **mason (ma'aikacin gini)** a wani ƙauye. Yana gina gidaje ne kawai ga waɗanda ba su yi wa kansu gida ba. Ana buƙatar a tantance wa ya gina wa **mason ɗin** gidansa.
A nan, zaɓuɓɓuka biyu sun taso.
1. **Mason ɗin** zai gina gidansa.
2. Wani ne zai gina wa **mason ɗin** gidansa.
Idan zaɓi na farko, **mason ɗin** zai gina gidansa, ya yi gaskiya, to hakan zai yi saɓani da sharaɗin cewa yana gina gidaje ne kawai ga waɗanda ba su gina wa kansu gida ba.
Yanzu, bari zaɓi na biyu ya yi gaskiya, wato, wani ne zai gina wa **mason ɗin** gidansa. Hakan ma yana sabawa da sharaɗin cewa **mason ɗin** yana gina gidaje.
Batu da aka ba shi babbar matsala ce ta lissafi. **Paradox** (wani abu mai ban mamaki ko mai rikici) ita ce faɗi ko magana wanda, ko da yake ta hanyar nazari mai kyau (ko da alama mai kyau) daga maganganun da aka yarda da su, ta kai ga wani ƙarshe wanda ke da ban mamaki ko kuma mai ɓata kai.
**Paradox** da aka ba ta sananne ce da **Bertrand Russell's paradox**. Babu wani bayani na musamman ga **paradox**.
Exact Answer: Babu wani mafita ta musamman ga matsalar ɓata lokaci

Question: $A = \{x: x \notin A\}$. A bayyana taƙaitaccen bayani game da tarin $A$.
Solution:
An bayar, $A = \{x: x \notin A\}$
Bari mu yi la'akari da yiwuwar biyu don sanin ko $x \in A$.
Yiwuwar 1: $x \in A$
A wannan yanayin, a bisa zatonmu, saitin $A$ memba ne na kansa. Amma halayen da ke ayyana kasancewa memba a cikin $A$ shine cewa abubuwan da ke cikinsa su ne saituna waɗanda ba sa zama membobin kansu; don haka wannan yana nufin $x \notin A$.
Yiwuwar 2: $x \notin A$
A wannan yanayin, muna zato cewa $A$ ba memba na kansa ba ne. Amma wannan yana nufin cewa $x \in A$, saboda ta rashin kasancewa da kansa a matsayin memba, a zahiri ya cika sharuddan kasancewa a cikin $A$.
Kuma wannan shine Russell's Paradox!
A bisa ma'anar ma'ana, muna da zaɓuɓɓuka biyu kawai, ko dai $x \in A$ ko kuma $x \notin A$. Amma idan muka yi la'akari da kowane zaɓi, muna gani cewa $x \in A$ yana nufin $x \notin A$ kuma haka nan kuma $x \notin A$ yana nufin $x \in A$.
Exact Answer: x na cikin A yana nufin x ba na cikin A ba kuma, kuma x ba na cikin A ba yana nufin x na cikin A

Question:
Nemo fagen shiga, fagen fita, da kuma dangantaka ta madubinsu na dangantaka $S$ da aka bayar.
Tabbatar ko dangantaka $S$ ko $S^{-1}$ ayyuka ne.
Shin ayyuka ne daga cikin waɗannan dangantaka waɗanda suke guda-daya?
$S = \{(1, 5), (2, 10), (3, 15), (4, 20)\}$
Solution:
A nan, $S = \{(1, 5), (2, 10), (3, 15), (4, 20)\}$
Dom $S = \{1, 2, 3, 4\}$
Range $S = \{5, 10, 15, 20\}$
$S^{-1} = \{(5, 1), (10, 2), (15, 3), (20, 4)\}$
Yanzu, dukkanin abubuwa na farko na ma'auratan tsari na $S$ sun bambanta sosai ga juna.
$\therefore S$ wani aiki ne.
Kuma, dukkanin abubuwa na farko na ma'auratan tsari na $S^{-1}$ sun bambanta sosai ga juna.
$\therefore S^{-1}$ wani aiki ne.
$S = \{(1, 5), (2, 10), (3, 15), (4, 20)\}$
Dom $S$ Range $S$
Siffofin membobi masu bambanci na yankin ayyuka na $S$ koyaushe suna bambanta.
$\therefore S$ aiki ne guda-daya.
Kuma, $S^{-1} = \{(5, 1), (10, 2), (15, 3), (20, 4)\}$

Dom $S^{-1}$ Range $S^{-1}$
Siffofin membobi masu bambanci na yankin ayyuka na $S^{-1}$ koyaushe suna bambanta.
$\therefore S^{-1}$ aiki ne guda-daya.
Exact Answer: S^{-1} = \{(5, 1), (10, 2), (15, 3), (20, 4)\} \therefore S misali ne. \therefore S^{-1} misali ne da ke daya-daya.

Question:
Nemo yankin daidaici, yankin sakamako, da kuma dangantakar juyawa ta dangantaka $S$ da aka bayar.
Tantance ko dangantakar $S$ ko $S^{-1}$ ayyuka ne.
Shin ayyukan da ke cikin waɗannan dangantaka masu iyaka ɗaya ne?
$S=\{(-3, 8), (-2, 3), (-1, 0), (0, -1), (1, 0), (2, 3), (3, 8)\}$
Solution:
Ga,
$S = \{(-3, 8), (-2, 3), (-1, 0), (0, -1), (1, 0), (2, 3), (3, 8)\}$
Dom $S = \{-3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3\}$
Range $S = \{-1, 0, 3, 8\}$
$S^{-1} = \{(8, -3), (3, -2), (0, -1), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (3, 2), (8, 3)\}$
Yanzu, duk waɗancan abubuwa na farko na jere abubuwan haɗin gwiwa na $S$ dukansu ba su bambanta da juna ba.
$\therefore S$ ƙayyadadden aiki ne.
Amma, akwai jere abubuwan haɗin gwiwa na $S^{-1}$ fiye da sau ɗaya waɗanda ke da iri ɗaya abin farko. A misali:
$(0, -1)$ da $(0, 1)$.
$\therefore S^{-1}$ ba ƙayyadadden aiki ba ne.
$S = \{(-3, 8), (-2, 3), (-1, 0), (0, -1), (1, 0), (2, 3), (3, 8)\}$
Dom $S$ Range $S$
Hotunan membobi biyu da suka bambanta na wurin asali na $S$ ɗaya ne. A misali: $(-3, 8)$ da $(3, 8)$.
$\therefore S$ ba shi da matsaya ɗaya ba kuma ba shi da aiki.
Exact Answer: Dom S = \{-3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3\} Range S = \{-1, 0, 3, 8\} S^{-1} = \{(8, -3), (3, -2), (0, -1), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (3, 2), (8, 3)\} \therefore S^{-1} ba ta zama aiki ba. \therefore S ba ta zama aiki ɗaya-daya ba.

Question:
Nemo yankin asali (domain), yankin sakamako (range), da kuma dangantakar-juya (inverse relation) ta dangantakar $S$ da aka bayar.
Tabbatar ko dangantakar $S$ ko $S^{-1}$ aiki ce (function).
Shin ayyuka a cikin waɗannan dangantaka su ne na ɗaya-daya (one-to-one)?
$S = \{(\frac{1}{2}, 0), (1, 1), (1, -1), (\frac{5}{2}, 2), (\frac{5}{2}, -2)\}$
Solution:
A nan, $S = \left\{\left(\frac{1}{2}, 0\right), (1, 1), (1, -1), \left(\frac{5}{2}, 2\right), \left(\frac{5}{2}, -2\right)\right\}$
Dom $S = \left\{\frac{1}{2}, 1, \frac{5}{2}\right\}$
Range $S = \{-2, -1, 0, 1, 2\}$
$S^{-1} = \left\{\left(0, \frac{1}{2}\right), (1, 1), (-1, 1), \left(2, \frac{5}{2}\right), \left(-2, \frac{5}{2}\right)\right\}$
Akwai nau'i na ma'aurata a $S$ fiye da sau ɗaya waɗanda ke da 1 guda ɗaya $^{\text{st}}$ element. Misali: $(1, 1)$ da $(1, -1)$.
$\therefore S$ ba aiki bane.
Babu nau'i na ma'aurata a $S^{-1}$ fiye da sau ɗaya waɗanda ke da 1 guda ɗaya $1^{\text{st}}$ element.
Don haka, $S^{-1}$ aiki ne.
$S^{-1} = \left\{\left(0, \frac{1}{2}\right), (1, 1), (-1, 1), \left(2, \frac{5}{2}\right), \left(-2, \frac{5}{2}\right)\right\}$
Dom $S^{-1}$ Range $S^{-1}$
Hotunan membobi biyu da suka bambanta na yankin $S^{-1}$ iri ɗaya ne. Misali: $(1, 1)$ da $(-1, 1)$.
Don haka, $S^{-1}$ ba aiki ɗaya-ɗaya bane.
Exact Answer: S^{-1} = \left\{\left(0, \frac{1}{2}\right), (1, 1), (-1, 1), \left(2, \frac{5}{2}\right), \left(-2, \frac{5}{2}\right)\right\} \therefore S ba shi da wata. Don haka, S^{-1} ba shi da wata-daya.

Question:
Nemo yankin bada (domain), yankin dawo (range), da kuma dangantakar dake juye (inverse relation) na dangantakar $S$ da aka bayar.
Tabbatar ko dangantakar $S$ ko $S^{-1}$ su ne ayyuka (functions).
Shin ayyuka na cikin waɗannan dangantaka ɗaya-da-ɗaya ne?
$S = \{(-3, -3), (-1, -1), (0, 0), (1, 1), (3, 3)\}$
Solution:
Anan, $S = \{(-3, -3), (-1, -1), (0, 0), (1, 1), (3, 3)\}$
Dom $S = \{-3, -1, 0, 1, 3\}$
Range $S = \{-3, -1, 0, 1, 3\}$
$S^{-1} = \{(-3, -3), (-1, -1), (0, 0), (1, 1), (3, 3)\}$
Duk abubuwan $1^{\text{st}}$ na ma'aurata masu tsari na $S$ duk sun bambanta da juna.
$\therefore S$ wani aiki ne.
Duk abubuwan $1^{\text{st}}$ na ma'aurata masu tsari na $S^{-1}$ duk sun bambanta da juna.
$\therefore S^{-1}$ wani aiki ne.
$S = \{(-3, -3), (-1, -1), (0, 0), (1, 1), (3, 3)\}$
Dom $S$ Range $S$
Hotunan membobi masu bambanta na yankin asali na $S$ koyaushe suna da bambanci.
Don haka, $S$ aiki ne na-daya-da-daya.
$S^{-1} = \{(-3, -3), (-1, -1), (0, 0), (1, 1), (3, 3)\}$
Dom $S^{-1}$ Range $S^{-1}$
Hotunan membobi masu bambanta na yankin asali na $S^{-1}$ koyaushe suna da bambanci.
Don haka, $S^{-1}$ aiki ne na-daya-da-daya.
Exact Answer: S^{-1} = \{(-3, -3), (-1, -1), (0, 0), (1, 1), (3, 3)\} Don haka, S ita ce daidai-daidai-daya. Don haka, S^{-1} ita ce daidai-daidai-daya.

Question:
Nemo yankin, kewayon, da kuma dangantakar bayan da aka bayar na dangantaka $S$.
Tabbatar da ko dangantakar $S$ ko $S^{-1}$ ayyuka ne.
Shin ayyuka ne a cikin waɗannan dangantaka masu ma'ana ɗaya zuwa ɗaya?
$S = \{(2, 1), (2, 2), (2, 3)\}$
Solution:
Anan, $S = \{(2, 1), (2, 2), (2, 3)\}$
Dom $= \{2\}$
Range $= \{1, 2, 3\}$
$S^{-1} = \{(1, 2), (2, 2), (3, 2)\}$
Yanzu, akwai ma'aurata da aka jera na $S$ fiye da sau ɗaya waɗanda ke da iri ɗaya na 1st element. A ce, $(2, 1)$ da $(2, 2)$.
Don haka, $S$ ba aiki ba ne.
Duk 1st elements na ma'aurata da aka jera na $S^{-1}$ sun bambanta sosai ga junansu.
Don haka, $S^{-1}$ aiki ne.
Anan, $S^{-1}$ aiki ne.
Dom $S^{-1}$ Range $S^{-1}$
Hotunan membobi biyu da aka bambanta na wurin zama na $S^{-1}$ iri ɗaya ne. A ce, $(1, 2)$, $(2, 2)$ da $(3, 2)$.
Don haka, $S^{-1}$ ba aiki ɗaya-ɗaya ba ne.
Exact Answer: Dom = \{2\} Range = \{1, 2, 3\}S^{-1} = \{(1, 2), (2, 2), (3, 2)\} Saboda haka, S ba ta zama aiki ba. Saboda haka, S^{-1}$ aiki ce. Saboda haka, S^{-1}$ ba ta zama aiki ɗaya-ɗaya ba.

Question:
Ga aikin lissafi da aka bayyana $F(x) = \sqrt{x-1}$
Nemo $F(1)$, $F(5)$ da $F(10)$.

Ga aikin da aka bayyana $F(x) = \sqrt{x-1}$
Nemo $F(a^2 + 1)$, inda $a \in \mathbb{R}$.
Solution:
An ba mu, $F(x) = \sqrt{x-1}$
$F(a^2 + 1) = \sqrt{a^2 + 1 - 1} = \sqrt{a^2} = |a|$
Ams. $|a|$

Question:
Ga aikin da aka bayyana $F(x) = \sqrt{x-1}$
Idan $F(x) = 5$, nemo $x$.
Solution:
An bayar, $F(x) = \sqrt{x-1}$
da $F(x) = 5$
$\therefore \sqrt{x-1} = 5$
ko kuma, $x-1 = 25$ [Ta hanyar yin murabba'i ga kowane bangare]
$\therefore x = 25 + 1 = 26$
Ams. 26

Question:
Ga aikin da aka bayyana $F(x) = \sqrt{x-1}$
Idan $F(x) = y$, nemo $x$ inda $y \geq 0$.
Solution:
An bayar, $F(x) = \sqrt{x-1}$
da $F(x) = y$
$\therefore \sqrt{x-1} = y$
ko kuma, $x-1 = y^2$ [Ta hanyar yin murabba'i ga dukkan bangarori]
$\therefore x = 1 + y^2$
Ams. $1+y^2$

Question:
Ga aikin $F: \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$, $F(x)=x^3$
Nemo yankin da yaci gaba da F da kuma yankin dawo da F.
Solution:
$F(x) = x^3$
Don haka, gaba ɗaya $F = \mathbb{R}$ kuma wurin yawa $F = \mathbb{R}$

Question:
Don aikin lissafi $F: \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$, $F(x)=x^3$
Nuna cewa, $F$ aiki ne mai-kama-daya (one-one function).
Solution:
Ana ɗaukar kowane sinadaru biyu $x_1, x_2 \in$ dom $F$, muna samu
$F(x_1) = F(x_2)$
ko, $x_1^3 = x_2^3$
ko, $x_1 = x_2$ [$\because x_1, x_2 \in \mathbb{R}$]
$\therefore F$ ita ce aiki ɗaya-daya.

Question:
Ga aikin lissafi $F: \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$, $F(x)=x^3$
Nemo $F^{-1}$
Solution:
Bari muce, $y = F(x) = x^3$
ko kuma, $y = x^3$
ko kuma, $x = y^{\frac{1}{3}}$
ko kuma, $F^{-1}(y) = y^{\frac{1}{3}}$ [$\because F(x) = y \quad \therefore x = F^{-1}(y)$]
$\therefore F^{-1}(x) = x^{\frac{1}{3}} = \sqrt[3]{x}$ (Amsar.)

Question:
Ga aikin lissafi $F: \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$, $F(x)=x^3$
Nuna cewa, $F^{-1}$ wani aiki ne
Solution:
Anan $F^{-1}(x) = \sqrt[3]{x}$
Yankin da $F^{-1}(x)$ ke iya karɓa = $\mathbb{R}_+$
Ga kowace ƙimar $\mathbb{R}$ muna samun wata ƙima guda ɗaya daga $F^{-1}(x) = \sqrt[3]{x}$
$\therefore F^{-1}(x)$ wata fasali ce (function).

Question: Idan $f: \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ aiki ne wanda aka bayyana shi ta hanyar $f(x) = ax + b$, inda $a, b \in \mathbb{R}$, kuma $a \ne 0$; nuna cewa $f$ yana ɗaya-daya (one-one) kuma yana kan-gaba (onto).
Solution:
An bayar, $f(x) = ax + b$
Bari, $x_1, x_2 \in$ dom $f$
Yanzu, domin $f(x_1) = f(x_2)$, aikin $f$ zai zama daya-daya idan kuma kawai idan $x_1 = x_2$.
Yanzu, $f(x_1) = ax_1 + b$ kuma $f(x_2) = ax_2 + b$
$\therefore f(x_1) = f(x_2)$
ko kuma, $ax_1 + b = ax_2 + b$
ko kuma, $ax_1 = ax_2$
$\therefore x_1 = x_2$
Don haka, an nuna cewa aikin da aka bayar yana daya-daya.
Sake, idan $y \in \mathbb{R}$ wani lambobi ne na tsawon lokaci,
Bari, $y = ax + b = f(x)$
ko kuma, $ax = y - b$
$\therefore x = \frac{y-b}{a} \in \mathbb{R}$
$\therefore f\left(\frac{y-b}{a}\right) = a \cdot \frac{y-b}{a} + b = y - b + b = y$
$\therefore f\left(\frac{y-b}{a}\right) = y = f(x)$
$\therefore$ Aikin yana kan gaci (onto) ko kuma mai sarauta (surjective).
Don haka, aikin yana daya-daya (one-one) kuma yana kan gaci (onto). (An nuna)
Exact Answer: Hanyar tana dai-dai da kuma kan duka

Question: Idan $f: [0, 1] \to [0, 1]$ aiki ne wanda aka bayyana shi ta hanyar $f(x) = \sqrt{1-x^2}$, nuna cewa $f$ yana ɗaya-daya ne kuma yana rufe kowane ɓangare na filin wanda aka tsara masa.
Solution:
$F(x) = \sqrt{1-x^2}$
Yanzu, $F(a) = \sqrt{1-a^2}$ da $F(b) = \sqrt{1-b^2}$
$\therefore F(a) = F(b)$,
ko, $\sqrt{1-a^2} = \sqrt{1-b^2}$
ko, $1-a^2 = 1-b^2$
ko, $-a^2 = -b^2$
ko, $a^2 = b^2$
ko, $a=b$
Don haka, an nuna cewa babbar siffar nan $F$ tana da kashi ɗaya (one-one).
Kuma, idan $y \in [0, 1]$ ya kasance kowace lamba ce arbitrarily da aka bayar,
Bari, $y = \sqrt{1-x^2} = f(x)$
ko, $y^2 = 1-x^2$
ko, $x^2 = 1-y^2$
$\therefore x = \sqrt{1-y^2} \in [0, 1]$
$\therefore f(\sqrt{1-y^2}) = \sqrt{1-(\sqrt{1-y^2})^2} = \sqrt{1-(1-y^2)}$
$= \sqrt{1-1+y^2} = \sqrt{y^2} = y = f(x)$
$\therefore$ An nuna cewa babbar siffar tana da duk abin da ke tsakanin ta (onto).
Don haka, $f$ tana da kashi ɗaya da kuma duk abin da ke tsakanin ta. (An nuna)
Exact Answer: f ɗaya-ɗaya ce kuma a kan ta

Question: Idan ayyuka $f: \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ da $g: \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ an ayyana su da $f(x) = x^3 + 5$ da $g(x) = (x-5)^{\frac{1}{3}}$, to ku nuna cewa $g = f^{-1}$.
Solution:
An bayar, $f(x) = x^3 + 5$ da $g(x) = (x-5)^{\frac{1}{3}}$
Bari, $y = f(x)$
$\Rightarrow y = x^3 + 5$
$\Rightarrow x^3 = y-5$
$\Rightarrow x = (y-5)^{\frac{1}{3}}$
$\Rightarrow f^{-1}(y) = (y-5)^{\frac{1}{3}}$ [$\because x = f^{-1}(y)$]
$\Rightarrow f^{-1}(x) = (x-5)^{\frac{1}{3}}$
$\Rightarrow f^{-1}(x) = g(x)$
$\therefore g = f^{-1}$ (An nuna)

Question: Idan aikin $f: \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ an bayyana shi ta hanyar $f(x) = 5x - 4$, to, nemo ma'anar $y = f^{-1}(x)$.
Solution:
An bayar da cewa, aikin $f: \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ an ayyana shi ta hanyar $f(x) = 5x-4$.
Ta hanyar maye gurbin $x$ da $f^{-1}(x)$, muna samun
$f(f^{-1}(x)) = 5(f^{-1}(x)) - 4$
ko kuma, $x = 5 \cdot f^{-1}(x) - 4$
ko kuma, $5 \cdot f^{-1}(x) = x + 4$
ko kuma, $f^{-1}(x) = \frac{x+4}{5}$
$\therefore y = f^{-1}(x) = \frac{x+4}{5}$ (Amsa.)

Question:
An baka cewa, $F(x)=2x-1$.
Nemo darajojin $F(x+1)$ da $F\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)$.
Solution:
An bamu, $F(x)=2x-1$
$\therefore F(x+1) = 2(x+1)-1 = 2x+2-1 = 2x+1$
da kuma $F\left(\frac{1}{2}\right) = 2 \cdot \frac{1}{2}-1 = 1-1 = 0$
Ams. $2x+1$; $0$

Question:
An baka cewa, $F(x)=2x-1$.
Ka tabbatar ko aikin $F(x)$ yana da mutum ɗaya (one-one), a lokacin da $x, y \in \mathbb{R}$.
Solution:
An bayar, $F(x) = 2x-1$
Bari, $a, b \in$ dom $F$, inda $a \ne b$
Yanzu, domin $F(a) = F(b)$ idan kuma kawai idan $a = b$, to ana kiran dambara $F$ da zama ɗaya-daya.
$\therefore F(a) = 2a-1$ kuma $F(b) = 2b-1$
Yanzu, $F(a) = F(b)$
$\Rightarrow 2a-1 = 2b-1$
$\Rightarrow 2a = 2b$
$\therefore a = b$
Don haka, dambara tana zama ɗaya-daya.

Question:
An bamu cewa, $F(x)=2x-1$.
Idan $F(x) = y$, tantance darajojin $y$ don uku daga cikin darajojin lambobi na $x$.
Solution:
$F(x)=y$
ko, $2x-1=y$ [$\because F(x)=2x-1$]
ko, $2x=y+1$
$\therefore x=\frac{1}{2}(y+1)$
Yanzu, Idan $y=1$, $x=\frac{1}{2}(1+1)=\frac{1}{2} \times 2=1$
Idan $y=3$, $x=\frac{1}{2}(3+1)=\frac{1}{2} \times 4=2$
Idan $y=5$, $x=\frac{1}{2}(5+1)=\frac{1}{2} \times 6=3$
$\therefore$ Manyan kimomi guda uku na $x$ sune $1, 2, 3$.

Question:
Ayyuka guda biyu $f: \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ da $g: \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ an bayyana su ta hanyar $f(x)=3x+3$ da $g(x)=\frac{x-3}{3}$ bi da bi.
Nemo ƙimar $g^{-1}(-3)$.
Solution:
An bayar, $g(x)=\frac{x-3}{3}$
Bari, $y=g(x)=\frac{x-3}{3}$
ko, $3y=x-3$
ko, $x=3y+3$
ko, $g^{-1}(y)=3y+3$ [$\because y=g(x) \therefore x=g^{-1}(y)$]
$\therefore g^{-1}(x)=3x+3$
$\therefore g^{-1}(-3)=3(-3)+3=-9+3=-6$

Question:
Ayuba biyu $f: \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ da $g: \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ an bayyana su ta yadda $f(x)=3x+3$ da $g(x)=\frac{x-3}{3}$ bi da bi.
Tantance ko $f(x)$ ayyukan da ake kira "onto" ne.
Solution:
An ba da cewa, $f(x)=3x+3$
 Bari, $y=f(x)=3x+3$
ko kuma, $3x+3=y$
ko kuma, $3x=y-3$
$\therefore x=\frac{y-3}{3}$
$\therefore f\left(\frac{y-3}{3}\right)=3\left(\frac{y-3}{3}\right)+3=y-3+3=y=f(x)$
Don haka, $f(x)$ wata alama ce ta ci gaba (onto function).

Question:
A sami ayyuka biyu $f: \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ da $g: \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ waɗanda aka bayyana su ta hanyar $f(x)=3x+3$ da $g(x)=\frac{x-3}{3}$ bi da bi.
Nuna cewa, $g=f^{-1}$.
Solution:
An ba da, $f(x)=3x+3$
A ɗauka, $y=f(x)=3x+3$
ko, $3x=y-3$
ko, $x=\frac{y-3}{3}$
ko, $f^{-1}(y)=\frac{y-3}{3}$ [$\because y=f(x)$]
ko, $f^{-1}(x)=\frac{x-3}{3}$
$\therefore x=f^{-1}(y)$
ko, $f^{-1}(x)=g(x)$
ko, $f^{-1}=g$ (An nuna)

Question:
Bari $f(x)=\sqrt{x-4}$.
Nemo yankin da $f(x)$ ke wanzuwa a ciki.
Solution:
An bayar da cewa, $f(x) \in \mathbb{R}$ idan kuma kawai idan $x-4 \ge 0$ ko kuma, $x \ge 4$
$\therefore$ Yankin $f = \{x \in \mathbb{R} : x \ge 4\}$

Question:
An baka cewa, $f(x)=\sqrt{x-4}$
Tantance ko $f(x)$ aiki ne mai-guda ɗaya.
Solution:
Ga kowacce $x_1 \in$ yankin asali na $f$, $x_2 \in$ yankin asali na $f$ idan kuma idan kaɗai $\sqrt{x_1-4} = \sqrt{x_2-4}$
ko kuma, $x_1-4 = x_2-4$ [Ta hanyar yin murabba'i]
ko kuma, $x_1 = x_2$
$\therefore f(x)$ wata dabara ce mai tattara guda ɗaya (one-to-one function).

Question: Idan wani sinadari na *polynomial* $x^4 - 5x^3 + 7x^2 - a$ shine $x - 2$ to, nuna cewa, $a = 4$.
Solution:
Bari, $P(x) = x^4 - 5x^3 + 7x^2 - a$
Idan $x - 2$ shine factor na $P(x)$ to $P(2) = 0$
ko kuma, $(2)^4 - 5(2)^3 + 7(2)^2 - a = 0$
ko kuma, $16 - 40 + 28 - a = 0$
$\therefore a = 4$ \textbf{(An Nuna)}

Question: Bari mu ɗauka cewa, $P(x) = ax^5 + bx^4 + cx^3 + cx^2 + bx + a$ inda $a, b, c$ su ne abubuwan da ba su canzawa (constants) kuma $a \ne 0$. Nuna cewa, idan $x - r$ shi ne wani sashi na $P(x)$, to wani sashi kuma na $P(x)$ zai zama $(rx - 1)$.
Solution:
An bayar,
$P(x) = ax^5 + bx^4 + cx^3 + cx^2 + bx + a \ldots \ldots \ldots (i)$
[inda $a, b, c$ su ne abubuwan da ba su canzawa kuma $a \ne 0$]
Tun da $(x - r)$ wani sassare ne na $P(x)$, Don haka, $P(r) = 0$.
Yanzu, $P(r) = ar^5 + br^4 + cr^3 + cr^2 + br + a$
$\therefore ar^5 + br^4 + cr^3 + cr^2 + br + a = 0 \ldots \ldots \ldots (ii)$
Bari, $rx - 1 = 0$
ko kuma, $rx = 1$
$\therefore x = \frac{1}{r}$
Yanzu, idan muka saka $x = \frac{1}{r}$ a cikin polynomial na lamba (i) idan darajar polynomial ta zama sifili (0), to $(rx - 1)$ zai zama wani sassare na polynomial.
$\therefore P\left(\frac{1}{r}\right) = a\left(\frac{1}{r}\right)^5 + b\left(\frac{1}{r}\right)^4 + c\left(\frac{1}{r}\right)^3 + c\left(\frac{1}{r}\right)^2 + b\left(\frac{1}{r}\right) + a$
$= \frac{a}{r^5} + \frac{b}{r^4} + \frac{c}{r^3} + \frac{c}{r^2} + \frac{b}{r} + a$
$= \frac{a + br + cr^2 + cr^3 + br^4 + ar^5}{r^5}$
$= \frac{ar^5 + br^4 + cr^3 + cr^2 + br + a}{r^5}$
$= \frac{0}{r^5}$ [Saka darajar daga lamba (ii)]
$= 0$
Tun da, idan muka saka $x = \frac{1}{r}$ a cikin polynomial na lamba (i) darajar ta zama sifili (0), Don haka $(rx - 1)$ wani sassare ne na polynomial.
$\therefore (rx - 1)$ ma wani sassare ne na $P(x)$. \textbf{(An Nuna)}

Question: Ku warware zuwa haddadi: $x^4 + 7x^3 + 17x^2 + 17x + 6$
A warware zuwa sassa: $4a^4 + 12a^3 + 7a^2 - 3a - 2$
Solution:
Bari mu ce, $P(a) = 4a^4 + 12a^3 + 7a^2 - 3a - 2$
A nan, lambar da ba ta da alaƙa da $a$ a cikin $P(a)$ ita ce $-2$, kuma jerin abubuwan da ke raba ta su ne, $F_1 = \{1, -1, 2, -2\}$
Jerin abubuwan da ke raba babbar lambar (leading coefficient) watau 4 su ne,
$F_2 = \{1, -1, 2, -2, 4, -4\}$
Yanzu, mu duba $P(m)$, inda $m = \frac{r}{s}$ kuma $r \in F_1, s \in F_2$.
Idan $m = 1$, to $P(1) = 4 + 12 + 7 - 3 - 2 \ne 0$
Idan $m = -1$, to $P(-1) = 4 - 12 + 7 + 3 - 2 = 0$
Idan $m = 2$, to $P(2) = 64 + 96 + 28 - 6 - 2 \ne 0$
Idan $m = -2$, to $P(-2) = 64 - 96 + 28 + 6 - 2 = 0$
Don haka, $(a + 1)$ da $(a + 2)$ su ne abubuwan da ke raba $P(a)$.
Yanzu, $4a^4 + 12a^3 + 7a^2 - 3a - 2$
$= 4a^4 + 4a^3 + 8a^3 + 8a^2 - a^2 - a - 2a - 2$
$= 4a^3(a + 1) + 8a^2(a + 1) - a(a + 1) - 2(a + 1)$
$= (a + 1)(4a^3 + 8a^2 - a - 2)$
Kuma sake, $4a^3 + 8a^2 - a - 2 = 4a^2(a + 2) - 1(a + 2)$
$= (a + 2)(4a^2 - 1)$
$= (a + 2)\{(2a)^2 - (1)^2\}$
$= (a + 2)(2a - 1)(2a + 1)$
$\therefore 4a^4 + 12a^3 + 7a^2 - 3a - 2$
$= (a + 1)(4a^3 + 8a^2 - a - 2)$
$= (a + 1)(a + 2)(2a - 1)(2a + 1)$
Amsar. $(a + 1)(a + 2)(2a - 1)(2a + 1)$

Question: A warware zuwa sassa: $x^3 + 2x^2 + 2x + 1$
Solution:
Bari, P(x) = $x^3 + 2x^2 + 2x + 1$
Anan, mafi ƙarancin ma'auni (constant term) na P(x) shine 1, kuma saitin abubuwan da ke raba shi (factors) shine, $F_1 = \{1, -1\}$.
Saitin abubuwan da ke raba mafi girman ma'auni (leading coefficient) na 1 shine,
$F_2 = \{1, -1\}$.
Yanzu, la'akari da P(a), inda $a = \frac{r}{s}$ kuma $r \in F_1$, $s \in F_2$.
Idan $a = 1$, to, P(1) $= 1 + 2 + 2 + 1 \ne 0$.
Idan $a = -1$, to, P(-1) $= -1 + 2 - 2 + 1 = 0$.
$\therefore \{x - (-1)\}$ watau $(x + 1)$ ɗin ne ke raba p(x).
Yanzu, $x^3 + 2x^2 + 2x + 1$
$= x^3 + x^2 + x^2 + x + x + 1$
$= x^2(x + 1) + x(x + 1) + 1(x + 1)$
$= (x + 1)(x^2 + x + 1)$.
Amsa. $(x + 1)(x^2 + x + 1)$.

Question: Sassaƙa zuwa abubuwan da za a iya raba su (factors): $x(y^2 + z^2) + y(z^2 + x^2) + z(x^2 + y^2) + 3xyz$
Solution:
$x(y^2 + z^2) + y(z^2 + x^2) + z(x^2 + y^2) + 3xyz$
$= xy^2 + xz^2 + yz^2 + yx^2 + zx^2 + zy^2 + 3xyz$
$= (xy^2 + x^2y + xyz) + (y^2z + yz^2 + xyz) + (z^2x + zx^2 + xyz)$
$= xy(y + x + z) + yz(y + z + x) + zx(x + z + y)$
$= (x + y + z)(xy + yz + zx)$
Ams. $(x + y + z)(xy + yz + zx)$

Question: (x + 1)^2 (y - z) + (y + 1)^2 (z - x) + (z + 1)^2 (x - y) ɓata shi zuwa abubuwan da za a iya raba su.
Nemo abubuwan da za a iya raba su a cikin: $b^2c^2(b^2 - c^2) + c^2a^2(c^2 - a^2) + a^2b^2(a^2 - b^2)$
Nemo abubuwan da za a iya raba su: $15x^2 + 2xy - 24y^2 - x + 24y - 6$
A warware zuwa sassa masu ma'auni: $15x^2 - 24y^2 - 6z^2 + 2xy - xz + 24yz$

Idan $\frac{1}{a^3} + \frac{1}{b^3} + \frac{1}{c^3} = \frac{3}{abc}$, nuna cewa,
$bc + ca + ab = 0$ ko kuma, $a = b = c$
Solution:
$\frac{1}{a^3} + \frac{1}{b^3} + \frac{1}{c^3} = \frac{3}{abc}$
ko kuma, $\left(\frac{1}{a}\right)^3 + \left(\frac{1}{b}\right)^3 + \left(\frac{1}{c}\right)^3 - 3 \cdot \frac{1}{a} \cdot \frac{1}{b} \cdot \frac{1}{c} = 0$
ko kuma, $\frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{b} + \frac{1}{c}\right)\left\{\left(\frac{1}{a} - \frac{1}{b}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{1}{b} - \frac{1}{c}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{1}{c} - \frac{1}{a}\right)^2\right\} = 0$
$[\therefore x^3 + y^3 + z^3 - 3xyz = \frac{1}{2}(x + y + z)\{(x - y)^2 + (y - z)^2 + (z - x)^2\}]$
$\therefore$ Ko dai $\frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{b} + \frac{1}{c} = 0$
ko kuma, $\frac{bc + ca + ab}{abc} = 0$
$\therefore bc + ca + ab = 0$
ko kuma, $\left(\frac{1}{a} - \frac{1}{b}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{1}{b} - \frac{1}{c}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{1}{c} - \frac{1}{a}\right)^2 = 0$
amma, jimlar murabba'ai na wasu ko fiye da abubuwa biyu zai zama sifili idan kuma kawai idan ƙimar su ta zama sifili daban-daban.
don haka, $\left(\frac{1}{a} - \frac{1}{b}\right)^2 = 0$
ko kuma, $\frac{1}{a} - \frac{1}{b} = 0$
ko kuma, $\frac{1}{a} = \frac{1}{b} \quad \therefore a = b$
$\therefore a = b = c$
sake, $\left(\frac{1}{b} - \frac{1}{c}\right)^2 = 0$
ko kuma, $\frac{1}{b} - \frac{1}{c} = 0$
ko kuma, $\frac{1}{b} = \frac{1}{c} \quad \therefore b = c$
Don haka idan $\frac{1}{a^3} + \frac{1}{b^3} + \frac{1}{c^3} = \frac{3}{abc}$, to $bc + ca + ab = 0$
ko kuma, $a = b = c$ (An nuna)

Question: Idan $x = b + c - a$, $y = c + a - b$ da $z = a + b - c$, nuna cewa, $x^3 + y^3 + z^3 - 3xyz = 4(a^3 + b^3 + c^3 - 3abc)$
Sanya: $\frac{a^2}{(a-b)(a-c)} + \frac{b^2}{(b-c)(b-a)} + \frac{c^2}{(c-a)(c-b)}$
Solution:
An bayar da magana $= \frac{a^2}{(a-b)(a-c)} + \frac{b^2}{(b-c)(b-a)} + \frac{c^2}{(c-a)(c-b)}$
$= \frac{a^2}{-(a-b)(c-a)} + \frac{b^2}{-(b-c)(a-b)} + \frac{c^2}{-(c-a)(b-c)}$
$= \frac{a^2(b-c) + b^2(c-a) + c^2(a-b)}{-(a-b)(b-c)(c-a)}$
Amma $a^2(b-c) + b^2(c-a) + c^2(a-b)$
$= a^2b - a^2c + b^2c - ab^2 + c^2a - bc^2$
$= a^2b - ab^2 - a^2c + b^2c + c^2a - bc^2$
$= ab(a-b) - c(a^2 - b^2) + c^2(a-b)$
$= (a-b) \{ab - c(a+b) + c^2\}$
$= (a-b) (ab - ca - bc + c^2)$
$= (a-b) \{a(b-c) - c(b-c)\}$
$= (a-b) (b-c) (a-c)$
$= -(a-b) (b-c) (c-a)$
$\therefore$ Magana da aka bayar $= \frac{-(a-b)(b-c)(c-a)}{-(a-b)(b-c)(c-a)} = 1$
Amsa. 1

Question: Sauƙaƙe: $\frac{(a+b)^2 - ab}{(b-c)(a-c)} + \frac{(b+c)^2 - bc}{(c-a)(b-a)} + \frac{(c+a)^2 - ca}{(a-b)(c-b)}$
Sanya waɗannan zuwa mafi sauƙi: $\frac{a}{(a-b)(a-c)(x-a)} + \frac{b}{(b-a)(b-c)(x-b)} + \frac{c}{(c-a)(c-b)(x-c)}$
Solution:
An bayar da magana $=$
$\frac{a}{(a-b)(a-c)(x-a)} + \frac{b}{(b-c)(b-a)(x-b)} + \frac{c}{(c-a)(c-b)(x-c)}$
$= \frac{a}{-(a-b)(c-a)(x-a)} + \frac{b}{-(a-b)(b-c)(x-b)} + \frac{c}{-(c-a)(b-c)(x-c)}$
$= \frac{a(b-c)(x-b)(x-c) + b(c-a)(x-c)(x-a) + c(a-b)(x-a)(x-b)}{-(a-b)(b-c)(c-a)(x-a)(x-b)(x-c)}$
$= \frac{a(b-c)\{x^2 - (b+c)x + bc\} + b(c-a)\{x^2 - (c+a)x + ca\} + c(a-b)\{x^2 - (a+b)x + ab\}}{-(a-b)(b-c)(c-a)(x-a)(x-b)(x-c)}$
$= \frac{x^2\{a(b-c)+b(c-a)+c(a-b)\} - x\{a(b-c)(b+c)+b(c-a)(c+a)+c(a-b)(a+b)\} + abc\{(b-c)+(c-a)+(a-b)\}}{-(a-b)(b-c)(c-a)(x-a)(x-b)(x-c)}$
Amma a cikin jimawa ta sama, $a(b-c) + b(c-a) + c(a-b) = ab - ac + bc - ab + ca - bc = 0$
Haka nan ma, $a(b-c)(b+c) + b(c-a)(c+a) + c(a-b)(a+b)$
$= a(b^2 - c^2) + b(c^2 - a^2) + c(a^2 - b^2) = -(a-b)(b-c)(c-a)$
kuma $abc\{(b-c) + (c-a) + (a-b)\} = abc \times 0 = 0$
$\therefore$ An bayar da magana $= \frac{-x\{a(b-c)(b+c)+b(c-a)(c+a)+c(a-b)(a+b)\}}{-(a-b)(b-c)(c-a)(x-a)(x-b)(x-c)}$
$= \frac{-x-(a-b)(b-c)(c-a)}{-(a-b)(b-c)(c-a)(x-a)(x-b)(x-c)} = \frac{x}{(x-a)(x-b)(x-c)}$
Ams. $\frac{x}{(x-a)(x-b)(x-c)}$

Question: Bayyana a matsayin ɓangarorin daidai wa:**$\frac{5x+4}{x(x+2)}$
Solution:
Bari mu yi la'akari da, $\frac{5x+4}{x(x+2)} = \frac{A}{x} + \frac{B}{x+2}$ ....................(i)
Sa'ad da muka ninka dukkan bangarori biyu na (i) da $x(x+2)$, muna samun,
$5x+4 = A(x+2) + Bx$ ...................(ii)
wanda yake gaskiya ga duk wani darajar x,
Da zarar mun sanya $x = 0$ a dukkan bangarori biyu na (ii), muna samun,
$0+4 = 2A+0$
$\therefore A=2$
A sake, da zarar mun sanya $x = -2$ a dukkan bangarori biyu na (ii), muna samun,
$-10+4 = 0-2B$
ko, $-6 = -2B$
$\therefore B=3$
Da zarar mun sanya darajojin A da B a (i), muna samun,
$\frac{5x+4}{x(x+2)} = \frac{2}{x} + \frac{3}{x+2}$
Wannan shine furcin da ake so na da'irar da aka bayar a matsayin jimlar duga-dugan kashi.
Amsa. $\frac{2}{x} + \frac{3}{x+2}$

Question: Nuna a matsayin ragin jimla: $\frac{x+2}{x^2-7x+12}$
Solution:
A nan, $x^2 - 7x + 12 = x^2 - 3x - 4x + 12$
$= (x-3)(x-4)$
Don haka, $\frac{x+2}{x^2-7x+12} = \frac{x+2}{(x-3)(x-4)}$
Bari mu ce, $\frac{x+2}{(x-3)(x-4)} = \frac{A}{x-3} + \frac{B}{x-4}$ .................(i)
Sa'ad da muka ninka dukkan bangarorin (i) da $(x-3)(x-4)$ muna samu,
$x+2 = A(x-4) + B(x-3)$ ....................(ii)
wanda ya yi daidai ga duk wani darajar $x$.
Yanzu, sa'ad da muka sa $x = 3$ a dukkan bangarorin (ii) muna samu,
$3+2 = A(3-4) + B(3-3)$
ko, $5 = -A$
$\therefore A = -5$
A sake, sa'ad da muka sa $x=4$ a dukkan bangarorin (ii) muna samu,
$4+2 = A(4-4) + B(4-3)$
ko, $6 = 0+B$
$\therefore B=6$
Sa'ad da muka saka darajojin A da B a (i), muna samu,
$\frac{x+2}{(x-3)(x-4)} = \frac{-5}{x-3} + \frac{6}{x-4} = \frac{6}{x-4} - \frac{5}{x-3}$
Wannan shine furucin da ake so na daidaitaccen rabo a matsayin jimlar rabo na bangare.
Amsa. $\frac{6}{x-4} - \frac{5}{x-3}$

Question: Bayyana a matsayin kaso na bangare: $\frac{x^2 - 9x - 6}{x(x-2)(x+3)}$
Solution:
Bari, $\frac{x^2 - 9x - 6}{x(x-2)(x+3)} = \frac{A}{x} + \frac{B}{x-2} + \frac{C}{x+3}$...........(i)
Ta hanyar narkar da dukkan bangarorin (i) da $x(x-2)(x+3)$ muna samu,
$x^2 - 9x - 6 = A(x-2)(x+3) + Bx(x+3) + Cx(x-2)$ ............(ii)
wanda gaskiya ne ga dukkan dabi'u na x.
Yanzu, ta hanyar sanya $x=0$ a dukkan bangarori biyu na (ii), muna samu,
$-6 = A(-2)(3) + 0 + 0$
$\therefore A=1$
Kuma, ta hanyar sanya $x=2$ a dukkan bangarori biyu na (ii), muna samu,
$4 - 18 - 6 = 0 + B \cdot 2 (5) + 0$
ko, $-20 = 10B$
$\therefore B=-2$
A karshe, ta hanyar sanya $x=-3$ a dukkan bangarori biyu na (ii), muna samu,
$9 + 27 - 6 = 0 + 0 + C(-3)(-5)$
ko, $30 = 15C$
$\therefore C=2$
Yanzu, ta hanyar sanya dabi'u na A, B, da C a (i), muna samu,
$\frac{x^2-9x-6}{x(x-2)(x+3)} = \frac{1}{x} - \frac{2}{x-2} + \frac{2}{x+3}$
Wannan shine furcin da ake bukata na rarrabawa kamar yadda aka bayar a matsayin jimlar sassauki.
Ams. $\frac{1}{x} - \frac{2}{x-2} + \frac{2}{x+3}$

Question: Bayyana a matsayin rarrabawa ta ɓangarori: $\frac{x^2 - 4x - 7}{(x+1)(x^2+4)}$
Solution:
Bari mu dauka, $\frac{x^2 - 4x - 7}{(x+1)(x^2+4)} = \frac{A}{x+1} + \frac{Bx+C}{x^2+4}$ ....... (i)
Sa'ad da muka ninka dukkan bangarorin (i) da $(x+1)(x^2+4)$ muna samu,
$x^2 - 4x - 7 = A(x^2+4) + (Bx+C)(x+1)$ ....... (ii)
Wanda yake gaskiya ga duk wata darajar x.
Yanzu, sa'ad da muka saka $x=-1$ muna samu
$(-1)^2 - 4(-1) - 7 = A(1+4)$
ko, $1+4-7 = 5A$
ko, $5A = -2$
$\therefore A = -\frac{2}{5}$
A sake, sa'ad da muka daidaita coefficients na $x^2$, x a dukkan bangarorin (ii)
$A+B=1$
ko, $-\frac{2}{5} + B = 1$
ko, $B = 1 + \frac{2}{5} \therefore B = \frac{7}{5}$
da $B+C = -4$
ko, $\frac{7}{5} + C = -4$
ko, $C = -4 - \frac{7}{5}$ ko, $C = \frac{-20-7}{5}$
$\therefore C = -\frac{27}{5}$
Sa'ad da muka saka darajojin A, B da C a (i), muna samu
$\frac{x^2 - 4x - 7}{(x+1)(x^2+4)} = \frac{-\frac{2}{5}}{x+1} + \frac{\frac{7}{5}x - \frac{27}{5}}{x^2+4}$
$= \frac{2}{5(x+1)} + \frac{7x-27}{5(x^2+4)}$
$= \frac{7x-27}{5(x^2+4)} - \frac{2}{5(x+1)}$
$= \frac{1}{5} \left( \frac{7x-27}{x^2+4} - \frac{2}{x+1} \right)$
Wanda shine ake bukata na rabon ɓangarori (partial fractions)

Question: Bada ita a matsayin gibbin gutsurori: $\frac{x^2}{(2x+1)(x+3)^2}$
Solution:
Bari mu yi,
$\frac{x^2}{(2x+1)(x+3)^2} = \frac{A}{2x+1} + \frac{B}{x+3} + \frac{C}{(x+3)^2}$ ...... (i)
Ta hanyar ninka bangarorin biyu na (i) da $(2x+1)(x+3)^2$ muna samu,
$x^2 = A(x+3)^2 + B(2x+1)(x+3) + C(2x+1)$ ... (ii)
wanda yake gaskiya ga dukkan dabi'un x.
Yanzu, saka $x=-3$ a dukkan bangarorin biyu na (ii) muna samu,
$(-3)^2 = C\{2(-3)+1\}$
ko, $9 = C(-6+1)$
ko, $-5C = 9 \therefore C = -\frac{9}{5}$
Duk, saka $x = -\frac{1}{2}$ a dukkan bangarorin biyu na (ii) muna samu,
$\left(-\frac{1}{2}\right)^2 = A\left(-\frac{1}{2}+3\right)^2$
ko, $\frac{1}{4} = A\left(\frac{-1+6}{2}\right)^2$ ko, $\frac{1}{4} = A \cdot \left(\frac{5}{2}\right)^2$
ko, $\frac{1}{4} = A \cdot \frac{25}{4}$ ko, $25A=1$
$\therefore A=\frac{1}{25}$
Duk, daidaita masu lissafi na $x^2$ na (ii), muna samu,
$A+2B=1$
ko, $\frac{1}{25} + 2B = 1$ ko, $2B = 1 - \frac{1}{25}$
ko, $2B = \frac{25-1}{25}$ ko, $2B = \frac{24}{25}$
ko, $B = \frac{24}{25 \times 2} \therefore B = \frac{12}{25}$
Saka dabi'un A, B da C a (i), muna samu,
$\frac{x^2}{(2x+1)(x+3)^2} = \frac{\frac{1}{25}}{2x+1} + \frac{\frac{12}{25}}{x+3} + \frac{-\frac{9}{5}}{(x+3)^2}$
$= \frac{1}{25(2x+1)} + \frac{12}{25(x+3)} - \frac{9}{5(x+3)^2}$
Wannan shine cikakken bayanin da ake bukata na rarraba kananan rarraba na abin da aka bayar.
Amsa. $\frac{1}{25(2x+1)} + \frac{12}{25(x+3)} - \frac{9}{5(x+3)^2}$

Question: Bari $F(x, y, z) = x^3+y^3+z^3-3xyz$ ta zama wani polynomial na $x, y, z$. Nuna cewa, $F(x, y, z)$ wani lafazi ne mai juyawa (cyclic expression).
Solution:
An bayar da cewa, $F(x, y, z) = x^3+y^3+z^3-3xyz$.
Bayyanar da aka bayar ita ce polynomial na masu canzawa $x, y, z$.
Yanzu, idan muka rubuta $y$ a maimakon $x$, $z$ a maimakon $y$, $x$ a maimakon $z$, muna samun,
$F(y, z, x) = y^3+z^3+x^3-3.y.z.x$
$= x^3+y^3+z^3-3xyz$
An gani, cewa bayyanar ba ta canzawa lokacin da aka canza masu canzawa a jere.
Wato, $F(x, y, z) = F(y, z, x)$
Don haka, $F(x, y, z)$ bayyanar madauki ce. (An nuna)
Exact Answer: F(x, y, z) shine magana mai zagaye

Question: Polynomial na $x, y, z$, $F(x, y, z) = x^3+y^3+z^3-3xyz$. Nuna factorization na $F(x, y, z)$ kuma idan $F(x, y, z)=0$, tare da $x+y+z \neq 0$, nuna cewa, $x^2+y^2+z^2=xy+yz+zx$
Solution:
An bayar,
$F(x, y, z) = x^3+y^3+z^3-3xyz$
$= (x+y)^3-3xy(x+y)+z^3-3xyz$
$= (x+y)^3+z^3-3xy(x+y+z)$
$= (x+y+z)\{(x+y)^2-(x+y).z+z^2\}$
\quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad $-3xy(x+y+z)$
$= (x+y+z)(x^2+2xy+y^2-zx-yz+z^2)$
\quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad $-3xy(x+y+z)$
$= (x+y+z)(x^2+2xy+y^2-zx-yz+z^2-3xy)$
$= (x+y+z)(x^2+y^2+z^2-xy-yz-zx)$ (An nuna.)
A bisa ga tambayar, $F(x, y, z)=0$
ko kuma, $(x+y+z)(x^2+y^2+z^2-xy-yz-zx)=0$
ko kuma, $x^2+y^2+z^2-xy-yz-zx = 0$ [$\because x+y+z \neq 0$]
$\therefore x^2+y^2+z^2 = xy+yz+zx$ (An nuna.)

Question:
A ce ga wani polynomial na $x, y, z$, $F(x, y, z) = x^3+y^3+z^3-3xyz$. Idan $x=(b+c-a)$, $y=(c+a-b)$ da $z=(a+b-c)$,
nuna cewa $F(a, b, c) : F(x, y, z)=1:4$

$P(a, b, c) = (a+b+c)(ab+bc+ca)$
kuma $Q = a^{-3} + b^{-3} + c^{-3} - 3a^{-1}b^{-1}c^{-1}$.
Da cikakken dalili, bayyana ko $P(a, b, c)$ siffa ce ta zagaye ko kuma siffa ce mai daidaituwa.
Solution:
An bamu cewa, $P(a, b, c) = (a+b+c)(ab+bc+ca)$
$= a^2b+abc+ca^2+ab^2+b^2c+abc+abc+bc^2+c^2a$
$= a^2b+ab^2+b^2c+bc^2+c^2a+ca^2+3abc$
$= ab(a+b)+bc(b+c)+ca(c+a)+3abc$
Don haka, furucin da aka bayar shine furucin zagaye (cyclic expression) na masu canzawa $a, b, c$ saboda maye gurbin $b$ da $a$, $c$ da $b$, da kuma $a$ da $c$, furucin bai canza ba.
Kuma furucin da aka bayar shine furucin simetri (symmetric expression) na masu canzawa, $a, b, c$ saboda furucin bai canza ba lokacin da aka musanya kowanne biyu daga cikin masu canzawa.
Exact Answer:
Don haka, idan muka maye gurbin $b$ da $a$, $c$ da $b$, da kuma $a$ da $c$, tsarin da aka bayar ya kasance iri ɗaya, wanda ke nuna cewa tsarin madauwari ne na masu canzawa $a, b, c$.
Bugu da ƙari, idan muka musanya kowace biyu daga cikin masu canzawa, tsarin da aka bayar ya kasance iri ɗaya, wanda ke nuna cewa tsarin yana daidai ga masu canzawa $a, b, c$.

Question:
$P(a, b, c) = (a+b+c)(ab+bc+ca)$
kuma $Q = a^{-3} + b^{-3} + c^{-3} - 3a^{-1}b^{-1}c^{-1}$.
2) Idan $Q=0$ tabbatar cewa $a=b=c$ ko kuma, $ab+bc+ca=0$
Solution:
An ba da cewa, $Q = a^{-3} + b^{-3} + c^{-3} - 3a^{-1}b^{-1}c^{-1}$
$= \frac{1}{a^3} + \frac{1}{b^3} + \frac{1}{c^3} - \frac{3}{abc}$
A bisa ga tambayar, $Q=0$
ko, $\frac{1}{a^3} + \frac{1}{b^3} + \frac{1}{c^3} - \frac{3}{abc} = 0$
ko, $\left(\frac{1}{a}\right)^3 + \left(\frac{1}{b}\right)^3 + \left(\frac{1}{c}\right)^3 - 3.\frac{1}{a}.\frac{1}{b}.\frac{1}{c} = 0$
ko, $\frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{1}{a}+\frac{1}{b}+\frac{1}{c}\right)\left\{\left(\frac{1}{a}-\frac{1}{b}\right)^2+\left(\frac{1}{b}-\frac{1}{c}\right)^2+\left(\frac{1}{c}-\frac{1}{a}\right)^2\right\}=0$
$\left[\therefore x^3+y^3+z^3-3xyz = \frac{1}{2}(x+y+z)\{(x-y)^2+(y-z)^2+(z-x)^2\}\right]$

Ko dai, $\frac{1}{a}+\frac{1}{b}+\frac{1}{c}=0$
ko, $\frac{bc+ca+ab}{abc}=0$
ko, $bc+ca+ab=0$
ko kuma, $\left(\frac{1}{a}-\frac{1}{b}\right)^2+\left(\frac{1}{b}-\frac{1}{c}\right)^2+\left(\frac{1}{c}-\frac{1}{a}\right)^2=0$
Mun sani, idan jimlar wasu kalmomi masu murabba'i biyu ko fiye da haka ta yi sifili, to kowace kalma daga cikinsu za ta zama sifili.
Saboda haka, $\left(\frac{1}{a}-\frac{1}{b}\right)^2=0$ Ko, $\frac{1}{a}-\frac{1}{b}=0$ kuma $\left(\frac{1}{b}-\frac{1}{c}\right)^2=0$
ko, $\frac{1}{a}=\frac{1}{b}$ \quad \quad \quad \quad ko, $\frac{1}{b}=\frac{1}{c}$
$\therefore a=b$ \quad \quad \quad \quad ko, $\therefore b=c$
$\therefore a=b=c$
$\therefore bc+ca+ab=0$ ko $a=b=c$ (An tabbatar)

Question:
$P(a, b, c) = (a+b+c)(ab+bc+ca)$
kuma $Q = a^{-3} + b^{-3} + c^{-3} - 3a^{-1}b^{-1}c^{-1}$.
Idan $P(a, b, c) = abc$ nuna cewa, $\frac{1}{(a+b+c)^7} = \frac{1}{a^7} + \frac{1}{b^7} + \frac{1}{c^7}$.
Solution:
An baka cewa, $P(a, b, c) = (a+b+c)(ab+bc+ca)$
ko, $abc = a^2b+ab^2+abc+abc+b^2c+bc^2+c^2a+ca^2$
ko, $a^2b+ab^2+b^2c+bc^2+c^2a+ca^2+2abc = 0$
ko, $ab(a+b)+bc(a+b)+c^2(a+b)+ac(a+b)=0$
ko, $(a+b)(ab+bc+c^2+ac)=0$
ko, $(a+b)\{b(a+c)+c(a+c)\}=0$
ko, $(a+b)(b+c)(c+a)=0$
Ko dai $a+b=0$ ko, $b+c=0$ ko, $c+a=0$
$\therefore a=-b \quad \therefore b=-c \quad \therefore c=-a$

Yanzu, $\frac{1}{(a+b+c)^7} = \frac{1}{(a-c+c)^7} = \frac{1}{a^7}$ [$\because b=-c$]
Kuma, $\frac{1}{a^7} + \frac{1}{b^7} + \frac{1}{c^7} = \frac{1}{a^7} + \frac{1}{(-c)^7} + \frac{1}{c^7}$ [$\therefore b=-c$]
$= \frac{1}{a^7} - \frac{1}{c^7} + \frac{1}{c^7}$
$= \frac{1}{a^7}$
$\therefore \frac{1}{(a+b+c)^7} = \frac{1}{a^7} + \frac{1}{b^7} + \frac{1}{c^7}$ (An nuna)

Question:
bari $P(x) = 18x^3 + bx^2 - x - 2$
kuma $Q(x) = 4x^4 + 12x^3 + 7x^2 - 3x - 2$.
kayyade digiri na kaso $\frac{Q(x)}{P(x)}$
Solution:
An baka cewa, $P(x) = 18x^3 + bx^2 - x - 2$
Kuma $Q(x) = 4x^4 + 12x^3 + 7x^2 - 3x - 2$
A nan, digiri na $P(x)$ shine 3 kuma digiri na $Q(x)$ shine 4.
Saboda haka, digiri na $\frac{Q(x)}{P(x)}$ shine $(4-3)=1$ (Amsar).

Question:
An ba ku cewa $P(x) = 18x^3 + bx^2 - x - 2$
da $Q(x) = 4x^4 + 12x^3 + 7x^2 - 3x - 2$.
Idan $3x+2$ shine sanadi na $P(x)$, nemo darajar $b$.
Solution:
An ba da cewa, $P(x) = 18x^3 + bx^2 - x - 2$
$(3x+2)$ wani factor ne na $P(x)$.
$\therefore P\left(-\frac{2}{3}\right)=0$
Yanzu, $P\left(-\frac{2}{3}\right) = 18\left(-\frac{2}{3}\right)^3 + b\left(-\frac{2}{3}\right)^2 - \left(-\frac{2}{3}\right) - 2$
ko, $0 = -18\frac{8}{27} + b\frac{4}{9} + \frac{2}{3} - 2$
ko, $0 = -\frac{4b}{9} + \frac{2}{3} - \frac{16}{3} - 2$
ko, $\frac{4b}{9} = 2 + \frac{16}{3} - \frac{2}{3}$
ko, $\frac{4b}{9} = \frac{20}{3}$
ko, $b = \frac{20}{3} \times \frac{9}{4}$
$\therefore b=15$ (Ams.)

Question:
Bari $P(x) = 18x^3 + bx^2 - x - 2$ da $Q(x) = 4x^4 + 12x^3 + 7x^2 - 3x - 2$.
Nuna $\frac{8x^2-2}{Q(x)}$ a matsayin *partial fraction*.
Solution:
An baki, $Q(x) = 4x^4 + 12x^3 + 7x^2 - 3x - 2$
$\therefore \frac{8x^2-2}{Q(x)} = \frac{8x^2-2}{4x^4 + 12x^3 + 7x^2 - 3x - 2}$
$= \frac{8x^2-2}{4x^4 + 4x^3 + 8x^3 + 8x^2 - x^2 - 3x - 2}$
$= \frac{8x^2-2}{4x^3(x+1) + 8x^2(x+1) - x(x+1) - 2(x+1)}$
$= \frac{8x^2-2}{4x^3(x+1)+8x^2(x+1)-x(x+1)-2(x+1)}$
$= \frac{8x^2-2}{(x+1)(4x^3+8x^2-x-2)}$
$= \frac{8x^2-2}{(x+1)\{4x^2(x+2)-1(x+2)\}}$
$= \frac{8x^2-2}{(x+1)(x+2)(4x^2-1)}$
$= \frac{2(4x^2-1)}{(x+1)(x+2)(4x^2-1)}$
$= \frac{2}{(x+1)(x+2)}$
Bari, $\frac{2}{(x+1)(x+2)} = \frac{A}{x+1} + \frac{B}{x+2}$ ........... (i)
Idan muka ninka dukkan bangarorin (i) da $(x+1)(x+2)$ zamu samu,
$2 = A(x+2) + B(x+1)$ ........... (ii)
Bangaren biyu na (ii) gaskiya ne ga duk wani darajin $x$.
Idan muka sanya $x = -2$ a dukkan bangarorin (ii) zamu samu,
$2 = A(-2+2) + B(-2+1)$
ko kuma, $2 = B(-1)$
$\therefore B = -2$
Sake, Idan muka sanya $x = -1$ a dukkan bangarorin (ii) zamu samu,
$2 = A(-1+2) + B(-1+1)$
ko kuma, $2 = A$
$\therefore A=2$
Yanzu, Idan muka sanya ddarajin $A$ da $B$ a (i) zamu samu,
$\frac{2}{(x+1)(x+2)} = \frac{2}{x+1} - \frac{2}{x+2}$
Wannan shine siffar da aka bayar ta kaso zuwa kaso na gaba daya.

Question:
Dige-dige guda biyu na juzu'i $x$ sune
$P(x) = 4x^4 + 12x^3 + 7x^2 - 3x - a$ da $Q(x) = 6x^3 + x^2 - 9x + 26$
Ta hanyar sake tsara $P(x)$ yadda ya kamata, tantance babbar siga.
Solution:
An baki cewa, $P(x) = 7x^2 - 3x + 4x^4 - a + 12x^3$
Nau'in daidaitaccen polynomial da aka bayar:
$P(x) = 4x^4 + 12x^3 + 7x^2 - 3x - a$ ....... (i)
$\therefore$ Babban Coefficient shine 4 (Ams.)

Question:
Akwa juzu'i biyu na polynomial na mai canzawa $x$ sune
$P(x) = 7x^2 - 3x + 4x^4 - a + 12x^3$ da $Q(x) = 6x^3 + x^2 - 9x + 26$
Idan wani sashi na $P(x)$ shine $(x+2)$ to, nemi darajar $a$.

An baka polynomials guda biyu na mai canzawa $x$ sune
$P(x) = 4x^4 + 12x^3 + 7x^2 - 3x - a + 1$ da $Q(x) = 6x^3 + x^2 - 9x + 26$
Nuna cewa, akwai wani sashi na gama-gari na $P(x)$ da $Q(x)$.
Solution:
Sanya $a=2$ a cikin (i) muna samun,
$P(x) = 4x^4 + 12x^3 + 7x^2 - 3x - 2$
Lambobin da ba su da alaƙa da $x$ a cikin $P(x)$ shine $-2$ kuma dukkan abubuwan da suke raba shi shine $F_1 = \{1, -1, 2, -2\}$ da kuma abubuwan da suke raba babban ma'auni 4 shine
$F_2 = \{1, -1, 2, -2, 4, -4\}$ na $P(x)$.
Yanzu la'akari da $P(b)$, inda $b=\frac{r}{s}$ kuma $r \in F_1$, $S \in F_2$.
A'a, idan $b=\frac{1}{2}$ to $P\left(\frac{1}{2}\right) = 4.\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^4 + 12.\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^3 + 7.\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^2 - 3.\left(\frac{1}{2}\right) - 2$
$= 4.\frac{1}{16} + 12.\frac{1}{8} + 7.\frac{1}{4} - \frac{3}{2} - 2$
$= \frac{1}{4} + \frac{3}{2} + \frac{7}{4} - \frac{3}{2} - 2 = \frac{1+7-8}{4} = \frac{8-8}{4} = 0$
Don haka $(2x-1)$ ɗan rabo ne na $P(x)$.
Idan $b=-\frac{1}{2}$ to $P\left(-\frac{1}{2}\right)$
$= 4.\left(-\frac{1}{2}\right)^4 + 12.\left(-\frac{1}{2}\right)^3 + 7.\left(-\frac{1}{2}\right)^2 - 3.\left(-\frac{1}{2}\right) - 2$
$= 4.\frac{1}{16} - 12.\frac{1}{8} + 7.\frac{1}{4} + \frac{3}{2} - 2 = \frac{1}{4} - \frac{3}{2} + \frac{7}{4} + \frac{3}{2} - 2$
$= \frac{1+7-8}{4} = \frac{8-8}{4} = 0$
Don haka $(2x+1)$ ɗan rabo ne na $P(x)$.
Idan $b=-1$ to
$P(-1) = 4(-1)^4 + 12.(-1)^3 + 7.(-1)^2 - 3.(-1) - 2$
$= 4 - 12 + 7 + 3 - 2 = 14 - 14 = 0$
Don haka $(x+1)$ ɗan rabo ne na $P(x)$.
Kuma an bayar da cewa, $(x+2)$ ɗan rabo ne na $P(x)$. Digiri na $P(x)$ shine 4 kuma mun sami rabobi huɗu na polynomial da aka bayar. Don haka la'akari da $k$ a matsayin ma'auni na polynomial $P(x)$.
$\therefore P(x) = K(x+1)(2x+1)(2x-1)(x+2)$
Da la'akari da mafi girman iko na $x$ daga bangarorin biyu mun samu, $K=1$.
$\therefore P(x) = (x+1)(2x+1)(2x-1)(x+2)$
Sake, $Q(x) = 6x^3+x^2-9x+26$.
Yanzu, $Q(-2) = 6(-2)^3+(-2)^2-9(-2)+26$
$= -48+4+18+26 = 0$
$\therefore (x+2)$ ɗan rabo ne na $Q(x)$.
Yanzu, $Q(x) = 6x^3+x^2-9x+26$
$= 6x^3+12x^2-11x^2-22x+13x+26$
$= 6x^2(x+2)-11x(x+2)+13(x+2)$
$= (x+2)(6x^2-11x+13)$
Rabon da ya dace tsakanin $P(x)$ da $Q(x)$ shine $(x+2)$ (Amsa).

Question: Yi amfani da tsarin lissafi don warware ma'auni masu biyowa: $2x^2 + 9x + 9 = 0$
Solution:
Ta hanyar kwatanta dalar $2x^2 + 9x + 9 = 0$ da dalar murabba'i ta tsari $ax^2 + bx + c = 0$, muna samu, $a = 2, b = 9$ da $c = 9$.
Don haka tushen dalar, $x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}$
$= \frac{-9 \pm \sqrt{9^2 - 4 \cdot 2 \cdot 9}}{2 \cdot 2} = \frac{-9 \pm \sqrt{81 - 72}}{4}$
$= \frac{-9 \pm \sqrt{9}}{4} = \frac{-9 \pm 3}{4}$
$= \frac{-9 + 3}{4}, \frac{-9 - 3}{4} = \frac{-6}{4}, \frac{-12}{4}$
$= -\frac{3}{2}, -3$
wato, $x_1 = -\frac{3}{2}$ da $x_2 = -3$
Ams. $-\frac{3}{2}, -3$

Question: Yi amfani da dabara wajen warware ma'auni masu zuwa: $3 - 4x - 2x^2 = 0$
Solution:
Da misalin lissafin $3 - 4x - 2x^2 = 0$ ko kuma, $-2x^2 - 4x + 3 = 0$, muna kwatanta shi da daidaitaccen lissafin murabba'i $ax^2 + bx + c = 0$, mun sami, $a = -2, b = -4$ da $c = 3$.

Saboda haka tushen lissafin, $x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}$
$= \frac{-(-4) \pm \sqrt{(-4)^2 - 4 \cdot (-2) \cdot 3}}{2 \cdot (-2)}$
$= \frac{4 \pm \sqrt{16 + 24}}{-4} = \frac{4 \pm \sqrt{40}}{-4}$
$= \frac{4 \pm 2\sqrt{10}}{-4} = \frac{2(2 \pm \sqrt{10})}{-4}$
$= \frac{2 \pm \sqrt{10}}{-2} = \frac{-2 \mp \sqrt{10}}{2}$
$= -1 \mp \frac{\sqrt{10}}{2}$

watau, $ -1 - \frac{\sqrt{10}}{2}$ da $-1 + \frac{\sqrt{10}}{2}$

Ams. $-1 - \frac{\sqrt{10}}{2}$, $-1 + \frac{\sqrt{10}}{2}$

Question: Yi amfani da dabara wajen warware ma'auni masu zuwa: $4x - 1 - x^2 = 0$
Solution:
Idan muka kwatanta equation ɗin $4x - 1 - x^2 = 0$ ko kuma, $-x^2 + 4x - 1 = 0$ daidai da standard quadratic equation ɗin $ax^2 + bx + c = 0$, muna samun, $a = -1, b = 4$ da $c = -1$.
Don haka tushen equation ɗin, $x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}$
$= \frac{-4 \pm \sqrt{4^2 - 4 \cdot (-1) \cdot (-1)}}{2 \cdot (-1)} = \frac{-4 \pm \sqrt{16 - 4}}{-2}$
$= \frac{-4 \pm \sqrt{12}}{-2} = \frac{-4 \pm 2\sqrt{3}}{-2}$
$= \frac{2(-2 \pm \sqrt{3})}{-2} = -(-2 \pm \sqrt{3})$
$= 2 \pm \sqrt{3}$
watau, $x_1 = 2 - \sqrt{3}$ da $x_2 = 2 + \sqrt{3}$.
Amsar. $2 - \sqrt{3}, 2 + \sqrt{3}$

Question: Yi amfani da tsarin lissafi don warware ma'auni masu zuwa: $2x^2 - 5x - 1 = 0$
Solution:
Idan muka kwatanta lissafin $2x^2 - 5x - 1 = 0$ da daidaitaccen lissafin murabba'i $ax^2 + bx + c = 0$, muna samun, $a = 2$, $b = -5$ da $c = -1$

Don haka tushen lissafin, $x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}$
$= \frac{5 \pm \sqrt{(-5)^2 - 4.2.(-1)}}{2.2} = \frac{5 \pm \sqrt{25 + 8}}{4} = \frac{5 \pm \sqrt{33}}{4}$

Wannan yana nufin, $x_1 = \frac{5 + \sqrt{33}}{4}$ da $x_2 = \frac{5 - \sqrt{33}}{4}$

Amsa. $\frac{5 + \sqrt{33}}{4}$, $\frac{5 - \sqrt{33}}{4}$

Question: Yi amfani da dabara don warware ma'auni masu zuwa: $3x^2 + 7x + 1 = 0$
Solution:
Idan aka kwatanta daidaitawa $3x^2 + 7x + 1 = 0$ da daidaitattun daidaitawa ta quadratic $ax^2 + bx + c = 0$, mun samu, $a = 3$, $b = 7$ da $c = 1$.

Don haka tushen daidaitawa sune, $x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}$
$= \frac{-7 \pm \sqrt{7^2 - 4.3.1}}{2.3} = \frac{-7 \pm \sqrt{49 - 12}}{6} = \frac{-7 \pm \sqrt{37}}{6}$

Wannan yana nufin, $x_1 = \frac{-7 + \sqrt{37}}{6}$ da $x_2 = \frac{-7 - \sqrt{37}}{6}$

Amsa. $\frac{-7 + \sqrt{37}}{6}$, $\frac{-7 - \sqrt{37}}{6}$

Question: Yi amfani da dabara don warware ma'auni masu biyowa: $2 - 3x^2 + 9x = 0$
Solution:
Idan muka kwatanta daidaitacciyar lissafin murabba'i $ax^2 + bx + c = 0$ da lissafin $2 - 3x^2 + 9x = 0$ ko kuma, $-3x^2 + 9x + 2 = 0$, muna samun, $a = -3$, $b = 9$ da $c = 2$

Don haka tushen lissafin, $x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}$
$= \frac{-9 \pm \sqrt{9^2 - 4.(-3).2}}{2.(-3)} = \frac{-9 \pm \sqrt{81 + 24}}{-6}$
$= \frac{-9 \pm \sqrt{105}}{-6} = \frac{9 \mp \sqrt{105}}{6}$

wato, $x_1 = \frac{9 - \sqrt{105}}{6}$ da $x_2 = \frac{9 + \sqrt{105}}{6}$

Amsa. $\frac{9 - \sqrt{105}}{6}$, $\frac{9 + \sqrt{105}}{6}$

Question: Yi amfani da dabarar warware ma'auni masu zuwa: $x^2 - 8x + 16 = 0$
Solution:
Da farko, idan muka kwatanta wannan equation ɗin $x^2 - 8x + 16 = 0$ da daidaitaccen quadratic equation ɗin $ax^2 + bx + c = 0$, muna samun , $a = 1$, $b = -8$ da $c = 16$.
Saboda haka, tushen equation ɗin guda biyu sune:
$x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}$
$= \frac{-(-8) \pm \sqrt{(-8)^2 - 4.1.16}}{2.1}$
$= \frac{8 \pm \sqrt{64 - 64}}{2} = \frac{8}{2} = 4$

wato, $x_1 = x_2 = 4$
Amsa. 4, 4

Question: Yi amfani da dabarar warware ma'auni mai zuwa: $2x^2 + 7x - 1 = 0$
Solution:
Idan muka kwatanta tsarin daidaitawa $2x^2 + 7x - 1 = 0$ tare da daidaitaccen tsarin quadratic $ax^2 + bx + c = 0$, muna samun, $a = 2$, $b = 7$ da $c = -1$.
Don haka, tushen daidaitawa biyu sune
$x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}$
$= \frac{-7 \pm \sqrt{7^2 - 4.2.(-1)}}{2.2}$
$= \frac{-7 \pm \sqrt{49 + 8}}{4}$
$= \frac{-7 \pm \sqrt{57}}{4}$

Watau, $x_1 = \frac{-7 + \sqrt{57}}{4}$ da $x_2 = \frac{-7 - \sqrt{57}}{4}$

Amsa. $\frac{-7 + \sqrt{57}}{4}$, $\frac{-7 - \sqrt{57}}{4}$

Question: Yi amfani da dabara wajen warware ma'auni masu biyowa: $7x - 2 - 3x^2 = 0$
Solution:
Idan muka kwatanta dalar da aka bayar $7x - 2 - 3x^2 = 0$ ko kuma, $-3x^2 + 7x - 2 = 0$ da dalar quadratic ta misali $ax^2 + bx + c = 0$, muna samun, $a = -3$, $b = 7$ da $c = -2$
Don haka, tushen dalar guda biyu sune
$x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}$
$= \frac{-7 \pm \sqrt{7^2 - 4.(-3).(-2)}}{2.(-3)}$
$= \frac{-7 \pm \sqrt{49 - 24}}{-6}$
$= \frac{-7 \pm \sqrt{25}}{-6} = \frac{-7 \pm 5}{-6}$
$= \frac{-7 + 5}{-6}$, $\frac{-7 - 5}{-6}$
$= \frac{-2}{-6}$, $\frac{-12}{-6} = \frac{1}{3}, 2$

watau, $x_1 = \frac{1}{3}$ Kuma $x_2 = 2$
Amsawa. $\frac{1}{3}, 2$

Question: Warware: $\sqrt{x-4}+2=\sqrt{x+12}$
Solution:
$\sqrt{x-4}+2=\sqrt{x+12}$
ko kuma, $(\sqrt{x-4}+2)^2=(\sqrt{x+12})^2$ [Saka dukkan bangarori a matsayi na biyu]
ko kuma, $x-4+4+2\sqrt{x-4 \cdot 2}=x+12$
ko kuma, $x+4\sqrt{x-4}=x+12$
ko kuma, $4\sqrt{x-4}=x+12-x$
ko kuma, $4\sqrt{x-4}=12$
ko kuma, $\sqrt{x-4}=3$
ko kuma, $(\sqrt{x-4})^2=3^2$ [Sake saka dukkan bangarori a matsayi na biyu]
ko kuma, $x-4=9$
$\therefore x=13$
Tabbatarwa:
Ga $x=13$, L.S. $=\sqrt{13-4}+2$
$=\sqrt{9}+2=3+2=5$
R.S. $=\sqrt{13+12}=\sqrt{25}=5$
$\therefore$ L.S. = R.S.
$\therefore x=13$ itace tushen daidaiton da aka bayar.
$\therefore$ Maganin da ake bukata: $x=13$

Question: Warware: $\sqrt{11x-6} = \sqrt{4x+5} - \sqrt{x-1}$
Solution:
$\sqrt{11x-6} = \sqrt{4x+5} - \sqrt{x-1}$

ko, $(\sqrt{11x-6})^2 = (\sqrt{4x+5} - \sqrt{x-1})^2$ [Sama da gefe biyu da murabba'i]

ko, $11x-6 = 4x+5+x-1-2\sqrt{4x+5}\sqrt{x-1}$

ko, $11x-6-5x-4 = -2\sqrt{(4x+5)(x-1)}$

ko, $6x-10 = -2\sqrt{4x^2+x-5}$

ko, $2(3x-5) = -2\sqrt{4x^2+x-5}$

ko, $3x-5 = -\sqrt{4x^2+x-5}$ [Raba gefe biyu da 2]

ko, $(3x-5)^2 = (-\sqrt{4x^2+x-5})^2$

[Sake sama da gefe biyu da murabba'i]

ko, $9x^2-30x+25 = 4x^2+x-5$

ko, $9x^2-30x+25-4x^2-x+5 = 0$

ko, $5x^2-31x+30 = 0$

ko, $5x^2-6x-25x+30 = 0$

ko, $x(5x-6)-5(5x-6)=0$

ko, $(5x-6)(x-5)=0$

Ko dai $5x-6=0$ ko, $x-5=0$

$\therefore x = \frac{6}{5}$ ko, $x=5$

Tabbatarwa:

Ga $x = \frac{6}{5}$,

Gefen Hagu $= \sqrt{11 \times \frac{6}{5} - 6} = \sqrt{\frac{66-30}{5}}$

$= \sqrt{\frac{36}{5}} = \frac{6}{\sqrt{5}}$

Gefen Dama $= \sqrt{4 \cdot \frac{6}{5} + 5} - \sqrt{\frac{6}{5}-1}$

$= \sqrt{\frac{24+25}{5}} - \sqrt{\frac{6-5}{5}}$

$= \sqrt{\frac{49}{5}} - \sqrt{\frac{1}{5}} = \frac{7}{\sqrt{5}} - \frac{1}{\sqrt{5}} = \frac{6}{\sqrt{5}}$

$\therefore$ Gefen Hagu = Gefen Dama

$\therefore x = \frac{6}{5}$ shine tushen daidaitaccen lissafi da aka bayar.

Sake ga $x=5$,

Gefen Hagu $= \sqrt{11 \cdot 5 - 6} = \sqrt{55-6} = \sqrt{49} = 7$

Gefen Dama $= \sqrt{4 \cdot 5 + 5} - \sqrt{5-1}$

$= \sqrt{25} - \sqrt{4}$

$= 5-2=3$

$\therefore$ Gefen Hagu $\ne$ Gefen Dama

$\therefore x=5$ ba tushen daidaitaccen lissafi da aka bayar bane.

$\therefore$ Maganar da ake buƙata: $x = \frac{6}{5}$

Question: Warware: $\sqrt{2x+7}+\sqrt{3x-18}=\sqrt{7x+1}$
Solution:
$\sqrt{2x+7}+\sqrt{3x-18}=\sqrt{7x+1}$
ko, $(\sqrt{2x+7}+\sqrt{3x-18})^2=(\sqrt{7x+1})^2$
[Murabba'i ga dukkan bangarori biyu]
ko, $2x+7+3x-18+2\sqrt{2x+7}\cdot\sqrt{3x-18} = 7x+1$
ko, $2\sqrt{2x+7}\cdot\sqrt{3x-18} = 7x+1-5x+11$
ko, $2\sqrt{6x^2-15x-126} = 2x+12$
ko, $2\sqrt{6x^2-15x-126} = 2(x+6)$
ko, $\sqrt{6x^2-15x-126} = x+6$ [Raba dukkan bangarori biyu da 2]
ko, $(\sqrt{6x^2-15x-126})^2 = (x+6)^2$
[Duk da haka, murabba'i ga dukkan bangarori biyu]
ko, $6x^2-15x-126 = x^2+12x+36$
ko, $6x^2-15x-126-x^2-12x-36 = 0$
ko, $5x^2-27x-162 = 0$
ko, $5x^2-45x+18x-162 = 0$
ko, $5x(x-9)+18(x-9) = 0$
ko, $(x-9)(5x+18) = 0$
Ko dai $(x-9)=0$ ko kuma, $5x+18=0$
$\therefore x=9$ $\therefore x=-\frac{18}{5}$

Tabbatarwa:
Ga $x=9$,
Hagu bangare $=\sqrt{2\cdot 9+7}+\sqrt{3\cdot 9-18}$
$=\sqrt{18+7}+\sqrt{27-18}$
$=\sqrt{25}+\sqrt{9}$
$=5+3=8$
Dama bangare $=\sqrt{7\cdot 9+1}=\sqrt{63+1}=\sqrt{64}=8$
$\therefore$ Hagu bangare $=$ Dama bangare
$\therefore x=9$ shine tushen da aka bayar na d equation.

Duk da haka, ga $x=-\frac{18}{5}$,
Hagu bangare $=\sqrt{2\left(-\frac{18}{5}\right)+7}+\sqrt{3\left(-\frac{18}{5}\right)-18}$
$=\sqrt{-\frac{36}{5}+7}+\sqrt{-\frac{54}{5}-18}$
$=\sqrt{\frac{35-36}{5}}+\sqrt{\frac{-54-90}{5}}$
$=\sqrt{-\frac{1}{5}}+\sqrt{-\frac{144}{5}}$, wanda ba lamba ce ta gaskiya ba.
$\therefore$ Hagu bangare $\neq$ Dama bangare
$\therefore x=-\frac{18}{5}$ ba tushen da aka bayar na equation ba ne.
$\therefore$ Solushin da ake bukata: $x=9$

Question: Warware: $\sqrt{x+4}+\sqrt{x+11}=\sqrt{8x+9}$
Solution:
$\sqrt{x+4}+\sqrt{x+11}=\sqrt{8x+9}$
ko, $(\sqrt{x+4}+\sqrt{x+11})^2=(\sqrt{8x+9})^2$
[Ta hanyar yin murabba'i ga dukkan bangarori]
ko, $x+4+2\sqrt{(x+4)(x+11)}+x+11 = 8x+9$
ko, $x+4+x+11-8x-9 = -2\sqrt{(x+4)(x+11)}$
ko, $-6x+6 = -2\sqrt{x^2+15x+44}$
ko, $-2(3x-3) = -2\sqrt{x^2+15x+44}$
ko, $3x-3 = \sqrt{x^2+15x+44}$
ko, $(3x-3)^2=(\sqrt{x^2+15x+44})^2$
[Maimakon yin murabba'i ga dukkan bangarori]
ko, $9x^2-18x+9 = x^2+15x+44$
ko, $9x^2-x^2-18x-15x+9-44 = 0$
ko, $8x^2-33x-35 = 0$
ko, $8x^2-40x+7x-35 = 0$
ko, $8x(x-5)+7(x-5) = 0$
ko, $(x-5)(8x+7) = 0$
Ko dai $x-5=0$ ko kuma, $8x+7=0$
$\therefore x=5$ $\therefore x=-\frac{7}{8}$

Bincike:
Ga, $x=5$,
Haguwar gefe (L.S.)$=\sqrt{5+4}+\sqrt{5+11}=3+4=7$
da kuma Dama gefe (R.S.)$=\sqrt{8\times 5+9}=\sqrt{49}=7$
$\therefore$ Haguwar gefe $=$ Dama gefe
$\therefore x=5$ tushe ne na lamarin da aka bayar.
Maimakon haka, idan $x=-\frac{7}{8}$,
Haguwar gefe (L.S.) $=\sqrt{-\frac{7}{8}+4}+\sqrt{-\frac{7}{8}+11}$
$=\sqrt{\frac{-7+32}{8}}+\sqrt{\frac{-7+88}{8}}$
$=\sqrt{\frac{25}{8}}+\sqrt{\frac{81}{8}}=\frac{5}{\sqrt{8}}+\frac{9}{\sqrt{8}}=\frac{14}{\sqrt{8}}=\frac{14}{2\sqrt{2}}=\frac{7}{\sqrt{2}}$
da kuma Dama gefe (R.S.)$=\sqrt{8\left(-\frac{7}{8}\right)+9}=\sqrt{-7+9}=\sqrt{2}$
$\therefore$ Haguwar gefe $\neq$ Dama gefe
$\therefore x=-\frac{7}{8}$, ba tushe bane na lamarin da aka bayar.
$\therefore$ Babban magani: $x=5$

Question: Warware: $\sqrt{11x-6}=\sqrt{4x+5}+\sqrt{x-1}$
Solution:
$\sqrt{11x-6}=\sqrt{4x+5}+\sqrt{x-1}$
ko kuma, $(\sqrt{11x-6})^2=(\sqrt{4x+5}+\sqrt{x-1})^2$
[Ta hanyar yin ruban biyu ga kowane bangare]
ko kuma, $11x-6 = 4x+5+x-1+2\sqrt{4x+5}\cdot\sqrt{x-1}$
ko kuma, $11x-6-5x-4 = 2\sqrt{4x^2+x-5}$
ko kuma, $6x-10 = 2\sqrt{4x^2+x-5}$
ko kuma, $2(3x-5) = 2\sqrt{4x^2+x-5}$
ko kuma, $3x-5 = \sqrt{4x^2+x-5}$
ko kuma, $(3x-5)^2=(\sqrt{4x^2+x-5})^2$
[Kuma ta hanyar yin ruban biyu ga kowane bangare]
ko kuma, $9x^2-30x+25 = 4x^2+x-5$
ko kuma, $9x^2-30x+25-4x^2-x+5 = 0$
ko kuma, $5x^2-31x+30 = 0$
ko kuma, $5x^2-6x-25x+30 = 0$
ko kuma, $x(5x-6)-5(5x-6) = 0$
ko kuma, $(5x-6)(x-5) = 0$
Ko dai, $5x-6=0$ ko kuma, $x-5=0$
$\therefore x=\frac{6}{5}$ $\therefore x=5$

Tabbatawa:
Don $x=\frac{6}{5}$,
Hagu: $=\sqrt{11\times\frac{6}{5}-6}=\sqrt{\frac{66}{5}-6}$
$=\sqrt{\frac{66-30}{5}}$
$=\sqrt{\frac{36}{5}}=\frac{6}{\sqrt{5}}$
Kuma Dama: $=\sqrt{4\times\frac{6}{5}+5}+\sqrt{\frac{6}{5}-1}$
$=\sqrt{\frac{24}{5}+5}+\sqrt{\frac{6-5}{5}}$
$=\sqrt{\frac{24+25}{5}}+\sqrt{\frac{1}{5}}$
$=\sqrt{\frac{49}{5}}+\sqrt{\frac{1}{5}}$
$=\frac{7}{\sqrt{5}}+\frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}=\frac{8}{\sqrt{5}}$
$\therefore$ Hagu $\neq$ Dama
$\therefore x=\frac{6}{5}$ ba tushen da ake nema na tsarin da aka bayar ba ne.

Kuma idan $x=5$,
Hagu: $=\sqrt{11\times 5-6}$
$=\sqrt{55-6}$
$=\sqrt{49}=7$
Dama: $=\sqrt{4\times 5+5}+\sqrt{5-1}$
$=\sqrt{20+5}+\sqrt{4}$
$=\sqrt{25}+\sqrt{4}$
$=5+2=7$
$\therefore$ Hagu $=$ Dama
$\therefore x=5$ tushen tsarin da aka bayar ne.
$\therefore$ Maganin da ake bukata: $x=5$

Question: Warware: $\sqrt{x^2-8} + \sqrt{x^2-14} = 6$
Solution:
$\sqrt{x^2-8} + \sqrt{x^2-14} = 6$
ko kuma, $\sqrt{x^2-8} = 6 - \sqrt{x^2-14}$
ko kuma, $x^2-8=36 - 12\sqrt{x^2-14} + x^2 - 14$; [ta hanyar daukar murabba'i ga bangarorin biyu]
ko kuma, $12\sqrt{x^2 - 14} = 30$
ko kuma, $2\sqrt{x^2 - 14} = 5$
ko kuma, $4(x^2 - 14) = 25$ [Kuma ta hanyar daukar murabba'i ga bangarorin biyu]
ko kuma, $4x^2 - 56 = 25$
ko kuma, $4x^2 = 81$
ko kuma, $x^2 = \frac{81}{4}$
$\therefore x = \pm\frac{9}{2}$

Tabbaci:
Ga $x = \frac{9}{2}$
Hagu. Bangare. $= \sqrt{\left(\frac{9}{2}\right)^2 - 8} + \sqrt{\left(\frac{9}{2}\right)^2 - 14}$
$= \sqrt{\frac{81}{4} - 8} + \sqrt{\frac{81}{4} - 14}$
$= \sqrt{\frac{81-32}{4}} + \sqrt{\frac{81-56}{4}}$
$= \sqrt{\frac{49}{4}} + \sqrt{\frac{25}{4}}$
$= \frac{7}{2} + \frac{5}{2} = \frac{12}{2} = 6$
= Dama. Bangare.
Kuma idan $x = -\frac{9}{2}$
Hagu. Bangare. $= \sqrt{\left(-\frac{9}{2}\right)^2 - 8} + \sqrt{\left(-\frac{9}{2}\right)^2 - 14}$
$= \sqrt{\frac{81}{4} - 8} + \sqrt{\frac{81}{4} - 14}$
$= \sqrt{\frac{81-32}{4}} + \sqrt{\frac{81-56}{4}}$
$= \sqrt{\frac{49}{4}} + \sqrt{\frac{25}{4}}$
$= \frac{7}{2} + \frac{5}{2} = \frac{12}{2} = 6$
= Dama. Bangare.
$\therefore$ Maganin da ake bukata: $x = \pm\frac{9}{2}$

Question: Warware: $\sqrt{x^2-6x+9} - \sqrt{x^2-6x+6} = 1$
Solution:
$\sqrt{x^2-6x+9} - \sqrt{x^2-6x+6} = 1$
ko, $\sqrt{y+9} - \sqrt{y+6} = 1$ [Aka dauka, $x^2 - 6x = y$]
ko, $\sqrt{y+9} = 1+\sqrt{y+6}$
ko, $(\sqrt{y+9})^2 = (1+\sqrt{y+6})^2$ [An dauki iyakar duka bangarorin]
ko, $y+9 = 1+2\cdot 1\cdot \sqrt{y+6} + y + 6$
ko, $y+9-1-y-6 = 2\sqrt{y+6}$
ko, $2 = 2\sqrt{y+6}$
ko, $2\sqrt{y+6} = 2$
ko, $\sqrt{y+6} = 1$ [An raba duka bangarorin da 2]
ko, $(\sqrt{y+6})^2 = (1)^2$ [An sake daukar iyakar duka bangarorin]
ko, $y+6 = 1$
ko, $y+6-1 = 0$
ko, $y+5 = 0$
ko, $x^2-6x+5 = 0$ [An maye gurbin darajar y]
ko, $x^2-5x-x+5 = 0$
ko, $x(x-5) - 1(x-5) = 0$
ko, $(x-1)(x-5) = 0$
Ko dai, $x-1 = 0$ ko, $x-5 = 0$
$\therefore x=1$ $\therefore x=5$

Tabbatawa:
Ga, $x=5$,
Hagu. Bangare $= \sqrt{5^2-6\cdot 5+9} - \sqrt{5^2-6\cdot 5+6}$
$= \sqrt{25-30+9} - \sqrt{25-30+6}$
$= \sqrt{4} - \sqrt{1}$
$= 2-1 = 1 =$ Dama. Bangare
$\therefore x = 5$ tushe ne na maganar da aka bayar.
Kara idan $x=1$,
Hagu. Bangare $= \sqrt{1^2-6\cdot 1+9} - \sqrt{1^2-6\cdot 1+6}$
$= \sqrt{1-6+9} - \sqrt{1-6+6}$
$= \sqrt{4} - \sqrt{1}$
$= 2-1$
$= 1$
= Dama. Bangare
$\therefore x = 1$ tushe ne na maganar da aka bayar.
$\therefore$ Maganar da ake bukata: $x=5, 1$

Question: Warware: $\sqrt{x-2}-\sqrt{x-9}=1$
Solution:
$\sqrt{x-2}-\sqrt{x-9}=1$
ko, $\sqrt{x-2}=1+\sqrt{x-9}$
ko, $(\sqrt{x-2})^2=(1+\sqrt{x-9})^2$ [Maura yin maura ga bangarorin biyu]
ko, $x-2=1+x-9+2\sqrt{x-9}$
ko, $x-2-1-x+9=2\sqrt{x-9}$
ko, $6=2\sqrt{x-9}$
ko, $3=\sqrt{x-9}$ [Raba bangarorin biyu da 2]
ko, $(3)^2=(\sqrt{x-9})^2$ [Kuma yin maura ga bangarorin biyu]
ko, $9=x-9$
ko, $x-9-9=0$
ko, $x-18=0$
$\therefore x=18$

Tabbaci:
Ga, $x=18$
Hagu na hannun dama (L.S.) $= \sqrt{18-2} - \sqrt{18-9}$
$= \sqrt{16} - \sqrt{9}$
$= 4-3$
$= 1$
= Dama na hannun dama (R.S.)
$\therefore$ Mafi kyawun mafita: $x=18$

Question: Warware: $6\sqrt{\frac{2x}{x-1}} + 5\sqrt{\frac{x-1}{2x}} = 13$
Solution:
$6\sqrt{\frac{2x}{x-1}} + 5\sqrt{\frac{x-1}{2x}} = 13$
Bari, $\frac{2x}{x-1} = a^2$, to sai wannan sabuwar madaidaiciyar lissafi ta zama
$6\sqrt{a^2} + 5\sqrt{\frac{1}{a^2}} = 13$ [$\therefore \frac{2x}{x-1} = a^2$, saboda haka $\frac{x-1}{2x} = \frac{1}{a^2}$]
ko, $6a + \frac{5}{a} = 13$
ko, $6a^2 + 5 = 13a$
ko, $6a^2 - 13a + 5 = 0$
ko, $6a^2 - 10a - 3a + 5 = 0$
ko, $2a(3a-5) - 1(3a-5) = 0$
ko, $(3a-5)(2a-1) = 0$
Ko dai $3a-5 = 0$ ko kuma, $2a-1 = 0$
ko, $3a = 5$ ko kuma, $2a = 1$
$\therefore a = \frac{5}{3}$ $\therefore a = \frac{1}{2}$
Ga $a = \frac{5}{3}$,
$\sqrt{\frac{2x}{x-1}} = \frac{5}{3}$
ko, $\frac{2x}{x-1} = \frac{25}{9}$
ko, $18x = 25x-25$
ko, $25x-18x = 25$
ko, $7x = 25$
$\therefore x = \frac{25}{7}$

Sake ga $a = \frac{1}{2}$
$\sqrt{\frac{2x}{x-1}} = \frac{1}{2}$
ko, $\frac{2x}{x-1} = \frac{1}{4}$
ko, $8x = x-1$
ko, $7x = -1$
$\therefore x = -\frac{1}{7}$

Tabbaci:
Ga $x = \frac{25}{7}$,
L.S. $= 6\sqrt{\frac{2\cdot \frac{25}{7}}{\frac{25}{7}-1}} + 5\sqrt{\frac{\frac{25}{7}-1}{2\cdot \frac{25}{7}}}$
$= 6\sqrt{\frac{\frac{50}{7}}{\frac{18}{7}}} + 5\sqrt{\frac{\frac{18}{7}}{\frac{50}{7}}}$
$= 6\sqrt{\frac{25}{9}} + 5\sqrt{\frac{9}{25}}$
$= 6\cdot \frac{5}{3} + 5\cdot \frac{3}{5}$
$= 10+3$
$= 13$
= R.S.
$\therefore x = \frac{25}{7}$ shine tushen madaidaiciyar lissafi da aka bayar.

Sake ga $x = -\frac{1}{7}$,
L.S. $= 6\sqrt{\frac{2\left(-\frac{1}{7}\right)}{-\frac{1}{7}-1}} + 5\sqrt{\frac{-\frac{1}{7}-1}{2\left(-\frac{1}{7}\right)}}$
$= 6\sqrt{\frac{-\frac{2}{7}}{-\frac{8}{7}}} + 5\sqrt{\frac{-\frac{8}{7}}{-\frac{2}{7}}}$
$= 6\sqrt{\frac{1}{4}} + 5\sqrt{4}$
$= 6\cdot \frac{1}{2} + 5\cdot 2$
$= 3+10$
$= 13$
= R.S.
$\therefore x = -\frac{1}{7}$ shine tushen madaidaiciyar lissafi da aka bayar.
$\therefore$ Maganin da ake bukata: $x = \frac{25}{7}, -\frac{1}{7}$

Question: Warware: $\sqrt{\frac{x-1}{3x+2}} + 2\sqrt{\frac{3x+2}{x-1}} = 3$
Solution:
$\sqrt{\frac{x-1}{3x+2}} + 2\sqrt{\frac{3x+2}{x-1}} = 3$
Bari, $\frac{x-1}{3x+2} = a^2$, sa'an nan equation ɗin ya zama
$\sqrt{a^2} + 2\sqrt{\frac{1}{a^2}} = 3$ [$\because \frac{x-1}{3x+2} = a^2$ saboda haka $\frac{3x+2}{x-1} = \frac{1}{a^2}$]
ko, $a + \frac{2}{a} = 3$
ko, $a^2+2 = 3a$
ko, $a^2-3a+2 = 0$
ko, $a^2-2a-a+2 = 0$
ko, $a(a-2) - 1(a-2) = 0$
ko, $(a-1)(a-2) = 0$
Ko dai, $a-1 = 0$ ko, $a-2 = 0$
$\therefore a=1$ $\therefore a=2$

Ga $a=2$,
$\sqrt{\frac{x-1}{3x+2}} = 2$ [Maye gurbin darajar a]
ko, $\frac{x-1}{3x+2} = 4$ [Ƙara maƙarfi ga bangarori biyu]
ko, $x-1 = 12x+8$
ko, $x-12x = 8+1$
ko, $-11x = 9$
$\therefore x = -\frac{9}{11}$

Kuma ga $a=1$,
$\sqrt{\frac{x-1}{3x+2}} = 1$
ko, $\frac{x-1}{3x+2} = 1^2$ [Ƙara maƙarfi ga bangarori biyu]
ko, $x-1 = 3x+2$
ko, $3x-x = -1-2$
ko, $2x = -3$
$\therefore x = -\frac{3}{2}$

Tabbaci: Ga $x = -\frac{9}{11}$,
L.S. $= \sqrt{\frac{-\frac{9}{11}-1}{3\left(-\frac{9}{11}\right)+2}} + 2\sqrt{\frac{3\left(-\frac{9}{11}\right)+2}{-\frac{9}{11}-1}}$
$= \sqrt{\frac{\frac{-9-11}{11}}{\frac{-27+22}{11}}} + 2\sqrt{\frac{\frac{-27+22}{11}}{\frac{-9-11}{11}}}$
$= \sqrt{\frac{-20}{11} \times \frac{11}{-5}} + 2\sqrt{\frac{-5}{11} \times \frac{11}{-20}}$
$= \sqrt{4} + 2\sqrt{\frac{1}{4}}$
$= 2+2\cdot \frac{1}{2}$
$= 2+1$
$= 3$
= R.S.

Kuma ga $x = -\frac{3}{2}$,
L.S. $= \sqrt{\frac{-\frac{3}{2}-1}{3\left(-\frac{3}{2}\right)+2}} + 2\sqrt{\frac{3\left(-\frac{3}{2}\right)+2}{-\frac{3}{2}-1}}$
$= \sqrt{\frac{\frac{-3-2}{2}}{\frac{-9+4}{2}}} + 2\sqrt{\frac{\frac{-9+4}{2}}{\frac{-3-2}{2}}}$
$= \sqrt{\frac{-5}{2} \times \frac{2}{-5}} + 2\sqrt{\frac{-5}{2} \times \frac{2}{-5}}$
$= \sqrt{1} + 2\sqrt{1}$
$= 1+2$
$= 3$
= R.S.
$\therefore$ Solushin da ake buƙata: $x = -\frac{9}{11}, -\frac{3}{2}$

Question: Warware: $3^{x+2} = 81$
Solution:
$3^{x+2} = 81$
ko kuma, $3^{x+2} = 3^4$
ko kuma, $x+2 = 4$ [Idan $a^m = a^n$, to $m = n$]
ko kuma, $x=4-2$
$\therefore x=2$
$\therefore$ Abin da ake buƙata $x=2$

Question: Warware: $5^{3x-7} = 3^{3x-7}$
Solution:
$5^{3x-7} = 3^{3x-7}$
ko, $\frac{5^{3x}}{5^7} = \frac{3^{3x}}{3^7} \quad \left[ \because a^{m-n} = \frac{a^m}{a^n} \right]$
ko, $\frac{5^{3x}}{3^{3x}} = \frac{5^7}{3^7}$
ko, $\left(\frac{5}{3}\right)^{3x} = \left(\frac{5}{3}\right)^7 \quad \left[ \because \frac{a^n}{b^n} = \left(\frac{a}{b}\right)^n \right]$
ko, $3x = 7$
$\therefore x = \frac{7}{3}$
$\therefore$ Abin da ake bukata $x = \frac{7}{3}$

Question: Warware: $2^{x-4} = 4a^{x-6}$, $(a > 0, a \ne 2)$
Solution:
$2^{x-4} = 4a^{x-6}$
ko, $\frac{2^{x-4}}{4} = a^{x-6}$
ko, $\frac{2^{x-4}}{2^2} = a^{x-6}$
ko, $2^{x-4-2} = a^{x-6} \quad \left[ \because \frac{a^m}{a^n} = a^{m-n} \right]$
ko, $2^{x-6} = a^{x-6}$
ko, $\frac{2^{x-6}}{a^{x-6}} = 1$
ko, $\left(\frac{2}{a}\right)^{x-6} = 1 \quad \left[ \because \frac{a^m}{b^m} = \left(\frac{a}{b}\right)^m \right]$
ko, $\left(\frac{2}{a}\right)^{x-6} = \left(\frac{2}{a}\right)^0 \quad [\because p^0 = 1]$
ko, $x-6 = 0$
$\therefore x = 6$
$\therefore$ Ana buƙatar $x = 6$

Question: Warware: $\frac{5^{2x} \cdot b^{x-3}}{5^{x+3}} = a^{x-3} \quad (a, b > 0, 5b \ne a)$
Solution:
$\frac{5^{2x} \cdot b^{x-3}}{5^{x+3}} = a^{x-3}$
ko, $\frac{5^{2x}}{5^{x+3}} = \frac{a^{x-3}}{b^{x-3}}$
ko, $5^{2x-x-3} = \left(\frac{a}{b}\right)^{x-3}$
ko, $5^{x-3} = \left(\frac{a}{b}\right)^{x-3}$
ko, $\frac{5^{x-3}}{\left(\frac{a}{b}\right)^{x-3}} = 1$
ko, $\left(\frac{5}{\frac{a}{b}}\right)^{x-3} = \left(\frac{5}{\frac{a}{b}}\right)^0$
ko, $x-3 = 0$
$\therefore x = 3$
$\therefore$ Da ake buƙata $x = 3$

Question: Warware: $4^{x+2} = 2^{2x+1} + 14$
Solution:
$4^{x+2} = 2^{2x+1} + 14$
ko kuma, $4^2 \cdot 4^x = 2^{2x} \cdot 2 + 14$
ko kuma, $16 \cdot 4^x = (2^2)^x \cdot 2 + 14$
ko kuma, $16 \cdot 4^x = 4^x \cdot 2 + 14$
ko kuma, $16 \cdot 4^x - 4^x \cdot 2 = 14$
ko kuma, $4^x(16-2) = 14$
ko kuma, $4^x \cdot 14 = 14$
ko kuma, $4^x = 1 \quad [\text{raba dukkan bangarorin da } 14]$
ko kuma, $4^x = 4^0 \quad [\because a^0 = 1]$
$\therefore x = 0$
$\therefore$ Bukatar $x = 0$

Question: Warware: $5^x + 5^{2-x} = 26$
Solution:
$5^x + 5^{2-x} = 26$
ko kuma, $5^x + \frac{5^2}{5^x} = 26 \quad \left[ \because a^{m-n} = \frac{a^m}{a^n} \right]$
ko kuma, $5^x \cdot 5^x + 5^2 = 26 \cdot 5^x$
ko kuma, $(5^x)^2 + 25 = 26 \cdot 5^x$
ko kuma, $(5^x)^2 - 26 \cdot 5^x + 25 = 0$
ko kuma, $a^2 - 26a + 25 = 0 \quad [\text{ Bari, } 5^x = a ]$
ko kuma, $a^2 - 25a - a + 25 = 0$
ko kuma, $a(a-25) - 1(a-25) = 0$
ko kuma, $(a-1)(a-25) = 0$
Ko dai $a-1=0 \quad \text{ko kuma, } a-25=0$
$\therefore a = 1 \quad \therefore a = 25$
Idan $a=1$, $\quad$ Sake, idan $a=25$,
$5^x = 1 \quad 5^x = 25$
ko kuma, $5^x = 5^0 \quad$ ko kuma, $5^x = 5^2$
$\therefore x=0 \quad \therefore x=2$
$\therefore$ Bukatar $x = 0, 2$

Question: Warware: $3(9^x - 4 \cdot 3^{x-1}) + 1 = 0$
Solution:
$3(9^x - 4 \cdot 3^{x-1}) + 1 = 0$
ko, $3 \cdot 9^x - 4 \cdot 3 \cdot 3^{x-1} + 1 = 0$
ko, $3 \cdot (3^2)^x - 4 \cdot 3^{x-1+1} + 1 = 0 \quad [\because a^m \cdot a^n = a^{m+n}]$
ko, $3(3^x)^2 - 4 \cdot 3^x + 1 = 0 \quad [\because (a^m)^n = a^{mn} = a^{nm} = (a^n)^m]$
ko, $3a^2 - 4a + 1 = 0 \quad [\text{Inda muka ɗauka } 3^x = a ]$
ko, $3a^2 - 3a - a + 1 = 0$
ko, $3a(a-1) - 1(a-1) = 0$
ko, $(3a-1)(a-1) = 0$
Ko dai, $3a - 1 = 0 \quad \text{ko, } a - 1 = 0$
$\therefore a=\frac{1}{3} \quad \therefore a=1$
Idan $a=\frac{1}{3}$, $\quad$ kuma, idan $a=1$,
to, $3^x = \frac{1}{3} \quad$ to, $3^x = 1$
ko, $3^x = 3^{-1} \quad$ ko, $3^x = 3^0$
$\therefore x = -1 \quad \therefore x = 0$
$\therefore$ Abin da ake buƙata shi ne $x = 0, -1$

Question: Warware: $4^{1+x} + 4^{1-x} = 10$
Solution:
$4^{1+x} + 4^{1-x} = 10$
ko, $4 \cdot 4^x + \frac{4}{4^x} = 10 \quad \left[ \therefore a^{m+n} = a^m \cdot a^n, a^{m-n} = \frac{a^m}{a^n} \right]$
ko, $4 \cdot 4^x \cdot 4^x + 4 = 10 \cdot 4^x$
ko, $4(4^x)^2 - 10 \cdot 4^x + 4 = 0$
ko, $4a^2 - 10a + 4 = 0 \quad [\text{Ta hanyar ɗaukar } 4^x = a]$
ko, $4a^2 - 8a - 2a + 4 = 0$
ko, $4a(a-2) - 2(a-2) = 0$
ko, $(a-2)(4a-2) = 0$
Ko dai $a-2=0 \quad \text{ko kuma, } 4a-2=0$
$\therefore a=2 \quad \text{ko kuma, } 4a=2$
$\therefore a = \frac{1}{2}$
Idan $a=2, 4^x = 2$
ko, $(4)^x = 4^{\frac{1}{2}} \left[ \because \sqrt{4} = 4^{\frac{1}{2}} = 2 \right] \therefore x = \frac{1}{2}$
A sake, idan $a=\frac{1}{2}$, to $4^x = \frac{1}{2}$
ko, $4^x = 4^{-\frac{1}{2}}$
ko, $4^x = 4^{-\frac{1}{2}}$
$\therefore x = -\frac{1}{2}$
$\therefore \text{Solisoshin da ake bukata: } x = \frac{1}{2}, -\frac{1}{2}$

Question: Warware: $2^{2x} - 3 \cdot 2^{x+2} = -32$
Solution:
$2^{2x} - 3 \cdot 2^{x+2} = -32$
ko, $(2^x)^2 - 3 \cdot 2^2 \cdot 2^x = -32 \quad [\because a^{mn} = (a^m)^n, a^{m+n} = a^m \cdot a^n]$
ko, $(2^x)^2 - 12 \cdot 2^x + 32 = 0$
ko, $a^2 - 12a + 32 = 0 \quad [\text{Inda muka ɗauka } 2^x = a]$
ko, $a^2 - 8a - 4a + 32 = 0$
ko, $a(a-8) - 4(a-8) = 0$
