$\therefore \cos A=\frac{12}{13}$
Kuma, $\tan A=\frac{\sin A}{\cos A}$
ko, $\sin A=\tan A \cdot \cos A=-\frac{5}{12}\left(\frac{12}{13}\right)=-\frac{5}{13}$
$\therefore \sin A=-\frac{5}{13}$
Amsa. $\sin A=-\frac{5}{13}, \cos A=\frac{12}{13}$

Question:
Tabbatar da daidaiton da ke biye da shi:
$\tan A + \cot A = \sec A \operatorname{cosec} A$
Solution:
L.S. $=\tan A+\cot A=\frac{\sin A}{\cos A}+\frac{\cos A}{\sin A}$
$=\frac{\sin ^{2} A+\cos ^{2} A}{\cos A \sin A}$
$=\frac{1}{\cos A \sin A}$ [$\because \sin ^{2} A+\cos ^{2} A=1$]
$=\frac{1}{\cos A} \cdot \frac{1}{\sin A}=\sec A \cdot \operatorname{cosec} A=\text{R.S}$
$\therefore \tan A+\cot A=\sec A \operatorname{cosec} A$ (An tabbatar)
Exact Answer: don haka \tan A+\cot A=\sec A \operatorname{cosec} A

Question:
Tabbatar da ma'auni masu zuwa:
$\sqrt{\frac{1+\cos \theta}{1-\cos \theta}}=\operatorname{cosec} \theta+\cot \theta=\sqrt{\frac{\sec \theta+1}{\sec \theta-1}}$
Solution:
Anan, $\sqrt{\frac{1+\cos \theta}{1-\cos \theta}}=\sqrt{\frac{(1+\cos \theta)(1+\cos \theta)}{(1-\cos \theta)(1+\cos \theta)}}$
$=\sqrt{\frac{(1+\cos \theta)^{2}}{1-\cos ^{2} \theta}}$
$=\sqrt{\frac{(1+\cos \theta)^{2}}{\sin ^{2} \theta}}$ [$\because \sin ^{2} \theta+\cos ^{2} \theta=1$]
$=\frac{1+\cos \theta}{\sin \theta}$
$=\frac{1}{\sin \theta}+\frac{\cos \theta}{\sin \theta}$
$=\operatorname{cosec} \theta+\cot \theta$

Duk da haka, $\sqrt{\frac{\sec \theta+1}{\sec \theta-1}}=\sqrt{\frac{(\sec \theta+1)(\sec \theta+1)}{(\sec \theta-1)(\sec \theta+1)}}$
$=\sqrt{\frac{(\sec \theta+1)^{2}}{\sec ^{2} \theta-1}}$
$=\sqrt{\frac{(\sec \theta+1)^{2}}{\tan ^{2} \theta}}$
$=\frac{\sec \theta+1}{\tan \theta}$
$=\frac{\sec \theta}{\tan \theta}+\frac{1}{\tan \theta}$
$=\frac{1}{\cos \theta} \cdot \frac{\cos \theta}{\sin \theta}+\cot \theta$
$=\frac{1}{\sin \theta}+\cot \theta$
$=\operatorname{cosec} \theta+\cot \theta$

$\therefore \sqrt{\frac{1+\cos \theta}{1-\cos \theta}}=\operatorname{cosec} \theta+\cot \theta=\sqrt{\frac{\sec \theta+1}{\sec \theta-1}}$ (An nuna)

Question:
Tabbatar da wadannan daidaitawa:
$\sqrt{\frac{1-\sin A}{1+\sin A}}=\sec A-\tan A$
Solution:
L.S. $=\sqrt{\frac{1-\sin A}{1+\sin A}}=\sqrt{\frac{(1-\sin A)(1-\sin A)}{(1+\sin A)(1-\sin A)}}$
$=\sqrt{\frac{(1-\sin A)^{2}}{1-\sin ^{2} A}}$
$=\sqrt{\frac{(1-\sin A)^{2}}{\cos ^{2} A}}$ [$\because \sin ^{2} A+\cos ^{2} A=1$]
$=\frac{1-\sin A}{\cos A}=\frac{1}{\cos A}-\frac{\sin A}{\cos A}$
$=\sec A-\tan A=\text{R.S}$
$\therefore \sqrt{\frac{1-\sin A}{1+\sin A}}=\sec A-\tan A$ (An tabbata)
Exact Answer: don haka \sqrt{\frac{1-\sin A}{1+\sin A}}=\sec A-\tan A

Question:
Tabbatar da **waɗannan** daidaitawa masu zuwa:
$\sec ^{4} \theta-\sec ^{2} \theta=\tan ^{4} \theta+\tan ^{2} \theta$
Solution:
L.S $=\sec ^{4} \theta-\sec ^{2} \theta$
$=\left(\sec ^{2} \theta\right)^{2}-\sec ^{2} \theta$
$=\left(1+\tan ^{2} \theta\right)^{2}-\left(1+\tan ^{2} \theta\right)$ [$\because \sec ^{2} \theta=1+\tan ^{2} \theta$]
$=1+2 \tan ^{2} \theta+\tan ^{4} \theta-1-\tan ^{2} \theta$
$=\tan ^{4} \theta+\tan ^{2} \theta$
$=$ R.S
$\therefore \sec ^{4} \theta-\sec ^{2} \theta=\tan ^{4} \theta+\tan ^{2} \theta$ (An tabbatar)

Question:
Tabbatar da wadannan daidaitattun dabi'u:
$(\sec \theta-\cos \theta)(\operatorname{cosec} \theta-\sin \theta)(\tan \theta+\cot \theta)=1$
Solution:
L.S $=(\sec \theta-\cos \theta)(\operatorname{cosec} \theta-\sin \theta)(\tan \theta+\cot \theta)$
$=\left(\frac{1}{\cos \theta}-\cos \theta\right)\left(\frac{1}{\sin \theta}-\sin \theta\right)\left(\frac{\sin \theta}{\cos \theta}+\frac{\cos \theta}{\sin \theta}\right)$
$=\left(\frac{1-\cos ^{2} \theta}{\cos \theta}\right)\left(\frac{1-\sin ^{2} \theta}{\sin \theta}\right)\left(\frac{\sin ^{2} \theta+\cos ^{2} \theta}{\cos \theta \sin \theta}\right)$
$=\left(\frac{\sin ^{2} \theta}{\cos \theta}\right)\left(\frac{\cos ^{2} \theta}{\sin \theta}\right)\left(\frac{1}{\cos \theta \sin \theta}\right)$ [$\because \sin ^{2} \theta+\cos ^{2} \theta=1$]
$=\frac{\sin ^{2} \theta \cdot \cos ^{2} \theta}{\cos ^{2} \theta \cdot \sin ^{2} \theta}$
$=1=$ R.S
$\therefore(\sec \theta-\cos \theta)(\operatorname{cosec} \theta-\sin \theta)(\tan \theta+\cot \theta)=1$ (An tabbata)

Question:
Tabbatar da waɗannan dai-daitattaki masu zuwa:
$\frac{\tan \theta+\sec \theta-1}{\tan \theta-\sec \theta+1}=\tan \theta+\sec \theta$
Solution:
L.S = $\frac{\tan \theta+\sec \theta-1}{\tan \theta-\sec \theta+1}$
$=\frac{(\sec \theta+\tan \theta)-\left(\sec ^{2} \theta-\tan ^{2} \theta\right)}{\tan \theta-\sec \theta+1}$
$=\frac{(\sec \theta+\tan \theta)-(\sec \theta+\tan \theta)(\sec \theta-\tan \theta)}{\tan \theta-\sec \theta+1}$
$=\frac{(\sec \theta+\tan \theta)(1-\sec \theta+\tan \theta)}{(1-\sec \theta+\tan \theta)}$
$=\sec \theta+\tan \theta$
= R.S
$\therefore \frac{\tan \theta+\sec \theta-1}{\tan \theta-\sec \theta+1}=\tan \theta+\sec \theta$ (An tabbatar)

Question: Idan $\operatorname{cosec} A=\frac{a}{b}$ inda $a>b>0$, to ka tabbatar cewa, $\tan A=\frac{\pm b}{\sqrt{a^{2}-b^{2}}}$
Solution:
An ba mu, $\operatorname{cosec} A=\frac{a}{b}$
ko, $\operatorname{cosec}^{2} A=\frac{a^{2}}{b^{2}}$ [ta hanyar yin murabba'i ga dukkan bangarorin biyu]
ko, $1+\cot ^{2} A=\frac{a^{2}}{b^{2}}$ [saboda, $\operatorname{cosec}^{2} A-\cot ^{2} A=1$]
ko, $\cot ^{2} A=\frac{a^{2}}{b^{2}}-1$
ko, $\frac{1}{\tan ^{2} A}=\frac{a^{2}-b^{2}}{b^{2}}$
ko, $\tan ^{2} A=\frac{b^{2}}{a^{2}-b^{2}}$
ko, $\tan A=\pm \sqrt{\frac{b^{2}}{a^{2}-b^{2}}}$
$\therefore \tan A=\frac{\pm b}{\sqrt{a^{2}-b^{2}}}$ (An tabbatar)

Question: Idan $\cos \theta-\sin \theta=\sqrt{2} \sin \theta$, to, tabbatar da cewa $\cos \theta+\sin \theta=\sqrt{2} \cos \theta$.
Solution:
An bayar,
$\cos \theta-\sin \theta=\sqrt{2} \sin \theta$
ko kuma, $\cos \theta=\sqrt{2} \sin \theta+\sin \theta$
ko kuma, $\cos \theta=(\sqrt{2}+1) \sin \theta$
ko kuma, $(\sqrt{2}-1) \cos \theta=(\sqrt{2}-1)(\sqrt{2}+1) \sin \theta$ [ta hanyar ninkawa kowane bangare da $(\sqrt{2}-1)$]
ko kuma, $(\sqrt{2}-1) \cos \theta=(2-1) \sin \theta$
ko kuma, $\sqrt{2} \cos \theta-\cos \theta=\sin \theta$
$\therefore \cos \theta+\sin \theta=\sqrt{2} \cos \theta$ (An tabbatar)

Question: Idan $\tan \theta=\frac{x}{y}, x \neq y$, to, nemo darajar $\frac{x \sin \theta+y \cos \theta}{x \sin \theta-y \cos \theta}$
Solution:
An bayar, $\tan \theta=\frac{x}{y}$
ko kuma, $\frac{\sin \theta}{\cos \theta}=\frac{x}{y}$
ko kuma, $\frac{x \sin \theta}{y \cos \theta}=\frac{x}{y} \cdot \frac{x}{y}$ [ta hanyar ninka bangarori biyu da $\frac{x}{y}$]
ko kuma, $\frac{x \sin \theta}{y \cos \theta}=\frac{x^{2}}{y^{2}}$
$\therefore \frac{x \sin \theta+y \cos \theta}{x \sin \theta-y \cos \theta}=\frac{x^{2}+y^{2}}{x^{2}-y^{2}}$ [ta hanyar gamawa-rabawa (componendo-dividendo)]
Amsa. $\frac{x^{2}+y^{2}}{x^{2}-y^{2}}$

Question: Idan $\tan\theta + \sec\theta = x$, to, nuna cewa $\sin\theta = \frac{x^2-1}{x^2+1}$.
Solution:
An bayar, $\tan\theta + \sec\theta = x$
ko, $\frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta} + \frac{1}{\cos\theta} = x$
ko, $\frac{1+\sin\theta}{\cos\theta} = x$
ko, $\frac{(1+\sin\theta)^2}{\cos^2\theta} = x^2$ [ta hanyar murabba'i ga dukkan bangarorin]
ko, $\frac{(1+\sin\theta)^2}{1-\sin^2\theta} = x^2$ [$\because \cos^2\theta = 1-\sin^2\theta$]
ko, $\frac{(1+\sin\theta)(1+\sin\theta)}{(1+\sin\theta)(1-\sin\theta)} = x^2$
ko, $\frac{1+\sin\theta}{1-\sin\theta} = x^2$
ko, $\frac{1+\sin\theta + 1-\sin\theta}{1+\sin\theta - (1-\sin\theta)} = \frac{x^2+1}{x^2-1}$ [ta hanyar componendo-dividendo]
ko, $\frac{2}{2\sin\theta} = \frac{x^2+1}{x^2-1}$
$\therefore \sin\theta = \frac{x^2-1}{x^2+1}$ (An nuna)

Question: Idan $a\cos\theta - b\sin\theta = c$, to, tabbatar cewa, $a\sin\theta + b\cos\theta = \pm\sqrt{a^2+b^2-c^2}$
Solution:
An bayar, $a\cos\theta - b\sin\theta = c$
ko, $(a\cos\theta - b\sin\theta)^2 = c^2$ [a yayin da aka yi murabba'i ga dukkan bangarorin biyu]
ko, $a^2\cos^2\theta - 2a\cos\theta. b\sin\theta + b^2\sin^2\theta = c^2$
ko, $a^2 (1 - \sin^2\theta) - 2a\cos\theta.b\sin\theta + b^2 (1 - \cos^2\theta) = c^2$
ko, $a^2 - a^2\sin^2\theta - 2a\cos\theta.b\sin\theta + b^2 - b^2\cos^2\theta = c^2$
ko, $- (a^2\sin^2\theta + 2a\cos\theta.b\sin\theta + b^2\cos^2\theta) = - (a^2+b^2-c^2)$
ko, $a^2\sin^2\theta + 2a\cos\theta.b\sin\theta + b^2\cos^2\theta = a^2+b^2-c^2$
ko, $(a\sin\theta)^2 + 2a\sin\theta.b\cos\theta + (b\cos\theta)^2 = a^2+b^2-c^2$
ko, $(a\sin\theta + b\cos\theta)^2 = a^2+b^2-c^2$
$\therefore a\sin\theta + b\cos\theta = \pm\sqrt{a^2+b^2-c^2}$ (An tabbatar)

Question:
Nemo ƙimar:
$\sin^2 \frac{\pi}{6} + \cos^2 \frac{\pi}{4} + \tan^2 \frac{\pi}{3} + \cot^2 \frac{\pi}{6}$
Solution:
$\sin^2 \frac{\pi}{6} + \cos^2 \frac{\pi}{4} + \tan^2 \frac{\pi}{3} + \cot^2 \frac{\pi}{6}$
$= (\frac{1}{2})^2 + (\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}})^2 + (\sqrt{3})^2 + (\sqrt{3})^2$
$= \frac{1}{4} + \frac{1}{2} + 3 + 3 = \frac{1+2+12+12}{4} = \frac{27}{4}$
$\therefore$ Kimar da ake buƙata $= \frac{27}{4}$ (Ams.)

Question:
Nemo ƙimar:
$3\tan^2\frac{\pi}{4} - \sin^2\frac{\pi}{3} - \frac{1}{2}\cot^2\frac{\pi}{6} + \frac{1}{3}\sec^2\frac{\pi}{4}$
Solution:
$3\tan^2\frac{\pi}{4} - \sin^2\frac{\pi}{3} - \frac{1}{2}\cot^2\frac{\pi}{6} + \frac{1}{3}\sec^2\frac{\pi}{4}$
$= 3(1)^2 - \left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)^2 - \frac{1}{2}(\sqrt{3})^2 + \frac{1}{3}(\sqrt{2})^2$
$= 3 - \frac{3}{4} - \frac{3}{2} + \frac{2}{3} = \frac{36 - 9 - 18 + 8}{12} = \frac{17}{12}$
$\therefore$ Ƙimar da ake buƙata $= \frac{17}{12}$ (Ams.)

Question:
Nemo ƙimar:
$\tan^2 \frac{\pi}{4} - \sin^2 \frac{\pi}{3} \tan^2 \frac{\pi}{6} \tan^2 \frac{\pi}{3} \cos^2 \frac{\pi}{4}$
Solution:
$\tan^2 \frac{\pi}{4} - \sin^2 \frac{\pi}{3} \tan^2 \frac{\pi}{6} \tan^2 \frac{\pi}{3} \cos^2 \frac{\pi}{4}$
$= 1^2 - (\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2})^2 \cdot (\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}})^2 \cdot (\sqrt{3})^2 \cdot (\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}})^2$
$= 1 - \frac{3}{4} \cdot \frac{1}{3} \cdot 3 \cdot \frac{1}{2} = 1 - \frac{3}{8} = \frac{8-3}{8} = \frac{5}{8}$
$\therefore$ Ƙimar da ake buƙata $= \frac{5}{8}$ (Amms.)

Question:
Nemo ƙimar:
$\frac{\tan\frac{\pi}{3} - \tan\frac{\pi}{6}}{1 + \tan\frac{\pi}{3}\tan\frac{\pi}{6}} + \cos\frac{\pi}{3}\cos\frac{\pi}{6} + \sin\frac{\pi}{3}\sin\frac{\pi}{6}$
Solution:
$\frac{\tan\frac{\pi}{3} - \tan\frac{\pi}{6}}{1 + \tan\frac{\pi}{3}\tan\frac{\pi}{6}} + \cos\frac{\pi}{3}\cos\frac{\pi}{6} + \sin\frac{\pi}{3}\sin\frac{\pi}{6}$
$= \frac{\sqrt{3} - \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}}{1 + \sqrt{3} \cdot \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}} + \frac{1}{2} \cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} + \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \cdot \frac{1}{2}$
$= \frac{\frac{3-1}{\sqrt{3}}}{1+1} + \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} + \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}$
$= \frac{\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}}{2} + \frac{2\sqrt{3}}{4}$
$= \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}} \times \frac{1}{2} + \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$
$= \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} + \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = \frac{2+3}{2\sqrt{3}} = \frac{5}{2\sqrt{3}} = \frac{5\sqrt{3}}{2\sqrt{3}\cdot\sqrt{3}} = \frac{5\sqrt{3}}{2\cdot 3} = \frac{5\sqrt{3}}{6}$
$\therefore$ Ƙimar da ake buƙata $= \frac{5\sqrt{3}}{6}$ (Amsa.)

Question:
Sauƙaƙe:
$\frac{1-\sin^2\frac{\pi}{6}}{1+\sin^2\frac{\pi}{4}} \times \frac{\cos^2\frac{\pi}{3}+\cos^2\frac{\pi}{6}}{\text{cosec}^2\frac{\pi}{2}-\cot^2\frac{\pi}{2}} \div \left(\sin\frac{\pi}{3}\tan\frac{\pi}{6}\right) + \left(\sec^2\frac{\pi}{6}-\tan^2\frac{\pi}{6}\right)$
Solution:
$\frac{1-\sin^2\frac{\pi}{6}}{1+\sin^2\frac{\pi}{4}} \times \frac{\cos^2\frac{\pi}{3}+\cos^2\frac{\pi}{6}}{\text{cosec}^2\frac{\pi}{2}-\cot^2\frac{\pi}{2}} \div \left(\sin\frac{\pi}{3}\tan\frac{\pi}{6}\right) + \left(\sec^2\frac{\pi}{6}-\tan^2\frac{\pi}{6}\right)$
$= \frac{1-(\frac{1}{2})^2}{1+(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}})^2} \times \frac{(\frac{1}{2})^2 + (\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2})^2}{1-0} \div \left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\cdot\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right) + \left\{\left(\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\right)^2 - \left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right)^2\right\}$
$= \frac{1-\frac{1}{4}}{1+\frac{1}{2}} \times \left(\frac{1}{4}+\frac{3}{4}\right) \div \frac{1}{2} + \left(\frac{4}{3}-\frac{1}{3}\right)$
$= \frac{\frac{3}{4}}{\frac{3}{2}} \times \frac{4}{4} \div \frac{1}{2} + \frac{3}{3} = \frac{3}{4} \times \frac{2}{3} \times 2 + \frac{3}{3} = 1+1=2$
$\therefore$ Ƙimar da ake buƙata don sauƙaƙewa $= 2$ (Ams.)

Question: Saurara: $\sin 7\pi$
Solution:
$\sin 7\pi = \sin \left(14 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} + 0\right)$. A nan, $n=14$ lambobi ne marasa izuwa (even number). Don haka, $\sin$ za ta zauna kamar yadda take kuma alamar $\sin$ za ta kasance mara kyau (negative), saboda kusurwar tana cikin rubu'i na uku (third quadrant).
$\therefore \sin \left(14 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} + 0\right) = -\sin 0^{\circ} = 0$
$\therefore$ Kimar da ake buƙata $= 0$

Question: Sauƙaƙe: $\cos \frac{11\pi}{2}$
Solution:
$\cos \frac{11\pi}{2} = \cos \left(11 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} + 0\right)$
A nan, $n=11$ lambobi ne marasa adadi (odd number). Don haka, $\cos$ za a canza shi zuwa $\sin$, kuma alamar $\cos$ za ta kasance mai kyau (positive), saboda kusurwar tana cikin kwata na huɗu (fourth quadrant).
$\cos \frac{11\pi}{2} = \cos \left(11 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} + 0\right) = \sin 0 = 0$
$\therefore$ Ƙimar da ake buƙata $= 0$

Question: Sarkake: $\cot 11\pi$
Solution:
$\cot 11\pi = \cot \left(22 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} + 0\right)$
A nan, $n=22$ lambobi ne masu yin hutu (even number). Don haka, $\cot$ ba za ta canza ba kuma alamar $\cot$ za ta kasance mai kyau, tunda kusurwar tana cikin rubu'i na farko ko na uku inda $\cot$ ke da kyau.
$\therefore \cot 11\pi = \cot \left(22 \frac{\pi}{2} + 0\right) = \cot 0 = \text{Marar Gane (Undefined).}$

Question: Sauƙaƙe: $\tan \left(-\frac{23\pi}{6}\right)$
Solution:
$-\tan \frac{23\pi}{6}$ [saboda, $\tan (-\theta) = -\tan \theta$]
$= -\tan \left(4\pi - \frac{\pi}{6}\right)$
$= -\tan \left(8 \times \frac{\pi}{2} - \frac{\pi}{6}\right)$
A nan, $n=8$ lambobi ne marasa iyaka, don haka $\tan$ zai kasance ba canzawa ba kuma alamun $\tan$ zai kasance mara kyau, saboda kusurwar tana cikin kusurwa ta huɗu.
$\therefore -\tan \left(8 \times \frac{\pi}{2} - \frac{\pi}{6}\right) = -\left(-\tan \frac{\pi}{6}\right) = \tan \frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$
$\therefore$ Ƙimar da ake buƙata $= \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$

Question: Sauƙaƙe: $\text{cosec } \frac{19\pi}{3}$
Solution:
$\text{cosec } \frac{19\pi}{3} = \text{cosec } \left(6\pi + \frac{\pi}{3}\right)$
$= \text{cosec } \left(12 \times \frac{\pi}{2} + \frac{\pi}{3}\right)$
A nan, $n=12$, lambobi ne marasa iyaka (even number), don haka cosec za ta kasance ba ta canza ba kuma alamar cosec za ta kasance mai kyau, saboda kusurwar tana cikin kwata na 1.
$\therefore \text{cosec } \frac{19\pi}{3} = \text{cosec } \left(12 \times \frac{\pi}{2} + \frac{\pi}{3}\right) = \text{cosec } \frac{\pi}{3}$
$= \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}} \left[\therefore \text{cosec } \frac{\pi}{3} = \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\right]$
Amsa: $\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}$

Question: Sauƙaƙe: $\sec \left(-\frac{25\pi}{2}\right)$
Solution:
$\sec \left(-\frac{25\pi}{2}\right) = \sec \left(\frac{25\pi}{2}\right) \left[\because \sec (-\theta) = \sec \theta\right]$
$= \sec \left(24 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} + \frac{\pi}{2}\right)$
A nan, $n=24$ lambobi ne masu adadi kuma kusurwar tana cikin kusurwar farko.
$\therefore \sec \left(-\frac{25\pi}{2}\right) = \sec \frac{\pi}{2} = \text{Mararrabewa.}$

Question: Sauƙaƙe: $\sin \frac{31\pi}{6}$
Solution:
$\sin \frac{31\pi}{6} = \sin \left(5\pi + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) = \sin \left(10 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} + \frac{\pi}{6}\right)$
A nan $n=10$ lambobi ne masu-girma (even number). Don haka, $\sin$ za ta kasance iri ɗaya kuma alamar $\sin$ za ta kasance mara kyau (negative), saboda kusurwar tana tsakiyar kusurwa ta uku (third quadrant).
$\therefore \sin \left(10 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) = -\sin \frac{\pi}{6} = -\frac{1}{2}$
$\therefore$ Ƙimar da ake buƙata $= -\frac{1}{2}$

Question: Sauƙaƙe: $\cos \left(-\frac{25\pi}{6}\right)$
Solution:
$\cos \left(-\frac{25\pi}{6}\right) = \cos \frac{25\pi}{6}$
$\left[\because \cos (-\theta) = \cos \theta\right]$
$= \cos \left(4\pi + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) = \cos \left(8 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} + \frac{\pi}{6}\right)$
A nan, $n=8$ lambobi ne masu adadi. Don haka, $\cos$ ba za ta canza ba kuma alamar $\cos$ za ta kasance mai kyau, saboda kusurwar tana cikin kwata na farko.
$\therefore \cos \left(8 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) = \cos \frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$
$\therefore$  Cikakken ƙimar da ake buƙata $= \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$

Question: Sauƙaƙe: $\cos \frac{17\pi}{10} + \cos \frac{13\pi}{10} + \cos \frac{9\pi}{10} + \cos \frac{\pi}{10} = 0$
Solution:
L.S. $= \cos \frac{17\pi}{10} + \cos \frac{13\pi}{10} + \cos \frac{9\pi}{10} + \cos \frac{\pi}{10}$
$= \cos \left(2\pi-\frac{3\pi}{10}\right) + \cos \left(\pi+\frac{3\pi}{10}\right) + \cos \left(\pi-\frac{\pi}{10}\right) + \cos \frac{\pi}{10}$
$= \cos \frac{3\pi}{10} - \cos \frac{3\pi}{10} - \cos \frac{\pi}{10} + \cos \frac{\pi}{10}$
$= 0 = \text{R.S}$
$\therefore \cos \frac{17\pi}{10} + \cos \frac{13\pi}{10} + \cos \frac{9\pi}{10} + \cos \frac{\pi}{10} = 0 \text{ (An tabbatar)}$

Question: Sauƙaƙe:  $\tan \frac{\pi}{12} \tan \frac{5\pi}{12} \tan \frac{7\pi}{12} \tan \frac{11\pi}{12} = 1$
Solution:
L.S. $= \tan \frac{\pi}{12} \tan \frac{5\pi}{12} \tan \frac{7\pi}{12} \tan \frac{11\pi}{12}$
$= \tan \frac{\pi}{12} \tan \left(\frac{\pi}{2} - \frac{\pi}{12}\right) \tan \left(\frac{\pi}{2} + \frac{\pi}{12}\right) \tan \left(2 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} - \frac{\pi}{12}\right)$
$= \tan \frac{\pi}{12} \cot \frac{\pi}{12} \left(-\cot \frac{\pi}{12}\right) \left(-\tan \frac{\pi}{12}\right)$
$= \tan \frac{\pi}{12} \cdot \frac{1}{\tan \frac{\pi}{12}} \cdot \frac{1}{\tan \frac{\pi}{12}} \cdot \tan \frac{\pi}{12} = 1 = \text{R.S}$
$\therefore \tan \frac{\pi}{12} \tan \frac{5\pi}{12} \tan \frac{7\pi}{12} \tan \frac{11\pi}{12} = 1 \text{ (an tabbata)}$

Question: Sauƙaƙe:  $\sin^2 \frac{2\pi}{7} + \sin^2 \frac{5\pi}{14} + \sin^2 \frac{8\pi}{7} + \sin^2 \frac{9\pi}{14} = 2$
Solution:
L.S. $= \sin^2 \frac{2\pi}{7} + \sin^2 \frac{5\pi}{14} + \sin^2 \frac{8\pi}{7} + \sin^2 \frac{9\pi}{14}$
$= \sin^2 \frac{2\pi}{7} + \left\{\sin \left(\frac{\pi}{2} - \frac{\pi}{7}\right)\right\}^2 + \left\{\sin \left(\pi + \frac{\pi}{7}\right)\right\}^2 + \left\{\sin \left(\frac{\pi}{2} + \frac{\pi}{7}\right)\right\}^2$
$= \sin^2 \frac{2\pi}{7} + \left(\cos \frac{\pi}{7}\right)^2 + \left(-\sin \frac{\pi}{7}\right)^2 + \left(\cos \frac{\pi}{7}\right)^2$
$= \sin^2 \frac{2\pi}{7} + \cos^2 \frac{\pi}{7} + \sin^2 \frac{\pi}{7} + \cos^2 \frac{2\pi}{7}$
$= 2\left(\sin^2 \frac{2\pi}{7} + \cos^2 \frac{2\pi}{7}\right) = 2 = \text{R.S.}$
$\therefore \sin^2 \frac{2\pi}{7} + \sin^2 \frac{5\pi}{14} + \sin^2 \frac{8\pi}{7} + \sin^2 \frac{9\pi}{14} = 2 \text{ (an tabbata)}$

Question: Sanya tsari mai sauki: $\sin \frac{7\pi}{3} \cos \frac{13\pi}{6} - \cos \frac{5\pi}{3} \sin \frac{11\pi}{6} = 1$
Solution:
L.S. $= \sin \frac{7\pi}{3} \cos \frac{13\pi}{6} - \cos \frac{5\pi}{3} \sin \frac{11\pi}{6}$
$= \sin \left(2\pi + \frac{\pi}{3}\right) \cos \left(2\pi + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) - \cos \left(2\pi - \frac{\pi}{3}\right) \sin \left(2\pi - \frac{\pi}{6}\right)$
$= \sin \frac{\pi}{3} \cos \frac{\pi}{6} - \cos \frac{\pi}{3} \left(-\sin \frac{\pi}{6}\right)$
$= \sin \frac{\pi}{3} \cos \frac{\pi}{6} + \cos \frac{\pi}{3} \sin \frac{\pi}{6}$
$= \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} + \frac{1}{2} \cdot \frac{1}{2}$
$= \frac{3}{4} + \frac{1}{4} = \frac{3+1}{4} = \frac{4}{4} = 1 = \text{R.S}$
$\therefore \sin \frac{7\pi}{3} \cos \frac{13\pi}{6} - \cos \frac{5\pi}{3} \sin \frac{11\pi}{6} = 1 \text{ (An tabbatar)}$

Question: Sauƙaƙe: $\sin \frac{13\pi}{3} \cos \frac{13\pi}{6} - \sin \frac{11\pi}{6} \cos \left(\frac{5\pi}{3}\right) = 1$
Solution:
L.S. $= \sin \frac{13\pi}{3} \cos \frac{13\pi}{6} - \sin \frac{11\pi}{6} \cos \left(\frac{5\pi}{3}\right)$
$= \sin \left(4\pi + \frac{\pi}{3}\right) \cos \left(2\pi + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) - \sin \left(2\pi - \frac{\pi}{6}\right) \cos \left(2\pi - \frac{\pi}{3}\right)$
$\left[\because \cos (-\theta) = \cos \theta\right]$
$= \sin \frac{\pi}{3} \cos \frac{\pi}{6} - \left(-\sin \frac{\pi}{6}\right) \cos \frac{\pi}{3}$
$= \sin \frac{\pi}{3} \cos \frac{\pi}{6} + \sin \frac{\pi}{6} \cos \frac{\pi}{3}$
$= \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} + \frac{1}{2} \cdot \frac{1}{2}$
$= \frac{3}{4} + \frac{1}{4} = \frac{3+1}{4} = \frac{4}{4} = 1 = \text{R.S}$
$\therefore \sin \frac{13\pi}{3} \cos \frac{13\pi}{6} - \sin \frac{11\pi}{6} \cos \left(\frac{5\pi}{3}\right) = 1 \text{ (an tabbata)}$

Question:
Idan $\tan \theta = \frac{3}{4}$ kuma $\sin \theta$ yana da darajar ragi (negative), nuna cewa,
$\frac{\sin \theta + \cos \theta}{\sec \theta + \tan \theta} = \frac{14}{5}$
Solution:
An bayar,
$\tan \theta = \frac{3}{4}$ kuma $\sin \theta$ mara kyau ne
ko kuma, $\frac{\sin \theta}{\cos \theta} = \frac{3}{4}$
ko kuma, $3\cos \theta = 4\sin \theta$
ko kuma, $9\cos^2 \theta = 16\sin^2 \theta$ [rufe bangarori biyu]
ko kuma, $9(1-\sin^2 \theta) = 16\sin^2 \theta$
ko kuma, $9 - 9\sin^2 \theta - 16\sin^2 \theta = 0$
ko kuma, $-25\sin^2 \theta = -9$
ko kuma, $\sin^2 \theta = \frac{9}{25}$
ko kuma, $\sin \theta = \pm \frac{3}{5}$
$\therefore \sin \theta = -\frac{3}{5}$ [$\therefore \sin \theta$ mara kyau ne]
Sake, $\tan \theta = \frac{3}{4}$
ko kuma, $\frac{\sin \theta}{\cos \theta} = \frac{3}{4}$
ko kuma, $3\cos \theta = 4\sin \theta$
$\therefore \cos \theta = \frac{4}{3} \times \left(-\frac{3}{5}\right) = -\frac{4}{5}$
kuma $\sec \theta = \frac{1}{\cos \theta} = \frac{1}{-\frac{4}{5}} = -\frac{5}{4}$
L.S. $= \frac{\sin \theta + \cos \theta}{\sec \theta + \tan \theta}$
$= \frac{-\frac{3}{5} + \left(-\frac{4}{5}\right)}{-\frac{5}{4} + \frac{3}{4}} = \frac{\frac{-3-4}{5}}{\frac{-5+3}{4}} = \frac{\frac{-7}{5}}{\frac{-2}{4}}$
$= -\frac{7}{5} \times -\frac{2}{1} = \frac{14}{5} = \text{R.S}$
$\therefore \frac{\sin \theta + \cos \theta}{\sec \theta + \tan \theta} = \frac{14}{5}$ (An tabbatar)

Question: Sauƙaƙe: $\cos \frac{9\pi}{4} + \cos \frac{5\pi}{4} + \sin \frac{31\pi}{36} - \sin \frac{5\pi}{36}$
Solution:
$\cos \frac{9\pi}{4} + \cos \frac{5\pi}{4} + \sin \frac{31\pi}{36} - \sin \frac{5\pi}{36}$
$= \cos \left(2\pi + \frac{\pi}{4}\right) + \cos \left(\pi + \frac{\pi}{4}\right) + \sin \left(\pi - \frac{5\pi}{36}\right) - \sin \frac{5\pi}{36}$
$= \cos \frac{\pi}{4} - \cos \frac{\pi}{4} + \sin \frac{5\pi}{36} - \sin \frac{5\pi}{36}$
$= 0$
$\therefore$ Ƙimar da ake buƙata $= 0$

Question: Sauƙaƙe: $\cot \frac{\pi}{20} \cot \frac{3\pi}{20} \cot \frac{5\pi}{20} \cot \frac{7\pi}{20} \cot \frac{9\pi}{20}$
Solution:
$\cot \frac{\pi}{20} \cot \frac{3\pi}{20} \cot \frac{5\pi}{20} \cot \frac{7\pi}{20} \cot \frac{9\pi}{20}$
$= \cot \frac{\pi}{20} \cot \left(\frac{\pi}{2} - \frac{7\pi}{20}\right) \cot \frac{\pi}{4} \cot \frac{7\pi}{20} \cot \left(\frac{\pi}{2} - \frac{\pi}{20}\right)$
$= \cot \frac{\pi}{20} \tan \frac{7\pi}{20} \cdot 1 \cdot \cot \frac{7\pi}{20} \tan \frac{\pi}{20}$
$= \cot \frac{\pi}{20} \cdot \frac{1}{\cot \frac{7\pi}{20}} \cdot \cot \frac{7\pi}{20} \cdot \frac{1}{\cot \frac{\pi}{20}} = 1$
$\therefore$ Ƙimar da ake buƙata $= 1$

Question: Sauƙaƙe:  $\sin^2 \frac{\pi}{4} + \sin^2 \frac{3\pi}{4} + \sin^2 \frac{5\pi}{4} + \sin^2 \frac{7\pi}{4}$
Solution:
$\sin^2 \frac{\pi}{4} + \sin^2 \frac{3\pi}{4} + \sin^2 \frac{5\pi}{4} + \sin^2 \frac{7\pi}{4}$
$= \sin^2 \frac{\pi}{4} + \sin^2 \left(\pi - \frac{\pi}{4}\right) + \sin^2 \left(\pi + \frac{\pi}{4}\right) + \sin^2 \left(2\pi - \frac{\pi}{4}\right)$
$= \sin^2 \frac{\pi}{4} + \sin^2 \frac{\pi}{4} + \left(-\sin \frac{\pi}{4}\right)^2 + \left(-\sin \frac{\pi}{4}\right)^2$
$= \sin^2 \frac{\pi}{4} + \sin^2 \frac{\pi}{4} + \sin^2 \frac{\pi}{4} + \sin^2 \frac{\pi}{4}$
$= 4 \sin^2 \frac{\pi}{4} = 4 \left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\right)^2 = 4 \cdot \frac{1}{2} = 2$
$\therefore$ Ƙimar da ake buƙata $= 2$

Question: Saurare: $\cos^2 \frac{\pi}{8} + \cos^2 \frac{3\pi}{8} + \cos^2 \frac{5\pi}{8} + \cos^2 \frac{7\pi}{8}$
Solution:
$\cos^2 \frac{\pi}{8} + \cos^2 \frac{3\pi}{8} + \cos^2 \frac{5\pi}{8} + \cos^2 \frac{7\pi}{8}$
$= \cos^2 \frac{\pi}{8} + \cos^2 \frac{3\pi}{8} + \cos^2 \left(\frac{\pi}{2} + \frac{\pi}{8}\right) + \cos^2 \left(\frac{\pi}{2} + \frac{3\pi}{8}\right)$
$= \cos^2 \frac{\pi}{8} + \cos^2 \frac{3\pi}{8} + \left(-\sin \frac{\pi}{8}\right)^2 + \left(-\sin \frac{3\pi}{8}\right)^2$
$= \cos^2 \frac{\pi}{8} + \sin^2 \frac{\pi}{8} + \cos^2 \frac{3\pi}{8} + \sin^2 \frac{3\pi}{8}$
$= 1+1=2$
$\therefore$ Ƙimar da ake buƙata $= 2$

Question: Sauƙaƙe: $\sin^2 \frac{17\pi}{18} + \sin^2 \frac{5\pi}{18} + \cos^2 \frac{37\pi}{18} + \cos^2 \frac{3\pi}{18}$
Solution:
$\sin^2 \frac{17\pi}{18} + \sin^2 \frac{5\pi}{18} + \cos^2 \frac{37\pi}{18} + \cos^2 \frac{3\pi}{18}$
$= \left(\sin \frac{17\pi}{18}\right)^2 + \left(\sin \frac{5\pi}{18}\right)^2 + \left(\cos \frac{37\pi}{18}\right)^2 + \left(\cos \frac{3\pi}{18}\right)^2$
$= \sin^2 \left(\pi - \frac{\pi}{18}\right) + \sin^2 \frac{5\pi}{18} + \cos^2 \left(2\pi + \frac{\pi}{18}\right) + \cos^2 \frac{3\pi}{18}$
$= \left\{\sin \left(\pi - \frac{\pi}{18}\right)\right\}^2 + \left\{\sin \left(\frac{\pi}{2} - \frac{4\pi}{18}\right)\right\}^2 + \left\{\cos \left(2\pi + \frac{\pi}{18}\right)\right\}^2 + \left\{\cos \left(\pi - \frac{5\pi}{18}\right)\right\}^2$
$= \sin^2 \frac{\pi}{18} + \cos^2 \frac{4\pi}{18} + \cos^2 \frac{\pi}{18} + \cos^2 \frac{5\pi}{18}$
$= \sin^2 \frac{\pi}{18} + \cos^2 \frac{\pi}{18} + \sin^2 \frac{5\pi}{18} + \cos^2 \frac{5\pi}{18}$
$= 1 + 1 \left[\because \sin^2 \theta + \cos^2 \theta = 1\right]$
$= 2$
$\therefore$ Ƙimar da ake buƙata $= 2$

Question: Idan $\theta = \frac{\pi}{3}$ to, ka tabbatar da waɗannan daidaiton: $\sin 2\theta = 2 \sin \theta \cos \theta = \frac{2 \tan \theta}{1+\tan^2 \theta}$
Solution:
An bayar, $\theta = \frac{\pi}{3}$
Yanzu, $\sin 2\theta = \sin 2 \cdot \frac{\pi}{3} \left[\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{3}\right]$
$= \sin \frac{2\pi}{3}$
$= \sin \left(\pi - \frac{\pi}{3}\right) = \sin \frac{\pi}{3} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$
Kuma $2 \sin \theta \cos \theta = 2 \sin \frac{\pi}{3} \cos \frac{\pi}{3} \left[\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{3}\right]$
$= 2 \cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \cdot \frac{1}{2} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$
A sake, $\frac{2 \tan \theta}{1 + \tan^2 \theta} = \frac{2 \tan \frac{\pi}{3}}{1 + \tan^2 \frac{\pi}{3}} \left[\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{3}\right]$
$= \frac{2 \cdot \sqrt{3}}{1 + (\sqrt{3})^2}$
$= \frac{2\sqrt{3}}{1+3} = \frac{2\sqrt{3}}{4} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$
$\therefore \sin 2\theta = 2 \sin \theta \cos \theta = \frac{2 \tan \theta}{1 + \tan^2 \theta} \text{ (An tabbatar da shi)}$

Question: Idan $\theta = \frac{\pi}{3}$ to, tabbatar da waɗannan daidaito: $\sin 3\theta = 3\sin \theta - 4\sin^3 \theta$
Solution:
An bayar, $\theta = \frac{\pi}{3}$
L.S. $= \sin 3\theta = \sin \left(3 \cdot \frac{\pi}{3}\right) \left[\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{3}\right]$
$= \sin \pi = \sin (2 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} + 0)$
$= \sin 0 = 0$
R.S. $= 3\sin \theta - 4\sin^3 \theta$
$= 3\sin \frac{\pi}{3} - 4\sin^3 \frac{\pi}{3} \left[\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{3}\right]$
$= 3 \cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} - 4 \cdot \left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)^3 = \frac{3\sqrt{3}}{2} - 4 \cdot \frac{3\sqrt{3}}{8}$
$= \frac{3\sqrt{3}}{2} - \frac{3\sqrt{3}}{2} = 0$
$\therefore \sin 3\theta = 3 \sin \theta - 4 \sin^3 \theta \text{ (An tabbatar)}$

Question: Idan $\theta = \frac{\pi}{3}$ to, ka tabbatar da daidaito masu zuwa: $\cos 3\theta = 4\cos^3 \theta - 3\cos \theta$.
Solution:
An bayar, $\theta = \frac{\pi}{3}$
L.S. $= \cos 3\theta$
$= \cos 3 \cdot \frac{\pi}{3} \left[\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{3}\right]$
$= \cos \pi$
$= \cos \left(2 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} + 0\right)$
$= -\cos 0^\circ = -1$
R.S. $= 4 \cos^3 \theta - 3 \cos \theta$
$= 4 \cos^3 \frac{\pi}{3} - 3 \cos \frac{\pi}{3} \left[\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{3}\right]$
$= 4 \cdot \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^3 - 3 \cdot \frac{1}{2} = 4 \cdot \frac{1}{8} - \frac{3}{2} = \frac{1}{2} - \frac{3}{2}$
$= \frac{1-3}{2} = \frac{-2}{2} = -1$
$\therefore \cos 3\theta = 4 \cos^3 \theta - 3 \cos \theta$. (An tabbatar)

Question: Nemo darajar $\alpha$ wadda ta cika sharuɗɗan da aka bayar: $\cot \alpha = -\sqrt{3} \, ; \, \frac{3\pi}{2} < \alpha < 2\pi$
Solution:
A sashe na huɗu,
$\cot \alpha = -\sqrt{3}$
ko kuma, $\cot \alpha = -\cot \frac{\pi}{6}$
$= \cot \left(2\pi - \frac{\pi}{6}\right)$
$= \cot \left(\frac{12\pi - \pi}{6}\right) = \cot \frac{11\pi}{6}$
$\therefore \alpha = \frac{11\pi}{6}$ ya yarda, tun da $\frac{3\pi}{2} < \alpha < 2\pi$
$\therefore$ ƙimar da ake buƙata, $\alpha = \frac{11\pi}{6}$

Question: Nemo darajar $\alpha$ wadda ta cika sharuddan da aka bayar: $\cos \alpha = -\frac{1}{2} \, ; \, \frac{\pi}{2} < \alpha < \frac{3\pi}{2}$
Solution:
A sashe na biyu, $\cos \alpha = -\frac{1}{2}$
ko kuma, $\cos \alpha = -\cos \frac{\pi}{3}$
ko kuma, $\cos \alpha = \cos \left(\pi - \frac{\pi}{3}\right)$
ko kuma, $\alpha = \frac{3\pi - \pi}{3}$
$\therefore \alpha = \frac{2\pi}{3}$
wanda ke cika sharaɗin $\frac{\pi}{2} < \alpha < \frac{3\pi}{2}$
Sake, a sashe na uku, $\cos \alpha = -\frac{1}{2}$
ko kuma, $\cos \alpha = -\cos \frac{\pi}{3}$
ko kuma, $\cos \alpha = \cos \left(\pi + \frac{\pi}{3}\right)$
ko kuma, $\alpha = \frac{3\pi + \pi}{3}$
$\therefore \alpha = \frac{4\pi}{3}$
wanda ke cika sharaɗin, $\frac{\pi}{2} < \alpha < \frac{3\pi}{2}$
$\therefore$ Ƙimar da ake buƙata, $\alpha = \frac{2\pi}{3} \text{ da } \frac{4\pi}{3}$

Question: Nemo darajar $\alpha$ wadda ta bi ka'idojin da aka bayar: $\sin \alpha = -\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \, ; \, \frac{\pi}{2} < \alpha < \frac{3\pi}{2}$
Solution:
$\sin \alpha = -\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$
ko kuma, $\sin \alpha = -\sin \frac{\pi}{3}$
ko kuma, $\sin \alpha = \sin \left(\pi + \frac{\pi}{3}\right) \left[\therefore \text{ sin yana da tambari mara kyau a sashe na uku}\right]$
ko kuma, $\alpha = \pi + \frac{\pi}{3}$
$\therefore \alpha = \frac{4\pi}{3}$, wanda ya cika sharadi $\frac{\pi}{2} < \alpha < \frac{3\pi}{2}$
$\therefore$ Darajar da ake buƙata $= \frac{4\pi}{3}$

Question: Nemo darajar $\alpha$ wadda ke biyan sharuddan da aka bayar: $\cot \alpha = -1 \, ; \, \pi < \alpha < 2\pi$
Solution:
$\cot \alpha = -1$
ko kuma, $\cot \alpha = -\cot \frac{\pi}{4}$
ko kuma, $\cot \alpha = \cot \left(2\pi - \frac{\pi}{4}\right) \, ; \, \left[\because \text{ cot ɗin yana da kyau a sashe na huɗu}\right]$
ko kuma, $\alpha = 2\pi - \frac{\pi}{4}$
$\therefore \alpha = \frac{7\pi}{4}$, wanda ya cika sharadi, $\pi < \alpha < 2\pi$
$\therefore$ Ƙimar da ake buƙata $= \frac{7\pi}{4}$

Question: Warware: $\left(\text{inda } 0 < \theta < \frac{\pi}{2}\right)$$2 \cos^2 \theta = 1 + 2 \sin^2 \theta$
Solution:
An baki cewa,
$2 \cos^2 \theta = 1 + 2 \sin^2 \theta$
ko, $2 \cos^2 \theta - 2 \sin^2 \theta = 1$
ko, $2(1-\sin^2 \theta) - 2 \sin^2 \theta = 1 \left[\therefore \cos^2 \theta = 1 - \sin^2 \theta\right]$
ko, $2 - 2\sin^2 \theta - 2\sin^2 \theta = 1$
ko, $2 - 4 \sin^2 \theta = 1$
ko, $-4\sin^2 \theta = -1$
ko, $\sin^2 \theta = \frac{1}{4}$
ko, $\sin \theta = \pm \frac{1}{2}$
Ganin cewa $0 < \theta < \frac{\pi}{2}$, don haka $\sin \theta = -\frac{1}{2}$ ba za a iya karɓa ba.
$\therefore \sin \theta = \frac{1}{2}$
ko, $\sin \theta = \sin \frac{\pi}{6} \left[\because \sin \frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{1}{2}\right]$
$\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{6}$
$\therefore$ Sauran mafita da ake bukata, $\theta = \frac{\pi}{6}$

Question: Warware: $\left(\text{inda } 0 < \theta < \frac{\pi}{2}\right)$ $2 \sin^2 \theta - 3 \cos \theta = 0$
Solution:
An bamu cewa,
$2 \sin^2 \theta - 3 \cos \theta = 0$
ko kuma, $2(1-\cos^2 \theta) - 3 \cos \theta = 0$
ko kuma, $2 - 2\cos^2 \theta - 3 \cos \theta = 0$
ko kuma, $-(2\cos^2 \theta + 3\cos \theta - 2) = 0$
ko kuma, $2 \cos^2 \theta + 3\cos \theta - 2 = 0$
ko kuma, $2 \cos^2 \theta + 4 \cos \theta - \cos \theta - 2 = 0$
ko kuma, $2 \cos \theta (\cos \theta + 2) - 1 (\cos \theta + 2) = 0$
ko kuma, $(2 \cos \theta - 1)(\cos \theta + 2) = 0$
A nan, $\cos \theta + 2 \neq 0$ saboda, idan $\cos \theta + 2 = 0$ to $\cos \theta = -2$, wanda ba'a karɓa ba, saboda ƙimar $\cos \theta$ ba za ta taɓa kasancewa fiye da 1 ko ƙasa da -1 ba.
$\therefore 2 \cos \theta - 1 = 0$ lokacin da $0^\circ < \theta < \frac{\pi}{2}$
ko kuma, $2 \cos \theta = 1$
ko kuma, $\cos \theta = \frac{1}{2}$
ko kuma, $\cos \theta = \cos \frac{\pi}{3}$,
$\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{3}$
$\therefore$ Amsar da ake buƙata, $\theta = \frac{\pi}{3}$

Question: Warware: $\left(\text{inda } 0 < \theta < \frac{\pi}{2}\right)$$6 \sin^2 \theta - 11\sin \theta + 4 = 0$
Solution:
An bayar,
$6 \sin^2 \theta - 11\sin \theta + 4 = 0$
ko, $6 \sin^2 \theta - 8\sin \theta - 3 \sin \theta + 4 = 0$
ko, $2 \sin \theta (3 \sin \theta - 4) - 1(3\sin \theta - 4) = 0$
ko, $(2 \sin \theta - 1)(3\sin \theta - 4) = 0$
Anan, $3\sin \theta - 4 \neq 0$ saboda, idan $3\sin \theta - 4 = 0$ to $\sin \theta = \frac{4}{3}$, wanda ba za a karba ba. Domin darajar $\sin \theta$ ba za ta iya kasancewa fiye da 1 kuma kasa da -1 ba.
$\therefore 2\sin \theta - 1 = 0$
ko, $\sin \theta = \frac{1}{2}$
ko, $\sin \theta = \sin \frac{\pi}{6}$
$\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{6}$
$\therefore$ Maganin da ake bukata, $\theta = \frac{\pi}{6}$

Question: Warware: $\left(\text{inda } 0 < \theta < \frac{\pi}{2}\right)$$\tan \theta + \cot \theta = \frac{4}{\sqrt{3}}$
Solution:
An baka,
$\tan \theta + \cot \theta = \frac{4}{\sqrt{3}}$
ko kuma, $\tan \theta + \frac{1}{\tan \theta} = \frac{4}{\sqrt{3}}$
ko kuma, $\frac{\tan^2 \theta + 1}{\tan \theta} = \frac{4}{\sqrt{3}}$
ko kuma, $\sqrt{3} (\tan^2 \theta + 1) = 4 \tan \theta$
ko kuma, $\sqrt{3} \tan^2 \theta + \sqrt{3} = 4 \tan \theta$
ko kuma, $\sqrt{3} \tan^2 \theta - 4 \tan \theta + \sqrt{3} = 0$
ko kuma, $\sqrt{3} \tan^2 \theta - 3 \tan \theta - \tan \theta + \sqrt{3} = 0$
ko kuma, $\sqrt{3} \tan \theta (\tan \theta - \sqrt{3}) - 1 (\tan \theta - \sqrt{3}) = 0$
ko kuma, $(\tan \theta - \sqrt{3}) (\sqrt{3} \tan \theta - 1) = 0$
Ko dai, $\tan \theta - \sqrt{3} = 0$ ko kuma, $\sqrt{3} \tan \theta - 1 = 0$
ko kuma, $\tan \theta = \sqrt{3}$ ko kuma, $\tan \theta = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$
ko kuma, $\tan \theta = \tan \frac{\pi}{3}$ ko kuma, $\tan \theta = \tan \frac{\pi}{6}$
$\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{3} \left[\therefore \tan \frac{\pi}{3} = \sqrt{3}\right]$
$\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{6} \left[\therefore \tan \frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right]$
wanda ya cika sharadin, $0 < \theta < \frac{\pi}{2}$
$\therefore$ Maganin da ake bukata, $\theta = \frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{\pi}{3}$

Question: Warware: $\left(\text{inda } 0 < \theta < \frac{\pi}{2}\right)$ $2\sin^2 \theta + 3 \cos \theta = 3$
Solution:
An bayar,
$2\sin^2 \theta + 3 \cos \theta = 3$
ko kuma, $2(1-\cos^2 \theta) + 3 \cos \theta - 3 = 0$
ko kuma, $2 - 2\cos^2 \theta + 3 \cos \theta - 3 = 0$
ko kuma, $-2\cos^2 \theta + 3 \cos \theta - 1 = 0$
ko kuma, $-(2\cos^2 \theta - 3 \cos \theta + 1) = 0$
ko kuma, $2\cos^2 \theta - 3 \cos \theta + 1 = 0$
ko kuma, $2\cos^2 \theta - 2 \cos \theta - \cos \theta + 1 = 0$
ko kuma, $2 \cos \theta (\cos \theta - 1) - 1 (\cos \theta - 1) = 0$
ko kuma, $(2 \cos \theta - 1) (\cos \theta - 1) = 0$
$\therefore$ Ko dai, $2\cos \theta - 1 = 0$ ko kuma, $\cos \theta - 1 = 0$
ko kuma, $\cos \theta = \frac{1}{2}$ ko kuma, $\cos \theta = 1$
ko kuma, $\cos \theta = \cos \frac{\pi}{3}$ ko kuma, $\cos \theta = \cos 0$
$\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{3}$ $\therefore \theta = 0$
Amma $0 < \theta < \frac{\pi}{2}$
$\therefore \theta \neq 0^\circ$
$\therefore$ Amsar da ake bukata, $\theta = \frac{\pi}{3}$

Question: Warware: (inda $0 < \theta < 2\pi$)$2 \sin^2 \theta + 3 \cos \theta = 0$
Solution:
An baka,
$2 \sin^2 \theta + 3 \cos \theta = 0$
ko, $2 (1-\cos^2\theta) + 3 \cos\theta = 0$
ko, $2 - 2 \cos^2\theta + 3 \cos\theta = 0$
ko, $2 \cos^2\theta - 3 \cos\theta - 2 = 0$ [haɗe dukkan bangarori da $(-1)$]
ko, $2 \cos^2\theta - 4 \cos\theta + \cos\theta - 2 = 0$
ko, $2 \cos\theta ( \cos\theta - 2) + 1 (\cos\theta - 2) = 0$
ko, $(2 \cos \theta + 1) (\cos \theta - 2) = 0$
Amma, $\cos\theta - 2 \ne 0$ domin, idan $\cos\theta - 2 = 0$ to $\cos\theta = 2$, wanda ba zai yiwu ba.
Don haka, $2\cos\theta + 1 = 0$
ko, $\cos\theta = -\frac{1}{2}$
ko, $\cos\theta = -\frac{1}{2} = -\cos\frac{\pi}{3}$
ko, $\cos\theta = \cos \left(\pi - \frac{\pi}{3} \right)$, $\cos \left(\pi + \frac{\pi}{3} \right)$
[a bisa ga sharadin $0 < \theta < 2\pi$]
ko, $\cos\theta = \cos\frac{2\pi}{3}$, $\cos\frac{4\pi}{3}$
$\therefore \theta = \frac{2\pi}{3}, \frac{4\pi}{3}$, waɗanda suka cika sharadin, $0 < \theta < 2\pi$
$\therefore$ Maganin da ake bukata: $\theta = \frac{2\pi}{3}, \frac{4\pi}{3}$

Question: Warware: (inda $0 < \theta < 2\pi$)$4 (\cos^2\theta + \sin\theta) = 5$
Solution:
An bayar,
$4 (\cos^2\theta + \sin\theta) = 5$
ko kuma, $4 (1 - \sin^2\theta + \sin\theta) = 5$
ko kuma, $4 - 4 \sin^2\theta + 4 \sin \theta = 5$
ko kuma, $4 \sin^2\theta - 4 \sin \theta + 1 = 0$ [in da muka ninka kowane bangare da $(-1)$]
ko kuma, $(2 \sin \theta - 1)^2 = 0$
ko kuma, $2\sin \theta - 1 = 0$ [in da muka dauki tushen murabba'i]
ko kuma, $\sin \theta = \frac{1}{2}$
ko kuma, $\sin \theta = \sin\frac{\pi}{6}$, $\sin\left(\pi - \frac{\pi}{6}\right)$ [a bisa ga sharadi]
ko kuma, $\sin\theta = \sin\frac{\pi}{6}$, $\sin\frac{5\pi}{6}$
$\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{5\pi}{6}$, wanda ya biya sharadi, $0 < \theta < 2\pi$
$\therefore$ Maganin da ake bukata: $\theta = \frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{5\pi}{6}$

Question: Warware: (inda $0 < \theta < 2\pi$) $\tan^2\theta + \cot^2\theta = 2$
Solution:
An bamu,
$\tan^2\theta + \cot^2\theta = 2$
ko kuma, $\tan^2\theta + \frac{1}{\tan^2\theta} = 2$
ko kuma, $\tan^4\theta + 1 = 2 \tan^2\theta$ [ta hanyar ninkawa dukkan bangarorin biyu da $\tan^2\theta$]
ko kuma, $\tan^4\theta - 2 \tan^2\theta + 1 = 0$
ko kuma, $(\tan^2\theta - 1)^2 = 0$
ko kuma, $\tan^2\theta - 1 = 0$
ko kuma, $\tan^2\theta = 1$
ko kuma, $\tan \theta = \pm 1$
Yanzu, ta hanyar daukar $\tan \theta = 1$ muna samu,
$\tan\theta = \tan\frac{\pi}{4}$, $\tan \left(\pi + \frac{\pi}{4} \right)$ [gwargwadon sharadi]
ko kuma, $\tan\theta = \tan\frac{\pi}{4}$, $\tan\frac{5\pi}{4}$
$\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{4}, \frac{5\pi}{4}$
Kuma ta hanyar daukar $\tan\theta = -1$ muna samu,
$\tan\theta = -\tan\frac{\pi}{4}$
ko kuma, $\tan\theta = \tan \left(\pi - \frac{\pi}{4} \right)$, $\tan \left(2\pi - \frac{\pi}{4} \right)$
[gwargwadon sharadi]
ko kuma, $\tan\theta = \tan\frac{3\pi}{4}$, $\tan\frac{7\pi}{4}$
$\therefore \theta = \frac{3\pi}{4}, \frac{7\pi}{4}$
$\therefore$ Maƙasudin bayani da ake buƙata: $\theta = \frac{\pi}{4}, \frac{3\pi}{4}, \frac{5\pi}{4}, \frac{7\pi}{4}$

Question: Warware: (inda $0 < \theta < 2\pi$) $\sec^2\theta + \tan^2\theta = \frac{5}{3}$
Solution:
An bayar,
$(\sec^2\theta + \tan^2\theta) = \frac{5}{3}$
ko, $3 (1 + \tan^2\theta + \tan^2\theta) = 5$
ko, $3 + 6 \tan^2\theta - 5 = 0$
ko, $6 \tan^2\theta = 2$
ko, $\tan^2\theta = \frac{1}{3}$
$\therefore \tan \theta = \pm \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$
Yanzu, ta hanyar ɗaukan $\tan \theta = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$ muna samu,
$\tan\theta = \tan\frac{\pi}{6}$, $\tan \left(\pi + \frac{\pi}{6} \right)$ [a bisa ga sharadi]
ko, $\tan\theta = \tan\frac{\pi}{6}$, $\tan\frac{7\pi}{6}$
$\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{7\pi}{6}$
Kuma sake, ta hanyar ɗaukan $\tan\theta = -\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$ muna samu,
ko, $\tan\theta = -\tan\frac{\pi}{6}$
ko, $\tan\theta = \tan \left(\pi - \frac{\pi}{6} \right)$, $\tan \left(2\pi - \frac{\pi}{6} \right)$ [a bisa ga sharadi]
ko, $\tan\theta = \tan\frac{5\pi}{6}$, $\tan\frac{11\pi}{6}$
$\therefore \theta = \frac{5\pi}{6}, \frac{11\pi}{6}$
$\therefore$ Amsar da ake buƙata: $\theta = \frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{5\pi}{6}, \frac{7\pi}{6}, \frac{11\pi}{6}$

Question: Warware: (inda $0 < \theta < 2\pi$) $5\operatorname{cosec}^2\theta - 7 \cot\theta \operatorname{cosec}\theta - 2 = 0$
Solution:
An bayar,
$5\operatorname{cosec}^2\theta - 7 \cot\theta \operatorname{cosec}\theta - 2 = 0$
ko, $5\frac{1}{\sin^2\theta} - 7\frac{\cos\theta}{\sin\theta} \frac{1}{\sin\theta} - 2 = 0$
ko, $5 - 7\cos\theta - 2\sin^2\theta = 0$
ko, $5 - 7\cos\theta - 2(1 - \cos^2\theta) = 0$
ko, $5 - 7\cos\theta - 2 + 2\cos^2\theta = 0$
ko, $2\cos^2\theta - 7\cos\theta + 3 = 0$
ko, $2\cos^2\theta - 6\cos\theta - \cos\theta + 3 = 0$
ko, $2\cos\theta(\cos\theta - 3) - 1(\cos\theta - 3) = 0$
ko, $(2\cos\theta - 1)(\cos\theta - 3) = 0$
Ko dai, $2\cos\theta - 1 = 0$ ko, $\cos\theta - 3 = 0$
$\therefore \cos\theta = \frac{1}{2}$ $\therefore \cos\theta = 3$
Amma, ƙimar $\cos\theta$ ba zata iya girma fiye da 1 ba.
$\therefore \cos\theta = \frac{1}{2}$
$\cos\theta = \cos\frac{\pi}{3}$, $\cos\left(2\pi - \frac{\pi}{3}\right)$ [bisa ga sharadi]
$\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{3}, \frac{5\pi}{3}$, waɗanda suke cikin iyakacin da aka bayar, $0 < \theta < 2\pi$
$\therefore$ Maganin da ake buƙata: $\theta = \frac{\pi}{3}, \frac{5\pi}{3}$

Question: Warware: ($0 < x < 2\pi$) $2\sin x \cos x = \sin x$ ($0 \le x \le 2\pi$).
Solution:
$2\sin x \cos x = \sin x$
ko kuma, $2\sin x \cos x - \sin x = 0$
ko kuma, $\sin x (2\cos x - 1) = 0$
Ko dai, $\sin x = 0$ ko kuma $2\cos x - 1 = 0$
$\therefore \cos x = \frac{1}{2}$
Idan $\sin x = 0$, to $\sin x = \sin 0$, $\sin\pi$, $\sin 2\pi$
$\therefore x = 0, \pi, 2\pi$
Idan $\cos x = \frac{1}{2}$, to $\cos x = \cos\frac{\pi}{3}$, $\cos\left(2\pi - \frac{\pi}{3}\right)$
ko kuma, $\cos x = \cos\frac{\pi}{3}, \cos\frac{5\pi}{3}$
$\therefore x = \frac{\pi}{3}, \frac{5\pi}{3}$
$\therefore$ Maganin da ake buƙata: $\theta = 0, \frac{\pi}{3}, \pi, \frac{5\pi}{3}, 2\pi$

Question: Jimlar duniyar tana da tsawon kilomita $6440$. Dhaka da Panchagarh suna samar da kusurwa $3.5^\circ$ a tsakiyar duniya. Wani mutum yana son jin daɗin kyawawan shimfida ta yanayi na Panchagarh a lokacin sanyi. Ya isa Panchagarh da mota mai dabaran mai diamita $0.84\text{m}$. Menene kusurwar da Dhaka da Panchagarh suke samarwa a tsakiyar duniya, daura da radians?
Solution:
***

Angle tsakanin Dhaka da Panchagarh $= 3.5^\circ$
Mun sani, $1^\circ = \frac{\pi}{180}$
$\therefore 3.5^\circ = \frac{3.5\pi}{180} = \frac{7\pi}{360}$ (Amsa.)

Question: Kusurwar duniya kimanin kilomita $6440 \text{ km}$. Dhaka da Panchagarh suna yin kusurwa $3.5^\circ$ a tsakiyar duniya. Wani mutum yana son jin daɗin kyawun yanayi na Panchagarh a lokacin hunturu. Ya isa Panchagarh da mota mai taya mai diamita $0.84\text{m}$. Nawa ne tsakanin Dhaka da Panchagarh?
Solution:
An bamu cewa,
Nisan duniyar, $r = 6440 \text{ kilomita}$
Ango tsakanin Dhaka da Panchagarh, $\theta = 3.5^\circ$
$= \frac{3.5 \times \pi}{180}$
$= \frac{7\pi}{360}$
$\therefore$ Nisa tsakanin Dhaka da Panchagarh, $S = r\theta$
$= (6440 \times \frac{7\pi}{360}) \text{ kilomita}$
$= 393.4 \text{ kilomita (kusan) (Ams.)}$

Question: Girma na radius ɗin Duniya shine $6440 \text{ km}$. Dhaka da Panchagarh suna bada kusurwa $3.5^\circ$ a tsakiyar Duniya. Wani mutum yana son jin daɗin kyawawan shimfiɗu na wuraren karkara na Panchagarh a lokacin sanyi. Ya isa Panchagarh da mota mai dabaran mai diamita $0.84\text{m}$. Nawa ne adadin juyawa da dabaran za ta yi yayin tafiyarsa daga Dhaka zuwa Panchagarh?
Solution:
An bayar da cewa,
Nisafin dabaran $= \frac{0.84}{2} \text{ mita} = 0.42 \text{ mita}$
Mun sani, a juyawa ɗaya dabaran tana rufe wani nesa wanda ya yi daidai da kewayarta.
$\therefore$ kewayar dabaran $= 2 \times 0.42 \times \pi$
$= 0.84\pi \text{ mita}$
$393.4 \text{ k.m.} = 393.4 \times 1000 \text{ mita}$
$= 393400 \text{ mita}$
$\therefore$ Adadin da ake buƙata na lokutan juyawar dabaran shine
$= \frac{393400}{0.84 \pi} \text{ sau}$
$\approx 149075 \text{ sau (kimanin)}$

Question: A cikin zane, ABC na nufin wani da'irar motsi kuma tsawon arki AB ya kai $25 \text{ cm}$. Nemi darajar $\theta$. Nawa nesa keken zai rufe a zagayawa guda?
Solution:
An bayar da cewa, tsawon madauki na gefe na AB na dabaran, $S = 25 \text{ cm}$.
Daga zane mun samu, nadi, $r = x^2 + 1 \text{ cm}$.
Trigonometry
Yanzu mun sani, $S = r\theta$
ko, $\theta = \frac{S}{r}$
ko, $\theta = \frac{25}{x^2+1}$ radian
$\therefore \theta = \frac{25}{x^2+1}$ (Amsa.)

Mun sani, bayan juya dabaran sau ɗaya, dabaran zata yi tafiya mai nisa wacce take daidai da kewayo ta.
Wato, $2\pi r \text{ cm}$
$= 2\pi (x^2+1)$ (Amsa.)
$\therefore$ Bayan juya dabaran sau ɗaya, dabaran zata yi tafiya mai nisa $= 2\pi (x^2+1)$ (Amsa.)

Question: Menene saurin dabaran ABC idan tana juyawa sau 5 a kowace daƙiƙa?
Solution:
1 hour $= 60 \text{ minti} = 60 \times 60 \text{ daƙiƙu}$
$= 3600 \text{ daƙiƙu}$
A ƙwanar ABC tana ɗaukar daƙiƙa 1 don juyawa 5.
$\therefore$ Ƙwanar tana juyawa a cikin 1 hour $= (3600 \times 5) \text{ sau}$
$= 18000 \text{ sau}$.
$\therefore$ Ƙwanar tana tafiyar da nisa a cikin 1 hour
$= (18000 \times 1.57) \text{ m.}$
$= 28260 \text{ m.}$
$= 28.26 \text{ km. (kimanin)}$
Saurin ƙwanar shine $28.26 \text{ km/hour (kimanin)}$
Amsa. $28.26 \text{ Km hour. (kimanin)}$

Question: A cikin tsarin da ke ƙasa, nemo ƙimar $\sin\theta$ daga $\triangle BOD$, don tabbatar da cewa, $\tan\theta + \sec\theta = x$.
Solution:
Daga siffar da muka samu, $\sin\theta = \frac{BD}{BO}$
ko kuma, $\sin \theta = \frac{x^2-1}{x^2+1}$
$\therefore \cos \theta = \sqrt{1 - \sin^2\theta}$
$= \sqrt{1 - \left(\frac{x^2-1}{x^2+1}\right)^2} = \sqrt{1 - \frac{(x^2-1)^2}{(x^2+1)^2}}$
$= \sqrt{\frac{(x^2+1)^2 - (x^2-1)^2}{(x^2+1)^2}}$
$= \sqrt{\frac{4x^2}{(x^2+1)^2}}$
$= \frac{2x}{x^2+1}$
Yanzu, $\tan\theta + \sec\theta = \frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta} + \frac{1}{\cos\theta}$
$= \frac{\frac{x^2-1}{x^2+1}}{\frac{2x}{x^2+1}} + \frac{1}{\frac{2x}{x^2+1}}$
$= \frac{x^2-1}{2x} + \frac{x^2+1}{2x}$
$= \frac{x^2-1+x^2+1}{2x}$
$= \frac{2x^2}{2x} = x$
$\therefore \tan\theta + \sec\theta = x$ (An tabbatar)

Question: A cikin wani triangle mai kusurwa dama, idan tsawon gefe mafi ƙanƙanta shine $7 \text{ cm}$ kuma kusurwa mafi ƙanƙanta ita ce $15^\circ$, to menene tsawon hypotenuse?
Solution:
A cikin $\triangle ABC$, $\sin \angle ACB = \frac{AB}{AC}$
ko kuma, $\sin 15^\circ = \frac{7}{AC}$ $7 \text{ c.m.}$
ko kuma, $0.2588 = \frac{7}{AC}$
ko kuma, $AC = \frac{7}{0.2588}$
$\therefore AC = 27.05 \text{ cm (kimanin) (Amsa.)}$

Question: Tabbatar da cewa, $\left(a^{\frac{m}{n}}\right)^p = a^{\frac{mp}{n}}$, inda $m,p \in \mathbb{Z}$ kuma $n \in \mathbb{N}$.
Solution:
L.H.S. $= \left(a^{\frac{m}{n}}\right)^p$
$= \left\{\left(a^{\frac{1}{n}}\right)^m\right\}^p \quad \left[\because a^{\frac{m}{n}} = \left(a^{\frac{1}{n}}\right)^m\right]$
$= \left(a^{\frac{1}{n}}\right)^{mp} \quad \left[\because (a^m)^n = a^{mn}\right]$
$= a^{\frac{mp}{n}} \quad \left[\because \left(a^{\frac{1}{n}}\right)^m = a^{\frac{m}{n}}\right]$
$=$ R.H.S.
$\therefore \left(a^{\frac{m}{n}}\right)^p = a^{\frac{mp}{n}}$ (An tabbata)

Question: Tabbatar da cewa, $\left(a^{\frac{1}{m}}\right)^{\frac{1}{n}} = a^{\frac{1}{mn}}$, inda $m, n \in \mathbb{Z}$, $m \ne 0$, $n \ne 0$.
Solution:
Gyara: Bari mu yi tunanin, $(a^{\frac{1}{m}})^{\frac{1}{n}} = x$

ko kuma, $a^{\frac{1}{m}} = (x^n)$ [saboda idan $\sqrt[n]{a} = x$, to $a = x^n$. Anan, muna da $a^{\frac{1}{m}} = x$, don haka $a = (x^n)^m$ ba daidai ba ne.]

daidai wannan shine: $a^{\frac{1}{m}} = x$, don haka $a = (x^m)$

kuma, $a = (x^m)^n$

ko kuma, $a = x^{mn} \quad [\therefore (a^m)^n = a^{mn}]$

$\therefore x = a^{\frac{1}{mn}}$

wato, $(a^{\frac{1}{m}})^{\frac{1}{n}} = a^{\frac{1}{mn}} \quad [\therefore x = (a^{\frac{1}{m}})^{\frac{1}{n}}]$ (An tabbatar)

Question: Tabbatar da cewa, $(ab)^{\frac{m}{n}} = a^{\frac{m}{n}} b^{\frac{m}{n}}$, inda $m \in \mathbb{Z}, n \in \mathbb{N}$.
Solution:
Bari mu ɗauka, $(ab)^{\frac{1}{n}} = x, a^{\frac{1}{n}} = y, b^{\frac{1}{n}} = z$
$\therefore x^n = ab, y^n = a, z^n = b$
Yanzu, $x^n = ab$
ko, $x^n = y^n z^n$ [ta hanyar maye gurbin ƙididdigar a da b]
ko, $x^n = (yz)^n \quad [\therefore (ab)^n = a^n b^n]$
$\therefore x = yz$
watau, $(ab)^{\frac{1}{n}} = a^{\frac{1}{n}} b^{\frac{1}{n}}$
$\therefore \left\{(ab)^{\frac{1}{n}}\right\}^m = \left(a^{\frac{1}{n}}b^{\frac{1}{n}}\right)^m$
[ana ɗaukar m a matsayin ikon dukkan bangarori biyu]
ko, $(ab)^{\frac{m}{n}} = \left\{(a)^{\frac{1}{n}}\right\}^m \left\{(b)^{\frac{1}{n}}\right\}^m$
$[\therefore (a^{\frac{1}{n}})^m = a^{\frac{m}{n}} \text{ da } (ab)^n = a^n b^n]$
$\therefore (ab)^{\frac{m}{n}} = a^{\frac{m}{n}} b^{\frac{m}{n}}$ (An tabbatar)

Question:
Nuna cewa,
 $(a^{\frac{1}{3}} - b^{\frac{1}{3}}) (a^{\frac{2}{3}} + a^{\frac{1}{3}} b^{\frac{1}{3}} + b^{\frac{2}{3}}) = a - b$
Solution:
Gyara:
(1) ɓangaren Hagu = $(a^{\frac{1}{3}} - b^{\frac{1}{3}}) (a^{\frac{2}{3}} + a^{\frac{1}{3}} b^{\frac{1}{3}} + b^{\frac{2}{3}})$
$= \left(a^{\frac{1}{3}} - b^{\frac{1}{3}}\right) \left\{ \left(a^{\frac{1}{3}}\right)^2 + a^{\frac{1}{3}} b^{\frac{1}{3}} + \left(b^{\frac{1}{3}}\right)^2 \right\}$
$= \left(a^{\frac{1}{3}}\right)^3 - \left(b^{\frac{1}{3}}\right)^3 \quad [\therefore (x-y)(x^2+xy+y^2)=x^3-y^3]$
$= a^{\frac{3}{3}} - b^{\frac{3}{3}} \quad \left[\therefore \left(a^{\frac{1}{n}}\right)^m = a^{\frac{m}{n}}\right]$
$= a^1 - b^1$
$= a - b$
$= ɓangaren Dama.$
$\therefore (a^{\frac{1}{3}} - b^{\frac{1}{3}}) (a^{\frac{2}{3}} + a^{\frac{1}{3}} b^{\frac{1}{3}} + b^{\frac{2}{3}}) = a - b$ (An Nuna)

Question:
Sauƙaƙe:
 $\frac{\left(\frac{a+b}{b}\right)^{\frac{a}{a-b}} \times \left(\frac{a-b}{a}\right)^{\frac{a}{a-b}}}{\left(\frac{a+b}{b}\right)^{\frac{b}{a-b}} \times \left(\frac{a-b}{a}\right)^{\frac{b}{a-b}}}$
Solution:
$= \frac{\left(\frac{a+b}{b}\right)^{\frac{a}{a-b}} \times \left(\frac{a-b}{a}\right)^{\frac{a}{a-b}}}{\left(\frac{a+b}{b}\right)^{\frac{b}{a-b}} \times \left(\frac{a-b}{a}\right)^{\frac{b}{a-b}}}$
$= \left(\frac{a+b}{b}\right)^{\frac{a}{a-b} - \frac{b}{a-b}} \times \left(\frac{a-b}{a}\right)^{\frac{a}{a-b} - \frac{b}{a-b}} \left[ \therefore \frac{a^r}{a^s} = a^{r-s} \right]$
$= \left(\frac{a+b}{b}\right)^{\frac{a-b}{a-b}} \times \left(\frac{a-b}{a}\right)^{\frac{a-b}{a-b}}$
$= \left(\frac{a+b}{b}\right)^1 \times \left(\frac{a-b}{a}\right)^1$
$= \frac{a+b}{b} \times \frac{a-b}{a} = \frac{a^2-b^2}{ab}$
Ams: $\frac{a^2-b^2}{ab}$

Question:
Sauƙaƙe:
 $\frac{a^{3/2} + ab}{ab - b^3} - \frac{\sqrt{a}}{\sqrt{a} - b}$
Solution:
$\frac{a^{3/2} + ab}{ab - b^3} - \frac{\sqrt{a}}{\sqrt{a} - b}$
$= \frac{a(\sqrt{a} + b)}{b(a - b^2)} - \frac{\sqrt{a}}{\sqrt{a} - b} \quad \left[ \therefore a^{3/2} = a \cdot a^{1/2} = a\sqrt{a} \right]$
$= \frac{a(\sqrt{a} + b)}{b((\sqrt{a})^2 - (b)^2)} - \frac{\sqrt{a}}{\sqrt{a} - b}$
$= \frac{a(\sqrt{a} + b)}{b(\sqrt{a} + b)(\sqrt{a} - b)} - \frac{\sqrt{a}}{\sqrt{a} - b}$
$= \frac{a}{b(\sqrt{a} - b)} - \frac{\sqrt{a}}{\sqrt{a} - b} = \frac{a - b\sqrt{a}}{b(\sqrt{a} - b)}$
$= \frac{\sqrt{a}(\sqrt{a} - b)}{b(\sqrt{a} - b)} \quad \left[ \therefore a = a^{1/2} \cdot a^{1/2} = \sqrt{a} \cdot \sqrt{a} \right]$
$= \frac{\sqrt{a}}{b}$
Ams. $\frac{\sqrt{a}}{b}$

Question:
Sauƙaƙe:
 $\left\{\left(x^{\frac{1}{a}}\right)^{\frac{a^2-b^2}{a-b}}\right\}^{\frac{a}{a+b}}$
Solution:
$\left\{\left(x^{\frac{1}{a}}\right)^{\frac{a^2-b^2}{a-b}}\right\}^{\frac{a}{a+b}} = \left(x^{\frac{1}{a}}\right)^{\frac{a^2-b^2}{a-b} \cdot \frac{a}{a+b}} \quad \left[\therefore (a^r)^s = a^{rs}\right]$
$= x^{\frac{1}{a} \cdot \frac{a^2-b^2}{a-b} \cdot \frac{a}{a+b}}$
$= x^{\frac{1}{a} \cdot \frac{(a+b)(a-b)}{ (a-b)} \cdot \frac{a}{(a+b)}}$
$= x^1 = x$
Amsar. $x$

Question:
Sauƙaƙe:
 $\frac{1}{1+a^{-m}b^n+a^{-m}c^p} + \frac{1}{1+b^{-n}c^p+b^{-n}a^m} + \frac{1}{1+c^{-p}a^m+c^{-p}b^n}$
Solution:
$\frac{1}{1+a^{-m}b^n+a^{-m}c^p} + \frac{1}{1+b^{-n}c^p+b^{-n}a^m} + \frac{1}{1+c^{-p}a^m+c^{-p}b^n}$
    A nan, sashe na farko $= \frac{1}{1+a^{-m}b^n+a^{-m}c^p}$
$= \frac{a^m}{a^m(1+a^{-m}b^n+a^{-m}c^p)}$
[muna ninka maƙalliya da wanda ke ƙasa da $a^m$]
$= \frac{a^m}{a^m+a^{-m}b^n+a^{-m+m}c^p}$
$= \frac{a^m}{a^m+a^0b^n+a^0c^p}$
$= \frac{a^m}{a^m+b^n+c^p} \quad [\therefore a^0=1]$
Hakazalika, sashe na biyu $= \frac{b^n}{a^m+b^n+c^p}$
da kuma sashe na uku $= \frac{c^p}{a^m+b^n+c^p}$
$\therefore$ Magana da aka bayar $= \frac{1}{1+a^{-m}b^n+a^{-m}c^p} + \frac{1}{1+b^{-n}c^p+b^{-n}a^m} + \frac{1}{1+c^{-p}a^m+c^{-p}b^n}$
$= \frac{a^m}{a^m+b^n+c^p} + \frac{b^n}{a^m+b^n+c^p} + \frac{c^p}{a^m+b^n+c^p}$
$= \frac{a^m+b^n+c^p}{a^m+b^n+c^p} = 1$
Amsar: 1

Question:
Sauƙaƙe:
 $bc\sqrt{\frac{x^{b/c}}{x^{c/b}}} \times ca\sqrt{\frac{x^{c/a}}{x^{a/c}}} \times ab\sqrt{\frac{x^{a/b}}{x^{b/a}}}$
Solution:
$bc\sqrt{\frac{x^{b/c}}{x^{c/b}}} \times ca\sqrt{\frac{x^{c/a}}{x^{a/c}}} \times ab\sqrt{\frac{x^{a/b}}{x^{b/a}}}$
$= \left(x^{b/c - c/b}\right)^{bc} \times \left(x^{c/a - a/c}\right)^{ca} \times \left(x^{a/b - b/a}\right)^{ab} \quad \left[\therefore \frac{x^r}{x^s} = x^{r-s}\right]$
$= \left(x^{\frac{b^2-c^2}{bc}}\right)^{bc} \times \left(x^{\frac{c^2-a^2}{ca}}\right)^{ca} \times \left(x^{\frac{a^2-b^2}{ab}}\right)^{ab}$
$= x^{\frac{b^2-c^2}{bc} \cdot bc} \cdot x^{\frac{c^2-a^2}{ca} \cdot ca} \cdot x^{\frac{a^2-b^2}{ab} \cdot ab} \quad \left[\therefore (x^r)^s = x^{rs}\right]$
$= x^{b^2-c^2} \cdot x^{c^2-a^2} \cdot x^{a^2-b^2}$
$= x^{b^2-c^2+c^2-a^2+a^2-b^2}$
$= x^0$
$= 1$
Amsar. $1$

Question:
Sauƙaƙe:
 $\frac{(a^2-b^{-2})^a (a-b^{-1})^{b-a}}{(b^2-a^{-2})^b (b+a^{-1})^{a-b}}$
Solution:
$\frac{(a^2-b^{-2})^a (a-b^{-1})^{b-a}}{(b^2-a^{-2})^b (b+a^{-1})^{a-b}}$
$= \frac{\left(a^2 - \frac{1}{b^2}\right)^a \left(a - \frac{1}{b}\right)^{b-a}}{\left(b^2 - \frac{1}{a^2}\right)^b \left(b + \frac{1}{a}\right)^{a-b}}$
Na farko, mun yi amfani da bambancin murabba'i (difference of squares): $x^2 - y^2 = (x-y)(x+y)$.
$a^2 - \frac{1}{b^2} = \left(a+\frac{1}{b}\right)\left(a-\frac{1}{b}\right)$
kuma
$b^2 - \frac{1}{a^2} = \left(b+\frac{1}{a}\right)\left(b-\frac{1}{a}\right)$
Don haka, mu samu:
$= \frac{\left\{\left(a+\frac{1}{b}\right)\left(a-\frac{1}{b}\right)\right\}^a \left(a-\frac{1}{b}\right)^{b-a}}{\left\{\left(b+\frac{1}{a}\right)\left(b-\frac{1}{a}\right)\right\}^b \left(b+\frac{1}{a}\right)^{a-b}}$
Sa'an nan, muna amfani da dokar 'yark'i (exponent rule): $(xy)^n = x^n y^n$.
$= \frac{\left(a+\frac{1}{b}\right)^a \left(a-\frac{1}{b}\right)^a \left(a-\frac{1}{b}\right)^{b-a}}{\left(b+\frac{1}{a}\right)^b \left(b-\frac{1}{a}\right)^b \left(b+\frac{1}{a}\right)^{a-b}}$
Yanzu, muna amfani da dokar 'yark'i: $x^m x^n = x^{m+n}$.
$= \frac{\left(a+\frac{1}{b}\right)^a \left(a-\frac{1}{b}\right)^{a+b-a}}{\left(b-\frac{1}{a}\right)^b \left(b+\frac{1}{a}\right)^{b+a-b}}$
Sauƙaƙewa:
$= \frac{\left(a+\frac{1}{b}\right)^a \left(a-\frac{1}{b}\right)^b}{\left(b-\frac{1}{a}\right)^b \left(b+\frac{1}{a}\right)^a}$
Yanzu, mun maye gurbin waɗannan abubuwan da abubuwan da suka dace don samun mai lissafi ɗaya (common denominator):
$a+\frac{1}{b} = \frac{ab+1}{b}$
$a-\frac{1}{b} = \frac{ab-1}{b}$
$b-\frac{1}{a} = \frac{ab-1}{a}$
$b+\frac{1}{a} = \frac{ab+1}{a}$
Ta hanyar maye gurbin waɗannan:
$= \frac{\left(\frac{ab+1}{b}\right)^a \left(\frac{ab-1}{b}\right)^b}{\left(\frac{ab-1}{a}\right)^b \left(\frac{ab+1}{a}\right)^a}$
Muna sake tsara waɗannan don dacewa:
$= \frac{\left(\frac{ab+1}{b}\right)^a}{\left(\frac{ab+1}{a}\right)^a} \times \frac{\left(\frac{ab-1}{b}\right)^b}{\left(\frac{ab-1}{a}\right)^b}$
Yanzu, muna amfani da dokar 'yark'i: $\left(\frac{x}{y}\right)^n = \frac{x^n}{y^n}$ kuma $\frac{x^n}{y^n} = \left(\frac{x}{y}\right)^n$.
$= \left(\frac{ab+1}{b} \times \frac{a}{ab+1}\right)^a \times \left(\frac{ab-1}{b} \times \frac{a}{ab-1}\right)^b$
Sauƙaƙewa:
$= \left(\frac{a}{b}\right)^a \times \left(\frac{a}{b}\right)^b$
A ƙarshe, muna amfani da dokar 'yark'i: $x^m x^n = x^{m+n}$.
$= \left(\frac{a}{b}\right)^{a+b}$
Amsa. $\boxed{\left(\frac{a}{b}\right)^{a+b}}$

Question:
NUNA CEWA
1) Idan $x=a^{q+r}b^p$, $y=a^{r+p}b^q$, $z=a^{p+q}b^r$, to, $x^{q-r} \cdot y^{r-p} \cdot z^{p-q}=1$
Solution:
An baka $x=a^{q+r}b^p$, $y=a^{r+p}b^q$, $z=a^{p+q}b^r$
L.H.S.$= x^{q-r} \cdot y^{r-p} \cdot z^{p-q}$
$= (a^{q+r}b^p)^{q-r} (a^{r+p}b^q)^{r-p} (a^{p+q}b^r)^{p-q}$
[Ta hanyar maye gurbin ƙimar $x, y \; da \; z$]
$= a^{(q+r)(q-r)} b^{p(q-r)} a^{(r+p)(r-p)} b^{q(r-p)} a^{(p+q)(p-q)} b^{r(p-q)}$
$= a^{q^2-r^2} \cdot b^{pq-pr} \cdot a^{r^2-p^2} \cdot b^{qr-pq} \cdot a^{p^2-q^2} \cdot b^{rp-qr}$
$= a^{q^2-r^2+r^2-p^2+p^2-q^2} \cdot b^{pq-pr+qr-pq+rp-qr}$
$= a^0 \cdot b^0$
$= 1 \cdot 1 \quad [\therefore a^0=1]$
$= 1 = \text{R.H.S.}$
$\therefore x^{q-r} \cdot y^{r-p} \cdot z^{p-q}=1$ (An nuna)

Question:
Nuna cewa:
2) Idan $a^p=b^q$, $b^q=c^r$ kuma $c^r=a$, to $pqr=1$
Solution:
An bayar, $a^p=b$, $b^q=c$, $c^r=a$
Anan, $c^r = a$
ko, $(b^q)^r = a \quad [\therefore b^q = c]$
ko, $b^{qr} = a \quad [\therefore (a^m)^n = a^{mn}]$
ko, $(a^p)^{qr} = a \quad [\therefore a^p = b]$
ko, $a^{pqr} = a \quad [\therefore (a^m)^n = a^{mn}]$
ko, $a^{pqr} = a^1$
$\therefore pqr=1$ (An nuna)

Question:
Nuna cewa
3) Idan $a^x=p$, $a^y=q$ kuma $a^z=(p^yq^x)^2$, to $xyz=1$
Solution:
An bayar da $a^x=p$, $a^y=q$ da $a^z = (p^y q^x)^2$
Anan, $(p^y q^x)^z = a^2$
ko kuma, $\{(a^x)^y (a^y)^x\}^z = a^2 \quad [\therefore p=a^x, q=a^y]$
ko kuma, $(a^{xy} a^{xy})^z = a^2 \quad [\therefore (a^r)^s = a^{rs}]$
ko kuma, $(a^{xy+xy})^z = a^2 \quad [\therefore a^r \cdot a^s = a^{r+s}]$
ko kuma, $(a^{2xy})^z = a^2$
ko kuma, $a^{2xyz} = a^2 \quad [\therefore (a^r)^s = a^{rs}]$
ko kuma, $2xyz = 2$
$\therefore xyz = 1$ (An nuna)

Question:
Idan $x\sqrt[3]{a} + y\sqrt[3]{b} + z\sqrt[3]{c} = 0$ kuma $a^2 = bc$,
sai a nuna cewa, $ax^3 + by^3 + cz^3 = 3axyz$
Solution:
An bayar da,
$x\sqrt[3]{a} + y\sqrt[3]{b} + z\sqrt[3]{c} = 0$ da $a^2 = bc$
A nan, $x\sqrt[3]{a} + y\sqrt[3]{b} + z\sqrt[3]{c} = 0$
ko, $x\sqrt[3]{a} = -(y\sqrt[3]{b} + z\sqrt[3]{c})$
ko, $(x\sqrt[3]{a})^3 = -(y\sqrt[3]{b} + z\sqrt[3]{c})^3$ [ana daukan cube a kowane bangare]
ko, $x^3 \left(a^{\frac{1}{3}}\right)^3 = -y^3 \left(b^{\frac{1}{3}}\right)^3 - z^3 \left(c^{\frac{1}{3}}\right)^3 - 3y\sqrt[3]{b} z\sqrt[3]{c} (y\sqrt[3]{b} + z\sqrt[3]{c})$
$[\therefore (x+y)^3 = x^3+y^3+3xy(x+y)]$
ko, $ax^3 = -by^3 - cz^3 - 3yz\sqrt{bc} (-x\sqrt[3]{a})$
$[ \therefore x\sqrt[3]{a} = -(y\sqrt[3]{b} + z\sqrt[3]{c}) ]$
ko, $ax^3+by^3+cz^3 = 3xyz (a^2)^{\frac{1}{2}} (a^{\frac{1}{3}}) \quad [ \therefore a^2=bc ]$
ko, $ax^3+by^3+cz^3 = 3xyz a^1 a^{\frac{1}{3}}$
$\therefore ax^3+by^3+cz^3 = 3axyz$ (An nuna)

Question:
Idan $x=(a+b)^{\frac{1}{3}} + (a-b)^{\frac{1}{3}}$ kuma $a^2-b^2=c^3$,
nuna cewa, $x^3 - 3cx - 2a = 0$
Solution:
An ba da $x=(a+b)^{\frac{1}{3}} + (a-b)^{\frac{1}{3}}$ da $a^2-b^2=c^3$
A nan, $x=(a+b)^{\frac{1}{3}} + (a-b)^{\frac{1}{3}}$
ko, $x^3 = \left\{(a+b)^{\frac{1}{3}} + (a-b)^{\frac{1}{3}}\right\}^3$ [an dauki cube a kowane bangare]
ko, $x^3 = \left\{(a+b)^{\frac{1}{3}}\right\}^3 + \left\{(a-b)^{\frac{1}{3}}\right\}^3$
$+ 3 \cdot (a+b)^{\frac{1}{3}} (a-b)^{\frac{1}{3}} \left\{(a+b)^{\frac{1}{3}} + (a-b)^{\frac{1}{3}}\right\}$
$[\therefore (x+y)^3 = x^3+y^3+3xy(x+y)]$
ko, $x^3 = a+b+a-b+3(a^2-b^2)^{\frac{1}{3}} \cdot x$
$[\therefore (a+b)^{\frac{1}{3}} + (a-b)^{\frac{1}{3}} = x]$
ko, $x^3 = 2a + 3 \cdot (c^3)^{\frac{1}{3}} \cdot x \quad [\therefore a^2-b^2=c^3]$
ko, $x^3 = 2a + 3cx$
$\therefore x^3 - 3cx - 2a = 0$ (An nuna)

Question: Idan $a = 2^{\frac{1}{3}} + 2^{-\frac{1}{3}}$, to nuna cewa, $2a^3 - 6a = 5$
Solution:
An bayar, $a = 2^{\frac{1}{3}} + 2^{-\frac{1}{3}}$
ko, $a^3 = \left(2^{\frac{1}{3}} + 2^{-\frac{1}{3}}\right)^3$ [a dauki cube a kowane bangare]
ko, $a^3 = \left(2^{\frac{1}{3}}\right)^3 + \left(2^{-\frac{1}{3}}\right)^3 + 3 \cdot 2^{\frac{1}{3}} \cdot 2^{-\frac{1}{3}} \left(2^{\frac{1}{3}} + 2^{-\frac{1}{3}}\right)$
$\left[\therefore (x+y)^3 = x^3 + y^3 + 3xy(x+y)\right]$
ko, $a^3 = 2^1 + 2^{-1} + 3 \cdot 2^0 \cdot a$
$\left[\therefore 2^{\frac{1}{3}} \cdot 2^{-\frac{1}{3}} = 2^{\frac{1}{3}-\frac{1}{3}} = 2^0 \text{ kuma } 2^{\frac{1}{3}} + 2^{-\frac{1}{3}} = a\right]$
ko, $a^3 = 2 + \frac{1}{2} + 3a$
ko, $a^3 = \frac{4+1+6a}{2}$
ko, $2a^3 = 4+1+6a$
$\therefore 2a^3 - 6a = 5$ (An nuna)

Question: Idan $a^2 + 2 = 3^{\frac{2}{3}} + 3^{-\frac{2}{3}}$ kuma $a \ge 0$, to nuna cewa, $3a^3 + 9a = 8$
Solution:
An ba da,
$a^2 + 2 = 3^{\frac{2}{3}} + 3^{-\frac{2}{3}}$
ko kuma, $a^2 = \left(3^{\frac{1}{3}}\right)^2 + \left(3^{-\frac{1}{3}}\right)^2 - 2$
ko kuma, $a^2 = \left(3^{\frac{1}{3}}\right)^2 + \left(3^{-\frac{1}{3}}\right)^2 - 2 \cdot 3^{\frac{1}{3}} \cdot 3^{-\frac{1}{3}}$
$\left[\therefore 3^{\frac{1}{3}} \cdot 3^{-\frac{1}{3}} = 3^0 = 1\right]$
ko kuma, $a^2 = \left(3^{\frac{1}{3}} - 3^{-\frac{1}{3}}\right)^2$
ko kuma, $a = 3^{\frac{1}{3}} - 3^{-\frac{1}{3}}$ [saboda $a \ge 0$, ana ɗaukar kawai tushen murabba'i mai kyau a bangarorin biyu]
ko kuma, $a^3 = \left(3^{\frac{1}{3}} - 3^{-\frac{1}{3}}\right)^3$ [ana ɗaukar siffa uku a bangarorin biyu]
ko kuma, $a^3 = \left(3^{\frac{1}{3}}\right)^3 - \left(3^{-\frac{1}{3}}\right)^3 - 3 \cdot 3^{\frac{1}{3}} \cdot 3^{-\frac{1}{3}} \left(3^{\frac{1}{3}} - 3^{-\frac{1}{3}}\right)$
$\left[\therefore (a-b)^3 = a^3 - b^3 - 3ab(a-b)\right]$
ko kuma, $a^3 = 3 - 3^{-1} - 3 \cdot 3^0 \cdot a$
$\left[\therefore 3^{\frac{1}{3}} \cdot 3^{-\frac{1}{3}} = 3^{\frac{1}{3}-\frac{1}{3}} = 3^0 \text{ da } 3^{\frac{1}{3}} - 3^{-\frac{1}{3}} = a\right]$
ko kuma, $a^3 = 3 - \frac{1}{3} - 3a$
ko kuma, $a^3 + 3a = \frac{8}{3}$
$\therefore 3a^3 + 9a = 8$ (An nuna)

Question: Idan $a^2 = b^3$, to nuna cewa, $\left(\frac{a}{b}\right)^{\frac{3}{2}} + \left(\frac{b}{a}\right)^{\frac{2}{3}} = a^{\frac{1}{2}} + b^{\frac{1}{3}}$
Solution:
A nan, $a^2 = b^3 \quad \therefore a = b^{\frac{3}{2}}$
Kuma, $a^2 = b^3$
ko, $b^3 = a^2$
$\therefore b = a^{\frac{2}{3}}$
Yanzu, L.H.S.$= \left(\frac{a}{b}\right)^{\frac{3}{2}} + \left(\frac{b}{a}\right)^{\frac{2}{3}}$
$= \frac{a^{\frac{3}{2}}}{b^{\frac{3}{2}}} + \frac{b^{\frac{2}{3}}}{a^{\frac{2}{3}}}$
$= \frac{a^{\frac{3}{2}}}{a} + \frac{b^{\frac{2}{3}}}{b} \quad \left[\therefore a=b^{\frac{3}{2}}, b=a^{\frac{2}{3}}\right]$
$= a^{\frac{3}{2}-1} + b^{\frac{2}{3}-1}$
$= a^{\frac{1}{2}} + b^{-\frac{1}{3}}$
$=$ R.H.S..
$\therefore \left(\frac{a}{b}\right)^{\frac{3}{2}} + \left(\frac{b}{a}\right)^{\frac{2}{3}} = a^{\frac{1}{2}} + b^{-\frac{1}{3}}$ (An nuna)

Question:
Idan $a+b+c=0$, to, nuna cewa,
$\frac{1}{x^b + x^{-c} + 1} + \frac{1}{x^c + x^{-a} + 1} + \frac{1}{x^a + x^{-b} + 1} = 1$
Solution:
L.H.S. $= \frac{1}{x^b + x^{-c} + 1} + \frac{1}{x^c + x^{-a} + 1} + \frac{1}{x^a + x^{-b} + 1}$
$= \frac{1}{x^b + \frac{1}{x^c} + 1} + \frac{1}{x^c + x^{-a} + 1} + \frac{1}{x^a + x^{-b} + 1}$
$= \frac{x^c}{x^b \cdot x^c + 1 + x^c} + \frac{1}{1+x^c+x^{-a}} + \frac{1}{x^a + x^{-b} + 1}$
$= \frac{x^c}{x^{b+c} + 1 + x^c} + \frac{1}{x^c + x^{-a} + 1} + \frac{1}{x^a + x^{-b} + 1} \quad [\because a+b+c=0 \quad \therefore b+c=-a]$
$= \frac{x^c}{x^{-a} + 1 + x^c} + \frac{1}{x^c + x^{-a} + 1} + \frac{1}{x^a + x^{-b} + 1}$
$= \frac{x^c}{1+x^c+x^{-a}} + \frac{1}{1+x^c+x^{-a}} + \frac{1}{\frac{x^a + 1}{x^b} + 1}$
$= \frac{x^c}{1+x^c+x^{-a}} + \frac{1}{1+x^c+x^{-a}} + \frac{x^b}{x^a + x^b + 1}$
$= \frac{x^c}{1+x^c+x^{-a}} + \frac{1}{1+x^c+x^{-a}} + \frac{x^b \cdot x^c}{x^a \cdot x^c + x^b \cdot x^c + x^c}$
$= \frac{x^c}{1+x^c+x^{-a}} + \frac{1}{1+x^c+x^{-a}} + \frac{x^{b+c}}{x^{a+c} + x^{b+c} + x^c}$
$= \frac{x^c+1}{1+x^c+x^{-a}} + \frac{x^{-a}}{x^{-b} + x^{-a} + x^c}$
$= \frac{x^c+1+x^{-a}}{1+x^c+x^{-a}} = 1$
$=$ R.H.S..
$\therefore \frac{1}{x^b + x^{-c} + 1} + \frac{1}{x^c + x^{-a} + 1} + \frac{1}{x^a + x^{-b} + 1} = 1$ (An nuna)

Question: Idan $a^x = b$, $b^y = c$ da kuma $c^z = 1$, to, nemo ƙimar $xyz$.
Solution:
An bayar,
$c^z = 1$
ko kuma, $(b^y)^z = 1 \quad [\because b^y = c]$
ko kuma, $\{(a^x)^y\}^z = 1 \quad [\because a^x = b]$
ko kuma, $\{a^{xy}\}^z = 1$
ko kuma, $a^{xyz} = a^0$
$\therefore xyz = 0$ (Ams.)

Question: Idan $x^a = y^b = z^c$ kuma $xyz = 1$, to nemi ƙimar $ab + bc + ca$.
Solution:
Bari, $x^a = y^b = z^c = k$
$\therefore x^a = k$
$\therefore x = k^{\frac{1}{a}}$
Haka nan, $y = k^{\frac{1}{b}}$ da $z = k^{\frac{1}{c}}$
Yanzu, $xyz = 1$
ko, $k^{\frac{1}{a}} \cdot k^{\frac{1}{b}} \cdot k^{\frac{1}{c}} = 1 \quad \left[\therefore x = k^{\frac{1}{a}}, y = k^{\frac{1}{b}} \text{ da } z = k^{\frac{1}{c}}\right]$
ko, $k^{\frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{b} + \frac{1}{c}} = 1$
ko, $k^{\frac{bc + ca + ab}{abc}} = k^0$
ko, $\frac{ab + bc + ca}{abc} = 0$
ko, $ab + bc + ca = 0 \times abc$
$\therefore ab + bc + ca = 0$ (Ams.)

Question:
Warware:
    $3^{2x+2} + 3^{3(x+1)} = 36$
Solution:
$3^{2x+2} + 27^{x+1} = 36$
ko, $3^{2x+2} + (3^3)^{x+1} = 36$
ko, $3^{2x+2} + 3^{3x+3} = 36$
ko, $\{3^{(x+1)}\}^2 + \{3^{(x+1)}\}^3 = 36$
ko, $a^2 + a^3 = 36 \quad [3^{(x+1)} = a, \text{ in ji}]$
ko, $a^3 + a^2 - 36 = 0$
ko, $a^3 - 3a^2 + 4a^2 - 12a + 12a - 36 = 0$
ko, $a^2(a-3) + 4a(a-3) + 12(a-3) = 0$
ko, $(a-3)(a^2 + 4a + 12) = 0$
Don haka, $a-3=0$
$\therefore a=3$
ko, $3^{x+1} = 3^1$ [maye gurbin dabi'u na a]
ko, $x+1=1$
$\therefore x=0$
ko, $a^2 + 4a + 12 = 0$
$\therefore a = \frac{-4 \pm \sqrt{4^2 - 4 \cdot 1 \cdot 12}}{2 \cdot 1}$
$\therefore a = \frac{-4 \pm \sqrt{16-48}}{2} = \frac{-4 \pm \sqrt{-32}}{2}$
$\therefore a^2 + 4a + 12 \ne 0$
Saboda babu wani ainihin lambar "a" da ta cika wannan lissafi
$\therefore$ Maganin da ake bukata shine $x=0$ (Ams.)

Question:
Warware:
    $5^x + 3^y = 8$,
$5^{x-1} + 3^{y-1} = 2$
Solution:
$5^x + 3^y = 8$ .................. (i)
$5^{x-1} + 3^{y-1} = 2$ .................. (ii)
Daga (ii),
$5^{x-1} + 3^{y-1} = 2$
ko, $\frac{5^x}{5} + \frac{3^y}{3} = 2$
$\therefore 5^x + 5 \cdot 3^{y-1} = 10$ .................. (iii)
Sa'ad da muka cire (i) daga (iii) muna samu,
$5 \cdot 3^{y-1} - 3^y = 2$
ko, $5 \cdot \frac{3^y}{3} - 3^y = 2$
ko, $5 \cdot 3^y - 3 \cdot 3^y = 6$
ko, $2 \cdot 3^y = 6$
ko, $3^y = 3$
ko, $3^y = 3^1$
$\therefore y=1$
Sa'ad da muka saka $y=1$ a (iii) muna samu,
$5^x + 5 \cdot 3^{1-1} = 10$
ko, $5^x + 5 \cdot 3^0 = 10 \quad [\therefore 3^0 = 1]$
ko, $5^x + 5 \cdot 1 = 10$
ko, $5^x = 10-5$
ko, $5^x = 5$
ko, $5^x = 5^1$
$\therefore x=1$
$\therefore$ Mafi kyawun Magani shine $(x, y) = (1, 1)$ (Amsa.)

Question:
Warware:
    $4^{3y-2} = 16^{x+y}$,
$3^{x+2y} = 9^{2x+1}$
Solution:
$4^{3y-2} = 16^{x+y}$ ..................... (i)
$3^{x+2y} = 9^{2x+1}$ ..................... (ii)
Daga (i) mun samu,
$4^{3y-2} = (4^2)^{x+y}$
ko kuma, $4^{3y-2} = 4^{2x+2y}$
ko kuma, $3y - 2 = 2x + 2y$
$\therefore 2x - y + 2 = 0$ ..................... (iii)
Daga (ii) mun samu,
$3^{x+2y} = (3^2)^{2x+1}$
ko kuma, $3^{x+2y} = 3^{4x+2}$
ko kuma, $x + 2y = 4x + 2$
$\therefore 3x - 2y + 2 = 0$ ........................ (iv)
Ninka (iii) da 3 sannan kuma ninka (iv) da 2 sannan a cire
$6x - 3y + 6 = 0$
$6x - 4y + 4 = 0$
$-$ $\quad$ $+$ $\quad$ $-$
$\overline{\quad\quad y+2=0\quad\quad}$
$\therefore y = -2$
Saka darajojin y a (iv) mun samu,
$3x + 4 + 2 = 0$
ko kuma, $3x + 6 = 0$
ko kuma, $3x = -6$
$\therefore x = -2$
$\therefore$ Nema Maganin Shine $(x, y) = (-2, -2)$ (Ams.)

Question:
Warware:
    $2^{2x+1} \cdot 3^{2y+1} = 8$,
$2^{x+2} \cdot 2^{2y+2} = 16$
Solution:
$2^{2x+1} \cdot 3^{2y+1} = 8$ .....................(i)
$2^{x+2} \cdot 2^{2y+2} = 16$ .....................(ii)
Daga (i) muna samu,
$2^{2x+1} \cdot 2^{3y+1} = 8$
ko, $2^{2x+1+3y+1} = 2^3$
ko, $2^{2x+3y+2} = 2^3$
ko, $2x+3y+2 = 3$
$\therefore 2x+3y-1 = 0$ .....................(iii)
Daga (ii) muna samu,
$2^{x+2} \cdot 2^{2y+2} = 16$
ko, $2^{x+2+2y+2} = 2^4$
ko, $x+2y+4 = 4$
ko, $x+2y = 0$
$\therefore x = -2y$ .....................(iv)
Sanya ƙimar x a cikin lissafi (iii)
muna samu,
$-2y+3y-1 = 0$
$\therefore y=1$
Sanya $y=1$ a (iv) muna samu,
$\therefore x = -1$
$\therefore$ Bayanin da ake buƙata shine $(x,y) = (-1,1)$ (Amsar.)

Question: Nuna cewa, $\log_k \left(\frac{a^n}{b^n}\right) + \log_k \left(\frac{b^n}{c^n}\right) + \log_k \left(\frac{c^n}{a^n}\right) = 0$
Solution:
L.S.$= \log_k \left(\frac{a^n}{b^n}\right) + \log_k \left(\frac{b^n}{c^n}\right) + \log_k \left(\frac{c^n}{a^n}\right)$

$= \log_k \frac{a^n}{b^n} \cdot \frac{b^n}{c^n} \cdot \frac{c^n}{a^n}$

$= \log_k 1$

$= 0$

$= \text{R.S. (An Nuna)}$

Question: Nuna cewa, $\log_k(\text{ab})\log_k\left(\frac{a}{b}\right) + \log_k(\text{bc})\log_k\left(\frac{b}{c}\right) + \log_k(\text{ca})\log_k\left(\frac{c}{a}\right) = 0$
Solution:
L.S.$= \log_k(\text{ab})\log_k\left(\frac{a}{b}\right) + \log_k(\text{bc})\log_k\left(\frac{b}{c}\right) + \log_k(\text{ca})\log_k\left(\frac{c}{a}\right)$

$= (\log_k a + \log_k b) (\log_k a - \log_k b) + (\log_k b + \log_k c) (\log_k b - \log_k c) + (\log_k c + \log_k a) (\log_k c - \log_k a)$

$= (\log_k a)^2 - (\log_k b)^2 + (\log_k b)^2 - (\log_k c)^2 + (\log_k c)^2 - (\log_k a)^2$

$= 0$

$= \text{R.S.(An nuna)}$

Question: Nuna cewa, $\log_{\sqrt{a}} b \times \log_{\sqrt{b}} c \times \log_{\sqrt{c}} a = 8$
Solution:
L.S.$= \log_{\sqrt{a}} b \times \log_{\sqrt{b}} c \times \log_{\sqrt{c}} a$

$= \log_{\sqrt{a}} (\sqrt{b})^2 \times \log_{\sqrt{b}} (\sqrt{c})^2 \times \log_{\sqrt{c}} (\sqrt{a})^2$

$= 2\log_{\sqrt{a}} \sqrt{b} \times 2\log_{\sqrt{b}} \sqrt{c} \times 2\log_{\sqrt{c}} \sqrt{a}$

$[:: \log_a P^r = r \log_a P]$

$= 8\log_{\sqrt{a}} \sqrt{b} \times \log_{\sqrt{b}} \sqrt{c} \times \log_{\sqrt{c}} \sqrt{a}$

$= 8\log_{\sqrt{a}} \sqrt{b} \times \log_{\sqrt{b}} \sqrt{a}$

$[:: \log_a P = \log_a b \times \log_b P]$

$= 8\log_{\sqrt{a}} \sqrt{a}$ $[:: \log_a P = \log_a b \times \log_b P]$

$= 8 \cdot 1$

$[:: \log_a a = 1]$

$= 8$

$= \text{R.S.(An nuna)}$

Question: Nuna cewa, $\log_a \log_a \log_a (a^{a^b}) = b$
Solution:
L.S.$= \log_a \log_a \log_a (a^{a^b})$

$= \log_a \log_a a^b \log_a a \quad [:: \log_a P^r = r\log_a P]$

$= \log_a \log_a a^b \cdot 1 \quad [:: \log_a a = 1]$

$= \log_a a^b \log_a a$

$= \log_a a^b \quad [:: \log_a a = 1]$

$= b \log_a a = b \cdot 1 = b$

$= \text{R.S.(An Nuna)}$

Question: Idan $\frac{\log_k a}{b-c} = \frac{\log_k b}{c-a} = \frac{\log_k c}{a-b}$ to, nuna cewa, $a^b b^c c^a = 1$
Solution:
Bari, $\frac{\log_k a}{b-c} = \frac{\log_k b}{c-a} = \frac{\log_k c}{a-b} = m$

$\therefore \log_k a = m (b-c)$

ko kuma, $a \log_k a = ma(b-c)$ [ana ninka kowane bangare da a]

$\therefore \log_k a^a = m(ab - ac)$ .... (i)

Sake, $\log_k b = m (c-a)$

ko kuma, $b \log_k b = mb(c-a)$ [ana ninka kowane bangare da b]

$\therefore \log_k b^b = m(bc - ab)$ .... (ii)

kuma $\log_k c = m (a-b)$

ko kuma, $c \log_k c = mc(a-b)$ [ana ninka kowane bangare da c]

$\therefore \log_k c^c = m(ac - bc)$ .... (iii)

Yanzu, idan muka ƙara (i), (ii) da (iii) mun samu,

ko kuma, $\log_k a^a + \log_k b^b + \log_k c^c = m(ab - ca + bc - ab + ca - bc)$

ko kuma, $\log_k a^a b^b c^c = 0$

ko kuma, $\log_k a^a b^b c^c = \log_k 1$

$\therefore a^a b^b c^c = 1$ (An nuna)

Question: Idan $\frac{\log a}{y-z} = \frac{\log b}{z-x} = \frac{\log c}{x-y}$ to nuna cewa,$a^{y+z} b^{z+x} c^{x+y} = 1$
Solution:
Bari, $\frac{\log a}{y-z} = \frac{\log b}{z-x} = \frac{\log c}{x-y} = m$

sa'an nan, $\frac{\log a}{y-z} = m$

ko kuma, $\log a = m (y-z)$

ko kuma, $(y+z) \log a = m (y-z)(y+z)$

[yin ninkin bangarori biyu da $(y+z)$]

$\therefore \log a^{y+z} = m(y^2-z^2)$ ........... (i)

Sake, $\frac{\log b}{z-x} = m$

ko kuma, $\log b = m (z-x)$

ko kuma, $(z+x) \log b = m (z+x) (z-x)$

[yin ninkin bangarori biyu da $(z+x)$]

$\therefore \log b^{z+x} = m(z^2-x^2)$ ........... (ii)

da kuma $\frac{\log c}{x-y} = m$

ko kuma, $\log c = m (x-y)$

ko kuma, $(x+y) \log c = m (x+y) (x-y)$

[yin ninkin bangarori biyu da $(x+y)$]

$\therefore \log c^{x+y} = m(x^2-y^2)$ ........... (iii)

Yanzu, ta hanyar ƙara (i), (ii) da (iii) muna samu,

$\therefore \log a^{y+z} + \log b^{z+x} + \log c^{x+y}$

$= m(y^2-z^2+z^2-x^2+x^2-y^2)$

ko kuma, $\log (a^{y+z} b^{z+x} c^{x+y}) = 0 = \log 1$

$\therefore a^{y+z} b^{z+x} c^{x+y} = 1$ (An nuna)

Question: Idan $\frac{\log a}{y-z} = \frac{\log b}{z-x} = \frac{\log c}{x-y}$ to, nuna cewa $a^{y^2+yz+z^2} . b^{z^2+zx+x^2} . c^{x^2+xy+y^2} = 1$
Solution:
Bari, $\frac{\log_k a}{y-z} = \frac{\log_k b}{z-x} = \frac{\log_k c}{x-y} = m$
$\therefore \log_k a = m (y-z)$

ko, $(y^2+yz+z^2) \log_k a = m(y-z)(y^2+yz+z^2)$
$\therefore \log_k a^{y^2+yz+z^2} = m(y^3-z^3)$ ........... (i)
A sake ganin, $\log_k b = m (z-x)$
ko, $(z^2+zx+x^2) \log_k b = m (z-x)(z^2+zx+x^2)$
$\therefore \log_k b^{z^2+zx+x^2} = m(z^3-x^3)$ ........... (ii)
kuma $\log_k c = m (x-y)$
ko, $(x^2+xy+y^2) \log_k c = m(x-y)(x^2+xy+y^2)$
$\therefore \log_k c^{x^2+xy+y^2} = m(x^3-y^3)$ ........... (iii)
Yanzu, idan muka ƙara (i), (ii) da (iii) muna samu,
$\therefore \log_k a^{y^2+yz+z^2} + \log_k b^{z^2+zx+x^2} + \log_k c^{x^2+xy+y^2}$
$= m(y^3-z^3) + m(z^3-x^3) + m(x^3-y^3)$
ko, $\log_k a^{y^2+yz+z^2} b^{z^2+zx+x^2} c^{x^2+xy+y^2} =$
$m(y^3-z^3+z^3-x^3+x^3-y^3)$ [$\because \log_k P^r = r \log_k P$]
ko, $\log_k a^{y^2+yz+z^2} b^{z^2+zx+x^2} c^{x^2+xy+y^2} = 0 = \log_k 1$
$\therefore a^{y^2+yz+z^2} b^{z^2+zx+x^2} c^{x^2+xy+y^2} = 1$ (An nuna)

Question: Idan $\frac{\log_k(1+x)}{\log_k x} = 2$ to, nuna cewa, $x = \frac{1+\sqrt{5}}{2}$
Solution:
An bayar, $\frac{\log_k (1+x)}{\log_k x} = 2$

ko, $\log_k (1+x) = 2 \log_k x$
ko, $\log_k (1+x) = \log_k x^2$ [$\log_a P^r = r \log_a P$]
ko, $1+x = x^2$ [Taking anti-log]
ko, $x^2-x-1 = 0$
ko, $4x^2-4x-4 = 0$ [sa'ad da muka ninka dukkan bangarori biyu da 4]
ko, $(2x)^2 - 2.2x.1 + 1^2 - 5 = 0$
ko, $(2x-1)^2 = 5$
ko, $2x-1 = \sqrt{5}$ [an watsi da darajar mara kyau]
ko, $2x = 1+\sqrt{5}$
ko, $x = \frac{\sqrt{5}+1}{2}$

$\therefore x = \frac{1+\sqrt{5}}{2}$ (An nuna)

Question: Nuna cewa, $\log_k \frac{x-\sqrt{x^2-1}}{x+\sqrt{x^2-1}} = 2\log_k(x-\sqrt{x^2-1})$
Solution:
L.S. = $\log_k \frac{x-\sqrt{x^2-1}}{x+\sqrt{x^2-1}}$

$= \log_k \frac{(x-\sqrt{x^2-1})^2}{(x+\sqrt{x^2-1})(x-\sqrt{x^2-1})}$

[ta hanyar ninkawa maɗaukakin ƙididdiga da kuma ƙafar ƙididdiga na ɓangaren da ke cikin dagiya da $(x-\sqrt{x^2-1})$]

$= \log_k \frac{(x-\sqrt{x^2-1})^2}{x^2-(\sqrt{x^2-1})^2} = \log_k \frac{(x-\sqrt{x^2-1})^2}{x^2-x^2+1}$

$= \log_k (x-\sqrt{x^2-1})^2$

$= 2\log_k(x-\sqrt{x^2-1})$ [$\because \log_a P^r = r \log_a P$]

$\therefore \log_k \frac{x-\sqrt{x^2-1}}{x+\sqrt{x^2-1}} = 2\log_k(x-\sqrt{x^2-1})$ (An nuna)

Question:
Idan $a^{3-x} b^{5x} = a^{5+x} b^{3x}$ to, nuna cewa,
$x \log_k \left(\frac{b}{a}\right) = \log_k a$
Solution:
An bayar, $a^{3-x} b^{5x} = a^{5+x} b^{3x}$
ko kuma, $\frac{b^{5x}}{b^{3x}} = \frac{a^{5+x}}{a^{3-x}}$ [raba duka bangarori da $a^{3-x} b^{3x}$]

ko kuma, $b^{5x-3x} = a^{5+x-3+x}$
ko kuma, $b^{2x} = a^{2+2x}$
ko kuma, $b^{2x} = a^2 \cdot a^{2x}$
ko kuma, $\frac{b^{2x}}{a^{2x}} = a^2$ [raba duka bangarori da $a^{2x}$]

ko kuma, $\log_k \frac{b^{2x}}{a^{2x}} = \log_k a^2$ [daukar $\log_k$ a duka bangarori]

ko kuma, $\log_k \left(\frac{b}{a}\right)^{2x} = \log_k a^2$

ko kuma, $2x \log_k \left(\frac{b}{a}\right) = 2 \log_k a$

$\therefore x \log_k \left(\frac{b}{a}\right) = \log_k a$ (An nuna)

Question:
Idan $xy^{a-1}=p$, $xy^{b-1}=q$, $xy^{c-1}=r$ ne, nuna cewa:
$(b-c) \log_k p + (c-a) \log_k q + (a-b) \log_k r = 0$
Solution:
L.S. = $(b-c) \log_k p + (c-a) \log_k q + (a-b) \log_k r$
$= \log_k p^{b-c} + \log_k q^{c-a} + \log_k r^{a-b}$
$= \log_k (xy^{a-1})^{b-c} + \log_k (xy^{b-1})^{c-a} + \log_k (xy^{c-1})^{a-b}$
$= \log_k x^{b-c} + \log_k y^{ab-ac-b+c} + \log_k x^{c-a} + \log_k y^{bc-ab-c+a} + \log_k x^{a-b} + \log_k y^{ac-bc-a+b}$
$= \log_k x^{b-c} + \log_k x^{c-a} + \log_k x^{a-b} + \log_k y^{ab-ac-b+c} + \log_k y^{bc-ab-c+a} + \log_k y^{ac-bc-a+b}$
$= \log_k (x^{b-c} \cdot x^{c-a} \cdot x^{a-b}) + \log_k (y^{ab-ac-b+c} \cdot y^{bc-ab-c+a} \cdot y^{ac-bc-a+b})$
$= \log_k x^{b-c+c-a+a-b} + \log_k y^{ab-ac-b+c+bc-ab-c+a+ac-bc-a+b}$
$= \log_k x^0 + \log_k y^0 = \log_k 1 + \log_k 1 = 0+0 = 0$
= R.S. (An Nuna)

Question: Idan $\frac{ab \log_k (ab)}{a+b} = \frac{bc \log_k (bc)}{b+c} = \frac{ca \log_k (ca)}{c+a}$ to, nuna cewa $a^a = b^b = c^c$
Solution:
Bari muce, $\frac{ab \log_k (ab)}{a+b} = \frac{bc \log_k (bc)}{b+c} = \frac{ca \log_k (ca)}{c+a} = m$

$\therefore \log_k (ab) = \frac{m(a+b)}{ab}$ ......... (i)
Kara, $\log_k (bc) = \frac{m(b+c)}{bc}$ ......... (ii)
da kuma $\log_k (ca) = \frac{m(c+a)}{ca}$ ......... (iii)
Yanzu, idan muka tara (i), (ii) da (iii) zamu samu,
$\log_k (ab) + \log_k (bc) + \log_k (ca) = \frac{m(a+b)}{ab} + \frac{m(b+c)}{bc} + \frac{m(c+a)}{ca}$
ko kuma, $\log_k (ab \cdot bc \cdot ca) = m \left[\frac{1}{a}+\frac{1}{b}+\frac{1}{c}+\frac{1}{a}\right]$
ko kuma, $\log_k (abc)^2 = 2m \left[\frac{1}{a}+\frac{1}{b}+\frac{1}{c}\right]$
ko kuma, $2 \log_k (abc) = 2m \left[\frac{1}{a}+\frac{1}{b}+\frac{1}{c}\right]$

$\therefore \log_k (abc) = m \left[\frac{1}{a}+\frac{1}{b}+\frac{1}{c}\right]$ ......... (iv)

Idan muka cire (i) daga (iv), zamu samu,
$\log_k (abc) - \log_k (ab) = m \left[\frac{1}{a}+\frac{1}{b}+\frac{1}{c}\right] - \frac{m(a+b)}{ab}$
$= m \left[\frac{1}{a}+\frac{1}{b}+\frac{1}{c} - \frac{1}{a} - \frac{1}{b}\right]$

ko kuma, $\log_k \frac{abc}{ab} = \frac{m}{c}$
ko kuma, $c \log_k c = m$
ko kuma, $\log_k c^c = m$
$\therefore c^c = k^m$ ......... (v)

Kara, idan muka cire (ii) daga (iv) zamu samu,
$\log_k (abc) - \log_k (bc) = m \left[\frac{1}{a}+\frac{1}{b}+\frac{1}{c}\right] - \frac{m(b+c)}{bc}$
ko kuma, $\log_k \frac{abc}{bc} = m \left[\frac{1}{a}+\frac{1}{b}+\frac{1}{c}-\frac{1}{b}-\frac{1}{c}\right]$
ko kuma, $\log_k a = \frac{m}{a}$
ko kuma, $a \log_k a = m$
ko kuma, $\log_k a^a = m$
$\therefore a^a = k^m$ ......... (vi)

Kara, idan muka cire (iii) daga (iv) zamu samu,
$\log_k (abc) - \log_k (ca) = m \left[\frac{1}{a}+\frac{1}{b}+\frac{1}{c}\right] - \frac{m(c+a)}{ca}$
ko kuma, $\log_k \frac{abc}{ca} = m \left[\frac{1}{a}+\frac{1}{b}+\frac{1}{c}-\frac{1}{c}-\frac{1}{a}\right]$
ko kuma, $\log_k b = \frac{m}{b}$
ko kuma, $b \log_k b = m$
ko kuma, $\log_k b^b = m$
$\therefore b^b = k^m$ ......... (vii)
Don haka daga (v), (vi) da (vii) zamu iya rubutawa,
$a^a = b^b = c^c = k^m$
$\therefore a^a = b^b = c^c$ (An nuna)

Question: Idan $\frac{x(y+z-x)}{\log_k x} = \frac{y(z+x-y)}{\log_k y} = \frac{z(x+y-z)}{\log_k z}$ to, nuna cewa $x^x y^y = y^y z^z = z^z x^x$
Solution:
Bari, $\frac{x(y+z-x)}{\log_k x} = \frac{y(z+x-y)}{\log_k y} = \frac{z(x+y-z)}{\log_k z} = m$

$\therefore \log_k x = \frac{x(y+z-x)}{m}$

Hakazalika, $\log_k y = \frac{y(z+x-y)}{m}$

kuma $\log_k z = \frac{z(x+y-z)}{m}$

Yanzu, $y \log_k x + x \log_k y = \frac{xy(y+z-x)}{m} + \frac{xy(z+x-y)}{m}$

$= \frac{xy}{m} (y+z-x+z+x-y) = \frac{2xyz}{m}$

ko kuma, $\log_k x^y + \log_k y^x = \frac{2xyz}{m}$

ko kuma, $\log_k x^y y^x = \frac{2xyz}{m}$

$\therefore x^y y^x = k^{\frac{2xyz}{m}}$ ......... (i)

Sake, $z \log_k y + y \log_k z = \frac{yz(z+x-y)}{m} + \frac{yz(x+y-z)}{m}$

ko kuma, $\log_k y^z + \log_k z^y = \frac{yz}{m} (z+x-y+x+y-z)$

ko kuma, $\log_k y^z z^y = \frac{2xyz}{m}$

$\therefore y^z z^y = k^{\frac{2xyz}{m}}$ ......... (ii)

Sake, $x \log_k z + z \log_k x = \frac{zx(x+y-z)}{m} + \frac{zx(y+z-x)}{m}$

ko kuma, $\log_k z^x + \log_k x^z = \frac{zx}{m} (x+y-z+y+z-x)$

ko kuma, $\log_k z^x x^z = \frac{2xyz}{m}$

$\therefore z^x x^z = k^{\frac{2xyz}{m}}$ ......... (iii)

Don haka daga (i), (ii) da kuma (iii) muna samun,
$x^y y^x = y^z z^y = z^x x^z$ (An Nuna)
Exact Answer: x^y y^x = y^z z^y = z^x x^z

Question: Rubuta **ma'auni** na juyawa a kowace yanayi: $y=1-2^x$
Solution:
Bari, $y=f(x)=1-2^x$
Yanzu, $y=1-2^x$
ko kuma, $2^x=1-y$
ko kuma, $1-y=2^x$
ko kuma, $\log_2(1-y)=x$
$\therefore x=\log_2(1-y)$
Sabin aiki, $f^{-1}: y \to x$
Inda, $x=\log_2(1-y)$
ko kuma, $f^{-1}: y \to \log_2(1-y)$ (Ams.)

Question: Rubuta aikin akasin kowane hali: $y = \log_{10} x$
Solution:
Bari mu yi tunanin cewa, $y = f(x) = \log_{10} x$
Yanzu, $y = \log_{10} x$
$\therefore x = 10^y$ (Amsa.)
Siffar akasin abin da ya gabata (Inverse function), $f^{-1}: y \to x$ inda, $x = 10^y$
ko kuma, $f^{-1}: y \to 10^y$
Sa'ad da muka maye gurbin $y$ da $x$ muna samu,
$f^{-1}: x \to 10^x$
$\therefore f^{-1}(x) = 10^x$

Question: Rubuta aikin juyawa a kowacce harka $y=x^2, x > 0$
Solution:
Bari, $y=f(x)=x^2, x > 0$
Yanzu, $y=x^2$
$\therefore x = \pm \sqrt{y}$ (Amsa.)
amma $x = \sqrt{y}$ [$\because x > 0$]
Sassauka aikin, $f^{-1}: y \to x$ inda $x=\sqrt{y}$
ko, $f^{-1}: y \to \sqrt{y}$
Ta hanyar maye gurbin $y$ da $x$ muna samun,
$f^{-1}: x \to \sqrt{x}$
$\therefore f^{-1}(x) = \sqrt{x}$

Question: Kayyade wa $f(x) = \ln(x-2)$ yankin sa $D_f$ da kuma iyakar sa $R_f$.
Solution:
An bayar, $f(x) = \ln(x-2)$
Don cewa logarithm yana da ma'ana ne kawai ga lambobi na gaskiya masu kyau,
$\therefore x-2>0$
$\therefore x>2$
$\therefore$ Yankin da aiki ke da ma'ana (Domain), $D_f = \{x:x>2\} = (2, \infty)$
Sashin da aiki ke samarwa (Range): $y = \ln(x-2)$ [$\because y=f(x)$]
$\Rightarrow e^y = x-2$
$\therefore x = e^y + 2$
A nan, $x$ yana da ma'ana ga dukkanin dabi'u na gaskiya na $y$
$\therefore$ Sashin da aiki mai bada ya samarwa (Range), $R_f=R$
Amsa: Yankin da aiki ke da ma'ana $D_f = (2, \infty)$ kuma Sashin da aiki ke samarwa $R_f = R$.

Question: Tantance yankin da kuma kewayon aikin $f(x) = \ln \frac{1-x}{1+x}$.
